verses.textZh: 大卫的儿子所罗门巩固了他对以色列的统治，耶和华他的神也和他同在，使他十分尊大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的儿子所罗门巩固了他对以色列的统治，耶和华他的神也和他同在，使他十分尊大。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的儿子所罗门国位坚固；耶和华－他的神与他同在，使他甚为尊大。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom, for the Lord his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon the son of David established himself in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him and exalted him exceedingly.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon son of David took firm control of his kingdom, for the Lord his God was with him and made him very powerful.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon the son of David established himself securely over his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him and exalted him greatly.
verses.textEn: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom, for the Lord his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.

verses.textZh: 所罗门召唤全体以色列人、千夫长、百夫长、审判官、以色列的各领袖和众家族的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门召唤全体以色列人、千夫长、百夫长、审判官、以色列的各领袖和众家族的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门吩咐以色列众人，就是千夫长、百夫长、审判官、首领与族长都来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel—to the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, to the judges and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of families—
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to all the leaders in all Israel, the heads of fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every leader in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon called together all the leaders of Israel—the generals and captains of the army, the judges, and all the political and clan leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands, of hundreds, and to the judges and to every leader in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel—to the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, to the judges and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of families—

verses.textZh: 所罗门和全体会众一同到基遍的高地去，因为那里有神的会幕，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在旷野所做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门和全体会众一同到基遍的高地去，因为那里有神的会幕，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在旷野所做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门和会众都往基遍的邱坛去，因那里有神的会幕，就是耶和华仆人摩西在旷野所制造的。
verses.textEnNiv: and Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, for God’s tent of meeting was there, which Moses the Lord ’s servant had made in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon, for the tent of meeting of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness, was there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for the tabernacle of meeting with God was there, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he led the entire assembly to the place of worship in Gibeon, for God’s Tabernacle was located there. (This was the Tabernacle that Moses, the Lord ’s servant, had made in the wilderness.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon and all the assembly with him went to the high place which was at Gibeon, because God’s tent of meeting was there which Moses, the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: and Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, for God’s tent of meeting was there, which Moses the Lord ’s servant had made in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 至于神的约柜，大卫已经从基列．耶琳抬到他预备好的地方，因为他曾在耶路撒冷为约柜盖搭了一个帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于神的约柜，大卫已经从基列．耶琳抬到他预备好的地方，因为他曾在耶路撒冷为约柜盖搭了一个帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是神的约柜，大卫已经从基列‧耶琳搬到他所预备的地方，因他曾在耶路撒冷为约柜支搭了帐幕，
verses.textEnNiv: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: (But David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place that David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.)
verses.textEnNkjv: But David had brought up the ark of God from Kirjath Jearim to theplace David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: David had already moved the Ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the tent he had prepared for it in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: However, David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place he had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列所做的铜祭坛也在那里，在耶和华的会幕前面；所罗门和会众同去求问耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列所做的铜祭坛也在那里，在耶和华的会幕前面；所罗门和会众同去求问耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列所造的铜坛也在基遍耶和华的会幕前。所罗门和会众都就近坛前。
verses.textEnNiv: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was in Gibeon in front of the tabernacle of the Lord ; so Solomon and the assembly inquired of him there.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, had made, was there before the tabernacle of the Lord . And Solomon and the assembly sought it out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord; Solomon and the assembly sought Him there.
verses.textEnNlt: But the bronze altar made by Bezalel son of Uri and grandson of Hur was there at Gibeon in front of the Tabernacle of the Lord . So Solomon and the people gathered in front of it to consult the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now the bronze altar which Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the tabernacle of the Lord, and Solomon and the assembly sought it out.
verses.textEn: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was in Gibeon in front of the tabernacle of the Lord ; so Solomon and the assembly inquired of him there.

verses.textZh: 所罗门上到耶和华会幕前面的铜祭坛旁边，在坛上献上了一千只燔祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门上到耶和华会幕前面的铜祭坛旁边，在坛上献上了一千只燔祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门上到耶和华面前会幕的铜坛那里，献一千牺牲为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the Lord in the tent of meeting and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the Lord , which was at the tent of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the Lord, which was at the tabernacle of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.
verses.textEnNlt: There in front of the Tabernacle, Solomon went up to the bronze altar in the Lord ’s presence and sacrificed 1,000 burnt offerings on it.
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon went up there before the Lord to the bronze altar which was at the tent of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.
verses.textEn: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the Lord in the tent of meeting and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

verses.textZh: 那一夜，神向所罗门显现，对他说："你无论求甚么，我必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一夜，神向所罗门显现，对他说："你无论求甚么，我必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，神向所罗门显现，对他说：「你愿我赐你什么，你可以求。」
verses.textEnNiv: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."
verses.textEnEsv: In that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, "Ask what I shall give you."
verses.textEnNkjv: On that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, "Ask! What shall I give you?"
verses.textEnNlt: That night God appeared to Solomon and said, "What do you want? Ask, and I will give it to you!"
verses.textEnNasb: In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask what I shall give you."
verses.textEn: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."

verses.textZh: 所罗门对神说："你曾经向我的父亲大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门对神说："你曾经向我的父亲大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门对神说：「你曾向我父大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon answered God, "You have shown great kindness to David my father and have made me king in his place.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon said to God, "You have shown great and steadfast love to David my father, and have made me king in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon said to God: "You have shown great mercy to David my father, and have made me king in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon replied to God, "You showed great and faithful love to David, my father, and now you have made me king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon said to God, "You have dealt with my father David with great faithfulness, and have made me king in his place.
verses.textEn: Solomon answered God, "You have shown great kindness to David my father and have made me king in his place.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神啊，现在求你实现你向我的父亲大卫应许的话；因为你立了我作王统治这好象地上的尘土那么多的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神啊，现在求你实现你向我的父亲大卫应许的话；因为你立了我作王统治这好象地上的尘土那么多的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神啊，现在求你成就向我父大卫所应许的话；因你立我作这民的王，他们如同地上尘沙那样多。
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Lord God, let your promise to my father David be confirmed, for you have made me king over a people who are as numerous as the dust of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord God, let your word to David my father be now fulfilled, for you have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, O Lord God, let Your promise to David my father be established, for You have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord God, please continue to keep your promise to David my father, for you have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Now, Lord God, Your promise to my father David is fulfilled, for You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.
verses.textEn: Now, Lord God, let your promise to my father David be confirmed, for you have made me king over a people who are as numerous as the dust of the earth.

verses.textZh: 现在求你赐我智慧和知识，使我可以领导这人民；否则，谁能治理你这众多的人民呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你赐我智慧和知识，使我可以领导这人民；否则，谁能治理你这众多的人民呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你赐我智慧聪明，我好在这民前出入；不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may lead this people, for who is able to govern this great people of yours?"
verses.textEnEsv: Give me now wisdom and knowledge to go out and come in before this people, for who can govern this people of yours, which is so great?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of Yours?"
verses.textEnNlt: Give me the wisdom and knowledge to lead them properly, for who could possibly govern this great people of yours?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may go out and come in before this people, for who can rule this great people of Yours?"
verses.textEn: Give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may lead this people, for who is able to govern this great people of yours?"

verses.textZh: 神对所罗门说："你既然有这个心意：不求富足、财产、尊荣，也不求你敌人的性命，又不求长寿，只为自己求智慧和知识，好治理我的子民，就是我立你作王统治的人民，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对所罗门说："你既然有这个心意：不求富足、财产、尊荣，也不求你敌人的性命，又不求长寿，只为自己求智慧和知识，好治理我的子民，就是我立你作王统治的人民，
verses.textZhCuv: 神对所罗门说：「我已立你作我民的王。你既有这心意，并不求资财、丰富、尊荣，也不求灭绝那恨你之人的性命，又不求大寿数，只求智慧聪明好判断我的民；
verses.textEnNiv: God said to Solomon, "Since this is your heart’s desire and you have not asked for wealth, possessions or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,
verses.textEnEsv: God answered Solomon, "Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked for possessions, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, and have not even asked for long life, but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself that you may govern my people over whom I have made you king,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said to Solomon: "Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches or wealth or honor or the life of your enemies, nor have you asked long life—but have asked wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge My people over whom I have made you king—
verses.textEnNlt: God said to Solomon, "Because your greatest desire is to help your people, and you did not ask for wealth, riches, fame, or even the death of your enemies or a long life, but rather you asked for wisdom and knowledge to properly govern my people—
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said to Solomon, "Because this was in your heart, and you did not ask for riches, wealth, or honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor did you even ask for long life, but you asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge so that you may rule My people over whom I have made you king,
verses.textEn: God said to Solomon, "Since this is your heart’s desire and you have not asked for wealth, possessions or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,

verses.textZh: 因此，智慧和知识必赐给你，我也把富足、财产和尊荣赐给你；在你以前的列王从没有这样，在你以后的也必没有这样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，智慧和知识必赐给你，我也把富足、财产和尊荣赐给你；在你以前的列王从没有这样，在你以后的也必没有这样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必赐你智慧聪明，也必赐你资财、丰富、尊荣。在你以前的列王都没有这样，在你以后也必没有这样的。」
verses.textEnNiv: therefore wisdom and knowledge will be given you. And I will also give you wealth, possessions and honor, such as no king who was before you ever had and none after you will have."
verses.textEnEsv: wisdom and knowledge are granted to you. I will also give you riches, possessions, and honor, such as none of the kings had who were before you, and none after you shall have the like."
verses.textEnNkjv: wisdom and knowledge are granted to you; and I will give you riches and wealth and honor, such as none of the kings have had who were before you, nor shall any after you have the like."
verses.textEnNlt: I will certainly give you the wisdom and knowledge you requested. But I will also give you wealth, riches, and fame such as no other king has had before you or will ever have in the future!"
verses.textEnNasb: wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you. I will also give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings who were before you has possessed, nor will those who will come after you."
verses.textEn: therefore wisdom and knowledge will be given you. And I will also give you wealth, possessions and honor, such as no king who was before you ever had and none after you will have."

verses.textZh: 于是，所罗门从基遍高地的会幕 回到耶路撒冷，统治以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，所罗门从基遍高地的会幕 回到耶路撒冷，统治以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，所罗门从基遍邱坛会幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting. And he reigned over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon came from the high place at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting, to Jerusalem. And he reigned over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon came to Jerusalem from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the tabernacle of meeting, and reigned over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon returned to Jerusalem from the Tabernacle at the place of worship in Gibeon, and he reigned over Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon went from the high place which was at Gibeon, from the tent of meeting, to Jerusalem, and he reigned over Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting. And he reigned over Israel.

verses.textZh: 所罗门召集了战车和马兵：他有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名；他把这些车马安置在囤车城，或在耶路撒冷，和王在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门召集了战车和马兵：他有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名；他把这些车马安置在囤车城，或在耶路撒冷，和王在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon built up a huge force of chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses. He stationed some of them in the chariot cities and some near him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon amassed chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 王在耶路撒冷积存的金银好象石头那么多，积存的香柏木好象平原的桑树那么多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王在耶路撒冷积存的金银好象石头那么多，积存的香柏木好象平原的桑树那么多。
verses.textZhCuv: 王在耶路撒冷使金银多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
verses.textEnNiv: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stone, and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars as abundant as the sycamores which are in the lowland.
verses.textEnNlt: The king made silver and gold as plentiful in Jerusalem as stone. And valuable cedar timber was as common as the sycamore-fig trees that grow in the foothills of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The king made silver and gold as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars as plentiful as sycamores in the lowland.
verses.textEn: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

verses.textZh: 所罗门拥有的马，都是从埃及和古厄运来的，是王的商人从古厄照价买来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门拥有的马，都是从埃及和古厄运来的，是王的商人从古厄照价买来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon’s import of horses was from Egypt and Kue, and the king’s traders would buy them from Kue for a price.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon had horses imported from Egypt and Keveh; the king’s merchants bought them in Keveh at the current price.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Cilicia ; the king’s traders acquired them from Cilicia at the standard price.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue; the king’s traders acquired them from Kue for a price.
verses.textEn: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.

verses.textZh: 他们从埃及运上来的车，每辆价银六千八百四十克；马每匹一千七百一十克。赫人众王和亚兰众王的车马，也都是这样经这些商人的手买来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从埃及运上来的车，每辆价银六千八百四十克；马每匹一千七百一十克。赫人众王和亚兰众王的车马，也都是这样经这些商人的手买来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百舍客勒，马每匹一百五十 舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。
verses.textEnNiv: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.
verses.textEnEsv: They imported a chariot from Egypt for 600 shekels of silver, and a horse for 150. Likewise through them these were exported to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also acquired and imported from Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred and fifty; thus, through their agents, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time chariots from Egypt could be purchased for 600 pieces of silver, and horses for 150 pieces of silver. They were then exported to the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: They imported chariots from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver apiece, horses for 150 apiece, and by the same means they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
verses.textEn: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.

verses.textZh: 所罗门决意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己建造王宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门决意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己建造王宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门定意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the Name of the Lord and a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Solomon purposed to build a temple for the name of the Lord , and a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon determined to build a temple for the name of the Lord, and a royal house for himself.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon decided to build a Temple to honor the name of the Lord , and also a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the name of the Lord, and a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEn: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the Name of the Lord and a royal palace for himself.

verses.textZh: 于是，所罗门选派了七万人作挑夫，八万人在山上凿石，三千六百人作督工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，所罗门选派了七万人作挑夫，八万人在山上凿石，三千六百人作督工。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门就挑选七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的，三千六百督工的。
verses.textEnNiv: He conscripted 70,000 men as carriers and 80,000 as stonecutters in the hills and 3,600 as foremen over them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon assigned 70,000 men to bear burdens and 80,000 to quarry in the hill country, and 3,600 to oversee them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon selected seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand to quarry stone in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.
verses.textEnNlt: He enlisted a force of 70,000 laborers, 80,000 men to quarry stone in the hill country, and 3,600 foremen.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon assigned seventy thousand men to carry loads, eighty thousand men to quarry stone in the mountains, and 3,600 to supervise them.
verses.textEn: He conscripted 70,000 men as carriers and 80,000 as stonecutters in the hills and 3,600 as foremen over them.

verses.textZh: 所罗门派人去见推罗王希兰说："你怎样待我的父亲大卫，给他运来香柏木，为他建造宫殿居住，请你也这样待我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门派人去见推罗王希兰说："你怎样待我的父亲大卫，给他运来香柏木，为他建造宫殿居住，请你也这样待我。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门差人去见泰尔王希兰，说：「你曾运香柏木与我父大卫建宫居住，求你也这样待我。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon sent this message to Hiram king of Tyre: "Send me cedar logs as you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon sent word to Hiram the king of Tyre: "As you dealt with David my father and sent him cedar to build himself a house to dwell in, so deal with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon sent to Hiram king of Tyre, saying: As you have dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build himself a house to dwell in, sodealwithme.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also sent this message to King Hiram at Tyre: "Send me cedar logs as you did for my father, David, when he was building his palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon sent word to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, "As you dealt with my father David and sent him cedars to build him a house to live in, do it for me.
verses.textEn: Solomon sent this message to Hiram king of Tyre: "Send me cedar logs as you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in.

verses.textZh: 现在我要为耶和华我神的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧芬芳的香，经常摆上陈设饼，每日早晚、安息日、初一，以及耶和华我们的神所定的节日，都献上燔祭；这是以色列人永远的定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我要为耶和华我神的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧芬芳的香，经常摆上陈设饼，每日早晚、安息日、初一，以及耶和华我们的神所定的节日，都献上燔祭；这是以色列人永远的定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要为耶和华－我神的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧美香，常摆陈设饼，每早晚、安息日、月朔，并耶和华－我们神所定的节期献燔祭。这是以色列人永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I am about to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God and to dedicate it to him for burning fragrant incense before him, for setting out the consecrated bread regularly, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening and on the Sabbaths, at the New Moons and at the appointed festivals of the Lord our God. This is a lasting ordinance for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the Lord my God and dedicate it to him for the burning of incense of sweet spices before him, and for the regular arrangement of the showbread, and for burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths and the new moons and the appointed feasts of the Lord our God, as ordained forever for Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I am building a temple for the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to Him, to burn before Him sweet incense, for the continual showbread, for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the New Moons, and on the set feasts of the Lord our God. This isanordinance forever to Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: I am about to build a Temple to honor the name of the Lord my God. It will be a place set apart to burn fragrant incense before him, to display the special sacrificial bread, and to sacrifice burnt offerings each morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, at new moon celebrations, and at the other appointed festivals of the Lord our God. He has commanded Israel to do these things forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the Lord my God, dedicating it to Him, to burn fragrant incense before Him and to set out the showbread continually, and to offer burnt offerings morning and evening, on Sabbaths, on new moons, and on the appointed feasts of the Lord our God. This is to be done in Israel forever.
verses.textEn: Now I am about to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God and to dedicate it to him for burning fragrant incense before him, for setting out the consecrated bread regularly, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening and on the Sabbaths, at the New Moons and at the appointed festivals of the Lord our God. This is a lasting ordinance for Israel.

verses.textZh: 我要建造的殿宇必须宏伟，因为我们的神伟大，超过众神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要建造的殿宇必须宏伟，因为我们的神伟大，超过众神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因为我们的神至大，超乎诸神。
verses.textEnNiv: "The temple I am going to build will be great, because our God is greater than all other gods.
verses.textEnEsv: The house that I am to build will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the temple which I build willbe great, for our God is greater than all gods.
verses.textEnNlt: "This must be a magnificent Temple because our God is greater than all other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: The house which I am about to build will be great, for our God is greater than all the gods.
verses.textEn: "The temple I am going to build will be great, because our God is greater than all other gods.

verses.textZh: 但谁能为他建造殿宇呢？天和天上的天也容不下他；我是谁，怎能为他建造殿宇？我不过在他面前烧香罢了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但谁能为他建造殿宇呢？天和天上的天也容不下他；我是谁，怎能为他建造殿宇？我不过在他面前烧香罢了。
verses.textZhCuv: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，谁能为他建造殿宇呢？我是谁？能为他建造殿宇吗？不过在他面前烧香而已。
verses.textEnNiv: But who is able to build a temple for him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain him? Who then am I to build a temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before him?
verses.textEnEsv: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven, even highest heaven, cannot contain him? Who am I to build a house for him, except as a place to make offerings before him?
verses.textEnNkjv: But who is able to build Him a temple, since heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Him? Who am I then, that I should build Him a temple, except to burn sacrifice before Him?
verses.textEnNlt: But who can really build him a worthy home? Not even the highest heavens can contain him! So who am I to consider building a Temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices to him?
verses.textEnNasb: But who is able to build a house for Him, since the heavens and the highest heavens cannot contain Him? And who am I, that I should build a house for Him, except to burn incense before Him?
verses.textEn: But who is able to build a temple for him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain him? Who then am I to build a temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before him?

verses.textZh: 现在请你派一个巧匠到我这里来，他要精于使用金、银、铜、铁和紫色朱红色蓝色线工作，并且懂得雕刻，好与我的父亲大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷预备的巧匠一同工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你派一个巧匠到我这里来，他要精于使用金、银、铜、铁和紫色朱红色蓝色线工作，并且懂得雕刻，好与我的父亲大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷预备的巧匠一同工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求你差一个巧匠来，就是善用金、银、铜、铁，和紫色、朱红色、蓝色线，并精于雕刻之工的巧匠，与我父大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷所预备的巧匠一同做工；
verses.textEnNiv: "Send me, therefore, a man skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, and in purple, crimson and blue yarn, and experienced in the art of engraving, to work in Judah and Jerusalem with my skilled workers, whom my father David provided.
verses.textEnEsv: So now send me a man skilled to work in gold, silver, bronze, and iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue fabrics, trained also in engraving, to be with the skilled workers who are with me in Judah and Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore send me at once a man skillful to work in gold and silver, in bronze and iron, in purple and crimson and blue, who has skill to engrave with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
verses.textEnNlt: "So send me a master craftsman who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as with purple, scarlet, and blue cloth. He must be a skilled engraver who can work with the craftsmen of Judah and Jerusalem who were selected by my father, David.
verses.textEnNasb: Now send me a skilled man to work in gold, silver, brass, iron, and in purple, crimson, and violet fabrics, one who knows how to make engravings, to work with the skilled workers whom I have in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided.
verses.textEn: "Send me, therefore, a man skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, and in purple, crimson and blue yarn, and experienced in the art of engraving, to work in Judah and Jerusalem with my skilled workers, whom my father David provided.

verses.textZh: 又请你从黎巴嫩运送香柏木、松木和檀香木到我这里来，因为我知道你的臣仆善于砍伐黎巴嫩的树木；我的臣仆可以和你的臣仆一同工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又请你从黎巴嫩运送香柏木、松木和檀香木到我这里来，因为我知道你的臣仆善于砍伐黎巴嫩的树木；我的臣仆可以和你的臣仆一同工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 又求你从黎巴嫩运些香柏木、松木、檀香木到我这里来，因我知道你的仆人善于砍伐黎巴嫩的树木。我的仆人也必与你的仆人同工。
verses.textEnNiv: "Send me also cedar, juniper and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants are skilled in cutting timber there. My servants will work with yours
verses.textEnEsv: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum timber from Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. And my servants will be with your servants,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also send me cedar and cypress and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and indeed my servants willbe with your servants,
verses.textEnNlt: "Also send me cedar, cypress, and red sandalwood logs from Lebanon, for I know that your men are without equal at cutting timber in Lebanon. I will send my men to help them.
verses.textEnNasb: Send me also cedar, juniper, and algum timber from Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber of Lebanon; and indeed my servants will work with your servants,
verses.textEn: "Send me also cedar, juniper and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants are skilled in cutting timber there. My servants will work with yours

verses.textZh: 给我预备大量的木材，因为我要建造的那殿宇，将会十分宏伟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 给我预备大量的木材，因为我要建造的那殿宇，将会十分宏伟。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，可以给我预备许多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。
verses.textEnNiv: to provide me with plenty of lumber, because the temple I build must be large and magnificent.
verses.textEnEsv: to prepare timber for me in abundance, for the house I am to build will be great and wonderful.
verses.textEnNkjv: to prepare timber for me in abundance, for the temple which I am about to build shallbe great and wonderful.
verses.textEnNlt: An immense amount of timber will be needed, for the Temple I am going to build will be very large and magnificent.
verses.textEnNasb: to prepare timber in abundance for me, for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.
verses.textEn: to provide me with plenty of lumber, because the temple I build must be large and magnificent.

verses.textZh: 至于你的仆人，就是砍伐树木的人，我必给他们食物，就是小麦四百万公升、大麦四百万公升、酒四十万公升、油四十万公升。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你的仆人，就是砍伐树木的人，我必给他们食物，就是小麦四百万公升、大麦四百万公升、酒四十万公升、油四十万公升。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的仆人砍伐树木，我必给他们打好了的小麦二万歌珥，大麦二万歌珥，酒二万罢特，油二万罢特。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand cors of ground wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of olive oil."
verses.textEnEsv: I will give for your servants, the woodsmen who cut timber, 20,000 cors of crushed wheat, 20,000 cors of barley, 20,000 baths of wine, and 20,000 baths of oil."
verses.textEnNkjv: And indeed I will give to your servants, the woodsmen who cut timber, twenty thousand kors of ground wheat, twenty thousand kors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.textEnNlt: In payment for your woodcutters, I will send 100,000 bushels of crushed wheat, 100,000 bushels of barley, 110,000 gallons of wine, and 110,000 gallons of olive oil. "
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand kors of crushed wheat, twenty thousand kors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil."
verses.textEn: I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand cors of ground wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of olive oil."

verses.textZh: 推罗王希兰回信给所罗门说："耶和华因为爱自己的子民，所以立你作他们的王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗王希兰回信给所罗门说："耶和华因为爱自己的子民，所以立你作他们的王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔王希兰写信回答所罗门说：「耶和华因为爱他的子民，所以立你作他们的王」；
verses.textEnNiv: Hiram king of Tyre replied by letter to Solomon: "Because the Lord loves his people, he has made you their king."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hiram the king of Tyre answered in a letter that he sent to Solomon, "Because the Lord loves his people, he has made you king over them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon: Because the Lord loves His people, He has made you king over them.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hiram sent this letter of reply to Solomon: "It is because the Lord loves his people that he has made you their king!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Huram, king of Tyre, answered in a letter sent to Solomon: "Because the Lord loves His people, He has made you king over them."
verses.textEn: Hiram king of Tyre replied by letter to Solomon: "Because the Lord loves his people, he has made you their king."

verses.textZh: 希兰又说："创造天地的耶和华以色列的神，是应当称颂的！因为他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，有聪明有见识，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，为自己建造王宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰又说："创造天地的耶和华以色列的神，是应当称颂的！因为他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，有聪明有见识，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，为自己建造王宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「创造天地的耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的！他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，使他有谋略聪明，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。
verses.textEnNiv: And Hiram added: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, endowed with intelligence and discernment, who will build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
verses.textEnEsv: Hiram also said, "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son, who has discretion and understanding, who will build a temple for the Lord and a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hiram also said: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, for He has given King David a wise son, endowed with prudence and understanding, who will build a temple for the Lord and a royal house for himself!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth! He has given King David a wise son, gifted with skill and understanding, who will build a Temple for the Lord and a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Huram continued, "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who will build a house for the Lord and a royal palace for himself.
verses.textEn: And Hiram added: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, endowed with intelligence and discernment, who will build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.

verses.textZh: 现在我派一个技艺精巧、满有聪明的人来，他是我父亲希兰的匠人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我派一个技艺精巧、满有聪明的人来，他是我父亲希兰的匠人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在我打发一个精巧有聪明的人去，他是我父亲希兰所用的，
verses.textEnNiv: "I am sending you Huram-Abi, a man of great skill,
verses.textEnEsv: "Now I have sent a skilled man, who has understanding, Huram-abi,
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram my master craftsman
verses.textEnNlt: "I am sending you a master craftsman named Huram-abi, who is extremely talented.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, I am sending Huram-abi, a skilled man, endowed with understanding,
verses.textEn: "I am sending you Huram-Abi, a man of great skill,

verses.textZh: 他是但支派一个妇人的儿子，他的父亲是推罗人。他精于使用金、银、铜、铁、石、木，以及紫色蓝色朱红色线和细麻作工，也能作各样雕刻的工作，又能设计各样交托他们的巧工。这人可以和你的巧匠，以及我主你父亲大卫的巧匠一同工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是但支派一个妇人的儿子，他的父亲是推罗人。他精于使用金、银、铜、铁、石、木，以及紫色蓝色朱红色线和细麻作工，也能作各样雕刻的工作，又能设计各样交托他们的巧工。这人可以和你的巧匠，以及我主你父亲大卫的巧匠一同工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 是但支派一个妇人的儿子。他父亲是泰尔人，他善用金、银、铜、铁、石、木，和紫色、蓝色、朱红色线与细麻制造各物，并精于雕刻，又能想出各样的巧工。请你派定这人，与你的巧匠和你父－我主大卫的巧匠一同做工。
verses.textEnNiv: whose mother was from Dan and whose father was from Tyre. He is trained to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, and with purple and blue and crimson yarn and fine linen. He is experienced in all kinds of engraving and can execute any design given to him. He will work with your skilled workers and with those of my lord, David your father.
verses.textEnEsv: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre. He is trained to work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, and in purple, blue, and crimson fabrics and fine linen, and to do all sorts of engraving and execute any design that may be assigned him, with your craftsmen, the craftsmen of my lord, David your father.
verses.textEnNkjv: (the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre), skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, purple and blue, fine linen and crimson, and to make any engraving and to accomplish any plan which may be given to him, with your skillful men and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.
verses.textEnNlt: His mother is from the tribe of Dan in Israel, and his father is from Tyre. He is skillful at making things from gold, silver, bronze, and iron, and he also works with stone and wood. He can work with purple, blue, and scarlet cloth and fine linen. He is also an engraver and can follow any design given to him. He will work with your craftsmen and those appointed by my lord David, your father.
verses.textEnNasb: the son of a Danite woman and a Tyrian father, who knows how to work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, and in purple, violet, linen, and crimson fabrics, and who knows how to make all kinds of engravings and to execute any design which is assigned to him, to work with your skilled workers and with those of my lord, your father David.
verses.textEn: whose mother was from Dan and whose father was from Tyre. He is trained to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, and with purple and blue and crimson yarn and fine linen. He is experienced in all kinds of engraving and can execute any design given to him. He will work with your skilled workers and with those of my lord, David your father.

verses.textZh: 我主所说的小麦、大麦、酒和油，请派人运来给众仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主所说的小麦、大麦、酒和油，请派人运来给众仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我主所说的小麦、大麦、酒、油，愿我主运来给众仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now let my lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore the wheat and barley, oil and wine, of which my lord has spoken, let him send to his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: "Send along the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine that my lord has mentioned.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, let my lord send his servants wheat and barley, oil and wine, of which he has spoken.
verses.textEn: "Now let my lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,

verses.textZh: 我们必照着你所需要的，从黎巴嫩砍下树木，扎成木筏，从海上运到约帕，你可以从那里把它们运上耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们必照着你所需要的，从黎巴嫩砍下树木，扎成木筏，从海上运到约帕，你可以从那里把它们运上耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们必照你所需用的，从黎巴嫩砍伐树木，扎成筏子，浮海运到约帕；你可以从那里运到耶路撒冷。」
verses.textEnNiv: and we will cut all the logs from Lebanon that you need and will float them as rafts by sea down to Joppa. You can then take them up to Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: And we will cut whatever timber you need from Lebanon and bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa, so that you may take it up to Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNkjv: And we will cut wood from Lebanon, as much as you need; we will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa, and you will carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: We will cut whatever timber you need from the Lebanon mountains and will float the logs in rafts down the coast of the Mediterranean Sea to Joppa. From there you can transport the logs up to Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNasb: We will cut whatever timber you need from Lebanon and bring it to you as rafts by sea to Joppa, so that you may carry it up to Jerusalem."
verses.textEn: and we will cut all the logs from Lebanon that you need and will float them as rafts by sea down to Joppa. You can then take them up to Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: 所罗门按照他父亲大卫数点的数目，又数点了住在以色列地所有的外族人，他们共有十五万三千六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门按照他父亲大卫数点的数目，又数点了住在以色列地所有的外族人，他们共有十五万三千六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门仿照他父大卫数点住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五万三千六百名；
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon took a census of all the foreigners residing in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon counted all the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel, after the census of them that David his father had taken, and there were found 153,600.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon numbered all the aliens who were in the land of Israel, after the census in which David his father had numbered them; and there were found to be one hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon took a census of all foreigners in the land of Israel, like the census his father had taken, and he counted 153,600.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, following the census which his father David had taken; and 153,600 were found.
verses.textEn: Solomon took a census of all the foreigners residing in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.

verses.textZh: 他选派七万人作挑夫，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人作监工，督促人民工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他选派七万人作挑夫，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人作监工，督促人民工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 使七万人扛抬材料，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人督理工作。
verses.textEnNiv: He assigned 70,000 of them to be carriers and 80,000 to be stonecutters in the hills, with 3,600 foremen over them to keep the people working.
verses.textEnEsv: Seventy thousand of them he assigned to bear burdens, 80,000 to quarry in the hill country, and 3,600 as overseers to make the people work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made seventy thousand of them bearers of burdens, eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain, and three thousand six hundred overseers to make the people work.
verses.textEnNlt: He assigned 70,000 of them as common laborers, 80,000 as quarry workers in the hill country, and 3,600 as foremen.
verses.textEnNasb: He appointed seventy thousand of them to carry loads and eighty thousand to quarry stones in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors to make the people work.
verses.textEn: He assigned 70,000 of them to be carriers and 80,000 to be stonecutters in the hills, with 3,600 foremen over them to keep the people working.

verses.textZh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷，在耶和华向他父亲大卫显现过的摩利亚山上，就是在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上，大卫预备的地方，开工建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在耶路撒冷，在耶和华向他父亲大卫显现过的摩利亚山上，就是在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上，大卫预备的地方，开工建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门就在耶路撒冷、耶和华向他父大卫显现的摩利亚山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上、大卫所指定的地方预备好了，开工建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon began to build the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to his father David. It was on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the place provided by David.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to David his father, at the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where theLord had appeared to his father David, at the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon began to build the Temple of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to David, his father. The Temple was built on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the site that David had selected.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to his father David, at the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon began to build the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to his father David. It was on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the place provided by David.

verses.textZh: 所罗门执政后第四年二月初二开始建造。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门执政后第四年二月初二开始建造。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门作王第四年二月初二日开工建造。
verses.textEnNiv: He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.textEnEsv: He began to build in the second month of the fourth year of his reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he began to build on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.textEnNlt: The construction began in midspring, during the fourth year of Solomon’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: He began to build on the second day in the second month of the fourth year of his reign.
verses.textEn: He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.textZh: 所罗门建造神殿宇的根基是这样：按古时的尺寸，长二十七公尺，宽九公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门建造神殿宇的根基是这样：按古时的尺寸，长二十七公尺，宽九公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建筑神殿的根基，乃是这样：长六十肘，宽二十肘，都按着古时的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: The foundation Solomon laid for building the temple of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide (using the cubit of the old standard).
verses.textEnEsv: These are Solomon’s measurements for building the house of God: the length, in cubits of the old standard, was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the foundation which Solomon laid for building the house of God: The length was sixty cubits (by cubits according to the former measure) and the width twenty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the dimensions Solomon used for the foundation of the Temple of God (using the old standard of measurement). It was 90 feet long and 30 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for building the house of God. The length in cubits, according to the old standard, was sixty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
verses.textEn: The foundation Solomon laid for building the temple of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide (using the cubit of the old standard).

verses.textZh: 殿前走廊长九公尺，与殿的宽度相等；高九公尺 ；里面贴上纯金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿前走廊长九公尺，与殿的宽度相等；高九公尺 ；里面贴上纯金。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，高一百二十肘；里面贴上精金。
verses.textEnNiv: The portico at the front of the temple was twenty cubits long across the width of the building and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The vestibule in front of the nave of the house was twenty cubits long, equal to the width of the house, and its height was 120 cubits. He overlaid it on the inside with pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the vestibule that was in front of the sanctuary was twenty cubits long across the width of the house, and the height was one hundred and twenty. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The entry room at the front of the Temple was 30 feet wide, running across the entire width of the Temple, and 30 feet high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: The porch which was in front of the house was as long as the width of the house, twenty cubits, and the height twenty; and inside he overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.textEn: The portico at the front of the temple was twenty cubits long across the width of the building and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.

verses.textZh: 大殿的墙都盖上松木，又贴上精金，又在上面刻上棕树和链子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大殿的墙都盖上松木，又贴上精金，又在上面刻上棕树和链子。
verses.textZhCuv: 大殿的墙都用松木板遮蔽，又贴了精金，上面雕刻棕树和链子；
verses.textEnNiv: He paneled the main hall with juniper and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.
verses.textEnEsv: The nave he lined with cypress and covered it with fine gold and made palms and chains on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The larger room he paneled with cypress which he overlaid with fine gold, and he carved palm trees and chainwork on it.
verses.textEnNlt: He paneled the main room of the Temple with cypress wood, overlaid it with fine gold, and decorated it with carvings of palm trees and chains.
verses.textEnNasb: He overlaid the main room with juniper wood and overlaid it with fine gold; and he ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
verses.textEn: He paneled the main hall with juniper and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.

verses.textZh: 又用宝石装饰殿墙，十分华美；金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用宝石装饰殿墙，十分华美；金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用宝石装饰殿墙，使殿华美；所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
verses.textEnNiv: He adorned the temple with precious stones. And the gold he used was gold of Parvaim.
verses.textEnEsv: He adorned the house with settings of precious stones. The gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he decorated the house with precious stones for beauty, and the gold was gold from Parvaim.
verses.textEnNlt: He decorated the walls of the Temple with beautiful jewels and with gold from the land of Parvaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Further, he overlaid the house with precious stones; and the gold was gold from Parvaim.
verses.textEn: He adorned the temple with precious stones. And the gold he used was gold of Parvaim.

verses.textZh: 正殿和殿的栋梁、门槛、墙壁和门扇，都贴上金子；墙上刻上基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正殿和殿的栋梁、门槛、墙壁和门扇，都贴上金子；墙上刻上基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用金子贴殿和殿的栋梁、门槛、墙壁、门扇；墙上雕刻基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: He overlaid the ceiling beams, doorframes, walls and doors of the temple with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.
verses.textEnEsv: So he lined the house with gold—its beams, its thresholds, its walls, and its doors— and he carved cherubim on the walls.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also overlaid the house—the beams and doorposts, its walls and doors—with gold; and he carved cherubim on the walls.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid the beams, thresholds, walls, and doors throughout the Temple with gold, and he carved figures of cherubim on the walls.
verses.textEnNasb: He also overlaid the house with gold—the beams, the thresholds, and its walls and doors; and he carved cherubim on the walls.
verses.textEn: He overlaid the ceiling beams, doorframes, walls and doors of the temple with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.

verses.textZh: 他又建造了至圣所，长九公尺，和殿的宽度相等，宽度也是九公尺；里面都贴上精金，共用了二十公吨金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又建造了至圣所，长九公尺，和殿的宽度相等，宽度也是九公尺；里面都贴上精金，共用了二十公吨金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建造至圣所，长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，宽也是二十肘；贴上精金，共用金子六百他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: He built the Most Holy Place, its length corresponding to the width of the temple—twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the Most Holy Place. Its length, corresponding to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and its breadth was twenty cubits. He overlaid it with 600 talents of fine gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the Most Holy Place. Its length was according to the width of the house, twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits. He overlaid it with six hundred talents of fine gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the Most Holy Place 30 feet wide, corresponding to the width of the Temple, and 30 feet deep. He overlaid its interior with 23 tons of fine gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the room of the Most Holy Place: its length across the width of the house was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.textEn: He built the Most Holy Place, its length corresponding to the width of the temple—twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.

verses.textZh: 钉子共重五百七十克金子。阁楼也贴上金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 钉子共重五百七十克金子。阁楼也贴上金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 金钉重五十舍客勒。楼房都贴上金子。
verses.textEnNiv: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also overlaid the upper parts with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The weight of gold for the nails was fifty shekels. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold; and he overlaid the upper area with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The gold nails that were used weighed 20 ounces each. He also overlaid the walls of the upper rooms with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He also overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
verses.textEn: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also overlaid the upper parts with gold.

verses.textZh: 在至圣所里，雕刻了两个基路伯，都包上金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在至圣所里，雕刻了两个基路伯，都包上金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 在至圣所按造像的法子造两个基路伯，用金子包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Most Holy Place he made a pair of sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: In the Most Holy Place he made two cherubim of wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the Most Holy Place he made two cherubim, fashioned by carving, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He made two figures shaped like cherubim, overlaid them with gold, and placed them in the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made two sculptured cherubim in the room of the Most Holy Place and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEn: For the Most Holy Place he made a pair of sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.

verses.textZh: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长九公尺；一个基路伯的一边翅膀长两公尺两公寸，触着殿墙；另一边翅膀也长两公尺两公寸，和另一个基路伯的翅膀相接。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长九公尺；一个基路伯的一边翅膀长两公尺两公寸，触着殿墙；另一边翅膀也长两公尺两公寸，和另一个基路伯的翅膀相接。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长二十肘。这基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿这边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与那基路伯翅膀相接。
verses.textEnNiv: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits. One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the temple wall, while its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the other cherub.
verses.textEnEsv: The wings of the cherubim together extended twenty cubits: one wing of the one, of five cubits, touched the wall of the house, and its other wing, of five cubits, touched the wing of the other cherub;
verses.textEnNkjv: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits in overall length: one wing oftheonecherubwas five cubits, touching the wall of the room, and the other wing was five cubits, touching the wing of the other cherub;
verses.textEnNlt: The total wingspan of the two cherubim standing side by side was 30 feet. One wing of the first figure was 7-1/2 feet long, and it touched the Temple wall. The other wing, also 7-1/2 feet long, touched one of the wings of the second figure.
verses.textEnNasb: The wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits; the wing of one, of five cubits, touched the wall of the house, and its other wing, of five cubits, touched the wing of the other cherub.
verses.textEn: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits. One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the temple wall, while its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the other cherub.

verses.textZh: 另一个基路伯的一边翅膀也长两公尺两公寸，触着殿墙；另一边的翅膀也长两公尺两公寸，和前一个基路伯的翅膀相接。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一个基路伯的一边翅膀也长两公尺两公寸，触着殿墙；另一边的翅膀也长两公尺两公寸，和前一个基路伯的翅膀相接。
verses.textZhCuv: 那基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿那边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与这基路伯的翅膀相接。
verses.textEnNiv: Similarly one wing of the second cherub was five cubits long and touched the other temple wall, and its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the first cherub.
verses.textEnEsv: and of this cherub, one wing, of five cubits, touched the wall of the house, and the other wing, also of five cubits, was joined to the wing of the first cherub.
verses.textEnNkjv: one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, touching the wall of the room, and the other wing alsowas five cubits, touching the wing of the other cherub.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, the second figure had one wing 7-1/2 feet long that touched the opposite wall. The other wing, also 7-1/2 feet long, touched the wing of the first figure.
verses.textEnNasb: The wing of the other cherub, of five cubits, touched the wall of the house; and its other wing, of five cubits, was attached to the wing of the first cherub.
verses.textEn: Similarly one wing of the second cherub was five cubits long and touched the other temple wall, and its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the first cherub.

verses.textZh: 这两个基路伯的翅膀都张开，共长九公尺；这两个基路伯都面向殿内站立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这两个基路伯的翅膀都张开，共长九公尺；这两个基路伯都面向殿内站立。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个基路伯张开翅膀，共长二十肘，面向外殿而立。
verses.textEnNiv: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.
verses.textEnEsv: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. The cherubim stood on their feet, facing the nave.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wings of these cherubim spanned twenty cubits overall. They stood on their feet, and they faced inward.
verses.textEnNlt: So the wingspan of the two cherubim side by side was 30 feet. They stood on their feet and faced out toward the main room of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits, and they stood on their feet facing the main room.
verses.textEn: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.

verses.textZh: 所罗门又用蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻做幔子，上面绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门又用蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻做幔子，上面绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线和细麻织幔子，在其上绣出基路伯来。
verses.textEnNiv: He made the curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim worked into it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the veil of blue and purple and crimson fabrics and fine linen, and he worked cherubim on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and wove cherubim into it.
verses.textEnNlt: Across the entrance of the Most Holy Place he hung a curtain made of fine linen, decorated with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and embroidered with figures of cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the veil of violet, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and he worked cherubim into it.
verses.textEn: He made the curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim worked into it.

verses.textZh: 在殿的前面又做了两根柱子，高十五公尺半，每根柱上面的柱顶，高两公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在殿的前面又做了两根柱子，高十五公尺半，每根柱上面的柱顶，高两公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 在殿前造了两根柱子，高三十五肘；每柱顶高五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: For the front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits long, each with a capital five cubits high.
verses.textEnEsv: In front of the house he made two pillars thirty-five cubits high, with a capital of five cubits on the top of each.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he made in front of the temple two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: For the front of the Temple, he made two pillars that were 27 feet tall, each topped by a capital extending upward another 7-1/2 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made two pillars for the front of the house, thirty-five cubits high, and the capital on the top of each was five cubits.
verses.textEn: For the front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits long, each with a capital five cubits high.

verses.textZh: 又做了像项链 的链子，安放在柱头上；又做了石榴一百个，安放在链子上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做了像项链 的链子，安放在柱头上；又做了石榴一百个，安放在链子上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又照圣所内链子的样式做链子，安在柱顶上；又做一百石榴，安在链子上。
verses.textEnNiv: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and attached them to the chains.
verses.textEnEsv: He made chains like a necklace and put them on the tops of the pillars, and he made a hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made wreaths of chainwork, as in the inner sanctuary, and put them on top of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the wreaths of chainwork.
verses.textEnNlt: He made a network of interwoven chains and used them to decorate the tops of the pillars. He also made 100 decorative pomegranates and attached them to the chains.
verses.textEnNasb: He made chains in the inner sanctuary and placed them on the tops of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates and placed them on the chains.
verses.textEn: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and attached them to the chains.

verses.textZh: 他把这两根柱子立在殿前，一根在左面，一根在右面；右面的叫雅斤，左面的叫波阿斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把这两根柱子立在殿前，一根在左面，一根在右面；右面的叫雅斤，左面的叫波阿斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 将两根柱子立在殿前，一根在右边，一根在左边；右边的起名叫雅斤，左边的起名叫波阿斯。
verses.textEnNiv: He erected the pillars in the front of the temple, one to the south and one to the north. The one to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.
verses.textEnEsv: He set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the south, the other on the north; that on the south he called Jachin, and that on the north Boaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; he called the name of the one on the right hand Jachin, and the name of the one on the left Boaz.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he set up the two pillars at the entrance of the Temple, one to the south of the entrance and the other to the north. He named the one on the south Jakin, and the one on the north Boaz.
verses.textEnNasb: He erected the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right and the other on the left, and named the one on the right Jachin and the one on the left Boaz.
verses.textEn: He erected the pillars in the front of the temple, one to the south and one to the north. The one to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

verses.textZh: 他又做了一座铜坛，长九公尺，宽九公尺，高四公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做了一座铜坛，长九公尺，宽九公尺，高四公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又制造一座铜坛，长二十肘，宽二十肘，高十肘；
verses.textEnNiv: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.
verses.textEnEsv: He made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover he made a bronze altar: twenty cubits was its length, twenty cubits its width, and ten cubits its height.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also made a bronze altar 30 feet long, 30 feet wide, and 15 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made a bronze altar, twenty cubits in length, twenty cubits in width, and ten cubits in height.
verses.textEn: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.

verses.textZh: 又铸造了一个铜海，直径有四公尺半，是圆形的，高两公尺两公寸，圆周有十三公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又铸造了一个铜海，直径有四公尺半，是圆形的，高两公尺两公寸，圆周有十三公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 又铸一个铜海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘；
verses.textEnNiv: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round, ten cubits from brim to brim, and five cubits high, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made the Sea of cast bronze, ten cubits from one brim to the other; itwas completely round. Its height was five cubits, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he cast a great round basin, 15 feet across from rim to rim, called the Sea. It was 7-1/2 feet deep and about 45 feet in circumference.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made the Sea of cast metal, ten cubits from brim to brim, circular in form, and its height was five cubits and its circumference thirty cubits.
verses.textEn: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

verses.textZh: 铜海底下四周有形状像牛的装饰物；每四十五公分十个，共分二行，是和铜海一体铸成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜海底下四周有形状像牛的装饰物；每四十五公分十个，共分二行，是和铜海一体铸成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 海周围有野瓜 的样式，每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的；
verses.textEnNiv: Below the rim, figures of bulls encircled it—ten to a cubit. The bulls were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Under it were figures of gourds, for ten cubits, compassing the sea all around. The gourds were in two rows, cast with it when it was cast.
verses.textEnNkjv: And under it was the likeness of oxen encircling it all around, ten to a cubit, all the way around the Sea. The oxen were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.textEnNlt: It was encircled just below its rim by two rows of figures that resembled oxen. There were about six oxen per foot all the way around, and they were cast as part of the basin.
verses.textEnNasb: Now figures like oxen were under it and all around it, ten cubits, entirely encircling the Sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast in one piece.
verses.textEn: Below the rim, figures of bulls encircled it—ten to a cubit. The bulls were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

verses.textZh: 有十二头铜牛驮着铜海：三头向北，三头向西，三头向南，三头向东。铜海在牛背上面，牛尾部向内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有十二头铜牛驮着铜海：三头向北，三头向西，三头向南，三头向东。铜海在牛背上面，牛尾部向内。
verses.textZhCuv: 有十二只铜牛驮海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；海在牛上，牛尾向内；
verses.textEnNiv: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.
verses.textEnEsv: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The sea was set on them, and all their rear parts were inward.
verses.textEnNkjv: It stood on twelve oxen: three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; the Sea wasset upon them, and all their back parts pointed inward.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sea was placed on a base of twelve bronze oxen, all facing outward. Three faced north, three faced west, three faced south, and three faced east, and the Sea rested on them.
verses.textEnNasb: It was standing on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; and the Sea was set on top of them and all their hindquarters turned inward.
verses.textEn: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

verses.textZh: 铜海厚七公分半，边缘像杯边的做法，形状似百合花，容量有六万公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜海厚七公分半，边缘像杯边的做法，形状似百合花，容量有六万公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容三千罢特；
verses.textEnNiv: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held three thousand baths.
verses.textEnEsv: Its thickness was a handbreadth. And its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held 3,000 baths.
verses.textEnNkjv: It was a handbreadth thick; and its brim was shaped like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It contained three thousand baths.
verses.textEnNlt: The walls of the Sea were about three inches thick, and its rim flared out like a cup and resembled a water lily blossom. It could hold about 16,500 gallons of water.
verses.textEnNasb: It was a hand width thick, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom; it could hold three thousand baths.
verses.textEn: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held three thousand baths.

verses.textZh: 他又做了十个洗濯盆：五个放在铜海的右边，五个放在左边，用来清洗东西；献燔祭所用的东西要在盆内清洗，但铜海是给祭司洗濯的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做了十个洗濯盆：五个放在铜海的右边，五个放在左边，用来清洗东西；献燔祭所用的东西要在盆内清洗，但铜海是给祭司洗濯的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又制造十个盆：五个放在右边，五个放在左边，献燔祭所用之物都洗在其内；但海是为祭司沐浴的。
verses.textEnNiv: He then made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. In them the things to be used for the burnt offerings were rinsed, but the Sea was to be used by the priests for washing.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made ten basins in which to wash, and set five on the south side, and five on the north side. In these they were to rinse off what was used for the burnt offering, and the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made ten lavers, and put five on the right side and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as they offered for the burnt offering they would wash in them, but the Sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made ten smaller basins for washing the utensils for the burnt offerings. He set five on the south side and five on the north. But the priests washed themselves in the Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made ten basins in which to wash, and he set five on the right side and five on the left to rinse things for the burnt offering; but the Sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.textEn: He then made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. In them the things to be used for the burnt offerings were rinsed, but the Sea was to be used by the priests for washing.

verses.textZh: 又照着规定的样式做了十个金灯台，放在殿内；五个在右边，五个在左边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又照着规定的样式做了十个金灯台，放在殿内；五个在右边，五个在左边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又照所定的样式造十个金灯台放在殿里：五个在右边，五个在左边；
verses.textEnNiv: He made ten gold lampstands according to the specifications for them and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made ten golden lampstands as prescribed, and set them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made ten lampstands of gold according to their design, and set them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left.
verses.textEnNlt: He then cast ten gold lampstands according to the specifications that had been given, and he put them in the Temple. Five were placed against the south wall, and five were placed against the north wall.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the ten golden lampstands in the way prescribed for them, and he set them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left.
verses.textEn: He made ten gold lampstands according to the specifications for them and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.

verses.textZh: 又做了十张桌子，安放在殿内；五张在右边，五张在左边。又做了一百个金碗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做了十张桌子，安放在殿内；五张在右边，五张在左边。又做了一百个金碗。
verses.textZhCuv: 又造十张桌子放在殿里：五张在右边，五张在左边；又造一百个金碗；
verses.textEnNiv: He made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. And he made a hundred basins of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made one hundred bowls of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He also built ten tables and placed them in the Temple, five along the south wall and five along the north wall. Then he molded 100 gold basins.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made a hundred golden bowls.
verses.textEn: He made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.

verses.textZh: 又建造祭司院、大院和大院的门；门都包上铜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又建造祭司院、大院和大院的门；门都包上铜。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建立祭司院和大院，并院门，用铜包裹门扇；
verses.textEnNiv: He made the courtyard of the priests, and the large court and the doors for the court, and overlaid the doors with bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the court of the priests and the great court and doors for the court and overlaid their doors with bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court and doors for the court; and he overlaid these doors with bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: He then built a courtyard for the priests, and also the large outer courtyard. He made doors for the courtyard entrances and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the courtyard of the priests and the great courtyard, and doors for the courtyard, and overlaid their doors with bronze.
verses.textEn: He made the courtyard of the priests, and the large court and the doors for the court, and overlaid the doors with bronze.

verses.textZh: 又把铜海放在殿的右边，就是东南方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把铜海放在殿的右边，就是东南方。
verses.textZhCuv: 将海安在殿门的右边，就是南边。
verses.textEnNiv: He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set the sea at the southeast corner of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: He set the Sea on the right side, toward the southeast.
verses.textEnNlt: The great bronze basin called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: He put the Sea on the right side of the house toward the southeast.
verses.textEn: He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.

verses.textZh: 户兰又做了锅、铲和碗。这样，户兰为所罗门王完成了神殿的工程，
verses.textZhCnvs: 户兰又做了锅、铲和碗。这样，户兰为所罗门王完成了神殿的工程，
verses.textZhCuv: 户兰又造了盆、铲、碗。这样，他为所罗门王做完了神殿的工。
verses.textEnNiv: And Huram also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of God:
verses.textEnEsv: Hiram also made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished the work that he did for King Solomon on the house of God:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Huram made the pots and the shovels and the bowls. So Huram finished doing the work that he was to do for King Solomon for the house of God:
verses.textEnNlt: Huram-abi also made the necessary washbasins, shovels, and bowls. So at last Huram-abi completed everything King Solomon had assigned him to make for the Temple of God:
verses.textEnNasb: Huram also made the pails, the shovels, and the bowls. So Huram finished the work that he did for King Solomon in the house of God:
verses.textEn: And Huram also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of God:

verses.textZh: 就是两根柱子和在柱子上面两个碗形柱顶，以及两个网子，遮盖柱子上面两个碗形的柱顶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是两根柱子和在柱子上面两个碗形柱顶，以及两个网子，遮盖柱子上面两个碗形的柱顶，
verses.textZhCuv: 所造的就是：两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶，并两个盖柱顶的网子
verses.textEnNiv: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;
verses.textEnEsv: the two pillars, the bowls, and the two capitals on the top of the pillars; and the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;
verses.textEnNkjv: the two pillars and the bowl-shaped capitals thatwere on top of the two pillars; the two networks covering the two bowl-shaped capitals which were on top of the pillars;
verses.textEnNlt: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two networks of interwoven chains that decorated the capitals;
verses.textEnNasb: the two pillars, the bowls and the two capitals on top of the pillars, and the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on top of the pillars,
verses.textEn: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;

verses.textZh: 又有四百个石榴，安放在两个网子上，每个网子有两行石榴，遮盖柱子上头两个碗形的柱顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有四百个石榴，安放在两个网子上，每个网子有两行石榴，遮盖柱子上头两个碗形的柱顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上（每网两行盖着两个柱上如球的顶）。
verses.textEnNiv: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);
verses.textEnEsv: and the 400 pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
verses.textEnNkjv: four hundred pomegranates for the two networks (two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowl-shaped capitals that were on the pillars);
verses.textEnNlt: the 400 pomegranates that hung from the chains on the capitals (two rows of pomegranates for each of the chain networks that decorated the capitals on top of the pillars);
verses.textEnNasb: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the pillars.
verses.textEn: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

verses.textZh: 又做了十个盆座和盆座上的十个洗濯盆，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做了十个盆座和盆座上的十个洗濯盆，
verses.textZhCuv: 盆座和其上的盆，
verses.textEnNiv: the stands with their basins;
verses.textEnEsv: He made the stands also, and the basins on the stands,
verses.textEnNkjv: he also made carts and the lavers on the carts;
verses.textEnNlt: the water carts holding the basins;
verses.textEnNasb: He also made the stands and he made the basins on the stands,
verses.textEn: the stands with their basins;

verses.textZh: 还有一个铜海和铜海底下的十二头铜牛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有一个铜海和铜海底下的十二头铜牛。
verses.textZhCuv: 海和海下的十二只牛，
verses.textEnNiv: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;
verses.textEnEsv: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath it.
verses.textEnNkjv: one Sea and twelve oxen under it;
verses.textEnNlt: the Sea and the twelve oxen under it;
verses.textEnNasb: and the one Sea with the twelve oxen under it.
verses.textEn: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;

verses.textZh: 锅、铲、肉叉和一切相关的器皿，都是户兰用磨光的铜给所罗门王，为耶和华的殿所做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锅、铲、肉叉和一切相关的器皿，都是户兰用磨光的铜给所罗门王，为耶和华的殿所做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 盆、铲子、肉锸子，与耶和华殿里的一切器皿，都是巧匠户兰用光亮的铜为所罗门王造成的，
verses.textEnNiv: the pots, shovels, meat forks and all related articles. All the objects that Huram-Abi made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of polished bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: The pots, the shovels, the forks, and all the equipment for these Huram-abi made of burnished bronze for King Solomon for the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: also the pots, the shovels, the forks—and all their articles Huram his master craftsman made of burnished bronze for King Solomon for the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: the ash buckets, the shovels, the meat hooks, and all the related articles. Huram-abi made all these things of burnished bronze for the Temple of the Lord , just as King Solomon had directed.
verses.textEnNasb: The pails, the shovels, the forks, and all its utensils, Huram-abi made of polished bronze for King Solomon, for the house of the Lord.
