verses.textEn: the pots, shovels, meat forks and all related articles. All the objects that Huram-Abi made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of polished bronze.

verses.textZh: 是王在约旦平原，在疏割和撒利但之间，用胶泥模铸成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是王在约旦平原，在疏割和撒利但之间，用胶泥模铸成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 是在约旦平原疏割和撒利但中间藉胶泥铸成的。
verses.textEnNiv: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.
verses.textEnEsv: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the plain of Jordan the king had them cast in clay molds, between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.textEnNlt: The king had them cast in clay molds in the Jordan Valley between Succoth and Zarethan.
verses.textEnNasb: On the plain of the Jordan the king cast them in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.textEn: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.

verses.textZh: 所罗门所做的这一切器皿，数量很多；铜的重量无法估计。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门所做的这一切器皿，数量很多；铜的重量无法估计。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门制造的这一切甚多，铜的轻重无法可查。
verses.textEnNiv: All these things that Solomon made amounted to so much that the weight of the bronze could not be calculated.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon made all these things in great quantities, for the weight of the bronze was not sought.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon had all these articles made in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze was not determined.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon used such great quantities of bronze that its weight could not be determined.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon made all these utensils in great quantities, for the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
verses.textEn: All these things that Solomon made amounted to so much that the weight of the bronze could not be calculated.

verses.textZh: 所罗门又做了神殿里的一切器具，就是金坛和放陈设饼的桌子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门又做了神殿里的一切器具，就是金坛和放陈设饼的桌子，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门又造神殿里的金坛和陈设饼的桌子，
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God’s temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of God: the golden altar, the tables for the bread of the Presence,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Solomon had all the furnishings made for the house of God: the altar of gold and the tables on which was the showbread;
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the Temple of God: the gold altar; the tables for the Bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon also made all the things that were in the house of God: the golden altar, the tables with the bread of the Presence on them,
verses.textEn: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God’s temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;

verses.textZh: 用纯金做的灯台和灯盏，按定例在内殿门前燃点，
verses.textZhCnvs: 用纯金做的灯台和灯盏，按定例在内殿门前燃点，
verses.textZhCuv: 并精金的灯台和灯盏，可以照例点在内殿前。
verses.textEnNiv: the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;
verses.textEnEsv: the lampstands and their lamps of pure gold to burn before the inner sanctuary, as prescribed;
verses.textEnNkjv: the lampstands with their lamps of pure gold, to burn in the prescribed manner in front of the inner sanctuary,
verses.textEnNlt: the lampstands and their lamps of solid gold, to burn in front of the Most Holy Place as prescribed;
verses.textEnNasb: the lampstands with their lamps of pure gold, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary in the way prescribed;
verses.textEn: the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;

verses.textZh: 还有灯花、灯盏和烛剪，都是精金做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有灯花、灯盏和烛剪，都是精金做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台上的花和灯盏，并蜡剪都是金的，且是纯金的；
verses.textEnNiv: the gold floral work and lamps and tongs (they were solid gold);
verses.textEnEsv: the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of purest gold;
verses.textEnNkjv: with the flowers and the lamps and the wick-trimmers of gold, of purest gold;
verses.textEnNlt: the flower decorations, lamps, and tongs—all of the purest gold;
verses.textEnNasb: the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold, that is, of purest gold;
verses.textEn: the gold floral work and lamps and tongs (they were solid gold);

verses.textZh: 又有剪刀、盘子、调羹和火鼎，都是用精金做的。殿门，就是进入至圣所里面的门和正殿的门，都是金的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有剪刀、盘子、调羹和火鼎，都是用精金做的。殿门，就是进入至圣所里面的门和正殿的门，都是金的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用精金制造镊子、盘子、调羹、火鼎。至于殿门和至圣所的门扇，并殿的门扇，都是金子妆饰的。
verses.textEnNiv: the pure gold wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors of the main hall.
verses.textEnEsv: the snuffers, basins, dishes for incense, and fire pans, of pure gold, and the sockets of the temple, for the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and for the doors of the nave of the temple were of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: the trimmers, the bowls, the ladles, and the censers of pure gold. As for the entry of the sanctuary, its inner doors to the Most Holy Place, and the doors of the main hall of the temple, were gold.
verses.textEnNlt: the lamp snuffers, bowls, ladles, and incense burners—all of solid gold; the doors for the entrances to the Most Holy Place and the main room of the Temple, overlaid with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: and the snuffers, the bowls, the spoons, and the firepans of pure gold; and the entrance of the house, its inner doors for the Most Holy Place and the doors of the house, that is, of the main room, of gold.
verses.textEn: the pure gold wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors of the main hall.

verses.textZh: 所罗门为耶和华的殿所作的一切工程完成了以后，就把他父亲大卫分别为圣的东西：金银和一切器皿，都带来存放在神殿的库房里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门为耶和华的殿所作的一切工程完成了以后，就把他父亲大卫分别为圣的东西：金银和一切器皿，都带来存放在神殿的库房里。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来，放在神殿的府库里。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the work Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and all the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of God’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the house of the Lord was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, and stored the silver, the gold, and all the vessels in the treasuries of the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the work that Solomon had done for the house of the Lord was finished; and Solomon brought in the things which his father David had dedicated: the silver and the gold and all the furnishings. And he put them in the treasuries of the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon finished all his work on the Temple of the Lord . Then he brought all the gifts his father, David, had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the various articles—and he stored them in the treasuries of the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the work that Solomon performed for the house of the Lord was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that his father David had dedicated, the silver, the gold, and all the utensils, and he put them in the treasuries of the house of God.
verses.textEn: When all the work Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and all the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of God’s temple.

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门把以色列的长老、各支派的首领和以色列人各家族的首领，都召集到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城，就是锡安运上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门把以色列的长老、各支派的首领和以色列人各家族的首领，都召集到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城，就是锡安运上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老、各支派的首领，并以色列的族长招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城－就是锡安－运上来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers’ houses of the people of Israel, in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel, in Jerusalem, that they might bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord up from the City of David, which is Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon then summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel and all the heads of tribes—the leaders of the ancestral families of Israel. They were to bring the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant to the Temple from its location in the City of David, also known as Zion.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon assembled at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes, and the leaders of the fathers’ households of the sons of Israel, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord up from the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.

verses.textZh: 于是，以色列众人在七月的节期来到时，都聚集到王那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以色列众人在七月的节期来到时，都聚集到王那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列众人在七月节前都聚集到王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: And all the Israelites came together to the king at the time of the festival in the seventh month.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the men of Israel assembled before the king at the feast that is in the seventh month.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all the men of Israel assembled with the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the men of Israel assembled before the king at the annual Festival of Shelters, which is held in early autumn.
verses.textEnNasb: All the men of Israel assembled themselves before the king at the feast, that is in the seventh month.
verses.textEn: And all the Israelites came together to the king at the time of the festival in the seventh month.

verses.textZh: 以色列的众长老来到了，利未人就抬起约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的众长老来到了，利未人就抬起约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众长老来到，利未人便抬起约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the elders of Israel came, and the Levites took up the ark.

verses.textEnNlt: When all the elders of Israel arrived, the Levites picked up the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the elders of Israel came, and the Levites picked up the ark.
verses.textEn: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,

verses.textZh: 他们把约柜、会幕和会幕里的一切神圣器皿都抬上来；是祭司和利未人把它们抬上来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把约柜、会幕和会幕里的一切神圣器皿都抬上来；是祭司和利未人把它们抬上来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司利未人将约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。
verses.textEnNiv: and they brought up the ark and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The Levitical priests carried them up;
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought up the ark, the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the tent; the Levitical priests brought them up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought up the ark, the tabernacle of meeting, and all the holy furnishings that were in the tabernacle. The priests and the Levites brought them up.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests and Levites brought up the Ark along with the special tent and all the sacred items that had been in it.
verses.textEnNasb: They brought up the ark, the tent of meeting, and all the holy utensils that were in the tent. The Levitical priests brought them up.
verses.textEn: and they brought up the ark and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The Levitical priests carried them up;

verses.textZh: 所罗门王和那些聚集到他那里的以色列全体会众，都在约柜前献上牛羊为祭，数量无法计算，不能数点。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王和那些聚集到他那里的以色列全体会众，都在约柜前献上牛羊为祭，数量无法计算，不能数点。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众都在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.
verses.textEnEsv: And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who had assembled before him, were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also King Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled with him before the ark, were sacrificing sheep and oxen that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: There, before the Ark, King Solomon and the entire community of Israel sacrificed so many sheep, goats, and cattle that no one could keep count!

verses.textEn: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

verses.textZh: 众祭司把耶和华的约柜抬进放约柜的地方，就是内殿，至圣所里面，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。

verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the temple, to the Most Holy Place, under the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priests carried the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant into the inner sanctuary of the Temple—the Most Holy Place—and placed it beneath the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the Most Holy Place, under the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEn: The priests then brought the ark of the Lord ’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

verses.textZh: 基路伯在约柜上面张开翅膀，遮盖着约柜和抬约柜的杠。

verses.textEnNiv: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and covered the ark and its carrying poles.
verses.textEnEsv: The cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, so that the cherubim made a covering above the ark and its poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim overshadowed the ark and its poles.
verses.textEnNlt: The cherubim spread their wings over the Ark, forming a canopy over the Ark and its carrying poles.
verses.textEnNasb: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, so that the cherubim made a covering over the ark and its poles.
verses.textEn: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and covered the ark and its carrying poles.

verses.textZh: 那两根杠很长，在内殿前可以看见约柜那里的杠头，在殿外却看不见；直到今日，那两根杠还在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那两根杠很长，在内殿前可以看见约柜那里的杠头，在殿外却看不见；直到今日，那两根杠还在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: These poles were so long that their ends, extending from the ark, could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.
verses.textEnEsv: And the poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the Holy Place before the inner sanctuary, but they could not be seen from outside. And they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poles extended so that the ends of the poles of the ark could be seen from theholyplace, in front of the inner sanctuary; but they could not be seen from outside. And they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place, which is in front of the Most Holy Place, but not from the outside. They are still there to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles of the ark could be seen in front of the inner sanctuary, but they could not be seen outside; and they are there to this day.
verses.textEn: These poles were so long that their ends, extending from the ark, could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

verses.textZh: 约柜里只有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及以后，耶和华和他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山放进去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约柜里只有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及以后，耶和华和他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山放进去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。
verses.textEnNiv: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the people of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nothing was in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the Lord made acovenant with the children of Israel, when they had come out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing was in the Ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Mount Sinai, where the Lord made a covenant with the people of Israel when they left Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the sons of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 众祭司从圣所里出来的时候 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众祭司从圣所里出来的时候 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，在那里所有的祭司都已自洁，并不分班供职。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place (for all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves, without regard to their divisions,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass when the priests came out of the Most Holy Place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, without keeping to their divisions),
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priests left the Holy Place. All the priests who were present had purified themselves, whether or not they were on duty that day.
verses.textEnNasb: When the priests came out from the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, without regard to divisions),
verses.textEn: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.

verses.textZh: 全体负责歌唱的利未人和亚萨、希幔、耶杜顿，以及他们的儿子和亲族，都穿著细麻布的衣服，站在祭坛的东边，敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴；和他们在一起的，还有一百二十个祭司吹号；
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体负责歌唱的利未人和亚萨、希幔、耶杜顿，以及他们的儿子和亲族，都穿著细麻布的衣服，站在祭坛的东边，敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴；和他们在一起的，还有一百二十个祭司吹号；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们出圣所的时候，歌唱的利未人亚萨、希幔、耶杜顿，和他们的众子众弟兄都穿细麻布衣服，站在坛的东边，敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，同着他们有一百二十个祭司吹号。
verses.textEnNiv: All the Levites who were musicians—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps and lyres. They were accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: and all the Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, their sons and kinsmen, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, stood east of the altar with 120 priests who were trumpeters;
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Levites whowere the singers, all those of Asaph and Heman and Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, stood at the east end of the altar, clothed in white linen, having cymbals, stringed instruments and harps, and with them one hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets—
verses.textEnNlt: And the Levites who were musicians—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and all their sons and brothers—were dressed in fine linen robes and stood at the east side of the altar playing cymbals, lyres, and harps. They were joined by 120 priests who were playing trumpets.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and kinsmen, clothed in fine linen, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, standing east of the altar, and with them 120 priests blowing trumpets
verses.textEn: All the Levites who were musicians—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps and lyres. They were accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.

verses.textZh: 吹号的和歌唱的都一致同声地赞美称谢耶和华。他们吹号、敲钹，用各种乐器高声赞美耶和华，说："耶和华是良善的，他的慈爱永远长存。"那时云彩充满了那殿，就是耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吹号的和歌唱的都一致同声地赞美称谢耶和华。他们吹号、敲钹，用各种乐器高声赞美耶和华，说："耶和华是良善的，他的慈爱永远长存。"那时云彩充满了那殿，就是耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 吹号的、歌唱的都一齐发声，声合为一，赞美感谢耶和华。吹号、敲钹，用各种乐器，扬声赞美耶和华说： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！ 那时，耶和华的殿有云充满，
verses.textEnNiv: The trumpeters and musicians joined in unison to give praise and thanks to the Lord . Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals and other instruments, the singers raised their voices in praise to the Lord and sang: "He is good; his love endures forever." Then the temple of the Lord was filled with the cloud,
verses.textEnEsv: and it was the duty of the trumpeters and singers to make themselves heard in unison in praise and thanksgiving to the Lord ), and when the song was raised, with trumpets and cymbals and other musical instruments, in praise to the Lord , "For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever," the house, the house of the Lord , was filled with a cloud,
verses.textEnNkjv: indeed it came to pass, when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord, and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the Lord, saying: "For He is good, For His mercy endures forever," that the house, the house of the Lord, was filled with a cloud,
verses.textEnNlt: The trumpeters and singers performed together in unison to praise and give thanks to the Lord . Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and other instruments, they raised their voices and praised the Lord with these words: "He is good! His faithful love endures forever!" At that moment a thick cloud filled the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: in unison when the trumpeters and the singers were to make themselves heard with one voice to praise and to glorify the Lord, and when they raised their voices accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and other musical instruments, and when they praised the Lordsaying, "He indeed is good for His kindness is everlasting," then the house, the house of the Lord, was filled with a cloud,
verses.textEn: The trumpeters and musicians joined in unison to give praise and thanks to the Lord . Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals and other instruments, the singers raised their voices in praise to the Lord and sang: "He is good; his love endures forever." Then the temple of the Lord was filled with the cloud,

verses.textZh: 由于那云彩的缘故，祭司都不能侍立供职，因为神的殿充满了耶和华的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 由于那云彩的缘故，祭司都不能侍立供职，因为神的殿充满了耶和华的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: and the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the temple of God.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that the priests could not continue ministering because of the cloud; for the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests could not continue their service because of the cloud, for the glorious presence of the Lord filled the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the priests could not rise to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.
verses.textEn: and the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the temple of God.

verses.textZh: 那时所罗门说： "耶和华曾说他要住在幽暗之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时所罗门说： "耶和华曾说他要住在幽暗之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，所罗门说： 耶和华曾说他必住在幽暗之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that he would dwell in thick darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon spoke: "The Lord said He would dwell in the dark cloud.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon prayed, "O Lord , you have said that you would live in a thick cloud of darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that He would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

verses.textZh: 我已经为你建造了巍峨的殿宇， 作你永远居住的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经为你建造了巍峨的殿宇， 作你永远居住的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我已经建造殿宇作你的居所， 为你永远的住处。
verses.textEnNiv: I have built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever."
verses.textEnEsv: But I have built you an exalted house, a place for you to dwell in forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: I have surely built You an exalted house, And a place for You to dwell in forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Now I have built a glorious Temple for you, a place where you can live forever!"
verses.textEnNasb: "I have built You a lofty house, And a place for Your dwelling forever."
verses.textEn: I have built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever."

verses.textZh: 然后王转过来，给以色列全体会众祝福，以色列全体会众都站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后王转过来，给以色列全体会众祝福，以色列全体会众都站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。
verses.textEnNiv: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel stood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king turned around and blessed the whole assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel was standing.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king turned around to the entire community of Israel standing before him and gave this blessing:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel was standing.
verses.textEn: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

verses.textZh: 所罗门说："耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的！他亲口对我的父亲大卫应许的，已亲手作成了，他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门说："耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的！他亲口对我的父亲大卫应许的，已亲手作成了，他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门说：「耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David. For he said,
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hand has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to David my father, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His hands what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who has kept the promise he made to my father, David. For he told my father,
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who spoke with His mouth to my father David, and fulfilled it with His hands, saying,
verses.textEn: Then he said: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David. For he said,

verses.textZh: ‘自从我领我的子民从埃及地出来的那天，我没有在以色列众支派中，拣选一座城建造殿宇，使我的名留在那里；我也没有拣选一个人作领袖，统治我的子民以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘自从我领我的子民从埃及地出来的那天，我没有在以色列众支派中，拣选一座城建造殿宇，使我的名留在那里；我也没有拣选一个人作领袖，统治我的子民以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：『自从我领我民出埃及地以来，我未曾在以色列众支派中选择一城建造殿宇为我名的居所，也未曾拣选一人作我民以色列的君；
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Since the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house, that my name might be there, and I chose no man as prince over my people Israel;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Since the day that I brought My people out of the land of Egypt, I have chosen no city from any tribe of Israel inwhich to build a house, that My name might be there, nor did I choose any man to be a ruler over My people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘From the day I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I have never chosen a city among any of the tribes of Israel as the place where a Temple should be built to honor my name. Nor have I chosen a king to lead my people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Since the day that I brought My people from the land of Egypt, I did not choose a city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house, so that My name might be there, nor did I choose a man to be the leader over My people Israel;
verses.textEn: ‘Since the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over my people Israel.

verses.textZh: 我却拣选了耶路撒冷，使我的名留在那里；也拣选了大卫，统治我的子民以色列。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却拣选了耶路撒冷，使我的名留在那里；也拣选了大卫，统治我的子民以色列。’
verses.textZhCuv: 但选择耶路撒冷为我名的居所，又拣选大卫治理我民以色列。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for my Name to be there, and I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: but I have chosen Jerusalem that my name may be there, and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I have chosen Jerusalem, that My name may be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
verses.textEnNlt: But now I have chosen Jerusalem as the place for my name to be honored, and I have chosen David to be king over my people Israel.’"
verses.textEnNasb: but I have chosen Jerusalem so that My name might be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
verses.textEn: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for my Name to be there, and I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’

verses.textZh: 我的父亲大卫有心要为耶和华以色列的神的名建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的父亲大卫有心要为耶和华以色列的神的名建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门说：「我父大卫曾立意要为耶和华－以色列神的名建殿，
verses.textEnNiv: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a temple for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon said, "My father, David, wanted to build this Temple to honor the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华却对我的父亲大卫说：‘你心想要为我的名建造殿宇，你心意很好；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华却对我的父亲大卫说：‘你心想要为我的名建造殿宇，你心意很好；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：『你立意要为我的名建殿，这意思甚好；
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a temple for My name, you did well in that it was in your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord told him, ‘You wanted to build the Temple to honor my name. Your intention is good,
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘Because it was in your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.

verses.textZh: 不过不是由你建造殿宇，而是你的儿子，你亲生的儿子，他必为我的名建殿。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过不是由你建造殿宇，而是你的儿子，你亲生的儿子，他必为我的名建殿。’
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。』
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, it is not you who shall build the house, but your son who shall be born to you shall build the house for my name.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless you shall not build the temple, but your son who will come from your body, he shall build the temple for My name.’
verses.textEnNlt: but you are not the one to do it. One of your own sons will build the Temple to honor me.’
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will be born to you, he shall build the house for My name.’
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’

verses.textZh: 现在耶和华实现了他所说过的话，我已经起来接续我的父亲大卫，坐上了以色列的王位，就像耶和华所说的；我为耶和华以色列的神的名建造了这殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在耶和华实现了他所说过的话，我已经起来接续我的父亲大卫，坐上了以色列的王位，就像耶和华所说的；我为耶和华以色列的神的名建造了这殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，是照耶和华所说的，又为耶和华－以色列神的名建造了殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord has kept the promise he made. I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord has fulfilled his promise that he made. For I have risen in the place of David my father and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and I have built the house for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord has fulfilled His word which He spoke, and I have filled the position of my father David, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised; and I have built the temple for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now the Lord has fulfilled the promise he made, for I have become king in my father’s place, and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised. I have built this Temple to honor the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord has fulfilled His word which He spoke; for I have risen in place of my father David and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built the house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: "The Lord has kept the promise he made. I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我也把约柜安放在殿里，约柜中有耶和华和以色列人所立的约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也把约柜安放在殿里，约柜中有耶和华和以色列人所立的约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我将约柜安置在其中，柜内有耶和华的约，就是他与以色列人所立的约。」
verses.textEnNiv: There I have placed the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with the people of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And there I have set the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And there I have put the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord which He made with the children of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: There I have placed the Ark, which contains the covenant that the Lord made with the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: There I have placed the ark in which is the covenant of the Lord, which He made with the sons of Israel."
verses.textEn: There I have placed the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with the people of Israel."

verses.textZh: 所罗门在以色列全体会众面前，站在耶和华的祭坛前，张开双手；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在以色列全体会众面前，站在耶和华的祭坛前，张开双手；
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，举起手来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the entire community of Israel, and he lifted his hands in prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

verses.textZh: 原来所罗门做了一座铜台，长两公尺两公寸，宽两公尺两公寸，高一公尺三公寸，安放在外院中。那时他站在铜台上，在以色列全体会众面前，屈膝下跪，向天张开双手，
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来所罗门做了一座铜台，长两公尺两公寸，宽两公尺两公寸，高一公尺三公寸，安放在外院中。那时他站在铜台上，在以色列全体会众面前，屈膝下跪，向天张开双手，
verses.textZhCuv: （所罗门曾造一个铜台，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，放在院中）就站在台上，当着以色列的会众跪下，向天举手，
verses.textEnNiv: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the court, and he stood on it. Then he knelt on his knees in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court; and he stood on it, knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven);
verses.textEnNlt: Now Solomon had made a bronze platform 7-1/2 feet long, 7-1/2 feet wide, and 4-1/2 feet high and had placed it at the center of the Temple’s outer courtyard. He stood on the platform, and then he knelt in front of the entire community of Israel and lifted his hands toward heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: For Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the courtyard; and he stood on it, knelt on his knees in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.
verses.textEn: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

verses.textZh: 说："耶和华以色列的神啊，天上地下没有神可以和你相比的，你向那些一心行在你面前的仆人，常是守约施慈爱的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："耶和华以色列的神啊，天上地下没有神可以和你相比的，你向那些一心行在你面前的仆人，常是守约施慈爱的；
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「耶和华－以色列的神啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；
verses.textEnNiv: He said: " Lord , the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "O Lord , God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven or on earth, keeping covenant and showing steadfast love to your servants who walk before you with all their heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: and he said: "Lord God of Israel, thereis no God in heaven or on earth like You, who keep Your covenant and mercy with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: He prayed, "O Lord , God of Israel, there is no God like you in all of heaven and earth. You keep your covenant and show unfailing love to all who walk before you in wholehearted devotion.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Lord, God of Israel, there is no god like You in heaven or on earth, keeping Your covenant and Your faithfulness to Your servants who walk before You with all their heart;
verses.textEn: He said: " Lord , the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

verses.textZh: 你对你的仆人我父亲大卫所应许的，你都遵守了，你亲口应许，也亲手成全，就像今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你对你的仆人我父亲大卫所应许的，你都遵守了，你亲口应许，也亲手成全，就像今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 向你仆人－我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: who have kept with your servant David my father what you declared to him. You spoke with your mouth, and with your hand have fulfilled it this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have kept what You promised Your servant David my father; You have both spoken with Your mouth and fulfilled it with Your hand, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: You have kept your promise to your servant David, my father. You made that promise with your own mouth, and with your own hands you have fulfilled it today.
verses.textEnNasb: You who have kept with Your servant, my father David, that which You promised him; You have spoken with Your mouth and have fulfilled it with Your hand, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神啊，你应许你的仆人我父亲大卫说：‘只要你的子孙谨守他们的行为，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一样，你就不会断人在我面前坐上以色列的王位。’现在求你应验这话吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神啊，你应许你的仆人我父亲大卫说：‘只要你的子孙谨守他们的行为，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一样，你就不会断人在我面前坐上以色列的王位。’现在求你应验这话吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神啊，你所应许你仆人－我父大卫的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』现在求你应验这话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, Lord , the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, O Lord , God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father what you have promised him, saying, ‘You shall not lack a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your sons pay close attention to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, Lord God of Israel, now keep what You promised Your servant David my father, saying, ‘You shall not fail to have a man sit before Me on the throne of Israel, only if your sons take heed to their way, that they walk in My law as you have walked before Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, O Lord , God of Israel, carry out the additional promise you made to your servant David, my father. For you said to him, ‘If your descendants guard their behavior and faithfully follow my Law as you have done, one of them will always sit on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, Lord, God of Israel, keep to Your servant David, my father, that which You promised him, saying, ‘ You shall not lack a man to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your sons pay attention to their way, to walk in My Law as you have walked before Me.’
verses.textEn: "Now, Lord , the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神啊，现在求你实现你向你的仆人大卫应许的话吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神啊，现在求你实现你向你的仆人大卫应许的话吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神啊，求你成就向你仆人大卫所应许的话。
verses.textEnNiv: And now, Lord , the God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David come true.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, O Lord , God of Israel, let your word be confirmed, which you have spoken to your servant David.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, O Lord God of Israel, let Your word come true, which You have spoken to Your servant David.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, O Lord , God of Israel, fulfill this promise to your servant David.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, Lord, God of Israel, let Your word be confirmed which You have spoken to Your servant David.
verses.textEn: And now, Lord , the God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David come true.

verses.textZh: "神真的要和人住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天也容不下你，何况我建造的这殿呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "神真的要和人住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天也容不下你，何况我建造的这殿呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「神果真与世人同住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "But will God really dwell on earth with humans? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!
verses.textEnEsv: "But will God indeed dwell with man on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you, how much less this house that I have built!
verses.textEnNkjv: "But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain You. How much less this temple which I have built!
verses.textEnNlt: "But will God really live on earth among people? Why, even the highest heavens cannot contain you. How much less this Temple I have built!
verses.textEnNasb: "But will God really dwell with mankind on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain You; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.textEn: "But will God really dwell on earth with humans? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊，求你垂注你仆人的祷告和祈求，聆听你仆人在你面前所发的呼喊和祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊，求你垂注你仆人的祷告和祈求，聆听你仆人在你面前所发的呼喊和祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟求耶和华－我的神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人在你面前的祈祷呼吁。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet, Lord my God, give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet have regard to the prayer of your servant and to his plea, O Lord my God, listening to the cry and to the prayer that your servant prays before you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet regard the prayer of Your servant and his supplication, O Lord my God, and listen to the cry and the prayer which Your servant is praying before You:
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, listen to my prayer and my plea, O Lord my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is making to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, turn Your attention to the prayer of Your servant and to his plea, Lord, my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which Your servant prays before You;
verses.textEn: Yet, Lord my God, give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence.

verses.textZh: 求你张开眼睛，昼夜看顾这殿，就是看顾你所说要立你名的地方；求你垂听你仆人向着这地方所发的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你张开眼睛，昼夜看顾这殿，就是看顾你所说要立你名的地方；求你垂听你仆人向着这地方所发的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。
verses.textEnNiv: May your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, this place of which you said you would put your Name there. May you hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.
verses.textEnEsv: that your eyes may be open day and night toward this house, the place where you have promised to set your name, that you may listen to the prayer that your servant offers toward this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Your eyes may be open toward this temple day and night, toward the place where You said Youwould put Your name, that You may hear the prayer which Your servant makes toward this place.
verses.textEnNlt: May you watch over this Temple day and night, this place where you have said you would put your name. May you always hear the prayers I make toward this place.
verses.textEnNasb: that Your eye will be open toward this house day and night, toward the place of which You have said that You would put Your name there, to listen to the prayer which Your servant shall pray toward this place.
verses.textEn: May your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, this place of which you said you would put your Name there. May you hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.

verses.textZh: 求你垂听你的仆人和你的子民以色列的祈求，就是他们向着这地方所发的祷告；求你从天上，从你的居所垂听，垂听和赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你垂听你的仆人和你的子民以色列的祈求，就是他们向着这地方所发的祷告；求你从天上，从你的居所垂听，垂听和赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你从天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear the supplications of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.
verses.textEnEsv: And listen to the pleas of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. And listen from heaven your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.
verses.textEnNkjv: And may You hear the supplications of Your servant and of Your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven Your dwelling place, and when You hear, forgive.
verses.textEnNlt: May you hear the humble and earnest requests from me and your people Israel when we pray toward this place. Yes, hear us from heaven where you live, and when you hear, forgive.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to the pleadings of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place; hear from Your dwelling place, from heaven; hear and forgive.
verses.textEn: Hear the supplications of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

verses.textZh: "人若是得罪了邻舍，有人要他起誓，他就来到这殿，在你的祭坛前起誓；
verses.textZhCnvs: "人若是得罪了邻舍，有人要他起誓，他就来到这殿，在你的祭坛前起誓；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿，在你的坛前起誓，
verses.textEnNiv: "When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man sins against his neighbor and is made to take an oath and comes and swears his oath before your altar in this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If anyone sins against his neighbor, and is forced to take an oath, and comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this temple,
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone wrongs another person and is required to take an oath of innocence in front of your altar at this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: "If someone sins against his neighbor and is made to take an oath, and he comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this house,
verses.textEn: "When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,

verses.textZh: 求你从天上垂听，施行你的作为，审判你的仆人，照着恶人所行的报应在他头上；宣告义人无罪，照着他的义行赏赐他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上垂听，施行你的作为，审判你的仆人，照着恶人所行的报应在他头上；宣告义人无罪，照着他的义行赏赐他。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上垂听，判断你的仆人，定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty and bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear from heaven and act and judge your servants, repaying the guilty by bringing his conduct on his own head, and vindicating the righteous by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear from heaven, and act, and judge Your servants, bringing retribution on the wicked by bringing his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven and judge between your servants—the accuser and the accused. Pay back the guilty as they deserve. Acquit the innocent because of their innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear from heaven and take action and judge Your servants, punishing the wicked by bringing his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous by repaying him according to his righteousness.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty and bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.

verses.textZh: "如果你的子民以色列得罪了你，以致在仇敌面前被击败；后来回心转意，承认你的名，在这殿里向你祷告祈求，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你的子民以色列得罪了你，以致在仇敌面前被击败；后来回心转意，承认你的名，在这殿里向你祷告祈求，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又回心转意承认你的名，在这殿里向你祈求祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you and when they turn back and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication before you in this temple,
verses.textEnEsv: "If your people Israel are defeated before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and acknowledge your name and pray and plead with you in this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or if Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and return and confess Your name, and pray and make supplication before You in this temple,
verses.textEnNlt: "If your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you, and if they turn back and acknowledge your name and pray to you here in this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: "If Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and praise Your name, and pray and plead before You in this house,
verses.textEn: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you and when they turn back and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication before you in this temple,

verses.textZh: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你子民以色列的罪，领他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖的土地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你子民以色列的罪，领他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖的土地。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖之地。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them again to the land that you gave to them and to their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them back to the land which You gave to them and their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and return them to this land you gave to them and to their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them back to the land which You have given to them and to their fathers.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their ancestors.

verses.textZh: "你的子民因得罪了你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨；如果他们向着这地方祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的子民因得罪了你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨；如果他们向着这地方祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨，他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
verses.textEnNiv: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,
verses.textEnEsv: "When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and acknowledge your name and turn from their sin, when you afflict them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, when they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and turn from their sin because You afflict them,
verses.textEnNlt: "If the skies are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and if they pray toward this Temple and acknowledge your name and turn from their sins because you have punished them,
verses.textEnNasb: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and praise Your name, and turn from their sin when You afflict them,
verses.textEn: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

verses.textZh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你的仆人和你的子民以色列的罪，把他们当行的正道指教他们，降雨在你的地上，就是你赐给你的子民作产业的地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你的仆人和你的子民以色列的罪，把他们当行的正道指教他们，降雨在你的地上，就是你赐给你的子民作产业的地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你民以色列的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and grant rain upon your land, which you have given to your people as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on Your land which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven and forgive the sins of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them to follow the right path, and send rain on your land that you have given to your people as their special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants and Your people Israel; indeed, teach them the good way in which they are to walk. And provide rain on Your land, which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

verses.textZh: "国中若是有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或是有仇敌围困城镇，或是有甚么灾祸，甚么疾病，
verses.textZhCnvs: "国中若是有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或是有仇敌围困城镇，或是有甚么灾祸，甚么疾病，
verses.textZhCuv: 「国中若有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境，围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，
verses.textEnNiv: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,
verses.textEnEsv: "If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence or blight or mildew or locust or caterpillar, if their enemies besiege them in the land at their gates, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When there is famine in the land, pestilence or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers; when their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness thereis;
verses.textEnNlt: "If there is a famine in the land or a plague or crop disease or attacks of locusts or caterpillars, or if your people’s enemies are in the land besieging their towns—whatever disaster or disease there is—
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is a famine in the land, if there is a plague, if there is blight or mildew, if there is locust or grasshopper, if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities, whatever plague or whatever sickness there is,
verses.textEn: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

verses.textZh: 你的子民以色列，无论是个别或是全体，自知自己的灾祸和痛苦，向着这殿张开双手祷告或祈求，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的子民以色列，无论是个别或是全体，自知自己的灾祸和痛苦，向着这殿张开双手祷告或祈求，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉灾祸甚苦，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，
verses.textEnNiv: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of their afflictions and pains, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—
verses.textEnEsv: whatever prayer, whatever plea is made by any man or by all your people Israel, each knowing his own affliction and his own sorrow and stretching out his hands toward this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: whatever prayer, whatever supplication is made by anyone, or by all Your people Israel, when each one knows his own burden and his own grief, and spreads out his hands to this temple:
verses.textEnNlt: and if your people Israel pray about their troubles or sorrow, raising their hands toward this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: whatever prayer or plea is made by anyone or by all Your people Israel, each knowing his own affliction and his own pain, and spreading his hands toward this house,
verses.textEn: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of their afflictions and pains, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—

verses.textZh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听和赦免他们，你是知道人心的，你必照着各人所行的报应各人；因为只有你知道世人的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上你的居所垂听和赦免他们，你是知道人心的，你必照着各人所行的报应各人；因为只有你知道世人的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive, and deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know the human heart),
verses.textEnEsv: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive and render to each whose heart you know, according to all his ways, for you, you only, know the hearts of the children of mankind,
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear from heaven Your dwelling place, and forgive, and give to everyone according to all his ways, whose heart You know (for You alone know the hearts of the sons of men),
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven where you live, and forgive. Give your people what their actions deserve, for you alone know each human heart.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and forgive, and render to each according to all his ways, whose heart You know—for You alone know the hearts of the sons of mankind—
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive, and deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know the human heart),

verses.textZh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖的地上，一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖的地上，一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。
verses.textEnNiv: so that they will fear you and walk in obedience to you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may fear you and walk in your ways all the days that they live in the land that you gave to our fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they may fear You, to walk in Your ways as long as they live in the land which You gave to our fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will fear you and walk in your ways as long as they live in the land you gave to our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: so that they may fear You, to walk in Your ways as long as they live in the land which You have given to our fathers.
verses.textEn: so that they will fear you and walk in obedience to you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.

verses.textZh: "至于在你的子民以色列以外的外族人，他们为了你的大名、你大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来；他们来向着这殿祷告的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于在你的子民以色列以外的外族人，他们为了你的大名、你大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来；他们来向着这殿祷告的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来，向这殿祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,
verses.textEnEsv: "Likewise, when a foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, comes from a far country for the sake of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when he comes and prays toward this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover, concerning a foreigner, who is not of Your people Israel, but has come from a far country for the sake of Your great name and Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm, when they come and pray in this temple;
verses.textEnNlt: "In the future, foreigners who do not belong to your people Israel will hear of you. They will come from distant lands when they hear of your great name and your strong hand and your powerful arm. And when they pray toward this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: "Also concerning the foreigner who is not from Your people Israel, when he comes from a far country on account of Your great name and Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,
verses.textEn: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,

verses.textZh: 求你从天上，从你的居所垂听他们，照着外族人向你呼求的一切而行，使地上万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的子民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿，是奉为你名的所在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上，从你的居所垂听他们，照着外族人向你呼求的一切而行，使地上万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的子民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿，是奉为你名的所在。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一样，又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.
verses.textEnEsv: hear from heaven your dwelling place and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to you, in order that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house that I have built is called by your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear from heaven Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You, that all peoples of the earth may know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that this temple which I have built is called by Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven where you live, and grant what they ask of you. In this way, all the people of the earth will come to know and fear you, just as your own people Israel do. They, too, will know that this Temple I have built honors your name.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear from heaven, from Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You, so that all the peoples of the earth may know Your name, and fear You as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by Your name.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

verses.textZh: "如果你的子民在你派他们出去的路上，和仇敌作战，他们向着你拣选的这城，和向着我为你的名建造的这殿向你祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你的子民在你派他们出去的路上，和仇敌作战，他们向着你拣选的这城，和向着我为你的名建造的这殿向你祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向你所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to you toward this city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,
verses.textEnEsv: "If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to you toward this city that you have chosen and the house that I have built for your name,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When Your people go out to battle against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to You toward this city which You have chosen and the temple which I have built for Your name,
verses.textEnNlt: "If your people go out where you send them to fight their enemies, and if they pray to you by turning toward this city you have chosen and toward this Temple I have built to honor your name,
verses.textEnNasb: "When Your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way You send them, and they pray to You toward this city which You have chosen and the house which I have built for Your name,
verses.textEn: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to you toward this city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

verses.textZh: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and maintain their cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear their prayers from heaven and uphold their cause.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear from heaven their prayer and their pleading, and maintain their cause.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

verses.textZh: "如果你的子民得罪了你 ，你向他们发怒，把他们交在仇敌面前，以致仇敌把他们掳到外地或远或近；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你的子民得罪了你 ，你向他们发怒，把他们交在仇敌面前，以致仇敌把他们掳到外地或远或近；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到或远或近之地；
verses.textEnNiv: "When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to a land far away or near;
verses.textEnEsv: "If they sin against you— for there is no one who does not sin—and you are angry with them and give them to an enemy, so that they are carried away captive to a land far or near,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When they sin against You (for thereis no one who does not sin), and You become angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, and they take them captive to a land far or near;
verses.textEnNlt: "If they sin against you—and who has never sinned?—you might become angry with them and let their enemies conquer them and take them captive to a foreign land far away or near.
verses.textEnNasb: "When they sin against You (for there is no one who does not sin), and You are angry with them and turn them over to an enemy, so that they take them away captive to a land far off or near,
verses.textEn: "When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to a land far away or near;

verses.textZh: 如果他们在被掳去的地方回心转意，在被掳去的地方祈求你说：‘我们犯了罪了，我们作了孽了，我们行了恶了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们在被掳去的地方回心转意，在被掳去的地方祈求你说：‘我们犯了罪了，我们作了孽了，我们行了恶了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：『我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了』；
verses.textEnNiv: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly’;
verses.textEnEsv: yet if they turn their heart in the land to which they have been carried captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned and have acted perversely and wickedly,’
verses.textEnNkjv: yet when they come to themselves in the land where they were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication to You in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, and have committed wickedness’;
verses.textEnNlt: But in that land of exile, they might turn to you in repentance and pray, ‘We have sinned, done evil, and acted wickedly.’
verses.textEnNasb: if they take it to heart in the land where they are taken captive, and repent and plead to You in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong and have acted wickedly’;
verses.textEn: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly’;

verses.textZh: 如果他们在被掳去的地方一心一意归向你，又向着他们自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖的地，和向着你拣选的这城，以及向着我为你的名建造的这殿祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们在被掳去的地方一心一意归向你，又向着他们自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖的地，和向着你拣选的这城，以及向着我为你的名建造的这殿祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;
verses.textEnEsv: if they repent with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity to which they were carried captive, and pray toward their land, which you gave to their fathers, the city that you have chosen and the house that I have built for your name,
verses.textEnNkjv: and when they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been carried captive, and pray toward their land which You gave to their fathers, the city which You have chosen, and toward the temple which I have built for Your name:
verses.textEnNlt: If they turn to you with their whole heart and soul in the land of their captivity and pray toward the land you gave to their ancestors—toward this city you have chosen, and toward this Temple I have built to honor your name—
verses.textEnNasb: if they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which You have given to their fathers and the city which You have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for Your name,
verses.textEn: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;

verses.textZh: 求你从天上，从你的居所垂听他们的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免得罪了你的那些子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上，从你的居所垂听他们的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免得罪了你的那些子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上你的居所垂听你民的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免他们的过犯。
verses.textEnNiv: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause. And forgive your people, who have sinned against you.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear from heaven your dwelling place their prayer and their pleas, and maintain their cause and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear from heaven Your dwelling place their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear their prayers and their petitions from heaven where you live, and uphold their cause. Forgive your people who have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear from heaven, from Your dwelling place, their prayer and pleadings, and maintain their cause, and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.
verses.textEn: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause. And forgive your people, who have sinned against you.

verses.textZh: "我的神啊，现在求你张开眼睛，求你的耳朵垂听在这地方献上的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的神啊，现在求你张开眼睛，求你的耳朵垂听在这地方献上的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的神啊，现在求你睁眼看，侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
verses.textEnEsv: Now, O my God, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayer of this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, my God, I pray, let Your eyes be open and let Your ears be attentive to the prayer made in this place.
verses.textEnNlt: "O my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to all the prayers made to you in this place.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, my God, please, let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.
verses.textEn: "Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

verses.textZh: 现在，耶和华神啊，求你起来，愿你和你有大能的约柜进入你安息的地方；耶和华神啊，愿你的祭司都披上救恩；愿你的圣民在福乐中欢欣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，耶和华神啊，求你起来，愿你和你有大能的约柜进入你安息的地方；耶和华神啊，愿你的祭司都披上救恩；愿你的圣民在福乐中欢欣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神啊，求你起来， 和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所。 耶和华神啊，愿你的祭司披上救恩； 愿你的圣民蒙福欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now arise, Lord God, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. May your priests, Lord God, be clothed with salvation, may your faithful people rejoice in your goodness.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now arise, O Lord God, and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. Let your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in your goodness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, Arise, O Lord God, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength. Let Your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, And let Your saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now arise, O Lord God, and enter your resting place, along with the Ark, the symbol of your power. May your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation; may your loyal servants rejoice in your goodness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then arise, Lord God, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might; let Your priests, Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let Your godly ones rejoice in what is good.
verses.textEn: "Now arise, Lord God, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. May your priests, Lord God, be clothed with salvation, may your faithful people rejoice in your goodness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神啊，求你不要转脸不顾你所膏的人：愿你记念你向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神啊，求你不要转脸不顾你所膏的人：愿你记念你向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神啊，求你不要厌弃你的受膏者， 要记念向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。」
verses.textEnNiv: Lord God, do not reject your anointed one. Remember the great love promised to David your servant."
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord God, do not turn away the face of your anointed one! Remember your steadfast love for David your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Lord God, do not turn away the face of Your Anointed; Remember the mercies of Your servant David."
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord God, do not reject the king you have anointed. Remember your unfailing love for your servant David."
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord God, do not turn away the face of Your anointed; remember Your faithfulness to Your servant David."
verses.textEn: Lord God, do not reject your anointed one. Remember the great love promised to David your servant."

verses.textZh: 所罗门祷告完了，有火从天上降下来，烧尽了燔祭和其他的祭品；耶和华的荣光充满了那殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门祷告完了，有火从天上降下来，烧尽了燔祭和其他的祭品；耶和华的荣光充满了那殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门祈祷已毕，就有火从天上降下来，烧尽燔祭和别的祭。耶和华的荣光充满了殿；
verses.textEnNiv: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Solomon finished his prayer, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: When Solomon finished praying, fire flashed down from heaven and burned up the burnt offerings and sacrifices, and the glorious presence of the Lord filled the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.textEn: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华的殿，祭司都不能进入耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华的殿，祭司都不能进入耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华殿，所以祭司不能进殿。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests could not enter the temple of the Lord because the glory of the Lord filled it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priests could not enter the house of the Lord , because the glory of the Lord filled the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priests could not enter the house of the Lord, because the glory of the Lord had filled the Lord’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests could not enter the Temple of the Lord because the glorious presence of the Lord filled it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priests could not enter the house of the Lord because the glory of the Lord filled the Lord’s house.
verses.textEn: The priests could not enter the temple of the Lord because the glory of the Lord filled it.

verses.textZh: 那火降下，耶和华的荣光停在殿上的时候，以色列众人都看见；于是他们在铺石地跪下，俯伏在地，敬拜称颂耶和华说："耶和华是良善的，他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那火降下，耶和华的荣光停在殿上的时候，以色列众人都看见；于是他们在铺石地跪下，俯伏在地，敬拜称颂耶和华说："耶和华是良善的，他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那火降下、耶和华的荣光在殿上的时候，以色列众人看见，就在铺石地俯伏叩拜，称谢耶和华说： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the Lord above the temple, they knelt on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the Lord , saying, "He is good; his love endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: When all the people of Israel saw the fire come down and the glory of the Lord on the temple, they bowed down with their faces to the ground on the pavement and worshiped and gave thanks to the Lord , saying, "For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever."
