verses.textEnNkjv: When all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord on the temple, they bowed their faces to the ground on the pavement, and worshiped and praised the Lord, saying: "For Heis good, For His mercy endures forever."
verses.textEnNlt: When all the people of Israel saw the fire coming down and the glorious presence of the Lord filling the Temple, they fell face down on the ground and worshiped and praised the Lord , saying, "He is good! His faithful love endures forever!"
verses.textEnNasb: All the sons of Israel, seeing the fire come down and the glory of the Lord upon the house, bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave praise to the Lord, saying, "Certainly He is good, certainly His faithfulness is everlasting."
verses.textEn: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the Lord above the temple, they knelt on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the Lord , saying, "He is good; his love endures forever."

verses.textZh: 王和全体人民都在耶和华面前献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和全体人民都在耶和华面前献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 王和众民在耶和华面前献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 所罗门王献上了二万二千头牛、十二万只羊为祭。这样，王和全体人民为神的殿举行了奉献礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王献上了二万二千头牛、十二万只羊为祭。这样，王和全体人民为神的殿举行了奉献礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王用牛二万二千，羊十二万献祭。这样，王和众民为神的殿行奉献之礼。
verses.textEnNiv: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon offered as a sacrifice 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand bulls and one hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep and goats. And so the king and all the people dedicated the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
verses.textEn: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.

verses.textZh: 祭司都站在自己的岗位上；利未人也站着，拿着大卫王所做的耶和华的乐器，称颂耶和华，因为他的慈爱永远长存；大卫借着他们赞美耶和华的时候，祭司在众人前面吹号；以色列众人都站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司都站在自己的岗位上；利未人也站着，拿着大卫王所做的耶和华的乐器，称颂耶和华，因为他的慈爱永远长存；大卫借着他们赞美耶和华的时候，祭司在众人前面吹号；以色列众人都站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司侍立，各供其职；利未人也拿着耶和华的乐器，就是大卫王造出来、藉利未人颂赞耶和华的。（他的慈爱永远长存！）祭司在众人面前吹号，以色列人都站立。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests took their positions, as did the Levites with the Lord ’s musical instruments, which King David had made for praising the Lord and which were used when he gave thanks, saying, "His love endures forever." Opposite the Levites, the priests blew their trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.
verses.textEnEsv: The priests stood at their posts; the Levites also, with the instruments for music to the Lord that King David had made for giving thanks to the Lord — for his steadfast love endures forever—whenever David offered praises by their ministry; opposite them the priests sounded trumpets, and all Israel stood.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priests attended to their services; the Levites also with instruments of the music of the Lord, which King David had made to praise the Lord, saying, "For His mercy endures forever," whenever David offered praise by their ministry. The priests sounded trumpets opposite them, while all Israel stood.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests took their assigned positions, and so did the Levites who were singing, "His faithful love endures forever!" They accompanied the singing with music from the instruments King David had made for praising the Lord . Across from the Levites, the priests blew the trumpets, while all Israel stood.
verses.textEnNasb: The priests stood at their posts, and the Levites also, with the musical instruments for the Lord, which King David had made for giving praise to the Lord—"for His faithfulness is everlasting"—whenever David gave praise through their ministry; the priests on the other side blew trumpets and all Israel was standing.
verses.textEn: The priests took their positions, as did the Levites with the Lord ’s musical instruments, which King David had made for praising the Lord and which were used when he gave thanks, saying, "His love endures forever." Opposite the Levites, the priests blew their trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.

verses.textZh: 所罗门把耶和华殿前院子当中的地方分别为圣，在那里献上了燔祭和平安祭的脂肪，因为所罗门所做的铜坛容不下所有的燔祭、素祭和脂肪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门把耶和华殿前院子当中的地方分别为圣，在那里献上了燔祭和平安祭的脂肪，因为所罗门所做的铜坛容不下所有的燔祭、素祭和脂肪。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门因他所造的铜坛容不下燔祭、素祭，和脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar he had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat portions.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon consecrated the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord , for there he offered the burnt offering and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar Solomon had made could not hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore Solomon consecrated the middle of the court that was in front of the house of the Lord; for there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the fat.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon then consecrated the central area of the courtyard in front of the Lord ’s Temple. He offered burnt offerings and the fat of peace offerings there, because the bronze altar he had built could not hold all the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and sacrificial fat.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard that was before the house of the Lord, for he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings there, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to contain the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the fat.
verses.textEn: Solomon consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar he had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat portions.

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门和全体以色列人，就是来自哈马口，直到埃及小河的一群极大的会众，一起举行了七天的节期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门和全体以色列人，就是来自哈马口，直到埃及小河的一群极大的会众，一起举行了七天的节期。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成为大会，守节七日。
verses.textEnNiv: So Solomon observed the festival at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Solomon held the feast for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the Brook of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: For the next seven days Solomon and all Israel celebrated the Festival of Shelters. A large congregation had gathered from as far away as Lebo-hamath in the north and the Brook of Egypt in the south.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly that came from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.
verses.textEn: So Solomon observed the festival at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 第八天举行了严肃会，又举行献坛礼七天，举行了七天的节期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八天举行了严肃会，又举行献坛礼七天，举行了七天的节期。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八日设立严肃会，行奉献坛的礼七日，守节七日。
verses.textEnNiv: On the eighth day they held an assembly, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days more.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for they had kept the dedication of the altar seven days and the feast seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the eighth day they held a sacred assembly, for they observed the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: On the eighth day they had a closing ceremony, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the Festival of Shelters for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, because they held the dedication of the altar for seven days, and the feast for seven days.
verses.textEn: On the eighth day they held an assembly, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days more.

verses.textZh: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民回家；他们因看见耶和华向大卫、所罗门和他的子民以色列所施的恩惠，心里都欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民回家；他们因看见耶和华向大卫、所罗门和他的子民以色列所施的恩惠，心里都欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民；他们因见耶和华向大卫和所罗门与他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their homes, joyful and glad in heart for the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon and for his people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their homes, joyful and glad of heart for the prosperity that the Lord had granted to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the good that the Lord had done for David, for Solomon, and for His people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at the end of the celebration, Solomon sent the people home. They were all joyful and glad because the Lord had been so good to David and to Solomon and to his people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their tents, rejoicing and happy in heart because of the goodness that the Lord had shown to David, to Solomon, and to His people Israel.
verses.textEn: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their homes, joyful and glad in heart for the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon and for his people Israel.

verses.textZh: 这样，所罗门完成了耶和华的殿宇和王宫。在耶和华的殿里或所罗门的宫中，所罗门心里要作的，都顺利地作成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，所罗门完成了耶和华的殿宇和王宫。在耶和华的殿里或所罗门的宫中，所罗门心里要作的，都顺利地作成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门造成了耶和华殿和王宫；在耶和华殿和王宫凡他心中所要做的，都顺顺利利地做成了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Solomon had finished the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had succeeded in carrying out all he had in mind to do in the temple of the Lord and in his own palace,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord and the king’s house. All that Solomon had planned to do in the house of the Lord and in his own house he successfully accomplished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord and the king’s house; and Solomon successfully accomplished all that came into his heart to make in the house of the Lord and in his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon finished the Temple of the Lord , as well as the royal palace. He completed everything he had planned to do in the construction of the Temple and the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon finished the house of the Lord and the king’s palace, and successfully completed everything that he had planned on doing in the house of the Lord and in his palace.
verses.textEn: When Solomon had finished the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had succeeded in carrying out all he had in mind to do in the temple of the Lord and in his own palace,

verses.textZh: 夜间，耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说："我已经听了你的祷告，也为我自己选择了这地方作献祭的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜间，耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说："我已经听了你的祷告，也为我自己选择了这地方作献祭的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说：「我已听了你的祷告，也选择这地方作为祭祀我的殿宇。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord appeared to him at night and said: "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon in the night and said to him: "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him: "I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: Then one night the Lord appeared to Solomon and said, "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this Temple as the place for making sacrifices.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon at night and said to him, "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice.
verses.textEn: the Lord appeared to him at night and said: "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 如果我使天闭塞不下雨，或吩咐蝗虫吞吃这地的土产，或差遣瘟疫到我的子民中间来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我使天闭塞不下雨，或吩咐蝗虫吞吃这地的土产，或差遣瘟疫到我的子民中间来；
verses.textZhCuv: 我若使天闭塞不下雨，或使蝗虫吃这地的出产，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，
verses.textEnNiv: "When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command locusts to devour the land or send a plague among my people,
verses.textEnEsv: When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command the locust to devour the land, or send pestilence among my people,
verses.textEnNkjv: When I shut up heaven and there is no rain, or command the locusts to devour the land, or send pestilence among My people,
verses.textEnNlt: At times I might shut up the heavens so that no rain falls, or command grasshoppers to devour your crops, or send plagues among you.
verses.textEnNasb: If I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people,
verses.textEn: "When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command locusts to devour the land or send a plague among my people,

verses.textZh: 这称为我名下的子民，若是谦卑、祷告、寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这称为我名下的子民，若是谦卑、祷告、寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 这称为我名下的子民，若是自卑、祷告，寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。
verses.textEnNiv: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
verses.textEnEsv: if my people who are called by my name humble themselves, and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and heal their land.
verses.textEnNkjv: if My people who are called by My name will humble themselves, and pray and seek My face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin and heal their land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sins and restore their land.
verses.textEnNasb: and My people who are called by My name humble themselves, and pray and seek My face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
verses.textEn: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

verses.textZh: 现在我的眼睛必张开，我的耳朵必垂听在这地所发的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我的眼睛必张开，我的耳朵必垂听在这地所发的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必睁眼看、侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
verses.textEnEsv: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to prayer made in this place.
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes will be open and my ears attentive to every prayer made in this place.
verses.textEnNasb: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.
verses.textEn: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

verses.textZh: 现在我拣选了这殿，把它分别为圣，使我的名永远在这殿中；我的眼和我的心也常常留在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我拣选了这殿，把它分别为圣，使我的名永远在这殿中；我的眼和我的心也常常留在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我已选择这殿，分别为圣，使我的名永在其中，我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: I have chosen and consecrated this temple so that my Name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.
verses.textEnEsv: For now I have chosen and consecrated this house that my name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will be there for all time.
verses.textEnNkjv: For now I have chosen and sanctified this house, that My name may be there forever; and My eyes and My heart will be there perpetually.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have chosen this Temple and set it apart to be holy—a place where my name will be honored forever. I will always watch over it, for it is dear to my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: For now I have chosen and consecrated this house so that My name may be there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there always.
verses.textEn: I have chosen and consecrated this temple so that my Name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

verses.textZh: 至于你，你若是在我面前行事为人像你的父亲大卫所行的那样，遵行我吩咐你的一切话，谨守我的律例和典章，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，你若是在我面前行事为人像你的父亲大卫所行的那样，遵行我吩咐你的一切话，谨守我的律例和典章，
verses.textZhCuv: 你若在我面前效法你父大卫所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，
verses.textEnNiv: "As for you, if you walk before me faithfully as David your father did, and do all I command, and observe my decrees and laws,
verses.textEnEsv: And as for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, doing according to all that I have commanded you and keeping my statutes and my rules,
verses.textEnNkjv: As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and My judgments,
verses.textEnNlt: "As for you, if you faithfully follow me as David your father did, obeying all my commands, decrees, and regulations,
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, to do according to everything that I have commanded you, and keep My statutes and My ordinances,
verses.textEn: "As for you, if you walk before me faithfully as David your father did, and do all I command, and observe my decrees and laws,

verses.textZh: 我就必巩固你的国位，好象我和你父亲大卫所立的约说：‘你的子孙必不会断人作君王统治以色列。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必巩固你的国位，好象我和你父亲大卫所立的约说：‘你的子孙必不会断人作君王统治以色列。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我就必坚固你的国位，正如我与你父大卫所立的约，说：『你的子孙必不断人作以色列的王。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to rule over Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: then I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘You shall not lack a man to rule Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘You shall not fail tohave a man as ruler in Israel.’
verses.textEnNlt: then I will establish the throne of your dynasty. For I made this covenant with your father, David, when I said, ‘One of your descendants will always rule over Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: then I will establish your royal throne as I covenanted with your father David, saying, ‘ You shall not lack a man to be ruler in Israel.’
verses.textEn: I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to rule over Israel.’

verses.textZh: "可是，如果你们转离我，丢弃我在你们面前颁布的律例和诫命，去事奉和敬拜别的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: "可是，如果你们转离我，丢弃我在你们面前颁布的律例和诫命，去事奉和敬拜别的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 「倘若你们转去丢弃我指示你们的律例诫命，去事奉敬拜别神，
verses.textEnNiv: "But if you turn away and forsake the decrees and commands I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnEsv: "But if you turn aside and forsake my statutes and my commandments that I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if you turn away and forsake My statutes and My commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods, and worship them,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if you or your descendants abandon me and disobey the decrees and commands I have given you, and if you serve and worship other gods,
verses.textEnNasb: "But if you turn away and abandon My statutes and My commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEn: "But if you turn away and forsake the decrees and commands I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

verses.textZh: 我就必把以色列人从我赐给他们的土地上拔出来，并且我为自己的名分别为圣的这殿，我也必从我面前舍弃，使这殿在万民中成为笑谈和讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必把以色列人从我赐给他们的土地上拔出来，并且我为自己的名分别为圣的这殿，我也必从我面前舍弃，使这殿在万民中成为笑谈和讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上拔出根来，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使他在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。
verses.textEnNiv: then I will uproot Israel from my land, which I have given them, and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. I will make it a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will pluck you up from my land that I have given you, and this house that I have consecrated for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will uproot them from My land which I have given them; and this house which I have sanctified for My name I will cast out of My sight, and will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: then I will uproot the people from this land that I have given them. I will reject this Temple that I have made holy to honor my name. I will make it an object of mockery and ridicule among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will uproot you from My land which I have given you, and this house which I have consecrated for My name I will cast out of My sight; and I will make it a proverb and an object of scorn among all peoples.
verses.textEn: then I will uproot Israel from my land, which I have given them, and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. I will make it a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

verses.textZh: 这殿虽然高大，但将来经过的人，都必惊讶，说：‘耶和华为甚么这样对待这地和这殿呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这殿虽然高大，但将来经过的人，都必惊讶，说：‘耶和华为甚么这样对待这地和这殿呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶说：『耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
verses.textEnEsv: And at this house, which was exalted, everyone passing by will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the Lord done thus to this land and to this house?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And asfor this house, which is exalted, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the Lord done thus to this land and this house?’
verses.textEnNlt: And though this Temple is impressive now, all who pass by will be appalled. They will ask, ‘Why did the Lord do such terrible things to this land and to this Temple?’
verses.textEnNasb: As for this house, which was exalted, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the Lord done these things to this land and to this house?’
verses.textEn: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’

verses.textZh: 人必回答说：‘是因为这地的人离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神，就是领他们从埃及地出来的神，去亲近别的神，敬拜和事奉他们；所以，耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人必回答说：‘是因为这地的人离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神，就是领他们从埃及地出来的神，去亲近别的神，敬拜和事奉他们；所以，耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 人必回答说：『是因此地的人离弃耶和华－他们列祖的神，就是领他们出埃及地的神，去亲近别神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。』」
verses.textEnNiv: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why he brought all this disaster on them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the Lord , the God of their fathers who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods and worshiped them and served them. Therefore he has brought all this disaster on them.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will answer, ‘Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them and served them; therefore He has brought all this calamity on them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "And the answer will be, ‘Because his people abandoned the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt, and they worshiped other gods instead and bowed down to them. That is why he has brought all these disasters on them.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the Lord, the God of their fathers, who brought them from the land of Egypt, and they adopted other gods, and worshiped and served them; therefore He has brought all this adversity on them.’ "
verses.textEn: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why he brought all this disaster on them.’ "

verses.textZh: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿和自己的王宫，用了二十年才完成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿和自己的王宫，用了二十年才完成。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，二十年才完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the Lord and his own palace,
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the house of the Lord and his own house,
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the house of the Lord and his own house,
verses.textEnNlt: It took Solomon twenty years to build the Lord ’s Temple and his own royal palace. At the end of that time,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about at the end of the twenty years in which Solomon had built the house of the Lord and his own house,
verses.textEn: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the Lord and his own palace,

verses.textZh: 所罗门又修筑希兰送给他的那些城市，使以色列人住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门又修筑希兰送给他的那些城市，使以色列人住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后所罗门重新修筑希兰送给他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon rebuilt the villages that Hiram had given him, and settled Israelites in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon rebuilt the cities that Hiram had given to him, and settled the people of Israel in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the cities which Hiram had given to Solomon, Solomon built them; and he settled the children of Israel there.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon turned his attention to rebuilding the towns that King Hiram had given him, and he settled Israelites in them.
verses.textEnNasb: that he built the cities which Huram had given him, and settled the sons of Israel there.
verses.textEn: Solomon rebuilt the villages that Hiram had given him, and settled Israelites in them.

verses.textZh: 所罗门到哈玛琐巴去，占领了那地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门到哈玛琐巴去，占领了那地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门往哈马琐巴去，攻取了那地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon then went to Hamath Zobah and captured it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and took it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon went to Hamath Zobah and seized it.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also fought against the town of Hamath-zobah and conquered it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.
verses.textEn: Solomon then went to Hamath Zobah and captured it.

verses.textZh: 所罗门又修筑了在旷野的达莫，和他在哈玛建造的一切贮藏货物的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门又修筑了在旷野的达莫，和他在哈玛建造的一切贮藏货物的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造旷野里的达莫，又建造哈马所有的积货城，
verses.textEnNiv: He also built up Tadmor in the desert and all the store cities he had built in Hamath.
verses.textEnEsv: He built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the store cities that he built in Hamath.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities which he built in Hamath.
verses.textEnNlt: He rebuilt Tadmor in the wilderness and built towns in the region of Hamath as supply centers.
verses.textEnNasb: He built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the storage cities which he had built in Hamath.
verses.textEn: He also built up Tadmor in the desert and all the store cities he had built in Hamath.

verses.textZh: 他又建造上伯．和仑和下伯．和仑，成了有墙、有门和有闩的设防城；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又建造上伯．和仑和下伯．和仑，成了有墙、有门和有闩的设防城；
verses.textZhCuv: 又建造上伯‧和仑、下伯‧和仑作为保障，都有墙，有门，有闩；
verses.textEnNiv: He rebuilt Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon as fortified cities, with walls and with gates and bars,
verses.textEnEsv: He also built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars,
verses.textEnNkjv: He built Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars,
verses.textEnNlt: He fortified the towns of Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon, rebuilding their walls and installing barred gates.
verses.textEnNasb: He also built upper Beth-horon and lower Beth-horon, which were fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.textEn: He rebuilt Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon as fortified cities, with walls and with gates and bars,

verses.textZh: 又建造巴拉和所罗门拥有的一切贮藏货物的城市，以及一切囤放战车的城市，马兵驻扎的城市，和所罗门在耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及他统治的全境内喜爱建造的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又建造巴拉和所罗门拥有的一切贮藏货物的城市，以及一切囤放战车的城市，马兵驻扎的城市，和所罗门在耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及他统治的全境内喜爱建造的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建造巴拉和所有的积货城，并屯车辆马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿意建造的。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as Baalath and all his store cities, and all the cities for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.
verses.textEnEsv: and Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had and all the cities for his chariots and the cities for his horsemen, and whatever Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.textEnNkjv: also Baalath and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities and the cities of the cavalry, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.textEnNlt: He also rebuilt Baalath and other supply centers and constructed towns where his chariots and horses could be stationed. He built everything he desired in Jerusalem and Lebanon and throughout his entire realm.
verses.textEnNasb: and Baalath and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots and cities for his horsemen, and everything that it pleased Solomon to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and all the land under his rule.
verses.textEn: as well as Baalath and all his store cities, and all the cities for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

verses.textZh: 至于以色列人以外的赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人和耶布斯人剩下来的人民，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于以色列人以外的赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人和耶布斯人剩下来的人民，
verses.textZhCuv: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
verses.textEnNiv: There were still people left from the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these people were not Israelites).
verses.textEnEsv: All the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: All the people whowere left of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who were not of Israel—
verses.textEnNlt: There were still some people living in the land who were not Israelites, including the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
verses.textEnNasb: All of the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel,
verses.textEn: There were still people left from the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these people were not Israelites).

verses.textZh: 他们的子孙仍然留在那地，以色列人没有消灭他们。于是，所罗门征召他们作苦工，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的子孙仍然留在那地，以色列人没有消灭他们。于是，所罗门征召他们作苦工，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是以色列人未曾灭绝的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these people remaining in the land—whom the Israelites had not destroyed—to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: from their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the people of Israel had not destroyed—these Solomon drafted as forced labor, and so they are to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: that is, their descendants who were left in the land after them, whom the children of Israel did not destroy—from these Solomon raised forced labor, as it is to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: These were descendants of the nations whom the people of Israel had not destroyed. So Solomon conscripted them for his labor force, and they serve as forced laborers to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, from their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel had not destroyed, Solomon raised them as forced laborers to this day.
verses.textEn: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these people remaining in the land—whom the Israelites had not destroyed—to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.

verses.textZh: 唯独以色列人，所罗门没有驱使他们为他的工程作奴仆；他们作了他的战士、军长、车兵长和马兵长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独以色列人，所罗门没有驱使他们为他的工程作奴仆；他们作了他的战士、军长、车兵长和马兵长。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们当奴仆做工，乃是作他的战士、军长的统领、车兵长、马兵长。
verses.textEnNiv: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.
verses.textEnEsv: But of the people of Israel Solomon made no slaves for his work; they were soldiers, and his officers, the commanders of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Solomon did not make the children of Israel servants for his work. Some were men of war, captains of his officers, captains of his chariots, and his cavalry.
verses.textEnNlt: But Solomon did not conscript any of the Israelites for his labor force. Instead, he assigned them to serve as fighting men, officers in his army, commanders of his chariots, and charioteers.
verses.textEnNasb: But Solomon did not make slaves from the sons of Israel for his work; for they were men of war, his chief captains and commanders of his chariots and his horsemen.
verses.textEn: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王有二百五十名监工，监督工人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王有二百五十名监工，监督工人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王有二百五十督工的，监管工人。
verses.textEnNiv: They were also King Solomon’s chief officials—two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.
verses.textEnEsv: And these were the chief officers of King Solomon, 250, who exercised authority over the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And others were chiefs of the officials of King Solomon: two hundred and fifty, who ruled over the people.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon appointed 250 of them to supervise the people.
verses.textEnNasb: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, 250 who ruled over the people.
verses.textEn: They were also King Solomon’s chief officials—two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.

verses.textZh: 所罗门把法老的女儿从大卫城，带到他为她建造的宫里去；因为他说："我的妻子不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里，因为耶和华的约柜所到的地方都是神圣的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门把法老的女儿从大卫城，带到他为她建造的宫里去；因为他说："我的妻子不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里，因为耶和华的约柜所到的地方都是神圣的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门将法老的女儿带出大卫城，上到为她建造的宫里；因所罗门说：「耶和华约柜所到之处都为圣地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, "My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the Lord has entered are holy."
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the city of David to the house that he had built for her, for he said, "My wife shall not live in the house of David king of Israel, for the places to which the ark of the Lord has come are holy."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the house he had built for her, for he said, "My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because theplaces to which the ark of the Lord has come are holy."
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon moved his wife, Pharaoh’s daughter, from the City of David to the new palace he had built for her. He said, "My wife must not live in King David’s palace, for the Ark of the Lord has been there, and it is holy ground."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the city of David to the house which he had built for her, for he said, "My wife shall not live in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where the ark of the Lord has entered are holy."
verses.textEn: Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, "My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the Lord has entered are holy."

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在走廊前面他建筑的坛上，向耶和华献上燔祭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在走廊前面他建筑的坛上，向耶和华献上燔祭，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在廊子前他所筑的坛上，与耶和华献燔祭；
verses.textEnNiv: On the altar of the Lord that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon offered up burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord that he had built before the vestibule,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord which he had built before the vestibule,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon presented burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar he had built for him in front of the entry room of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord which he had built in front of the porch;
verses.textEn: On the altar of the Lord that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 又照着摩西的吩咐，在安息日、初一和一年三次特定的节期，就是除酵节、七七节、住棚节，献上每日当献的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又照着摩西的吩咐，在安息日、初一和一年三次特定的节期，就是除酵节、七七节、住棚节，献上每日当献的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，并一年三节，就是除酵节、七七节、住棚节，献每日所当献的祭。
verses.textEnNiv: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for the Sabbaths, the New Moons and the three annual festivals—the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnEsv: as the duty of each day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses for the Sabbaths, the new moons, and the three annual feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEnNkjv: according to the daily rate, offering according to the commandment of Moses, for the Sabbaths, the New Moons, and the three appointed yearly feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnNlt: He offered the sacrifices for the Sabbaths, the new moon festivals, and the three annual festivals—the Passover celebration, the Festival of Harvest, and the Festival of Shelters—as Moses had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: and he did so according to the daily rule, offering them up according to the commandment of Moses, for the Sabbaths, the new moons, and the three annual feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEn: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for the Sabbaths, the New Moons and the three annual festivals—the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles.

verses.textZh: 所罗门又照着他父亲大卫所定的，设立了祭司的班次，执行他们的事奉，又派遣利未人，各守本职，赞美耶和华，在祭司面前照着每日的本分事奉。又派守门的按着班次看守各门。因为这是神人大卫的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门又照着他父亲大卫所定的，设立了祭司的班次，执行他们的事奉，又派遣利未人，各守本职，赞美耶和华，在祭司面前照着每日的本分事奉。又派守门的按着班次看守各门。因为这是神人大卫的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门照着他父大卫所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他们各供己事，又使利未人各尽其职，赞美耶和华，在祭司面前做每日所当做的；又派守门的按着班次看守各门，因为神人大卫是这样吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day’s requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: According to the ruling of David his father, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their service, and the Levites for their offices of praise and ministry before the priests as the duty of each day required, and the gatekeepers in their divisions at each gate, for so David the man of God had commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: And, according to the order of David his father, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their service, the Levites for their duties (to praise and serve before the priests) as the duty of each day required, and the gatekeepers by their divisions at each gate; for so David the man of God had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: In assigning the priests to their duties, Solomon followed the regulations of his father, David. He also assigned the Levites to lead the people in praise and to assist the priests in their daily duties. And he assigned the gatekeepers to their gates by their divisions, following the commands of David, the man of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now according to the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their service, and the Levites for their duties of praise and ministering before the priests according to the daily rule, and the gatekeepers by their divisions at every gate; for this is what David, the man of God, had commanded.
verses.textEn: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day’s requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.

verses.textZh: 王对祭司和利未人所吩咐的，无论是甚么事务，或是有关库房的事，他们都没有违抗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对祭司和利未人所吩咐的，无论是甚么事务，或是有关库房的事，他们都没有违抗。
verses.textZhCuv: 王所吩咐众祭司和利未人的，无论是管府库或办别的事，他们都不违背。
verses.textEnNiv: They did not deviate from the king’s commands to the priests or to the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did not turn aside from what the king had commanded the priests and Levites concerning any matter and concerning the treasuries.
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not depart from the command of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasuries.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon did not deviate in any way from David’s commands concerning the priests and Levites and the treasuries.
verses.textEnNasb: And they did not deviate from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites in any matter or regarding the storehouses.
verses.textEn: They did not deviate from the king’s commands to the priests or to the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.

verses.textZh: 从耶和华的殿奠基的日子起，直到建成，所罗门的一切工程都进行顺利。这样，耶和华的殿就完成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从耶和华的殿奠基的日子起，直到建成，所罗门的一切工程都进行顺利。这样，耶和华的殿就完成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿，从立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱备。这样，耶和华的殿全然完毕。
verses.textEnNiv: All Solomon’s work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid until its completion. So the temple of the Lord was finished.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus was accomplished all the work of Solomon from the day the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was completed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the work of Solomon was well-ordered from the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was completed.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon made sure that all the work related to building the Temple of the Lord was carried out, from the day its foundation was laid to the day of its completion.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the work of Solomon was carried out from the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was completed.
verses.textEn: All Solomon’s work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid until its completion. So the temple of the Lord was finished.

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门往以东地，到靠近海边的以旬．迦别和以禄去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门往以东地，到靠近海边的以旬．迦别和以禄去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，所罗门往以东地靠海的以旬‧迦别和以禄去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the shore of the sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the seacoast, in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: Later Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Elath, ports along the shore of the Red Sea in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the seashore in the land of Edom.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.

verses.textZh: 希兰派他的臣仆，把船只和熟悉航海的仆人，送到所罗门那里。他们和所罗门的仆人一同去到俄斐，从那里得了一万五千公斤金子，运到所罗门王那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰派他的臣仆，把船只和熟悉航海的仆人，送到所罗门那里。他们和所罗门的仆人一同去到俄斐，从那里得了一万五千公斤金子，运到所罗门王那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰差遣他的臣仆，将船只和熟悉泛海的仆人送到所罗门那里。他们同着所罗门的仆人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own men, sailors who knew the sea. These, with Solomon’s men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hiram sent to him by the hand of his servants ships and servants familiar with the sea, and they went to Ophir together with the servants of Solomon and brought from there 450 talents of gold and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hiram sent him ships by the hand of his servants, and servants who knew the sea. They went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and acquired four hundred and fifty talents of gold from there, and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own officers and manned by experienced crews of sailors. These ships sailed to Ophir with Solomon’s men and brought back to Solomon almost seventeen tons of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And by his servants Huram sent him ships and servants who knew the sea; and they went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and took from there 450 talents of gold, and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.textEn: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own men, sailors who knew the sea. These, with Solomon’s men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

verses.textZh: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难题试试所罗门。跟随她的人很多，又有骆驼驮着香料、大批黄金和宝石。她来到所罗门那里，就把她心里所有的难题，都对所罗门说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难题试试所罗门。跟随她的人很多，又有骆驼驮着香料、大批黄金和宝石。她来到所罗门那里，就把她心里所有的难题，都对所罗门说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难解的话试问所罗门；跟随她的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。
verses.textEnNiv: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions, having a very great retinue and camels bearing spices and very much gold and precious stones. And when she came to Solomon, she told him all that was on her mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test Solomon with hard questions, having a very great retinue, camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones; and when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him about all that was in her heart.
verses.textEnNlt: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. She arrived with a large group of attendants and a great caravan of camels loaded with spices, large quantities of gold, and precious jewels. When she met with Solomon, she talked with him about everything she had on her mind.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test Solomon with riddles. She had a very large entourage, with camels carrying balsam oil and a large amount of gold and precious stones; and when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him about everything that was on her heart.
verses.textEn: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.

verses.textZh: 所罗门把她的一切难题，都给她解答了；没有一样难倒所罗门，不能给她解答的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门把她的一切难题，都给她解答了；没有一样难倒所罗门，不能给她解答的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon answered all her questions. There was nothing hidden from Solomon that he could not explain to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing so difficult for Solomon that he could not explain it to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon had answers for all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was hidden from Solomon which he did not explain to her.
verses.textEn: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.

verses.textZh: 示巴女王看见所罗门的智慧和他建造的宫殿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴女王看见所罗门的智慧和他建造的宫殿，
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴女王见所罗门的智慧和他所建造的宫室、
verses.textEnNiv: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.textEnNlt: When the queen of Sheba realized how wise Solomon was, and when she saw the palace he had built,
verses.textEnNasb: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house which he had built,
verses.textEn: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,

verses.textZh: 他席上的食物，群臣的座位，仆人的侍候和他们的服饰，酒政和酒政的服饰，以及所罗门在耶和华殿里所献的燔祭，就十分惊讶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他席上的食物，群臣的座位，仆人的侍候和他们的服饰，酒政和酒政的服饰，以及所罗门在耶和华殿里所献的燔祭，就十分惊讶。
verses.textZhCuv: 席上的珍馐美味、群臣分列而坐、仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰、酒政，和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍，
verses.textEnNiv: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.
verses.textEnEsv: the food of his table, the seating of his officials, and the attendance of his servants, and their clothing, his cupbearers, and their clothing, and his burnt offerings that he offered at the house of the Lord , there was no more breath in her.
verses.textEnNkjv: the food on his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his waiters and their apparel, his cupbearers and their apparel, and his entryway by which he went up to the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.
verses.textEnNlt: she was overwhelmed. She was also amazed at the food on his tables, the organization of his officials and their splendid clothing, the cup-bearers and their robes, and the burnt offerings Solomon made at the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers and their attire, his cupbearers and their attire, and his stairway by which he went up to the house of the Lord, she was breathless.
verses.textEn: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.

verses.textZh: 于是她对王说："我在本国听见关于你的事和你的智慧，实在是真的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她对王说："我在本国听见关于你的事和你的智慧，实在是真的。
verses.textZhCuv: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！
verses.textEnNiv: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to the king, "The report was true that I heard in my own land of your words and of your wisdom,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to the king: "Itwas a true report which I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: She exclaimed to the king, "Everything I heard in my country about your achievements and wisdom is true!
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said to the king, "It was a true story that I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom.
verses.textEn: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

verses.textZh: 我先前不信他们的话，等到我来了，亲眼看见了，才知道你智慧的伟大，人告诉我的还不到一半。你实在是见面胜似闻名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我先前不信他们的话，等到我来了，亲眼看见了，才知道你智慧的伟大，人告诉我的还不到一半。你实在是见面胜似闻名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告诉我的，还不到一半；你的实迹越过我所听见的名声。
verses.textEnNiv: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.
verses.textEnEsv: but I did not believe the reports until I came and my own eyes had seen it. And behold, half the greatness of your wisdom was not told me; you surpass the report that I heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: However I did not believe their words until I came and saw with my own eyes; and indeed the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me. You exceed the fame of which I heard.
verses.textEnNlt: I didn’t believe what was said until I arrived here and saw it with my own eyes. In fact, I had not heard the half of your great wisdom! It is far beyond what I was told.
verses.textEnNasb: But I did not believe their stories until I came and my own eyes saw it all. And behold, not even half of the greatness of your wisdom was reported to me. You have surpassed the report that I heard.
verses.textEn: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.

verses.textZh: 属你的人是有福的，你的臣仆是有福的，因为他们可以常常侍立在你面前，聆听你的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属你的人是有福的，你的臣仆是有福的，因为他们可以常常侍立在你面前，聆听你的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的群臣、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。
verses.textEnNiv: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEnEsv: Happy are your men! Happy are these your servants, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy are your men and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEnNlt: How happy your people must be! What a privilege for your officials to stand here day after day, listening to your wisdom!
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed are your men, how blessed are these servants of yours, who stand before you continually and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEn: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神是应当称颂的，因他喜悦你，使你坐在他的王位上，为耶和华你的神作王；因为你的神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，好秉公行义。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神是应当称颂的，因他喜悦你，使你坐在他的王位上，为耶和华你的神作王；因为你的神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，好秉公行义。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐他的国位，为耶和华－你的神作王；因为你的神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，使你秉公行义。」
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the Lord your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and set you on his throne as king for the Lord your God! Because your God loved Israel and would establish them forever, he has made you king over them, that you may execute justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you, setting you on His throne tobe king for the Lord your God! Because your God has loved Israel, to establish them forever, therefore He made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord your God, who delights in you and has placed you on the throne as king to rule for him. Because God loves Israel and desires this kingdom to last forever, he has made you king over them so you can rule with justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord your God who delighted in you, setting you on His throne as king for the Lord your God; because your God loved Israel, establishing them forever, He made you king over them, to carry out justice and righteousness."
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the Lord your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness."

verses.textZh: 于是示巴女王把约四千公斤金子、大批香料和宝石送给所罗门王；示巴女王送给所罗门王的香料，是犹大地从来没有过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是示巴女王把约四千公斤金子、大批香料和宝石送给所罗门王；示巴女王送给所罗门王的香料，是犹大地从来没有过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料送给所罗门王；她送给王的香料，以后再没有这样的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. There were no spices such as those that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones; there never were any spices such as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she gave the king a gift of 9,000 pounds of gold, great quantities of spices, and precious jewels. Never before had there been spices as fine as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold and a very great amount of balsam oil and precious stones; there had never been balsam oil like that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.
verses.textEn: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.textZh: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐把黄金运来，也把檀香木和宝石运了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐把黄金运来，也把檀香木和宝石运了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐运了金子来，也运了檀香木 和宝石来。
verses.textEnNiv: (The servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon brought gold from Ophir; they also brought algumwood and precious stones.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum wood and precious stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, the servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum wood and precious stones.
verses.textEnNlt: (In addition, the crews of Hiram and Solomon brought gold from Ophir, and they also brought red sandalwood and precious jewels.
verses.textEnNasb: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.textEn: (The servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon brought gold from Ophir; they also brought algumwood and precious stones.

verses.textZh: 王用檀香木为耶和华的殿和王宫作了台阶，又为唱歌的人作了琴瑟；像这样的东西，是在犹大地从来没有见过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王用檀香木为耶和华的殿和王宫作了台阶，又为唱歌的人作了琴瑟；像这样的东西，是在犹大地从来没有见过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做台，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟；犹大地从来没有见过这样的。
verses.textEnNiv: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)
verses.textEnEsv: And the king made from the algum wood supports for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, lyres also and harps for the singers. There never was seen the like of them before in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king made walkways of the algum wood for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, also harps and stringed instruments for singers; and there were none such asthese seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: The king used the sandalwood to make steps for the Temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and to construct lyres and harps for the musicians. Never before had such beautiful things been seen in Judah.)
verses.textEnNasb: From the algum trees the king made steps to the house of the Lord and for the king’s palace, and lyres and harps for the singers; and nothing like them was seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.textEn: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)

verses.textZh: 所罗门王按着示巴女王带来给他的，回送她礼物；此外，还把女王所愿所求的，都送给她，于是女王和她的臣仆都返回本国去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王按着示巴女王带来给他的，回送她礼物；此外，还把女王所愿所求的，都送给她，于是女王和她的臣仆都返回本国去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还她礼物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送给她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.
verses.textEnEsv: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked besides what she had brought to the king. So she turned and went back to her own land with her servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all she desired, whatever she asked, muchmore than she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba whatever she asked for—gifts of greater value than the gifts she had given him. Then she and all her attendants returned to their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba her every desire, whatever she requested, besides gifts equal to what she had brought to the king. Then she turned and went to her own land with her servants.
verses.textEn: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

verses.textZh: 所罗门每年所得的金子，共重两万三千公斤，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门每年所得的金子，共重两万三千公斤，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得，
verses.textEnNiv: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold,
verses.textEnNkjv: The weight of gold that came to Solomon yearly was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.textEnNlt: Each year Solomon received about 25 tons of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold,
verses.textEn: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,

verses.textZh: 另外，还有从商人和行商运来的，阿拉伯诸王和本国的各总督，都把金银运来给所罗门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另外，还有从商人和行商运来的，阿拉伯诸王和本国的各总督，都把金银运来给所罗门。
verses.textZhCuv: 另外还有商人所进的金子，并且阿拉伯诸王与属国的省长都带金银给所罗门。
verses.textEnNiv: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the territories brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: besides that which the explorers and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: besides what the traveling merchants and traders brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: This did not include the additional revenue he received from merchants and traders. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the provinces also brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: besides what the traders and merchants brought; and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.textEn: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the territories brought gold and silver to Solomon.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王用锤炼好的金子做了二百面大盾牌，每一面大盾牌用锤炼好的金子七公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王用锤炼好的金子做了二百面大盾牌，每一面大盾牌用锤炼好的金子七公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon made 200 large shields of beaten gold; 600 shekels of beaten gold went into each shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: And King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon made 200 large shields of hammered gold, each weighing more than 15 pounds.
verses.textEnNasb: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold, using six hundred shekels of beaten gold on each large shield.
verses.textEn: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.

verses.textZh: 又用锤炼好的金子做了三百面小盾牌，每一面小盾牌用锤炼好的金子约三公斤；王把这些盾牌都放在黎巴嫩林宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用锤炼好的金子做了三百面小盾牌，每一面小盾牌用锤炼好的金子约三公斤；王把这些盾牌都放在黎巴嫩林宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百舍客勒，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。
verses.textEnNiv: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred shekels of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made 300 shields of beaten gold; 300 shekels of gold went into each shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made three hundred shields of hammered gold; three hundred shekels of gold went into each shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made 300 smaller shields of hammered gold, each weighing more than 7-1/2 pounds. The king placed these shields in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold, using three hundred shekels of gold on each shield; and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred shekels of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 王用象牙做了一个大宝座，包上纯金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王用象牙做了一个大宝座，包上纯金。
verses.textZhCuv: 王用象牙制造一个大宝座，用精金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The king also made a great ivory throne and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king made a huge throne, decorated with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.textEn: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.

verses.textZh: 宝座有六级台阶，又用金脚凳和宝座相连，座位两边都有扶手，扶手旁边各有一只狮子站立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宝座有六级台阶，又用金脚凳和宝座相连，座位两边都有扶手，扶手旁边各有一只狮子站立。
verses.textZhCuv: 宝座有六层台阶，又有金脚凳，与宝座相连。宝座两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。
verses.textEnNiv: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.
verses.textEnEsv: The throne had six steps and a footstool of gold, which were attached to the throne, and on each side of the seat were armrests and two lions standing beside the armrests,
verses.textEnNkjv: The throne had six steps, with a footstool of gold, whichwere fastened to the throne; there were armrests on either side of the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the armrests.
verses.textEnNlt: The throne had six steps, with a footstool of gold. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, and the figure of a lion stood on each side of the throne.
verses.textEnNasb: There were six steps to the throne and a footstool in gold attached to the throne, and arms on each side of the seat, and two lions standing beside the arms.
verses.textEn: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

verses.textZh: 六级台阶上共有十二只狮子站立；每级两只，一左一右；在列国中都没有这样做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六级台阶上共有十二只狮子站立；每级两只，一左一右；在列国中都没有这样做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: while twelve lions stood there, one on each end of a step on the six steps. Nothing like it was ever made for any kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Twelve lions stood there, one on each side of the six steps; nothing like this had been made for any other kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: There were also twelve other lions, one standing on each end of the six steps. No other throne in all the world could be compared with it!
verses.textEnNasb: Twelve lions were standing there on the six steps on the one side and on the other; nothing like it was made for any other kingdom.
verses.textEn: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王的一切杯爵都是金的；黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金做的；在所罗门的时代，银子算不得甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王的一切杯爵都是金的；黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金做的；在所罗门的时代，银子算不得甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。
verses.textEnNiv: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s day.
verses.textEnEsv: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Not onewas silver, for this was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: All of King Solomon’s drinking cups were solid gold, as were all the utensils in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon. They were not made of silver, for silver was considered worthless in Solomon’s day!
verses.textEnNasb: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEn: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s day.

verses.textZh: 因为王的船只和希兰的仆人一同到他施去；往他施的船只每三年回来一次，载着金银、象牙、猿猴和孔雀回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为王的船只和希兰的仆人一同到他施去；往他施的船只每三年回来一次，载着金银、象牙、猿猴和孔雀回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为王的船只与希兰的仆人一同往他施去；他施船只三年一次装载金、银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。
verses.textEnNiv: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram’s servants. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.
verses.textEnEsv: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram. Once every three years the ships of Tarshish used to come bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram. Once every three years the merchant ships came, bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and monkeys.
verses.textEnNlt: The king had a fleet of trading ships of Tarshish manned by the sailors sent by Hiram. Once every three years the ships returned, loaded with gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.textEnNasb: For the king had ships which went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once every three years the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold and silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.textEn: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram’s servants. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王的财富和智慧，胜过世上的列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王的财富和智慧，胜过世上的列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus King Solomon excelled all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Solomon became richer and wiser than any other king on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: So King Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.
verses.textEn: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

verses.textZh: 世上的列王都求见所罗门的面，要听神赐给他的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上的列王都求见所罗门的面，要听神赐给他的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听神赐给他智慧的话。
verses.textEnNiv: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put into his mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Kings from every nation came to consult him and to hear the wisdom God had given him.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the kings of the earth were seeking the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.
verses.textEn: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.

verses.textZh: 他们各人带来的礼物有：银器、金器、衣服、兵器、香料、骡马；每年都有一定的数量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人带来的礼物有：银器、金器、衣服、兵器、香料、骡马；每年都有一定的数量。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。
verses.textEnNiv: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.
verses.textEnEsv: Every one of them brought his present, articles of silver and of gold, garments, myrrh, spices, horses, and mules, so much year by year.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each man brought his present: articles of silver and gold, garments, armor, spices, horses, and mules, at a set rate year by year.
verses.textEnNlt: Year after year everyone who visited brought him gifts of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
verses.textEnNasb: They were bringing, each of them his gift: articles of silver and gold, garments, weapons, balsam oil, horses, and mules, so much year by year.
verses.textEn: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

verses.textZh: 所罗门有四千马廊的车马，还有马兵一万二千，他把这些人马安置在囤车城和耶路撒冷，就是与王在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门有四千马廊的车马，还有马兵一万二千，他把这些人马安置在囤车城和耶路撒冷，就是与王在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门有套车的马四千棚，有马兵一万二千，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon had 4,000 stalls for horses and chariots, and 12,000 horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for his horses and chariots, and he had 12,000 horses. He stationed some of them in the chariot cities, and some near him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 所罗门统治列王，从幼发拉底河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门统治列王，从幼发拉底河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。
verses.textEnNiv: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And he ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he reigned over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of the Philistines and the border of Egypt in the south.
verses.textEnNasb: He was ruler over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, and as far as the border of Egypt.
verses.textEn: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子好象石头，使香柏木好象平原的桑树那么多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王在耶路撒冷使银子好象石头，使香柏木好象平原的桑树那么多。
verses.textZhCuv: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
verses.textEnNiv: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stone, and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king made silver ascommon in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar trees as abundant as the sycamores which are in the lowland.
verses.textEnNlt: The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stone. And valuable cedar timber was as common as the sycamore-fig trees that grow in the foothills of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars as plentiful as sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
verses.textEn: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

verses.textZh: 人们从埃及和各地把马匹运到所罗门那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人们从埃及和各地把马匹运到所罗门那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人从埃及和各国为所罗门赶马群来。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.
verses.textEnEsv: And horses were imported for Solomon from Egypt and from all lands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought horses to Solomon from Egypt and from all lands.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and many other countries.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were bringing horses for Solomon from Egypt and from all countries.
verses.textEn: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.
