verses.textZh: 所罗门其余的事迹，一生的始末，不是都记在拿单先知的记录上，示罗人亚希雅的预言上，以及先见易多论到尼八的儿子耶罗波安的启示录上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门其余的事迹，一生的始末，不是都记在拿单先知的记录上，示罗人亚希雅的预言上，以及先见易多论到尼八的儿子耶罗波安的启示录上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门其余的事，自始至终，不都写在先知拿单的书上和示罗人亚希雅的预言书上，并先见易多论尼八儿子耶罗波安的默示书上吗？
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, from first to last, are they not written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Solomon’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded in The Record of Nathan the Prophet, and The Prophecy of Ahijah from Shiloh, and also in The Visions of Iddo the Seer, concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, from the first to the last, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

verses.textZh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作王统治全以色列共四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作王统治全以色列共四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon ruled in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.
verses.textEn: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

verses.textZh: 所罗门和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在他父亲大卫的城里；他的儿子罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在他父亲大卫的城里；他的儿子罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父大卫城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David his father, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David his father. And Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When he died, he was buried in the City of David, named for his father. Then his son Rehoboam became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon lay down with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David; and his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 罗波安到示剑去，因为全体以色列人都去了示剑，要立他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安到示剑去，因为全体以色列人都去了示剑，要立他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列人都到了示剑，要立他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
verses.textEnEsv: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone to Shechem to make him king.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had gathered to make him king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, because all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.

verses.textZh: 那时，尼八的儿子耶罗波安，因为逃避所罗门王，住在埃及；他一听见这事，就从埃及回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，尼八的儿子耶罗波安，因为逃避所罗门王，住在埃及；他一听见这事，就从埃及回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里；他听见这事，就从埃及回来。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), then Jeroboam returned from Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it happened, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard it (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), that Jeroboam returned from Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard of this, he returned from Egypt, for he had fled to Egypt to escape from King Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard about it (he was in Egypt where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned from Egypt.
verses.textEn: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 他们派人去叫耶罗波安回来；他就和全体以色列人来见罗波安，对他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们派人去叫耶罗波安回来；他就和全体以色列人来见罗波安，对他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人打发人去请他，他就和以色列众人来见罗波安，对他说：
verses.textEnNiv: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:
verses.textEnEsv: And they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all Israel came and said to Rehoboam,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they sent for him and called him. And Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of Israel summoned him, and Jeroboam and all Israel went to speak with Rehoboam.
verses.textEnNasb: So they sent word and summoned him. When Jeroboam and all Israel came, they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.textEn: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:

verses.textZh: "你父亲使我们所负的轭甚重，现在求你减轻你父亲加在我们身上的劳役和重轭，我们就服事你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你父亲使我们所负的轭甚重，现在求你减轻你父亲加在我们身上的劳役和重轭，我们就服事你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你父亲使我们负重轭做苦工，现在求你使我们做的苦工负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEnEsv: "Your father made our yoke heavy. Now therefore lighten the hard service of your father and his heavy yoke on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your father made our yoke heavy; now therefore, lighten the burdensome service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Your father was a hard master," they said. "Lighten the harsh labor demands and heavy taxes that your father imposed on us. Then we will be your loyal subjects."
verses.textEnNasb: "Your father made our yoke hard; but now, lighten the hard labor imposed by your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEn: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."

verses.textZh: 罗波安对他们说："三天以后你们再来见我吧！"众人就离去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安对他们说："三天以后你们再来见我吧！"众人就离去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安对他们说：「第三日再来见我吧！」民就去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam answered, "Come back to me in three days." So the people went away.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Come to me again in three days." So the people went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "Come back to me after three days." And the people departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam replied, "Come back in three days for my answer." So the people went away.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to them, "Return to me again in three days." So the people departed.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam answered, "Come back to me in three days." So the people went away.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王和一些在他父亲所罗门在世的时候，侍立在所罗门面前的老人商议，说："你们有甚么提议，我好回复这班民众呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王和一些在他父亲所罗门在世的时候，侍立在所罗门面前的老人商议，说："你们有甚么提议，我好回复这班民众呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：「你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复这民。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he was yet alive, saying, "How do you advise me to answer this people?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who stood before his father Solomon while he still lived, saying, "How do you advise me to answer these people?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Rehoboam discussed the matter with the older men who had counseled his father, Solomon. "What is your advice?" he asked. "How should I answer these people?"
verses.textEnNasb: And then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served his father Solomon while he was still alive, saying, "How do you advise me to answer this people?"
verses.textEn: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："如果王善待人民，使他们喜悦，对他们说好话，他们就必永远作你的仆人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："如果王善待人民，使他们喜悦，对他们说好话，他们就必永远作你的仆人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 老年人对他说：「王若恩待这民，使他们喜悦，用好话回复他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "If you will be good to this people and please them and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they spoke to him, saying, "If you are kind to these people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants forever."
verses.textEnNlt: The older counselors replied, "If you are good to these people and do your best to please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your loyal subjects."
verses.textEnNasb: They spoke to him, saying, "If you are kind to this people and please them and speak pleasant words to them, then they will be your servants always."
verses.textEn: They replied, "If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."

verses.textZh: 王不接受这些老人的意见，却去和那些同他一起长大，侍立在他面前的年轻人商议，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王不接受这些老人的意见，却去和那些同他一起长大，侍立在他面前的年轻人商议，
verses.textZhCuv: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大、在他面前侍立的少年人商议，
verses.textEnNiv: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.
verses.textEnEsv: But he abandoned the counsel that the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him and stood before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he rejected the advice which the elders had given him, and consulted the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the older men and instead asked the opinion of the young men who had grown up with him and were now his advisers.
verses.textEnNasb: But he ignored the advice of the elders which they had given him, and consulted with the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
verses.textEn: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

verses.textZh: 问他们："这人民对我说：求你减轻你父亲加在我们身上的重轭吧。你们有甚么提议，我好回复他们呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 问他们："这人民对我说：求你减轻你父亲加在我们身上的重轭吧。你们有甚么提议，我好回复他们呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「这民对我说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些』；你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "What do you advise that we answer this people who have said to me, ‘Lighten the yoke that your father put on us’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "What advice do you give? How should we answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What is your advice?" he asked them. "How should I answer these people who want me to lighten the burdens imposed by my father?"
verses.textEnNasb: He said to them, "What advice do you give, so that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?"
verses.textEn: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?"

verses.textZh: 那些同他一起长大的年轻人对他说："这人民对王说：‘你父亲使我们所负的轭甚重，现在求你减轻些吧。’王要这样对他们说：‘我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗呢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些同他一起长大的年轻人对他说："这人民对王说：‘你父亲使我们所负的轭甚重，现在求你减轻些吧。’王要这样对他们说：‘我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗呢。
verses.textZhCuv: 那同他长大的少年人说：「这民对王说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些』；王要对他们如此说：『我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗；
verses.textEnNiv: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "The people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
verses.textEnEsv: And the young men who had grown up with him said to him, "Thus shall you speak to the people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you lighten it for us’; thus shall you say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s thighs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "Thus you should speak to the people who have spoken to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make it lighter on us’—thus you shall say to them: ‘My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s waist!
verses.textEnNlt: The young men replied, "This is what you should tell those complainers who want a lighter burden: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
verses.textEnNasb: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "This is what you should say to the people who spoke to you, saying: ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make it lighter for us!’ You should speak this way to them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
verses.textEn: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "The people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

verses.textZh: 我父亲把重轭加在你们身上，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭打你们，我却要用蝎子鞭责打你们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我父亲把重轭加在你们身上，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭打你们，我却要用蝎子鞭责打你们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。』」
verses.textEnNiv: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And now, whereas my father laid on you a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, whereas my father put a heavy yoke on you, I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I willchastiseyou with scourges!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, my father laid heavy burdens on you, but I’m going to make them even heavier! My father beat you with whips, but I will beat you with scorpions!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, my father loaded you with a heavy yoke; yet I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions!’ "
verses.textEn: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安和全体人民都遵照罗波安王所说"你们第三天再来见我"的话，第三天来见罗波安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安和全体人民都遵照罗波安王所说"你们第三天再来见我"的话，第三天来见罗波安。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说「你们第三日再来见我」的那话，第三日他们果然来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."
verses.textEnEsv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king said, "Come to me again the third day."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had directed, saying, "Come back to me the third day."
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to hear Rehoboam’s decision, just as the king had ordered.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had directed, saying, "Return to me on the third day."
verses.textEn: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."

verses.textZh: 罗波安王很严厉地回答他们。罗波安王不接受老人的意见，
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王很严厉地回答他们。罗波安王不接受老人的意见，
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王用严厉的话回复他们，不用老年人所出的主意，
verses.textEnNiv: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,
verses.textEnEsv: And the king answered them harshly; and forsaking the counsel of the old men,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king answered them roughly. King Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders,
verses.textEnNlt: But Rehoboam spoke harshly to them, for he rejected the advice of the older counselors
verses.textEnNasb: The king answered them harshly, and King Rehoboam ignored the advice of the elders.
verses.textEn: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,

verses.textZh: 却照着年轻人的主意对他们说："我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我却要用蝎子鞭责打你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 却照着年轻人的主意对他们说："我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我却要用蝎子鞭责打你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 照着少年人所出的主意对他们说：「我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."
verses.textEnEsv: King Rehoboam spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions."
verses.textEnNkjv: and he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it; my father chastised you with whips, but I willchastiseyou with scourges!"
verses.textEnNlt: and followed the counsel of his younger advisers. He told the people, "My father laid heavy burdens on you, but I’m going to make them even heavier! My father beat you with whips, but I will beat you with scorpions!"
verses.textEnNasb: He spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, " My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it; my father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions."
verses.textEn: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."

verses.textZh: 王不听从人民的要求，这事原是出于神，为要实现耶和华借着示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王不听从人民的要求，这事原是出于神，为要实现耶和华借着示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 王不肯依从百姓；这事乃出于神，为要应验耶和华藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
verses.textEnEsv: So the king did not listen to the people, for it was a turn of affairs brought about by God that the Lord might fulfill his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king did not listen to the people; for the turn ofevents was from God, that the Lord might fulfill His word, which He had spoken by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king paid no attention to the people. This turn of events was the will of God, for it fulfilled the Lord ’s message to Jeroboam son of Nebat through the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king did not listen to the people, because it was a turn of events from God so that the Lord might establish His word, which He spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEn: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

verses.textZh: 以色列人见王不听他们的要求，就对王说： "我们和大卫有甚么关系呢？ 我们和耶西的儿子并不相干。 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧， 大卫啊，现在只顾你自己的家吧。" 于是全体以色列人都回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人见王不听他们的要求，就对王说： "我们和大卫有甚么关系呢？ 我们和耶西的儿子并不相干。 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧， 大卫啊，现在只顾你自己的家吧。" 于是全体以色列人都回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说： 我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？ 与耶西的儿子并没有关涉！ 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大卫家啊，自己顾自己吧！ 于是，以色列众人都回自己家里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!" So all the Israelites went home.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, "What portion have we in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Each of you to your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, David." So all Israel went to their tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, saying: "What share have we in David? Wehave no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to your tents, O Israel! Now see to your own house, O David!" So all Israel departed to their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: When all Israel realized that the king had refused to listen to them, they responded, "Down with the dynasty of David! We have no interest in the son of Jesse. Back to your homes, O Israel! Look out for your own house, O David!" So all the people of Israel returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: When all Israel saw that the king had not listened to them, the people replied to the king, saying, "What share do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Everyone to your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David!" So all Israel went away to their tents.
verses.textEn: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!" So all the Israelites went home.

verses.textZh: 只有那些住在犹大众城镇的以色列人，罗波安仍然作他们的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有那些住在犹大众城镇的以色列人，罗波安仍然作他们的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独住在犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.
verses.textEnEsv: But Rehoboam reigned over the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Rehoboam reigned over the children of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: But Rehoboam continued to rule over the Israelites who lived in the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for the sons of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.textEn: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王差派了监管苦工的哈多兰 到以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头把他打死了。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王差派了监管苦工的哈多兰 到以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头把他打死了。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was taskmaster over the forced labor, and the people of Israel stoned him to death with stones. And King Rehoboam quickly mounted his chariot to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was in charge of revenue; but the children of Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. Therefore King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: King Rehoboam sent Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, to restore order, but the people of Israel stoned him to death. When this news reached King Rehoboam, he quickly jumped into his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, and the sons of Israel stoned him to death. And King Rehoboam hurried to mount his chariot to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列人背叛了大卫家，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列人背叛了大卫家，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: And to this day the northern tribes of Israel have refused to be ruled by a descendant of David.
verses.textEnNasb: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEn: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

verses.textZh: 罗波安回到耶路撒冷，就召集犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是精兵，要和以色列人交战，好把王国夺回，再归自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安回到耶路撒冷，就召集犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是精兵，要和以色列人交战，好把王国夺回，再归自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列人争战，好将国夺回再归自己。
verses.textEnNiv: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered Judah and Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.
verses.textEnEsv: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors, to fight against Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled from the house of Judah and Benjamin one hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
verses.textEnNlt: When Rehoboam arrived at Jerusalem, he mobilized the men of Judah and Benjamin—180,000 select troops—to fight against Israel and to restore the kingdom to himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors, to fight against Israel to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
verses.textEn: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered Judah and Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅说：
verses.textEnNiv: But this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:
verses.textEnEsv: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:
verses.textEnNkjv: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Shemaiah, the man of God,
verses.textEnNasb: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.textEn: But this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:

verses.textZh: "你要告诉所罗门的儿子、犹大王罗波安，以及所有住在犹大和便雅悯的以色列人，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉所罗门的儿子、犹大王罗波安，以及所有住在犹大和便雅悯的以色列人，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和住犹大、便雅悯的以色列众人说，
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin:
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.textEn: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,

verses.textZh: ‘耶和华这样说：你们不可上去，也不可和你们的兄弟交战。你们各自回家去吧，因为这事是出于我。’"于是他们听从耶和华的话，都回家，不去攻打耶罗波安。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘耶和华这样说：你们不可上去，也不可和你们的兄弟交战。你们各自回家去吧，因为这事是出于我。’"于是他们听从耶和华的话，都回家，不去攻打耶罗波安。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：『你们不可上去与你们的弟兄争战，各归各家去吧！因为这事出于我。』」众人就听从耶和华的话归回，不去与耶罗波安争战。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your fellow Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ " So they obeyed the words of the Lord and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Thus says the Lord , You shall not go up or fight against your relatives. Return every man to his home, for this thing is from me.’" So they listened to the word of the Lord and returned and did not go against Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord: "You shall not go up or fight against your brethren! Let every man return to his house, for this thing is from Me." ’ " Therefore they obeyed the words of the Lord, and turned back from attacking Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not fight against your relatives. Go back home, for what has happened is my doing!’" So they obeyed the message of the Lord and did not fight against Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord says: "You shall not go up nor fight against your relatives; return, every man, to his house, for this event is from Me." ’ " So they listened to the words of the Lord and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.textEn: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your fellow Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ " So they obeyed the words of the Lord and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.

verses.textZh: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，他在犹大建造了多座设防城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，他在犹大建造了多座设防城。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，在犹大地修筑城邑，
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and he built cities for defense in Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam remained in Jerusalem and fortified various towns for the defense of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built cities for defense in Judah.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:

verses.textZh: 他修筑了伯利恒、以坦、提哥亚、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他修筑了伯利恒、以坦、提哥亚、
verses.textZhCuv: 为保障修筑伯利恒、以坦、提哥亚、
verses.textEnNiv: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.textEnEsv: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.textEnNlt: He built up Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.textEnNasb: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.textEn: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

verses.textZh: 伯．夙、梭哥、亚杜兰、
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯．夙、梭哥、亚杜兰、
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧夙、梭哥、亚杜兰、
verses.textEnNiv: Beth Zur, Soko, Adullam,
verses.textEnEsv: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,
verses.textEnNkjv: Beth Zur, Sochoh, Adullam,
verses.textEnNlt: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,
verses.textEnNasb: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,
verses.textEn: Beth Zur, Soko, Adullam,

verses.textZh: 迦特、玛利沙、西弗、
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦特、玛利沙、西弗、
verses.textZhCuv: 迦特、玛利沙、西弗、
verses.textEnNiv: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.textEnEsv: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.textEnNkjv: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.textEnNlt: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.textEnNasb: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.textEn: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

verses.textZh: 亚多莱音、拉吉、亚西加、
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多莱音、拉吉、亚西加、
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多莱音、拉吉、亚西加、
verses.textEnNiv: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.textEnEsv: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.textEnNlt: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.textEnNasb: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.textEn: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

verses.textZh: 琐拉、亚雅仑、希伯仑；这些都是犹大和便雅悯境内的设防城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 琐拉、亚雅仑、希伯仑；这些都是犹大和便雅悯境内的设防城。
verses.textZhCuv: 琐拉、亚雅仑、希伯仑。这都是犹大和便雅悯的坚固城。
verses.textEnNiv: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, fortified cities that are in Judah and in Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and Benjamin, fortified cities.
verses.textEnNlt: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. These became the fortified towns of Judah and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
verses.textEn: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 他又巩固这些设防城，在城里设军长，贮备粮食、油和酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又巩固这些设防城，在城里设军长，贮备粮食、油和酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安又坚固各处的保障，在其中安置军长，又预备下粮食、油、酒。
verses.textEnNiv: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the fortresses strong, and put commanders in them, and stores of food, oil, and wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil, and wine.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam strengthened their defenses and stationed commanders in them, and he stored supplies of food, olive oil, and wine.
verses.textEnNasb: He also strengthened the fortresses and put officers in them and supplies of food, oil, and wine.
verses.textEn: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.

verses.textZh: 又在各城装备了大盾牌和矛枪，使这些城市十分坚固。这样，犹大和便雅悯都在他统治之下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在各城装备了大盾牌和矛枪，使这些城市十分坚固。这样，犹大和便雅悯都在他统治之下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在各城里预备盾牌和枪，且使城极其坚固。犹大和便雅悯都归了他。
verses.textEnNiv: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put shields and spears in all the cities and made them very strong. So he held Judah and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also in every city heput shields and spears, and made them very strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.textEnNlt: He also put shields and spears in these towns as a further safety measure. So only Judah and Benjamin remained under his control.
verses.textEnNasb: He put shields and spears in every city and strengthened them greatly. So he held Judah and Benjamin.
verses.textEn: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.

verses.textZh: 全以色列的祭司和利未人，都从各地来归向罗波安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全以色列的祭司和利未人，都从各地来归向罗波安。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都从四方来归罗波安。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel presented themselves to him from all places where they lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from all their territories the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel took their stand with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But all the priests and Levites living among the northern tribes of Israel sided with Rehoboam.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel also stood with him from all their districts.
verses.textEn: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.

verses.textZh: 利未人放弃了他们的草场和产业，来到犹大和耶路撒冷，是因为耶罗波安和他的儿子排斥他们，不准他们作祭司事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人放弃了他们的草场和产业，来到犹大和耶路撒冷，是因为耶罗波安和他的儿子排斥他们，不准他们作祭司事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人撇下他们的郊野和产业，来到犹大与耶路撒冷，是因耶罗波安和他的儿子拒绝他们，不许他们供祭司职分事奉耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the Lord
verses.textEnEsv: For the Levites left their common lands and their holdings and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out from serving as priests of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Levites left their common-lands and their possessions and came to Judah and Jerusalem, for Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them from serving as priests to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property and moved to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons would not allow them to serve the Lord as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their property and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had excluded them from serving as priests to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the Lord

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安为邱坛、公山羊神，以及他铸造的牛犊，自己设立了祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安为邱坛、公山羊神，以及他铸造的牛犊，自己设立了祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安为邱坛、为鬼魔 、为自己所铸造的牛犊设立祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: when he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.
verses.textEnEsv: and he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat idols and for the calves that he had made.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he appointed for himself priests for the high places, for the demons, and the calf idols which he had made.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam appointed his own priests to serve at the pagan shrines, where they worshiped the goat and calf idols he had made.
verses.textEnNasb: He set up priests of his own for the high places, for the satyrs and the calves which he had made.
verses.textEn: when he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.

verses.textZh: 以色列众支派中所有定意寻求耶和华以色列的神的，都随着利未人来到耶路撒冷，向耶和华他们列祖的神献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众支派中所有定意寻求耶和华以色列的神的，都随着利未人来到耶路撒冷，向耶和华他们列祖的神献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意寻求耶和华－以色列神的，都随从利未人，来到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和华－他们列祖的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who had set their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel came after them from all the tribes of Israel to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord , the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after the Levites left, those from all the tribes of Israel, such as set their heart to seek the Lord God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: From all the tribes of Israel, those who sincerely wanted to worship the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Those from all the tribes of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the Lord God of Israel followed them to Jerusalem, to sacrifice to the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 这样，他们就加强了犹大国的势力，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛了三年，因为他们在这三年，跟随了大卫和所罗门的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他们就加强了犹大国的势力，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛了三年，因为他们在这三年，跟随了大卫和所罗门的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，就坚固犹大国，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛三年，因为他们三年遵行大卫和所罗门的道。
verses.textEnNiv: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, following the ways of David and Solomon during this time.
verses.textEnEsv: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and for three years they made Rehoboam the son of Solomon secure, for they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, because they walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.
verses.textEnNlt: This strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and for three years they supported Rehoboam son of Solomon, for during those years they faithfully followed in the footsteps of David and Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam the son of Solomon for three years, for they walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.
verses.textEn: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, following the ways of David and Solomon during this time.

verses.textZh: 罗波安娶了大卫的儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉作妻子，她也就是耶西的儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩的女儿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安娶了大卫的儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉作妻子，她也就是耶西的儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩的女儿；
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安娶大卫儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉为妻，又娶耶西儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.
verses.textEnEsv: Rehoboam took as wife Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rehoboam took for himself as wife Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, andof Abihail the daughter of Eliah the son of Jesse.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam married his cousin Mahalath, the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rehoboam married Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse,
verses.textEn: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.

verses.textZh: 她给罗波安生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施、示玛利雅和撒罕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她给罗波安生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施、示玛利雅和撒罕。
verses.textZhCuv: 从她生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施、示玛利雅、撒罕。
verses.textEnNiv: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.
verses.textEnEsv: and she bore him sons, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she bore him children: Jeush, Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.textEnNlt: Mahalath had three sons—Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.textEnNasb: and she bore to him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.textEn: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.

verses.textZh: 后来，罗波安又娶了押沙龙的外孙女玛迦；玛迦给他生了亚比雅、亚太、细撒和示罗密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，罗波安又娶了押沙龙的外孙女玛迦；玛迦给他生了亚比雅、亚太、细撒和示罗密。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来又娶押沙龙的女儿玛迦 ，从她生了亚比雅、亚太、细撒、示罗密。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he married Maakah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.
verses.textEnEsv: After her he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.textEnNkjv: After her he took Maachah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.textEnNlt: Later Rehoboam married another cousin, Maacah, the granddaughter of Absalom. Maacah gave birth to Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.textEnNasb: After her he married Maacah the daughter of Absalom, and she bore to him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.textEn: Then he married Maakah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.

verses.textZh: 罗波安共娶了十八个妻子和六十个妾；共生了二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；他却爱押沙龙的外孙女玛迦，胜过其他的妻妾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安共娶了十八个妻子和六十个妾；共生了二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；他却爱押沙龙的外孙女玛迦，胜过其他的妻妾。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安娶十八个妻，立六十个妾，生二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；他却爱押沙龙的女儿玛迦，比爱别的妻妾更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam loved Maakah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and concubines (he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters).
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Rehoboam loved Maachah the granddaughter of Absalom more than all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and begot twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam loved Maacah more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and they gave birth to twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom more than all his other wives and concubines. For he had taken eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam loved Maakah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

verses.textZh: 于是罗波安立了玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他的兄弟中为首，因为罗波安想立他继承王位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是罗波安立了玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他的兄弟中为首，因为罗波安想立他继承王位。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安立玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他弟兄中为首，因为想要立他接续作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maakah as crown prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maachah as chief, tobe leader among his brothers; for he intended to make him king.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam appointed Maacah’s son Abijah as leader among the princes, making it clear that he would be the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah as head and leader among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maakah as crown prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.

verses.textZh: 罗波安很有智慧地把自己的儿子分散在犹大和便雅悯各地的设防城中，供给他们大批粮食，又为他们娶了多位妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安很有智慧地把自己的儿子分散在犹大和便雅悯各地的设防城中，供给他们大批粮食，又为他们娶了多位妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安办事精明，使他众子分散在犹大和便雅悯全地各坚固城里，又赐他们许多粮食，为他们多寻妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he dealt wisely and distributed some of his sons through all the districts of Judah and Benjamin, in all the fortified cities, and he gave them abundant provisions and procured wives for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the territories of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city; and he gave them provisions in abundance. He also sought many wives forthem.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam also wisely gave responsibilities to his other sons and stationed some of them in the fortified towns throughout the land of Judah and Benjamin. He provided them with generous provisions, and he found many wives for them.
verses.textEnNasb: He acted wisely and distributed some of his sons through all the territories of Judah and Benjamin to all the fortified cities, and he gave them plenty of provisions. And he sought many wives for them.
verses.textEn: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.

verses.textZh: 罗波安的王位稳定，他也强盛起来，就离弃了耶和华的律法，全体以色列人也都跟随他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安的王位稳定，他也强盛起来，就离弃了耶和华的律法，全体以色列人也都跟随他。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安的国坚立，他强盛的时候就离弃耶和华的律法，以色列人也都随从他。
verses.textEnNiv: After Rehoboam’s position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When the rule of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the law of the Lord , and all Israel with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom and had strengthened himself, that he forsook the law of the Lord, and all Israel along with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Rehoboam was firmly established and strong, he abandoned the Law of the Lord , and all Israel followed him in this sin.
verses.textEnNasb: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the Law of the Lord.
verses.textEn: After Rehoboam’s position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为他们得罪了耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为他们得罪了耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为王和民得罪了耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: Because they were unfaithful to the Lord , King Shishak of Egypt came up and attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about in King Rehoboam’s fifth year, because they had been unfaithful to the Lord, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem
verses.textEn: Because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.

verses.textZh: 示撒率领战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，和他一同从埃及出来的路比人、苏基人和古实人，多得无法数算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示撒率领战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，和他一同从埃及出来的路比人、苏基人和古实人，多得无法数算。
verses.textZhCuv: 示撒带战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，并且跟从他出埃及的路比人、苏基人，和古实人，多得不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: with 1,200 chariots and 60,000 horsemen. And the people were without number who came with him from Egypt— Libyans, Sukkiim, and Ethiopians.
verses.textEnNkjv: with twelve hundred chariots, sixty thousand horsemen, and people without number who came with him out of Egypt— the Lubim and the Sukkiim and the Ethiopians.
verses.textEnNlt: He came with 1,200 chariots, 60,000 horses, and a countless army of foot soldiers, including Libyans, Sukkites, and Ethiopians.
verses.textEnNasb: with 1,200 chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. And the people who came with him from Egypt were innumerable: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
verses.textEn: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,

verses.textZh: 他攻取了犹大境内的设防城，然后来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他攻取了犹大境内的设防城，然后来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他攻取了犹大的坚固城，就来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took the fortified cities of Judah and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Shishak conquered Judah’s fortified towns and then advanced to attack Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 那时，犹大的众领袖，因为示撒的缘故，就聚集在耶路撒冷；示玛雅先知就来见罗波安和众领袖，对他们说："耶和华这样说：‘你们既然离弃了我，所以我也离弃你们，把你们交在示撒的手里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，犹大的众领袖，因为示撒的缘故，就聚集在耶路撒冷；示玛雅先知就来见罗波安和众领袖，对他们说："耶和华这样说：‘你们既然离弃了我，所以我也离弃你们，把你们交在示撒的手里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹大的首领因为示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示玛雅去见罗波安和众首领，对他们说：「耶和华如此说：『你们离弃了我，所以我使你们落在示撒手里。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, "This is what the Lord says, ‘You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, "Thus says the Lord , ‘You abandoned me, so I have abandoned you to the hand of Shishak.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah, who were gathered together in Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, "Thus says the Lord: ‘You have forsaken Me, and therefore I also have left you in the hand of Shishak.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet Shemaiah then met with Rehoboam and Judah’s leaders, who had all fled to Jerusalem because of Shishak. Shemaiah told them, "This is what the Lord says: You have abandoned me, so I am abandoning you to Shishak."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the princes of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and he said to them, "This is what the Lord says: ‘You have abandoned Me, so I also have abandoned you to Shishak.’ "
verses.textEn: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, "This is what the Lord says, ‘You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是以色列的众领袖和君王，都谦卑下来，说："耶和华是公义的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列的众领袖和君王，都谦卑下来，说："耶和华是公义的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是王和以色列的众首领都自卑说：「耶和华是公义的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is just."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is righteous."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, "The Lordis righteous."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is right in doing this to us!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is righteous."
verses.textEn: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The Lord is just."

verses.textZh: 耶和华看见他们谦卑下来，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅，说："他们既然谦卑下来，我就不灭绝他们；我必使他们暂时得救，我必不借着示撒把我的烈怒倾倒在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华看见他们谦卑下来，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅，说："他们既然谦卑下来，我就不灭绝他们；我必使他们暂时得救，我必不借着示撒把我的烈怒倾倒在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华见他们自卑，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅说：「他们既自卑，我必不灭绝他们；必使他们略得拯救，我不藉着示撒的手将我的怒气倒在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: "Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: "They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, "They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance. My wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord saw their change of heart, he gave this message to Shemaiah: "Since the people have humbled themselves, I will not completely destroy them and will soon give them some relief. I will not use Shishak to pour out my anger on Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, "They have humbled themselves, so I will not destroy them; and I will grant them a little deliverance, and My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem by means of Shishak.
verses.textEn: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: "Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，他们仍必作示撒的仆人，好使他们知道，服事我和服事世上的列国有甚么分别。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，他们仍必作示撒的仆人，好使他们知道，服事我和服事世上的列国有甚么分别。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而他们必作示撒的仆人，好叫他们知道，服事我与服事外邦人有何分别。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands."
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, they shall be servants to him, that they may know my service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may distinguish My service from the service of the kingdoms of the nations."
verses.textEnNlt: But they will become his subjects, so they will know the difference between serving me and serving earthly rulers."
verses.textEnNasb: But they will become his slaves, so that they may learn the difference between My service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries."
verses.textEn: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands."

verses.textZh: 于是埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，夺取了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，把它们全部带走，又夺去了所罗门所做的金盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，夺取了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，把它们全部带走，又夺去了所罗门所做的金盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.
verses.textEnEsv: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem. He took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house. He took away everything. He also took away the shields of gold that Solomon had made,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house; he took everything. He also carried away the gold shields which Solomon had made.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Shishak of Egypt came up and attacked Jerusalem. He ransacked the treasuries of the Lord ’s Temple and the royal palace; he stole everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.
verses.textEnNasb: So Shishak king of Egypt went up against Jerusalem, and he took the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s palace. He took everything; he even took the gold shields which Solomon had made.
verses.textEn: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王做了一些铜盾牌代替那些金盾牌，交给那些看守宫门的守卫长看管。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王做了一些铜盾牌代替那些金盾牌，交给那些看守宫门的守卫长看管。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。
verses.textEnNiv: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
verses.textEnEsv: and King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the doorway of the king’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: King Rehoboam later replaced them with bronze shields as substitutes, and he entrusted them to the care of the commanders of the guard who protected the entrance to the royal palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place and committed them to the care of the commanders of the guards who guarded the entrance of the king’s house.
verses.textEn: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.

verses.textZh: 每逢王进耶和华殿的时候，守卫就来拿这些盾牌，事后又把盾牌送回守卫房那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢王进耶和华殿的时候，守卫就来拿这些盾牌，事后又把盾牌送回守卫房那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards went with him, bearing the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.
verses.textEnEsv: And as often as the king went into the house of the Lord , the guard came and carried them and brought them back to the guardroom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whenever the king entered the house of the Lord, the guard would go and bring them out; then they would take them back into the guardroom.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the king went to the Temple of the Lord , the guards would also take the shields and then return them to the guardroom.
verses.textEnNasb: As often as the king entered the house of the Lord, the guards came and carried them and then brought them back into the guards’ room.
verses.textEn: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards went with him, bearing the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.

verses.textZh: 王既然谦卑下来，耶和华的烈怒就止息，没有把他完全消灭。何况在犹大中还有善事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王既然谦卑下来，耶和华的烈怒就止息，没有把他完全消灭。何况在犹大中还有善事。
verses.textZhCuv: 王自卑的时候，耶和华的怒气就转消了，不将他灭尽，并且在犹大中间也有善益的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord ’s anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he humbled himself the wrath of the Lord turned from him, so as not to make a complete destruction. Moreover, conditions were good in Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he humbled himself, the wrath of the Lord turned from him, so as not to destroy him completely; and things also went well in Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord ’s anger was turned away, and he did not destroy him completely. There were still some good things in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he humbled himself, the anger of the Lord turned away from him, so as not to destroy him completely; and conditions were also good in Judah.
verses.textEn: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord ’s anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王在耶路撒冷渐渐强盛，继续作王。罗波安登基的时候是四十一岁；他在耶和华从以色列众支派中选出来，立下他名的耶路撒冷城中，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王在耶路撒冷渐渐强盛，继续作王。罗波安登基的时候是四十一岁；他在耶和华从以色列众支派中选出来，立下他名的耶路撒冷城中，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王自强，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
verses.textEnNiv: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.
verses.textEnEsv: So King Rehoboam grew strong in Jerusalem and reigned. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned. Now Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king; and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. His mother’s name was Naamah, an Ammonitess.
verses.textEnNlt: King Rehoboam firmly established himself in Jerusalem and continued to rule. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen from among all the tribes of Israel as the place to honor his name. Rehoboam’s mother was Naamah, a woman from Ammon.
verses.textEnNasb: So King Rehoboam became powerful in Jerusalem and reigned there. For Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen from all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
verses.textEn: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

verses.textZh: 罗波安行恶，因为他没有定意寻求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安行恶，因为他没有定意寻求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安行恶，因他不立定心意寻求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And he did evil, for he did not set his heart to seek the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil, because he did not prepare his heart to seek the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But he was an evil king, for he did not seek the Lord with all his heart.
verses.textEnNasb: But he did evil because he did not set his heart to seek the Lord.
verses.textEn: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the Lord .

verses.textZh: 罗波安的事迹，一生的始末，不是都记在示玛雅先知，和先见易多有关家谱的记录上吗？罗波安和耶罗波安二人常有争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安的事迹，一生的始末，不是都记在示玛雅先知，和先见易多有关家谱的记录上吗？罗波安和耶罗波安二人常有争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安所行的事，自始至终不都写在先知示玛雅和先见易多的史记上吗？罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the events of Rehoboam’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from first to last, are they not written in the chronicles of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer? There were continual wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNkjv: The acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And therewere wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Rehoboam’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded in The Record of Shemaiah the Prophet and The Record of Iddo the Seer, which are part of the genealogical record. Rehoboam and Jeroboam were continually at war with each other.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from the first to the last, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, according to genealogical enrollment? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.textEn: As for the events of Rehoboam’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

verses.textZh: 罗波安和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫城里。他的儿子亚比雅 接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫城里。他的儿子亚比雅 接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚比雅接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David, and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Rehoboam rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David. Then Abijah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Rehoboam died, he was buried in the City of David. Then his son Abijah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Rehoboam lay down with his fathers and was buried in the city of David; and his son Abijah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安王第十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安王第十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安王十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王，
verses.textEnNiv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah became king over Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Abijah began to rule over Judah in the eighteenth year of Jeroboam’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah became king over Judah.
verses.textEn: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,

verses.textZh: 他在耶路撒冷作王三年；他母亲名叫米该亚 ，是基比亚人乌列的女儿。亚比雅和耶罗波安常有争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在耶路撒冷作王三年；他母亲名叫米该亚 ，是基比亚人乌列的女儿。亚比雅和耶罗波安常有争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫米该亚 ，是基比亚人乌列的女儿。 亚比雅常与耶罗波安争战。
verses.textEnNiv: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnEsv: He reigned for three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. Now there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNkjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNlt: He reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother was Maacah, the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Then war broke out between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNasb: He reigned in Jerusalem for three years; and his mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. Now there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.textEn: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

verses.textZh: 有一次，亚比雅带着精兵四十万，都是英勇的战士，准备开战；耶罗波安也带着八十万精兵，都是英勇的战士，列阵对抗亚比雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，亚比雅带着精兵四十万，都是英勇的战士，准备开战；耶罗波安也带着八十万精兵，都是英勇的战士，列阵对抗亚比雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一次亚比雅率领挑选的兵四十万摆阵，都是勇敢的战士；耶罗波安也挑选大能的勇士八十万，对亚比雅摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: Abijah went into battle with an army of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.
verses.textEnEsv: Abijah went out to battle, having an army of valiant men of war, 400,000 chosen men. And Jeroboam drew up his line of battle against him with 800,000 chosen mighty warriors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abijah set the battle in order with an army of valiant warriors, four hundred thousand choice men. Jeroboam also drew up in battle formation against him with eight hundred thousand choice men, mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah, led by King Abijah, fielded 400,000 select warriors, while Jeroboam mustered 800,000 select troops from Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Abijah began the battle with an army of warriors, four hundred thousand chosen men, while Jeroboam drew up in battle formation against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men who were valiant warriors.
verses.textEn: Abijah went into battle with an army of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅起来站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说："耶罗波安和以色列众民哪，你们要听我的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅起来站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说："耶罗波安和以色列众民哪，你们要听我的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说：「耶罗波安和以色列众人哪，要听我说！
verses.textEnNiv: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim that is in the hill country of Ephraim and said, "Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the mountains of Ephraim, and said, "Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: When the army of Judah arrived in the hill country of Ephraim, Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim and shouted to Jeroboam and all Israel: "Listen to me!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Listen to me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
verses.textEn: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神曾经立了盐约，要把以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神曾经立了盐约，要把以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神曾立盐约 ，将以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t you know that the Lord , the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?
verses.textEnEsv: Ought you not to know that the Lord God of Israel gave the kingship over Israel forever to David and his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.textEnNkjv: Should you not know that the Lord God of Israel gave the dominion over Israel to David forever, to him and his sons, by a covenant of salt?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that the Lord , the God of Israel, made a lasting covenant with David, giving him and his descendants the throne of Israel forever?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that the Lord God of Israel gave the rule over Israel forever to David and his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.textEn: Don’t you know that the Lord , the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?

verses.textZh: 可是大卫的儿子所罗门的仆人，尼八的儿子耶罗波安，却起来背叛了他的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是大卫的儿子所罗门的仆人，尼八的儿子耶罗波安，却起来背叛了他的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 无奈大卫儿子所罗门的臣仆、尼八儿子耶罗波安起来背叛他的主人。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his lord,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, a mere servant of David’s son Solomon, rebelled against his master.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his master,
verses.textEn: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.

verses.textZh: 有些无赖匪徒结集跟从他，欺负所罗门的儿子罗波安；那时罗波安还年幼，心里惊怯，所以不能抵挡他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些无赖匪徒结集跟从他，欺负所罗门的儿子罗波安；那时罗波安还年幼，心里惊怯，所以不能抵挡他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些无赖的匪徒聚集跟从他，逞强攻击所罗门的儿子罗波安；那时罗波安还幼弱，不能抵挡他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.
verses.textEnEsv: and certain worthless scoundrels gathered about him and defied Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and irresolute and could not withstand them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then worthless rogues gathered to him, and strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and inexperienced and could not withstand them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a whole gang of scoundrels joined him, defying Solomon’s son Rehoboam when he was young and inexperienced and could not stand up to them.
verses.textEnNasb: and worthless men gathered to him, wicked men, who proved too strong for Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, when he was young and timid and could not hold his own against them.
verses.textEn: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.

verses.textZh: 现在你们有意要反抗大卫子孙手下的耶和华的国；你们人数众多，你们那里也有金牛犊，就是耶罗波安为你们所做，当作神的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们有意要反抗大卫子孙手下的耶和华的国；你们人数众多，你们那里也有金牛犊，就是耶罗波安为你们所做，当作神的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在你们有意抗拒大卫子孙手下所治耶和华的国，你们的人也甚多，你们那里又有耶罗波安为你们所造当作神的金牛犊。
verses.textEnNiv: "And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the Lord , which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord in the hand of the sons of David, because you are a great multitude and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made you for gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord, which is in the hand of the sons of David; and you are a great multitude, and with you are the gold calves which Jeroboam made for you as gods.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you really think you can stand against the kingdom of the Lord that is led by the descendants of David? You may have a vast army, and you have those gold calves that Jeroboam made as your gods.
verses.textEnNasb: "So now you intend to assert yourselves against the kingdom of the Lord through the sons of David, being a great multitude and having with you the golden calves which Jeroboam made for you as gods.
verses.textEn: "And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the Lord , which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.

verses.textZh: 你们不是驱逐了耶和华的祭司，亚伦的子孙和利未人吗？你们不是像世上万民为自己立祭司吗？无论甚么人牵来一头公牛犊和七只公绵羊，自己授圣职，就可以作那本不是神的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不是驱逐了耶和华的祭司，亚伦的子孙和利未人吗？你们不是像世上万民为自己立祭司吗？无论甚么人牵来一头公牛犊和七只公绵羊，自己授圣职，就可以作那本不是神的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不是驱逐耶和华的祭司亚伦的后裔和利未人吗？不是照着外邦人的恶俗为自己立祭司吗？无论何人牵一只公牛犊、七只公绵羊将自己分别出来，就可作虚无之神的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: But didn’t you drive out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not driven out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves like the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes for ordination with a young bull or seven rams becomes a priest of what are not gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made for yourselves priests, like the peoples of other lands, so that whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of thingsthatare not gods?
verses.textEnNlt: But you have chased away the priests of the Lord (the descendants of Aaron) and the Levites, and you have appointed your own priests, just like the pagan nations. You let anyone become a priest these days! Whoever comes to be dedicated with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest of these so-called gods of yours!
verses.textEnNasb: Have you not driven out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron and the Levites, and made for yourselves priests like the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a bull and seven rams, even he may become a priest of things that are not gods.
verses.textEn: But didn’t you drive out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.

verses.textZh: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的神，我们并没有离弃他；我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的子孙，并且有利未人负责工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的神，我们并没有离弃他；我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的子孙，并且有利未人负责工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的神，我们并没有离弃他。我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的后裔，并有利未人各尽其职，
verses.textEnNiv: "As for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the Lord are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests ministering to the Lord who are sons of Aaron, and Levites for their service.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for us, the Lordis our God, and we have not forsaken Him; and the priests who minister to the Lordare the sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
verses.textEnNlt: "But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not abandoned him. Only the descendants of Aaron serve the Lord as priests, and the Levites alone may help them in their work.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not abandoned Him; and the sons of Aaron are ministering to the Lord as priests, and the Levites attend to their work.
verses.textEn: "As for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the Lord are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.

verses.textZh: 他们每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，焚烧芬芳的香；在清洁的桌子上摆上陈设饼；每天晚上燃点金灯台的灯盏；我们谨守耶和华我们的神的吩咐，你们却离弃了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，焚烧芬芳的香；在清洁的桌子上摆上陈设饼；每天晚上燃点金灯台的灯盏；我们谨守耶和华我们的神的吩咐，你们却离弃了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，烧美香，又在精金的桌子上摆陈设饼；又有金灯台和灯盏，每晚点起，因为我们遵守耶和华－我们神的命；惟有你们离弃了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Every morning and evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the Lord . They set out the bread on the ceremonially clean table and light the lamps on the gold lampstand every evening. We are observing the requirements of the Lord our God. But you have forsaken him.
verses.textEnEsv: They offer to the Lord every morning and every evening burnt offerings and incense of sweet spices, set out the showbread on the table of pure gold, and care for the golden lampstand that its lamps may burn every evening.
