For we keep the charge of the Lord our God, but you have forsaken him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they burn to the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense; they also set the showbread inorderon the pure gold table, and the lampstand of gold with its lamps to burn every evening; for we keep the command of the Lord our God, but you have forsaken Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the Lord every morning and evening. They place the Bread of the Presence on the holy table, and they light the gold lampstand every evening. We are following the instructions of the Lord our God, but you have abandoned him.
verses.textEnNasb: Every morning and evening they burn to the Lord burnt offerings and fragrant incense, and the showbread is set on the clean table, and the golden lampstand with its lamps is ready to light every evening; for we perform our duty to the Lord our God, but you have abandoned Him.
verses.textEn: Every morning and evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the Lord . They set out the bread on the ceremonially clean table and light the lamps on the gold lampstand every evening. We are observing the requirements of the Lord our God. But you have forsaken him.

verses.textZh: "看哪，神和我们同在，率领我们；他的祭司拿着号筒向你们大声吹响。以色列人哪，你们不可和耶和华你们列祖的神作战，因为你们必不能得胜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，神和我们同在，率领我们；他的祭司拿着号筒向你们大声吹响。以色列人哪，你们不可和耶和华你们列祖的神作战，因为你们必不能得胜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 率领我们的是神，我们这里也有神的祭司拿号向你们吹出大声。以色列人哪，不要与耶和华－你们列祖的神争战，因你们必不能亨通。」
verses.textEnNiv: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. People of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your ancestors, for you will not succeed."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with their battle trumpets to sound the call to battle against you. O sons of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your fathers, for you cannot succeed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now look, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with sounding trumpets to sound the alarm against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the Lord God of your fathers, for you shall not prosper!"
verses.textEnNlt: So you see, God is with us. He is our leader. His priests blow their trumpets and lead us into battle against you. O people of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your ancestors, for you will not succeed!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, God is with us at our head, and His priests with the signal trumpets to sound the war cry against you. Sons of Israel, do not fight against the Lord God of your fathers, for you will not succeed."
verses.textEn: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. People of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your ancestors, for you will not succeed."

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安却派伏兵绕到犹大人的背后。这样，犹大人前面有以色列人，他们背后也有伏兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安却派伏兵绕到犹大人的背后。这样，犹大人前面有以色列人，他们背后也有伏兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安却在犹大人的后头设伏兵。这样，以色列人在犹大人的前头，伏兵在犹大人的后头。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeroboam had sent an ambush around to come upon them from behind. Thus his troops were in front of Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to go around behind them; so they were in front of Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Jeroboam had secretly sent part of his army around behind the men of Judah to ambush them.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jeroboam had set an ambush to come from behind, so that Israel was in front of Judah and the ambush was behind them.
verses.textEn: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.

verses.textZh: 犹大人转身，看见自己前后受敌，就呼求耶和华，祭司也都吹号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人转身，看见自己前后受敌，就呼求耶和华，祭司也都吹号。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人回头观看，见前后都有敌兵，就呼求耶和华，祭司也吹号。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the Lord . The priests blew their trumpets
verses.textEnEsv: And when Judah looked, behold, the battle was in front of and behind them. And they cried to the Lord , and the priests blew the trumpets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Judah looked around, to their surprise the battle line was at both front and rear; and they cried out to the Lord, and the priests sounded the trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: When Judah realized that they were being attacked from the front and the rear, they cried out to the Lord for help. Then the priests blew the trumpets,
verses.textEnNasb: When Judah turned around, behold, they were attacked both from front and rear; so they cried out to the Lord, and the priests blew the trumpets.
verses.textEn: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the Lord . The priests blew their trumpets

verses.textZh: 于是犹大人大声吶喊；犹大人大声吶喊的时候，神就在亚比雅和犹大人面前，使耶罗波安和以色列众人大败而逃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹大人大声吶喊；犹大人大声吶喊的时候，神就在亚比雅和犹大人面前，使耶罗波安和以色列众人大败而逃。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是犹大人呐喊；犹大人呐喊的时候，神就使耶罗波安和以色列众人败在亚比雅与犹大人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men of Judah raised the battle shout. And when the men of Judah shouted, God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Judah gave a shout; and as the men of Judah shouted, it happened that God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: and the men of Judah began to shout. At the sound of their battle cry, God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel and routed them before Abijah and the army of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Judah raised a war cry, and when the men of Judah raised the war cry, God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.textEn: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑；神把他们交在犹大人手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑；神把他们交在犹大人手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑，神将他们交在犹大人手里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Israel fled before Judah, and God gave them into their hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelite army fled from Judah, and God handed them over to Judah in defeat.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Israel fled from Judah, God handed them over to them.
verses.textEn: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅和他的人民大大地击杀以色列人；以色列人中倒毙的精兵共有五十万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅和他的人民大大地击杀以色列人；以色列人中倒毙的精兵共有五十万。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅和他的军兵大大杀戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十万。
verses.textEnNiv: Abijah and his troops inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel’s able men.
verses.textEnEsv: Abijah and his people struck them with great force, so there fell slain of Israel 500,000 chosen men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abijah and his people struck them with a great slaughter; so five hundred thousand choice men of Israel fell slain.
verses.textEnNlt: Abijah and his army inflicted heavy losses on them; 500,000 of Israel’s select troops were killed that day.
verses.textEnNasb: Abijah and his people defeated them with a great slaughter, so that five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell slain.
verses.textEn: Abijah and his troops inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel’s able men.

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列人被击败了，犹大人获得胜利，因为他们倚靠耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列人被击败了，犹大人获得胜利，因为他们倚靠耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以色列人被制伏了，犹大人得胜，是因倚靠耶和华－他们列祖的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites were subdued on that occasion, and the people of Judah were victorious because they relied on the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the men of Israel were subdued at that time, and the men of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the Lord , the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the children of Israel were subdued at that time; and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: So Judah defeated Israel on that occasion because they trusted in the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel were subdued at that time, and the sons of Judah conquered because they trusted in the Lord, the God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: The Israelites were subdued on that occasion, and the people of Judah were victorious because they relied on the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，夺取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属于伯特利的乡镇，耶沙拿和属于耶沙拿的乡镇，以法拉音和属于以法拉音的乡镇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，夺取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属于伯特利的乡镇，耶沙拿和属于耶沙拿的乡镇，以法拉音和属于以法拉音的乡镇。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，攻取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属伯特利的镇市，耶沙拿和属耶沙拿的镇市，以法拉音 和属以法拉音的镇市。
verses.textEnNiv: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages and Jeshanah with its villages and Ephron with its villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephrain with its villages.
verses.textEnNlt: Abijah and his army pursued Jeroboam’s troops and captured some of his towns, including Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, along with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and captured from him several cities, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
verses.textEn: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅在世的日子，耶罗波安不再强盛。耶和华击打他，他就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅在世的日子，耶罗波安不再强盛。耶和华击打他，他就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅在世的时候，耶罗波安不能再强盛；耶和华攻击他，他就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the Lord struck him down and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeroboam did not recover his power in the days of Abijah. And the Lord struck him down, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jeroboam did not recover strength again in the days of Abijah; and the Lord struck him, and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeroboam of Israel never regained his power during Abijah’s lifetime, and finally the Lord struck him down and he died.
verses.textEnNasb: Jeroboam did not again recover strength in the days of Abijah; and the Lord struck him and he died.
verses.textEn: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the Lord struck him down and he died.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅却不断强盛起来，娶了十四个妻妾，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅却不断强盛起来，娶了十四个妻妾，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅却渐渐强盛，娶妻妾十四个，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: But Abijah grew mighty. And he took fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abijah grew mighty, married fourteen wives, and begot twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Abijah of Judah grew more and more powerful. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abijah became powerful, and he took fourteen wives for himself, and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
verses.textEn: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅其余的事迹和他的言行，都记在易多先知的传记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅其余的事迹和他的言行，都记在易多先知的传记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅其余的事和他的言行都写在先知易多的传上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Abijah’s reign, what he did and what he said, are written in the annotations of the prophet Iddo.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the annals of the prophet Iddo.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Abijah’s reign, including his words and deeds, are recorded in The Commentary of Iddo the Prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways and his words are written in the treatise of Iddo the prophet.
verses.textEn: The other events of Abijah’s reign, what he did and what he said, are written in the annotations of the prophet Iddo.

verses.textZh: 亚比雅和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫城里，他的儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒在世的日子，国中太平了十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比雅和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫城里，他的儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒在世的日子，国中太平了十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒年间，国中太平十年。
verses.textEnNiv: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.
verses.textEnEsv: Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land had rest for ten years.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abijah rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet for ten years.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abijah died, he was buried in the City of David. Then his son Asa became the next king. There was peace in the land for ten years.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abijah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David, and his son Asa became king in his place. The land was undisturbed for ten years during his days.
verses.textEn: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.

verses.textZh: 亚撒行耶和华他的神看为善为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒行耶和华他的神看为善为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒行耶和华－他神眼中看为善为正的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asa did whatwas good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God,
verses.textEnNlt: Asa did what was pleasing and good in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNasb: And Asa did what was good and right in the sight of the Lord his God,
verses.textEn: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 他除掉外族人的祭坛和邱坛，打断神柱，砍下亚舍拉，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他除掉外族人的祭坛和邱坛，打断神柱，砍下亚舍拉，
verses.textZhCuv: 除掉外邦神的坛和邱坛，打碎柱像，砍下木偶，
verses.textEnNiv: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.
verses.textEnEsv: He took away the foreign altars and the high places and broke down the pillars and cut down the Asherim
verses.textEnNkjv: for he removed the altars of the foreign gods and the high places, and broke down the sacred pillars and cut down the wooden images.
verses.textEnNlt: He removed the foreign altars and the pagan shrines. He smashed the sacred pillars and cut down the Asherah poles.
verses.textEnNasb: for he removed the foreign altars and high places, tore down the memorial stones, cut down the Asherim,
verses.textEn: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.

verses.textZh: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华他们列祖的神，遵行他的律法和诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华他们列祖的神，遵行他的律法和诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华－他们列祖的神，遵行他的律法、诫命；
verses.textEnNiv: He commanded Judah to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and to obey his laws and commands.
verses.textEnEsv: and commanded Judah to seek the Lord , the God of their fathers, and to keep the law and the commandment.
verses.textEnNkjv: He commanded Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers, and to observe the law and the commandment.
verses.textEnNlt: He commanded the people of Judah to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and to obey his law and his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: and commanded Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers and to comply with the Law and the commandment.
verses.textEn: He commanded Judah to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and to obey his laws and commands.

verses.textZh: 他又在犹大各城中，除掉邱坛和香坛。那时全国在他的统治下享受太平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在犹大各城中，除掉邱坛和香坛。那时全国在他的统治下享受太平。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在犹大各城邑除掉邱坛和日像，那时国享太平；
verses.textEnNiv: He removed the high places and incense altars in every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him.
verses.textEnEsv: He also took out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the incense altars. And the kingdom had rest under him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also removed the high places and the incense altars from all the cities of Judah, and the kingdom was quiet under him.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa also removed the pagan shrines, as well as the incense altars from every one of Judah’s towns. So Asa’s kingdom enjoyed a period of peace.
verses.textEnNasb: He also removed the high places and the incense altars from all the cities of Judah. And the kingdom was undisturbed under him.
verses.textEn: He removed the high places and incense altars in every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him.

verses.textZh: 他又在犹大建造了几座设防城，因为国中太平，多年没有战争，耶和华使他享受安宁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在犹大建造了几座设防城，因为国中太平，多年没有战争，耶和华使他享受安宁。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在犹大建造了几座坚固城。国中太平数年，没有战争，因为耶和华赐他平安。
verses.textEnNiv: He built up the fortified cities of Judah, since the land was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, for the Lord gave him rest.
verses.textEnEsv: He built fortified cities in Judah, for the land had rest. He had no war in those years, for the Lord gave him peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built fortified cities in Judah, for the land had rest; he had no war in those years, because the Lord had given him rest.
verses.textEnNlt: During those peaceful years, he was able to build up the fortified towns throughout Judah. No one tried to make war against him at this time, for the Lord was giving him rest from his enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: He built fortified cities in Judah, since the land was undisturbed, and there was no one at war with him during those years, because the Lord had given him rest.
verses.textEn: He built up the fortified cities of Judah, since the land was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, for the Lord gave him rest.

verses.textZh: 他对犹大人说："我们要建造这些城，在四周筑墙，建造城楼，安设城门，制作门闩。这地还属于我们，是因为我们寻求耶和华我们的神；我们既然寻求他，他就使我们四境平安。"于是他们兴工建造，事事顺利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对犹大人说："我们要建造这些城，在四周筑墙，建造城楼，安设城门，制作门闩。这地还属于我们，是因为我们寻求耶和华我们的神；我们既然寻求他，他就使我们四境平安。"于是他们兴工建造，事事顺利。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对犹大人说：「我们要建造这些城邑，四围筑墙，盖楼，安门，做闩；地还属我们，是因寻求耶和华－我们的神；我们既寻求他，他就赐我们四境平安。」于是建造城邑，诸事亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let us build up these towns," he said to Judah, "and put walls around them, with towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the Lord our God; we sought him and he has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to Judah, "Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the Lord our God. We have sought him, and he has given us peace on every side." So they built and prospered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he said to Judah, "Let us build these cities and make walls around them, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us, because we have sought the Lord our God; we have sought Him, and He has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa told the people of Judah, "Let us build towns and fortify them with walls, towers, gates, and bars. The land is still ours because we sought the Lord our God, and he has given us peace on every side." So they went ahead with these projects and brought them to completion.
verses.textEnNasb: For he said to Judah, "Let’s build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought the Lord our God; we have sought Him, and He has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.
verses.textEn: "Let us build up these towns," he said to Judah, "and put walls around them, with towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the Lord our God; we sought him and he has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.

verses.textZh: 亚撒的军队，拿大盾牌和矛枪的犹大人，共有三十万；拿小盾牌和拉弓的便雅悯人，共有二十八万；他们都是英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒的军队，拿大盾牌和矛枪的犹大人，共有三十万；拿小盾牌和拉弓的便雅悯人，共有二十八万；他们都是英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒的军兵，出自犹大拿盾牌拿枪的三十万人；出自便雅悯拿盾牌拉弓的二十八万人。这都是大能的勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men from Judah, equipped with large shields and with spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin, armed with small shields and with bows. All these were brave fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa had an army of 300,000 from Judah, armed with large shields and spears, and 280,000 men from Benjamin that carried shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Asa had an army of three hundred thousand from Judah who carried shields and spears, and from Benjamin two hundred and eighty thousand men who carried shields and drew bows; all these were mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: King Asa had an army of 300,000 warriors from the tribe of Judah, armed with large shields and spears. He also had an army of 280,000 warriors from the tribe of Benjamin, armed with small shields and bows. Both armies were composed of well-trained fighting men.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Asa had an army of three hundred thousand from Judah, carrying large shields and spears, and 280,000 from Benjamin, carrying shields and wielding bows; all of them were valiant warriors.
verses.textEn: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men from Judah, equipped with large shields and with spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin, armed with small shields and with bows. All these were brave fighting men.

verses.textZh: 那时有古实人谢拉率领一百万军队，战车三百辆，前来攻打犹大人；他来到了玛利沙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时有古实人谢拉率领一百万军队，战车三百辆，前来攻打犹大人；他来到了玛利沙。
verses.textZhCuv: 有古实王谢拉率领军兵一百万，战车三百辆，出来攻击犹大人，到了玛利沙。
verses.textEnNiv: Zerah the Cushite marched out against them with an army of thousands upon thousands and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.
verses.textEnEsv: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million men and 300 chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million men and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.
verses.textEnNlt: Once an Ethiopian named Zerah attacked Judah with an army of 1,000,000 men and 300 chariots. They advanced to the town of Mareshah,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Zerah the Ethiopian went out against them with an army of a million men and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.
verses.textEn: Zerah the Cushite marched out against them with an army of thousands upon thousands and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.

verses.textZh: 于是亚撒出去迎战；他们就在玛利沙的洗法谷列阵相对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚撒出去迎战；他们就在玛利沙的洗法谷列阵相对。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚撒出去与他迎敌，就在玛利沙的洗法谷彼此摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: Asa went out to meet him, and they took up battle positions in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa went out to meet him, and they drew up their lines of battle in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Asa went out against him, and they set the troops in battle array in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.textEnNlt: so Asa deployed his armies for battle in the valley north of Mareshah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Asa went out to meet him, and they drew up in battle formation in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.textEn: Asa went out to meet him, and they took up battle positions in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.

verses.textZh: 亚撒呼求耶和华他的神说："耶和华啊，强弱悬殊，除你以外没有别的帮助。耶和华我们的神啊，求你帮助我们。因为我们倚靠你，奉你的名去对抗这大军。耶和华啊，你是我们的神，不要让人胜过你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒呼求耶和华他的神说："耶和华啊，强弱悬殊，除你以外没有别的帮助。耶和华我们的神啊，求你帮助我们。因为我们倚靠你，奉你的名去对抗这大军。耶和华啊，你是我们的神，不要让人胜过你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒呼求耶和华－他的神说：「耶和华啊，惟有你能帮助软弱的，胜过强盛的。耶和华－我们的神啊，求你帮助我们；因为我们仰赖你，奉你的名来攻击这大军。耶和华啊，你是我们的神，不要容人胜过你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Asa called to the Lord his God and said, " Lord , there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, Lord our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this vast army. Lord , you are our God; do not let mere mortals prevail against you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa cried to the Lord his God, "O Lord , there is none like you to help, between the mighty and the weak. Help us, O Lord our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. O Lord , you are our God; let not man prevail against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Asa cried out to the Lord his God, and said, "Lord, itis nothing for You to help, whether with many or with those who have no power; help us, O Lord our God, for we rest on You, and in Your name we go against this multitude. O Lord, You are our God; do not let man prevail against You!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Asa cried out to the Lord his God, "O Lord , no one but you can help the powerless against the mighty! Help us, O Lord our God, for we trust in you alone. It is in your name that we have come against this vast horde. O Lord , you are our God; do not let mere men prevail against you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Asa called to the Lord his God and said, "Lord, there is no one besides You to help in the battle between the powerful and those who have no strength; help us, Lord our God, for we trust in You, and in Your name have come against this multitude. Lord, You are our God; do not let man prevail against You."
verses.textEn: Then Asa called to the Lord his God and said, " Lord , there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, Lord our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this vast army. Lord , you are our God; do not let mere mortals prevail against you."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华在亚撒和犹大人面前，使古实人大败，古实人就逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华在亚撒和犹大人面前，使古实人大败，古实人就逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华使古实人败在亚撒和犹大人面前，古实人就逃跑了；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah. The Cushites fled,
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord defeated the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah, and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord struck the Ethiopians before Asa and Judah, and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord defeated the Ethiopians in the presence of Asa and the army of Judah, and the enemy fled.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord routed the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah, and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.textEn: The Lord struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah. The Cushites fled,

verses.textZh: 亚撒和跟随他的人民追赶他们，直到基拉耳；古实人被杀的很多，不能恢复强盛；因为他们在耶和华和他的军队面前被击溃了；犹大人夺取了极多战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒和跟随他的人民追赶他们，直到基拉耳；古实人被杀的很多，不能恢复强盛；因为他们在耶和华和他的军队面前被击溃了；犹大人夺取了极多战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒和跟随他的军兵追赶他们，直到基拉耳。古实人被杀的甚多，不能再强盛，因为败在耶和华与他军兵面前。犹大人就夺了许多财物，
verses.textEnNiv: and Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Such a great number of Cushites fell that they could not recover; they were crushed before the Lord and his forces. The men of Judah carried off a large amount of plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them as far as Gerar, and the Ethiopians fell until none remained alive, for they were broken before the Lord and his army. The men of Judah carried away very much spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So the Ethiopians were overthrown, and they could not recover, for they were broken before the Lord and His army. And they carried away very much spoil.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar, and so many Ethiopians fell that they were unable to rally. They were destroyed by the Lord and his army, and the army of Judah carried off a vast amount of plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them as far as Gerar; and so many Ethiopians fell that they could not recover, for they were shattered before the Lord and before His army. And they carried away a very large amount of plunder.
verses.textEn: and Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Such a great number of Cushites fell that they could not recover; they were crushed before the Lord and his forces. The men of Judah carried off a large amount of plunder.

verses.textZh: 他们又攻击基拉耳周围的一切城市，因为各城的人都惧怕耶和华。犹大人又把各城洗掠一空，因为城中的财物甚多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又攻击基拉耳周围的一切城市，因为各城的人都惧怕耶和华。犹大人又把各城洗掠一空，因为城中的财物甚多。
verses.textZhCuv: 又打破基拉耳四围的城邑；耶和华使其中的人都甚恐惧。犹大人又将所有的城掳掠一空，因其中的财物甚多，
verses.textEnNiv: They destroyed all the villages around Gerar, for the terror of the Lord had fallen on them. They looted all these villages, since there was much plunder there.
verses.textEnEsv: And they attacked all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the Lord was upon them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they defeated all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the Lord came upon them; and they plundered all the cities, for there was exceedingly much spoil in them.
verses.textEnNlt: While they were at Gerar, they attacked all the towns in that area, and terror from the Lord came upon the people there. As a result, a vast amount of plunder was taken from these towns, too.
verses.textEnNasb: They destroyed all the cities around Gerar, for the dread of the Lord had fallen on them; and they pillaged all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.
verses.textEn: They destroyed all the villages around Gerar, for the terror of the Lord had fallen on them. They looted all these villages, since there was much plunder there.

verses.textZh: 他们又毁坏了牲畜的棚，牵走了很多的羊和骆驼，然后回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又毁坏了牲畜的棚，牵走了很多的羊和骆驼，然后回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又毁坏了群畜的圈，夺取许多的羊和骆驼，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: They also attacked the camps of the herders and carried off droves of sheep and goats and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And they struck down the tents of those who had livestock and carried away sheep in abundance and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also attacked the livestock enclosures, and carried off sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: They also attacked the camps of herdsmen and captured many sheep, goats, and camels before finally returning to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: They also fatally struck those who owned livestock, and they led away large numbers of sheep and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: They also attacked the camps of the herders and carried off droves of sheep and goats and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 神的灵降在俄德的儿子亚撒利雅身上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的灵降在俄德的儿子亚撒利雅身上，
verses.textZhCuv: 神的灵感动俄德的儿子亚撒利雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit of God came on Azariah son of Oded.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded,
verses.textEn: The Spirit of God came on Azariah son of Oded.

verses.textZh: 亚撒利雅就出来迎接亚撒，对他说："亚撒和犹大、便雅悯所有的人哪！请听我说。你们跟随耶和华，耶和华就和你们同在；你们寻求他，就必给你们寻见；你们离弃他，他必离弃你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒利雅就出来迎接亚撒，对他说："亚撒和犹大、便雅悯所有的人哪！请听我说。你们跟随耶和华，耶和华就和你们同在；你们寻求他，就必给你们寻见；你们离弃他，他必离弃你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说：「亚撒和犹大、便雅悯众人哪，要听我说：你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在；你们若寻求他，就必寻见；你们若离弃他，他必离弃你们。
verses.textEnNiv: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The Lord is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.textEnEsv: and he went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: The Lord is with you while you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he went out to meet Asa, and said to him: "Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin. The Lordis with you while you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
verses.textEnNlt: and he went out to meet King Asa as he was returning from the battle. "Listen to me, Asa!" he shouted. "Listen, all you people of Judah and Benjamin! The Lord will stay with you as long as you stay with him! Whenever you seek him, you will find him. But if you abandon him, he will abandon you.
verses.textEnNasb: and he went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Listen to me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: the Lord is with you when you are with Him. And if you seek Him, He will let you find Him; but if you abandon Him, He will abandon you.
verses.textEn: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The Lord is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

verses.textZh: 以色列人没有真神，没有教导他们的祭司，没有律法，已经很久了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人没有真神，没有教导他们的祭司，没有律法，已经很久了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人不信真神，没有训诲的祭司，也没有律法，已经好久了；
verses.textEnNiv: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach and without the law.
verses.textEnEsv: For a long time Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest and without law,
verses.textEnNkjv: For a long time Israel hasbeen without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law;
verses.textEnNlt: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach them, and without the Law to instruct them.
verses.textEnNasb: For many days Israel was without the true God and without a teaching priest and without the Law.
verses.textEn: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach and without the law.

verses.textZh: 但他们在遭难的时候，回转归向耶和华以色列的神，寻求他，他就给他们寻见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们在遭难的时候，回转归向耶和华以色列的神，寻求他，他就给他们寻见。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们在急难的时候归向耶和华－以色列的神，寻求他，他就被他们寻见。
verses.textEnNiv: But in their distress they turned to the Lord , the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found by them.
verses.textEnEsv: but when in their distress they turned to the Lord , the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.
verses.textEnNkjv: but when in their trouble they turned to the Lord God of Israel, and sought Him, He was found by them.
verses.textEnNlt: But whenever they were in trouble and turned to the Lord , the God of Israel, and sought him out, they found him.
verses.textEnNasb: But in their distress they turned to the Lord God of Israel, and they sought Him, and He let them find Him.
verses.textEn: But in their distress they turned to the Lord , the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found by them.

verses.textZh: 那时，出入的人都没有平安，因为各国的居民都遭遇动乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，出入的人都没有平安，因为各国的居民都遭遇动乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，出入的人不得平安，列国的居民都遭大乱；
verses.textEnNiv: In those days it was not safe to travel about, for all the inhabitants of the lands were in great turmoil.
verses.textEnEsv: In those times there was no peace to him who went out or to him who came in, for great disturbances afflicted all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in those times therewas no peace to the one who went out, nor to the one who came in, but great turmoil was on all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.textEnNlt: "During those dark times, it was not safe to travel. Problems troubled the people of every land.
verses.textEnNasb: In those times there was no peace for him who went out or him who came in, because many disturbances afflicted all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.textEn: In those days it was not safe to travel about, for all the inhabitants of the lands were in great turmoil.

verses.textZh: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，因为神用各样灾难使他们纷乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，因为神用各样灾难使他们纷乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，互相破坏，因为神用各样灾难扰乱他们。
verses.textEnNiv: One nation was being crushed by another and one city by another, because God was troubling them with every kind of distress.
verses.textEnEsv: They were broken in pieces. Nation was crushed by nation and city by city, for God troubled them with every sort of distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: So nation was destroyed by nation, and city by city, for God troubled them with every adversity.
verses.textEnNlt: Nation fought against nation, and city against city, for God was troubling them with every kind of problem.
verses.textEnNasb: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God troubled them with every kind of distress.
verses.textEn: One nation was being crushed by another and one city by another, because God was troubling them with every kind of distress.

verses.textZh: 但你们要坚强，不要胆怯，因为你们所行的，必有赏报。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们要坚强，不要胆怯，因为你们所行的，必有赏报。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们要刚强，不要手软，因你们所行的必得赏赐。」
verses.textEnNiv: But as for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded."
verses.textEnEsv: But you, take courage! Do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded."
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, be strong and do not let your hands be weak, for your work shall be rewarded!"
verses.textEnNlt: But as for you, be strong and courageous, for your work will be rewarded."
verses.textEnNasb: But you, be strong and do not lose courage, for there is a reward for your work."
verses.textEn: But as for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded."

verses.textZh: 亚撒听了这些话，和俄德的儿子亚撒利雅先知所说的预言以后，就勇敢起来，在犹大、便雅悯全地，以及以法莲山地夺取的各城，把可憎的偶像除去，又在耶和华殿的走廊前面，重新修造耶和华的祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒听了这些话，和俄德的儿子亚撒利雅先知所说的预言以后，就勇敢起来，在犹大、便雅悯全地，以及以法莲山地夺取的各城，把可憎的偶像除去，又在耶和华殿的走廊前面，重新修造耶和华的祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒听见这话和俄德儿子先知亚撒利雅的预言，就壮起胆来，在犹大、便雅悯全地，并以法莲山地所夺的各城，将可憎之物尽都除掉，又在耶和华殿的廊前重新修筑耶和华的坛；
verses.textEnNiv: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage. He removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hills of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the Lord that was in front of the portico of the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Asa heard these words, the prophecy of Azariah the son of Oded, he took courage and put away the detestable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities that he had taken in the hill country of Ephraim, and he repaired the altar of the Lord that was in front of the vestibule of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and removed the abominable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities which he had taken in the mountains of Ephraim; and he restored the altar of the Lord that was before the vestibule of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When Asa heard this message from Azariah the prophet, he took courage and removed all the detestable idols from the land of Judah and Benjamin and in the towns he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. And he repaired the altar of the Lord , which stood in front of the entry room of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Asa heard these words and the prophecy which Azariah the son of Oded the prophet spoke, he took courage and removed the abominable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and from the cities which he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He then restored the altar of the Lord which was in front of the porch of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage. He removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hills of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the Lord that was in front of the portico of the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 他又召聚了犹大和便雅悯所有的人，以及在他们中间寄居的以法莲人、玛拿西人、西缅人。以色列人看见了耶和华亚撒的神和他同在，就有很多人投奔亚撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又召聚了犹大和便雅悯所有的人，以及在他们中间寄居的以法莲人、玛拿西人、西缅人。以色列人看见了耶和华亚撒的神和他同在，就有很多人投奔亚撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 又招聚犹大、便雅悯的众人，并他们中间寄居的以法莲人、玛拿西人、西缅人。有许多以色列人归降亚撒，因见耶和华－他的神与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he assembled all Judah and Benjamin and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them, for large numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who were residing with them, for great numbers had deserted to him from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who dwelt with them from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon, for they came over to him in great numbers from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Asa called together all the people of Judah and Benjamin, along with the people of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who had settled among them. For many from Israel had moved to Judah during Asa’s reign when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who resided with them, for many defected to him from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.textEn: Then he assembled all Judah and Benjamin and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them, for large numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

verses.textZh: 亚撒在位第十五年三月，他们聚集在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒在位第十五年三月，他们聚集在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒十五年三月，他们都聚集在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.textEnEsv: They were gathered at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gathered together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.textEnNlt: The people gathered at Jerusalem in late spring, during the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: So they assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.textEn: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

verses.textZh: 那一天，他们从夺回来的战利品当中，把七百头牛，七千只羊，献给耶和华为祭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，他们从夺回来的战利品当中，把七百头牛，七千只羊，献给耶和华为祭，
verses.textZhCuv: 当日他们从所取的掳物中，将牛七百只、羊七千只献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time they sacrificed to the Lord seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep and goats from the plunder they had brought back.
verses.textEnEsv: They sacrificed to the Lord on that day from the spoil that they had brought 700 oxen and 7,000 sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they offered to the Lord at that time seven hundred bulls and seven thousand sheep from the spoil they had brought.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day they sacrificed to the Lord 700 cattle and 7,000 sheep and goats from the plunder they had taken in the battle.
verses.textEnNasb: They sacrificed to the Lord on that day seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from the spoils they had brought.
verses.textEn: At that time they sacrificed to the Lord seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep and goats from the plunder they had brought back.

verses.textZh: 他们也立约，要一心一意寻求耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也立约，要一心一意寻求耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就立约，要尽心尽性地寻求耶和华－他们列祖的神。
verses.textEnNiv: They entered into a covenant to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and soul.
verses.textEnEsv: And they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord , the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.textEnNlt: Then they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and soul.
verses.textEnNasb: They entered into the covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and soul;
verses.textEn: They entered into a covenant to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and soul.

verses.textZh: 不寻求耶和华以色列的神的，无论男女老幼，都必处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不寻求耶和华以色列的神的，无论男女老幼，都必处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不寻求耶和华－以色列神的，无论大小、男女，必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: All who would not seek the Lord , the God of Israel, were to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.
verses.textEnEsv: but that whoever would not seek the Lord , the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: and whoever would not seek the Lord God of Israel was to be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.textEnNlt: They agreed that anyone who refused to seek the Lord , the God of Israel, would be put to death—whether young or old, man or woman.
verses.textEnNasb: and whoever would not seek the Lord God of Israel was to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.
verses.textEn: All who would not seek the Lord , the God of Israel, were to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.

verses.textZh: 他们就大声欢呼，吹起号角，向耶和华起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就大声欢呼，吹起号角，向耶和华起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就大声欢呼，吹号吹角，向耶和华起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: They took an oath to the Lord with loud acclamation, with shouting and with trumpets and horns.
verses.textEnEsv: They swore an oath to the Lord with a loud voice and with shouting and with trumpets and with horns.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took an oath before the Lord with a loud voice, with shouting and trumpets and rams’ horns.
verses.textEnNlt: They shouted out their oath of loyalty to the Lord with trumpets blaring and rams’ horns sounding.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they made an oath to the Lord with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and with horns.
verses.textEn: They took an oath to the Lord with loud acclamation, with shouting and with trumpets and horns.

verses.textZh: 犹大众人都为了所起的誓快乐，因为他们一心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就给他们寻见，并且使他们四境安宁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大众人都为了所起的誓快乐，因为他们一心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就给他们寻见，并且使他们四境安宁。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大众人为所起的誓欢喜；因他们是尽心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就被他们寻见，且赐他们四境平安。
verses.textEnNiv: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the Lord gave them rest on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and had sought him with their whole desire, and he was found by them, and the Lord gave them rest all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought Him with all their soul; and He was found by them, and the Lord gave them rest all around.
verses.textEnNlt: All in Judah were happy about this covenant, for they had entered into it with all their heart. They earnestly sought after God, and they found him. And the Lord gave them rest from their enemies on every side.
verses.textEnNasb: All Judah rejoiced concerning the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and had sought Him earnestly, and He let them find Him. So the Lord gave them rest on every side.
verses.textEn: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the Lord gave them rest on every side.

verses.textZh: 亚撒王也废掉他的祖母玛迦太后的位，因为她曾给亚舍拉做了可憎的像；亚撒把她那可憎的像砍了下来，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪旁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒王也废掉他的祖母玛迦太后的位，因为她曾给亚舍拉做了可憎的像；亚撒把她那可憎的像砍了下来，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪旁。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒王贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪边。
verses.textEnNiv: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnEsv: Even Maacah, his mother, King Asa removed from being queen mother because she had made a detestable image for Asherah. Asa cut down her image, crushed it, and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he removed Maachah, the mother of Asa the king, from being queen mother, because she had made an obscene image of Asherah; and Asa cut down her obscene image, then crushed and burned it by the Brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNlt: King Asa even deposed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made an obscene Asherah pole. He cut down her obscene pole, broke it up, and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: He also removed Maacah, the mother of King Asa, from the position of queen mother, because she had made an abominable image as an Asherah, and Asa cut down her abominable image, crushed it, and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.textEn: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

verses.textZh: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中除掉，但亚撒的心一生都完全忠于耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中除掉，但亚撒的心一生都完全忠于耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中废去，然而亚撒的心一生诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: Although he did not remove the high places from Israel, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.
verses.textEnEsv: But the high places were not taken out of Israel. Nevertheless, the heart of Asa was wholly true all his days.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the high places were not removed from Israel. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was loyal all his days.
verses.textEnNlt: Although the pagan shrines were not removed from Israel, Asa’s heart remained completely faithful throughout his life.
verses.textEnNasb: But the high places were not removed from Israel; nevertheless Asa’s heart was blameless all his days.
verses.textEn: Although he did not remove the high places from Israel, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.

verses.textZh: 亚撒把他父亲所分别为圣，和他自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿，都送进神的殿里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒把他父亲所分别为圣，和他自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿，都送进神的殿里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒将他父所分别为圣、与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到神的殿里。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought into the house of God the sacred gifts of his father and his own sacred gifts, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated: silver and gold and utensils.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought into the Temple of God the silver and gold and the various items that he and his father had dedicated.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought into the house of God the dedicated things of his father and his own dedicated things: silver, gold, and utensils.
verses.textEn: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

verses.textZh: 从那时，直到亚撒在位第三十五年，都没有战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那时，直到亚撒在位第三十五年，都没有战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 从这时直到亚撒三十五年，都没有争战的事。
verses.textEnNiv: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was no war until the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.textEnNlt: So there was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
verses.textEn: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

verses.textZh: 亚撒在位第三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻打犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人离开或进入犹大王亚撒的国境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒在位第三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻打犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人离开或进入犹大王亚撒的国境。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and built Ramah, that he might permit no one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah and built Ramah, that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, King Baasha of Israel invaded Judah and fortified Ramah in order to prevent anyone from entering or leaving King Asa’s territory in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah and fortified Ramah in order to prevent anyone from going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

verses.textZh: 于是亚撒从耶和华的殿和王宫的库房里取出金银来，送给住在大马士革的亚兰王便．哈达，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚撒从耶和华的殿和王宫的库房里取出金银来，送给住在大马士革的亚兰王便．哈达，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚撒从耶和华殿和王宫的府库里拿出金银来，送与住大马士革的亚兰王便哈达，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Asa then took the silver and gold out of the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace and sent it to Ben-Hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Asa took silver and gold from the treasures of the house of the Lord and the king’s house and sent them to Ben-hadad king of Syria, who lived in Damascus, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Asa brought silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the Lord and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-Hadad king of Syria, who dwelt in Damascus, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Asa responded by removing the silver and gold from the treasuries of the Temple of the Lord and the royal palace. He sent it to King Ben-hadad of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus, along with this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Asa brought out silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the Lord and the king’s house, and sent it to Ben-hadad king of Aram, who lived in Damascus, saying,
verses.textEn: Asa then took the silver and gold out of the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace and sent it to Ben-Hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

verses.textZh: "你父亲和我父亲曾经立约，你和我也要立约。现在我把金银送给你，请你去废除你和以色列王巴沙订立的约，好使他离开我而去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你父亲和我父亲曾经立约，你和我也要立约。现在我把金银送给你，请你去废除你和以色列王巴沙订立的约，好使他离开我而去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送给你，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."
verses.textEnEsv: "There is a covenant between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I am sending to you silver and gold. Go, break your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, that he may withdraw from me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lettherebe a treaty between you and me, as there was between my father and your father. See, I have sent you silver and gold; come, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Let there be a treaty between you and me like the one between your father and my father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel so that he will leave me alone."
verses.textEnNasb: "A treaty must be made between you and me, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold; go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so that he will withdraw from me."
verses.textEn: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."

verses.textZh: 便．哈达听从了亚撒王的话，就派遣他属下的众军长去攻击以色列的城市，他们攻陷了以云、但、亚伯．玛音和拿弗他利一切贮藏货物的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．哈达听从了亚撒王的话，就派遣他属下的众军长去攻击以色列的城市，他们攻陷了以云、但、亚伯．玛音和拿弗他利一切贮藏货物的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 便‧哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑。他们就攻破以云、但、亚伯‧玛音，和拿弗他利一切的积货城。
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, and they conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ben-Hadad heeded King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel. They attacked Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-hadad agreed to King Asa’s request and sent the commanders of his army to attack the towns of Israel. They conquered the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and all the store cities in Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa, and he sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, and they conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.
verses.textEn: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 巴沙听见了，就停止修筑拉玛，把工程都停止了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴沙听见了，就停止修筑拉玛，把工程都停止了。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴沙听见就停工，不修筑拉玛了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah and let his work cease.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Baasha heard it, that he stopped building Ramah and ceased his work.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Baasha of Israel heard what was happening, he abandoned his project of fortifying Ramah and stopped all work on it.
verses.textEnNasb: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped fortifying Ramah and put an end to his work.
verses.textEn: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.

verses.textZh: 于是亚撒王带领犹大众人，把巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头和木材都搬走，用来修筑迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚撒王带领犹大众人，把巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头和木材都搬走，用来修筑迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚撒王率领犹大众人，将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头、木头都运去，用以修筑迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using. With them he built up Geba and Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Asa took all Judah, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber, with which Baasha had been building, and with them he built Geba and Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Asa took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, which Baasha had used for building; and with them he built Geba and Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Asa called out all the men of Judah to carry away the building stones and timbers that Baasha had been using to fortify Ramah. Asa used these materials to fortify the towns of Geba and Mizpah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Asa brought all Judah, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber with which Baasha had been building, and with it he fortified Geba and Mizpah.
verses.textEn: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using. With them he built up Geba and Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说："因你倚靠亚兰王，没有倚靠耶和华你的神，所以亚兰王的军队才可以脱离你的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说："因你倚靠亚兰王，没有倚靠耶和华你的神，所以亚兰王的军队才可以脱离你的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说：「因你仰赖亚兰王，没有仰赖耶和华－你的神，所以亚兰王的军兵脱离了你的手。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him: "Because you relied on the king of Aram and not on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, "Because you relied on the king of Syria, and did not rely on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Syria has escaped you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him: "Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the Lord your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped from your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa and told him, "Because you have put your trust in the king of Aram instead of in the Lord your God, you missed your chance to destroy the army of the king of Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, "Because you have relied on the king of Aram and have not relied on the Lord your God, for that reason the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
verses.textEn: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him: "Because you relied on the king of Aram and not on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.

verses.textZh: 古实人和路比人不是有强大的军队吗？战车和马兵不是极多吗？只因你倚靠耶和华，耶和华就把他们交在你手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实人和路比人不是有强大的军队吗？战车和马兵不是极多吗？只因你倚靠耶和华，耶和华就把他们交在你手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实人、路比人的军队不是甚大吗？战车马兵不是极多吗？只因你仰赖耶和华，他便将他们交在你手里。
verses.textEnNiv: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a mighty army with great numbers of chariots and horsemen ? Yet when you relied on the Lord , he delivered them into your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge army with very many chariots and horsemen? Yet because you relied on the Lord , he gave them into your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Were the Ethiopians and the Lubim not a huge army with very many chariots and horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the Lord, He delivered them into your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you remember what happened to the Ethiopians and Libyans and their vast army, with all of their chariots and charioteers? At that time you relied on the Lord , and he handed them over to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubim an immense army with very many chariots and horsemen? Yet because you relied on the Lord, He handed them over to you.
verses.textEn: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a mighty army with great numbers of chariots and horsemen ? Yet when you relied on the Lord , he delivered them into your hand.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，一心归向他的，他必以大能扶助他们；你作这事太愚昧了。从今以后，你必常有战争。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，一心归向他的，他必以大能扶助他们；你作这事太愚昧了。从今以后，你必常有战争。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，要显大能帮助向他心存诚实的人。你这事行得愚昧；此后，你必有争战的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war."
verses.textEnEsv: For the eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to give strong support to those whose heart is blameless toward him. You have done foolishly in this, for from now on you will have wars."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose heart is loyal to Him. In this you have done foolishly; therefore from now on you shall have wars."
verses.textEnNlt: The eyes of the Lord search the whole earth in order to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. What a fool you have been! From now on you will be at war."
verses.textEnNasb: For the eyes of the Lord roam throughout the earth, so that He may strongly support those whose heart is completely His. You have acted foolishly in this. Indeed, from now on you will have wars."
verses.textEn: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war."

verses.textZh: 于是亚撒对先见发怒，把他囚在监里，因为亚撒为了这事很恼怒他。同时亚撒也压迫人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚撒对先见发怒，把他囚在监里，因为亚撒为了这事很恼怒他。同时亚撒也压迫人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒因此恼恨先见，将他囚在监里。那时亚撒也虐待一些人民。
verses.textEnNiv: Asa was angry with the seer because of this; he was so enraged that he put him in prison. At the same time Asa brutally oppressed some of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Asa was angry with the seer and put him in the stocks in prison, for he was in a rage with him because of this. And Asa inflicted cruelties upon some of the people at the same time.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in prison, for hewas enraged at him because of this. And Asa oppressed some of the people at that time.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa became so angry with Hanani for saying this that he threw him into prison and put him in stocks. At that time Asa also began to oppress some of his people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Asa was angry with the seer and put him in prison, for he was enraged at him for this. And Asa mistreated some of the people at the same time.
verses.textEn: Asa was angry with the seer because of this; he was so enraged that he put him in prison. At the same time Asa brutally oppressed some of the people.

verses.textZh: 亚撒所行的事迹，一生的始末，都记在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒所行的事迹，一生的始末，都记在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒所行的事，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The events of Asa’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The acts of Asa, from first to last, are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Note that the acts of Asa, first and last, are indeed written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Asa’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, the acts of Asa from the first to the last, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEn: The events of Asa’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚撒在位第三十九年，患了脚病，病情严重；可是，连他患病的时候，也没有寻求耶和华，只管寻求医生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒在位第三十九年，患了脚病，病情严重；可是，连他患病的时候，也没有寻求耶和华，只管寻求医生。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒作王三十九年，他脚上有病，而且甚重。病的时候没有求耶和华，只求医生。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was afflicted with a disease in his feet. Though his disease was severe, even in his illness he did not seek help from the Lord , but only from the physicians.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was diseased in his feet, and his disease became severe. Yet even in his disease he did not seek the Lord , but sought help from physicians.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa became diseased in his feet, and his malady was severe; yet in his disease he did not seek the Lord, but the physicians.
verses.textEnNlt: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa developed a serious foot disease. Yet even with the severity of his disease, he did not seek the Lord ’s help but turned only to his physicians.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa became diseased in his feet. His disease was severe, yet even in his disease he did not seek the Lord, but the physicians.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was afflicted with a disease in his feet. Though his disease was severe, even in his illness he did not seek help from the Lord , but only from the physicians.

verses.textZh: 亚撒作王四十一年以后死了，和他的列祖同睡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒作王四十一年以后死了，和他的列祖同睡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他作王四十一年而死，与他列祖同睡，
verses.textEnNiv: Then in the forty-first year of his reign Asa died and rested with his ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa slept with his fathers, dying in the forty-first year of his reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Asa rested with his fathers; he died in the forty-first year of his reign.
verses.textEnNlt: So he died in the forty-first year of his reign.
verses.textEnNasb: So Asa lay down with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.
verses.textEn: Then in the forty-first year of his reign Asa died and rested with his ancestors.

verses.textZh: 人把他埋葬在大卫城里他为自己所凿的坟墓中。他们把他放在堆满按著作香的方法调和的各样香料的床上，又为他烧了很多香料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人把他埋葬在大卫城里他为自己所凿的坟墓中。他们把他放在堆满按著作香的方法调和的各样香料的床上，又为他烧了很多香料。
verses.textZhCuv: 葬在大卫城自己所凿的坟墓里，放在床上，其床堆满各样馨香的香料，就是按做香的作法调和的香料，又为他烧了许多的物件。
verses.textEnNiv: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier covered with spices and various blended perfumes, and they made a huge fire in his honor.
verses.textEnEsv: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut for himself in the city of David. They laid him on a bier that had been filled with various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumer’s art, and they made a very great fire in his honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had made for himself in the City of David; and they laid him in the bed which was filled with spices and various ingredients prepared in a mixture of ointments. They made a very great burning for him.
verses.textEnNlt: He was buried in the tomb he had carved out for himself in the City of David. He was laid on a bed perfumed with sweet spices and fragrant ointments, and the people built a huge funeral fire in his honor.
verses.textEnNasb: They buried him in his own tomb which he had cut out for himself in the city of David, and they laid him in the resting place which he had filled with spices of various kinds blended by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.
verses.textEn: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier covered with spices and various blended perfumes, and they made a huge fire in his honor.

verses.textZh: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王；约沙法发愤图强，对抗以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王；约沙法发愤图强，对抗以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王，奋勇自强，防备以色列人，
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoshaphat, Asa’s son, became the next king. He strengthened Judah to stand against any attack from Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: His son Jehoshaphat then became king in his place, and he proved himself strong over Israel.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel.

verses.textZh: 他把军队安置在犹大的一切设防城里，又在犹大地和他父亲亚撒占领的以法莲各城里驻扎防军。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把军队安置在犹大的一切设防城里，又在犹大地和他父亲亚撒占领的以法莲各城里驻扎防军。
verses.textZhCuv: 安置军兵在犹大一切坚固城里，又安置防兵在犹大地和他父亚撒所得以法莲的城邑中。
verses.textEnNiv: He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and put garrisons in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
verses.textEnEsv: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim that Asa his father had captured.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he placed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim which Asa his father had taken.
verses.textEnNlt: He stationed troops in all the fortified towns of Judah, and he assigned additional garrisons to the land of Judah and to the towns of Ephraim that his father, Asa, had captured.
verses.textEnNasb: He placed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah, and placed garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim which his father Asa had captured.
verses.textEn: He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and put garrisons in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

verses.textZh: 耶和华和约沙法同在，因为他遵行了他祖先大卫最初所行的道路，没有寻求巴力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华和约沙法同在，因为他遵行了他祖先大卫最初所行的道路，没有寻求巴力。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与约沙法同在；因为他行他祖大卫初行的道，不寻求巴力，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the ways of his father David before him. He did not consult the Baals
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek the Baals,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the former ways of his father David; he did not seek the Baals,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the example of his father’s early years and did not worship the images of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the example of his father David’s earlier days and did not seek the Baals,
verses.textEn: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the ways of his father David before him. He did not consult the Baals

verses.textZh: 只寻求他父亲的神，遵行神的诫命，没有随从以色列人的行为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只寻求他父亲的神，遵行神的诫命，没有随从以色列人的行为。
verses.textZhCuv: 只寻求他父亲的神，遵行他的诫命，不效法以色列人的行为。
verses.textEnNiv: but sought the God of his father and followed his commands rather than the practices of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: but sought the God of his father and walked in his commandments, and not according to the practices of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: but sought the God of his father, and walked in His commandments and not according to the acts of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He sought his father’s God and obeyed his commands instead of following the evil practices of the kingdom of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: but sought the God of his father, followed His commandments, and did not act as Israel did.
verses.textEn: but sought the God of his father and followed his commands rather than the practices of Israel.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华使他统治的国稳固；犹大各地都给他进贡，所以约沙法的财富很多，极有尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华使他统治的国稳固；犹大各地都给他进贡，所以约沙法的财富很多，极有尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华坚定他的国，犹大众人给他进贡；约沙法大有尊荣资财。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord established the kingdom under his control; and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord established the kingdom in his hand. And all Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had great riches and honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah gave presents to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord established Jehoshaphat’s control over the kingdom of Judah. All the people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so he became very wealthy and highly esteemed.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord established the kingdom in his control, and all Judah gave tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had great riches and honor.
verses.textEn: The Lord established the kingdom under his control; and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.

verses.textZh: 他勇敢地遵行耶和华的道路，并且从犹大地中除掉邱坛和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他勇敢地遵行耶和华的道路，并且从犹大地中除掉邱坛和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 他高兴遵行耶和华的道，并且从犹大除掉一切邱坛和木偶。
verses.textEnNiv: His heart was devoted to the ways of the Lord ; furthermore, he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: His heart was courageous in the ways of the Lord . And furthermore, he took the high places and the Asherim out of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his heart took delight in the ways of the Lord; moreover he removed the high places and wooden images from Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: He was deeply committed to the ways of the Lord . He removed the pagan shrines and Asherah poles from Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: He took great pride in the ways of the Lord, and again removed the high places and the Asherim from Judah.
verses.textEn: His heart was devoted to the ways of the Lord ; furthermore, he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.

verses.textZh: 他作王第三年，就差派他的大臣便．亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦业、米该亚，到犹大各城去教训人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他作王第三年，就差派他的大臣便．亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦业、米该亚，到犹大各城去教训人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便‧亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦业、米该亚往犹大各城去教训百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah to teach in the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials, Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
verses.textEnNkjv: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his leaders, Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: In the third year of his reign Jehoshaphat sent his officials to teach in all the towns of Judah. These officials included Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then in the third year of his reign he sent his officials, Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
verses.textEn: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah to teach in the towns of Judah.

verses.textZh: 和他们同去的，还有示玛雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亚撒黑、示米拉末、约拿单、亚多尼雅、多比雅和驼．巴多尼雅等几位利未人；又有以利沙玛和约兰两位祭司和他们同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和他们同去的，还有示玛雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亚撒黑、示米拉末、约拿单、亚多尼雅、多比雅和驼．巴多尼雅等几位利未人；又有以利沙玛和约兰两位祭司和他们同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 同着他们有利未人示玛雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亚撒黑、示米拉末、约拿单、亚多尼雅、多比雅、驼‧巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙玛、约兰同着他们。
verses.textEnNiv: With them were certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-Adonijah—and the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
verses.textEnEsv: and with them the Levites, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah; and with these Levites, the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with them hesent Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah—the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent Levites along with them, including Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah. He also sent out the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
verses.textEnNasb: and with them the Levites, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
verses.textEn: With them were certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-Adonijah—and the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

verses.textZh: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，在犹大教训人；他们走遍犹大各城，在民间教训人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，在犹大教训人；他们走遍犹大各城，在民间教训人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，走遍犹大各城教训百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the Lord ; they went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And they taught in Judah, having the Book of the Law of the Lord with them. They went about through all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they taught in Judah, and had the Book of the Law of the Lord with them; they went throughout all the cities of Judah and taught the people.
verses.textEnNlt: They took copies of the Book of the Law of the Lord and traveled around through all the towns of Judah, teaching the people.
verses.textEnNasb: They taught in Judah, having the Book of the Law of the Lord with them; and they went throughout the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
verses.textEn: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the Lord ; they went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people.

verses.textZh: 犹大地周围的列国都惧怕耶和华，不敢和约沙法交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大地周围的列国都惧怕耶和华，不敢和约沙法交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使犹大四围的列国都甚恐惧，不敢与约沙法争战。
