verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not go to war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnEsv: And the fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, and they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fear of the Lord fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the fear of the Lord fell over all the surrounding kingdoms so that none of them wanted to declare war on Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the dread of the Lord was on all the kingdoms of the lands which were around Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not go to war against Jehoshaphat.

verses.textZh: 有些非利士人送礼和纳贡银给约沙法；阿拉伯人也送给他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些非利士人送礼和纳贡银给约沙法；阿拉伯人也送给他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些非利士人与约沙法送礼物，纳贡银。阿拉伯人也送他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。
verses.textEnNiv: Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute, and the Arabians also brought him 7,700 rams and 7,700 goats.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver as tribute; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the Philistines brought him gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the Philistines brought gifts and silver as tribute to Jehoshaphat; the Arabians also brought him flocks, 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.
verses.textEn: Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.

verses.textZh: 约沙法逐渐变得十分强大，在犹大建造了几座堡垒和贮藏货物的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法逐渐变得十分强大，在犹大建造了几座堡垒和贮藏货物的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法日渐强大，在犹大建造营寨和积货城。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat grew steadily greater. He built in Judah fortresses and store cities,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoshaphat became increasingly powerful, and he built fortresses and storage cities in Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful and built fortresses and storage cities throughout Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoshaphat grew greater and greater, and he built fortresses and storage cities in Judah.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah

verses.textZh: 他在犹大各城中储备了大批物资；在耶路撒冷也有不少战士，都是英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在犹大各城中储备了大批物资；在耶路撒冷也有不少战士，都是英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在犹大城邑中有许多工程，又在耶路撒冷有战士，就是大能的勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: and had large supplies in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: and he had large supplies in the cities of Judah. He had soldiers, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He had much property in the cities of Judah; and the men of war, mighty men of valor, were in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He stored numerous supplies in Judah’s towns and stationed an army of seasoned troops at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He had large supplies in the cities of Judah, and warriors, valiant mighty men, in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: and had large supplies in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们的数目，按着他们的家族记在下面：犹大支派的千夫长中，有押拿军长，率领英勇的战士三十万；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的数目，按着他们的家族记在下面：犹大支派的千夫长中，有押拿军长，率领英勇的战士三十万；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的数目，按着宗族，记在下面：犹大族的，千夫长押拿为首率领大能的勇士－三十万；
verses.textEnNiv: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;
verses.textEnEsv: This was the muster of them by fathers’ houses: Of Judah, the commanders of thousands: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 mighty men of valor;
verses.textEnNkjv: These are their numbers, according to their fathers’ houses. Of Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;
verses.textEnNlt: His army was enrolled according to ancestral clans. From Judah there were 300,000 troops organized in units of 1,000, under the command of Adnah.
verses.textEnNasb: This was their muster according to their fathers’ households: of Judah, commanders of thousands, Adnah was the commander, and with him three hundred thousand valiant warriors;
verses.textEn: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;

verses.textZh: 在押拿底下，是约哈难军长，率领二十八万人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在押拿底下，是约哈难军长，率领二十八万人；
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是，千夫长约哈难率领大能的勇士－二十八万；
verses.textEnNiv: next, Jehohanan the commander, with 280,000;
verses.textEnEsv: and next to him Jehohanan the commander, with 280,000;
verses.textEnNkjv: and next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand;
verses.textEnNlt: Next in command was Jehohanan, who commanded 280,000 troops.
verses.textEnNasb: and next to him was Johanan the commander, and with him 280,000;
verses.textEn: next, Jehohanan the commander, with 280,000;

verses.textZh: 在约哈难底下，是细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅，他是个甘愿献身给耶和华的人，率领英勇的战士二十万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约哈难底下，是细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅，他是个甘愿献身给耶和华的人，率领英勇的战士二十万。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是，细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅（他为耶和华牺牲自己）率领大能的勇士－二十万。
verses.textEnNiv: next, Amasiah son of Zikri, who volunteered himself for the service of the Lord , with 200,000.
verses.textEnEsv: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, a volunteer for the service of the Lord , with 200,000 mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNkjv: and next to him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: Next was Amasiah son of Zicri, who volunteered for the Lord ’s service, with 200,000 troops under his command.
verses.textEnNasb: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who volunteered for the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand valiant warriors;
verses.textEn: next, Amasiah son of Zikri, who volunteered himself for the service of the Lord , with 200,000.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯支派中有英勇的战士以利雅大，率领配备弓箭和盾牌的人二十万，
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯支派中有英勇的战士以利雅大，率领配备弓箭和盾牌的人二十万，
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率领拿弓箭和盾牌的－二十万；
verses.textEnNiv: From Benjamin: Eliada, a valiant soldier, with 200,000 men armed with bows and shields;
verses.textEnEsv: Of Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, with 200,000 men armed with bow and shield;
verses.textEnNkjv: Of Benjamin: Eliada a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand men armed with bow and shield;
verses.textEnNlt: From Benjamin there were 200,000 troops equipped with bows and shields. They were under the command of Eliada, a veteran soldier.
verses.textEnNasb: and of Benjamin, Eliada, a valiant warrior, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
verses.textEn: From Benjamin: Eliada, a valiant soldier, with 200,000 men armed with bows and shields;

verses.textZh: 在以利雅大底下是约萨拔，率领常备军十八万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以利雅大底下是约萨拔，率领常备军十八万。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是，约萨拔率领预备打仗的－十八万。
verses.textEnNiv: next, Jehozabad, with 180,000 men armed for battle.
verses.textEnEsv: and next to him Jehozabad with 180,000 armed for war.
verses.textEnNkjv: and next to him was Jehozabad, and with him one hundred and eighty thousand prepared for war.
verses.textEnNlt: Next in command was Jehozabad, who commanded 180,000 armed men.
verses.textEnNasb: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him 180,000 equipped for war.
verses.textEn: next, Jehozabad, with 180,000 men armed for battle.

verses.textZh: 这些人都是服事王的；还有王在犹大全地各设防城里安置的，没有计算在内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都是服事王的；还有王在犹大全地各设防城里安置的，没有计算在内。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是伺候王的，还有王在犹大全地坚固城所安置的不在其内。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: These were in the service of the king, besides those whom the king had placed in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: These served the king, besides those the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the troops stationed in Jerusalem to serve the king, besides those Jehoshaphat stationed in the fortified towns throughout Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who served the king, apart from those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
verses.textEn: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

verses.textZh: 约沙法的财富很多，极有尊荣，他和亚哈也结了亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法的财富很多，极有尊荣，他和亚哈也结了亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法大有尊荣资财，就与亚哈结亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jehoshaphat had great riches and honor, and he made a marriage alliance with Ahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and by marriage he allied himself with Ahab.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat enjoyed great riches and high esteem, and he made an alliance with Ahab of Israel by having his son marry Ahab’s daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jehoshaphat had great riches and honor; and he allied himself by marriage to Ahab.
verses.textEn: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.

verses.textZh: 过了几年，他下到撒玛利亚去见亚哈。亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了很多牛羊，又怂恿他一同上去攻打基列的拉末。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了几年，他下到撒玛利亚去见亚哈。亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了很多牛羊，又怂恿他一同上去攻打基列的拉末。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了几年，他下到撒马利亚去见亚哈；亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了许多牛羊，劝他与自己同去攻取基列的拉末。
verses.textEnNiv: Some years later he went down to see Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to attack Ramoth Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: After some years he went down to Ahab in Samaria. And Ahab killed an abundance of sheep and oxen for him and for the people who were with him, and induced him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: After some years he went down to visit Ahab in Samaria; and Ahab killed sheep and oxen in abundance for him and the people who were with him, and persuaded him to go up withhim to Ramoth Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: A few years later he went to Samaria to visit Ahab, who prepared a great banquet for him and his officials. They butchered great numbers of sheep, goats, and cattle for the feast. Then Ahab enticed Jehoshaphat to join forces with him to recover Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: Some years later he went down to visit Ahab at Samaria, and Ahab slaughtered many sheep and oxen for him and the people who were with him. And he incited him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEn: Some years later he went down to see Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to attack Ramoth Gilead.

verses.textZh: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法："你愿意和我一同到基列的拉末去吗？"他回答："你我不分彼此；我的人民就是你的人民；我必和你一同作战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法："你愿意和我一同到基列的拉末去吗？"他回答："你我不分彼此；我的人民就是你的人民；我必和你一同作战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法说：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？」他回答说：「你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，必与你同去争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied, "I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will join you in the war."
verses.textEnEsv: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead?" He answered him, "I am as you are, my people as your people. We will be with you in the war."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?" And he answered him, "I am as you are, and my people as your people; wewillbe with you in the war."
verses.textEnNlt: "Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead?" King Ahab of Israel asked King Jehoshaphat of Judah. Jehoshaphat replied, "Why, of course! You and I are as one, and my troops are your troops. We will certainly join you in battle."
verses.textEnNasb: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me against Ramoth-gilead?" And he said to him, "I am as you are, and my people as your people, and we will be with you in the battle."
verses.textEn: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied, "I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will join you in the war."

verses.textZh: 约沙法对以色列王说："请你先求问耶和华的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法对以色列王说："请你先求问耶和华的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法对以色列王说：「请你先求问耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Inquire first for the word of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Please inquire for the word of the Lord today."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoshaphat added, "But first let’s find out what the Lord says."
verses.textEnNasb: However, Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Please request the word of the Lord first."
verses.textEn: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 于是以色列王召集了四百位先知，问他们："我们可以到基列的拉末去作战吗？还是不要去呢？"他们回答："你可以上去，神必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列王召集了四百位先知，问他们："我们可以到基列的拉末去作战吗？还是不要去呢？"他们回答："你可以上去，神必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列王招聚先知四百人，问他们说：「我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他们说：「可以上去，因为神必将那城交在王的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—four hundred men—and asked them, "Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?" "Go," they answered, "for God will give it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, for God will give it into the hand of the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" So they said, "Go up, for God will deliver it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Israel summoned the prophets, 400 of them, and asked them, "Should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should I hold back?" They all replied, "Yes, go right ahead! God will give the king victory."
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Israel assembled the prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, "Should we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, for God will hand it over to the king."
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—four hundred men—and asked them, "Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?" "Go," they answered, "for God will give it into the king’s hand."

verses.textZh: 约沙法问："这里不是还有一位耶和华的先知吗？我们也可以向他求问。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法问："这里不是还有一位耶和华的先知吗？我们也可以向他求问。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法说：「这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here another prophet of the Lord of whom we may inquire?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jehoshaphat said, "Isthere not still a prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not also a prophet of the Lord here? We should ask him the same question."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of him?"
verses.textEn: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?"

verses.textZh: 以色列王回答约沙法说："还有一个人，我们可以向他求问耶和华；只是我恨他，因为他对我说的预言，都是凶话，不是吉话。这人就是音拉的儿子米该雅。"约沙法说："王不要这样说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王回答约沙法说："还有一个人，我们可以向他求问耶和华；只是我恨他，因为他对我说的预言，都是凶话，不是吉话。这人就是音拉的儿子米该雅。"约沙法说："王不要这样说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对约沙法说：「还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅。我们可以托他求问耶和华，只是我恨他；因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，常说凶言。」约沙法说：「王不必这样说。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say such a thing," Jehoshaphat replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the Lord , Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say so."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Thereis still one man by whom we may inquire of the Lord; but I hate him, because he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say such things!"
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Israel replied to Jehoshaphat, "There is one more man who could consult the Lord for us, but I hate him. He never prophesies anything but trouble for me! His name is Micaiah son of Imlah." Jehoshaphat replied, "That’s not the way a king should talk! Let’s hear what he has to say."
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man by whom we may inquire of the Lord, but I hate him, for he never prophesies anything good regarding me, but always bad. He is Micaiah the son of Imlah." But Jehoshaphat said, "May the king not say so."
verses.textEn: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say such a thing," Jehoshaphat replied.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列王召了一个太监来，说："快去把音拉的儿子米该雅召来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列王召了一个太监来，说："快去把音拉的儿子米该雅召来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, "Bring quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel called one ofhis officers and said, "Bring Micaiah the son of Imla quickly!"
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Quick! Bring Micaiah son of Imlah."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah quickly."
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列王和犹大王约沙法各自坐在王位上，穿著朝服，坐在撒玛利亚城门口的广场上；所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列王和犹大王约沙法各自坐在王位上，穿著朝服，坐在撒玛利亚城门口的广场上；所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒马利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
verses.textEnNiv: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting on their thrones, arrayed in their robes. And they were sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah, clothed in their robes, sat each on his throne; and they sat at a threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.textEnNlt: King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah, dressed in their royal robes, were sitting on thrones at the threshing floor near the gate of Samaria. All of Ahab’s prophets were prophesying there in front of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting, each on his throne, dressed in their robes, and they were sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.textEn: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

verses.textZh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家为自己做了些铁角，说："耶和华这样说：‘你要用这些铁角抵触亚兰人，直到把他们完全消灭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基拿拿的儿子西底家为自己做了些铁角，说："耶和华这样说：‘你要用这些铁角抵触亚兰人，直到把他们完全消灭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：「耶和华如此说：『你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns, and he declared, "This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron and said, "Thus says the Lord , ‘With these you shall push the Syrians until they are destroyed.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made horns of iron for himself; and he said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘With these you shall gore the Syrians until they are destroyed.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: One of them, Zedekiah son of Kenaanah, made some iron horns and proclaimed, "This is what the Lord says: With these horns you will gore the Arameans to death!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made horns of iron for himself and said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed!’ "
verses.textEn: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns, and he declared, "This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ "

verses.textZh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说："你可以上基列的拉末去，必得胜利！因为耶和华必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的先知也都这样预言说："你可以上基列的拉末去，必得胜利！因为耶和华必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnEsv: And all the prophets prophesied so and said, "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph. The Lord will give it into the hand of the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, "Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper, for the Lord will deliver it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnNlt: All the other prophets agreed. "Yes," they said, "go up to Ramoth-gilead and be victorious, for the Lord will give the king victory!"
verses.textEnNasb: All the prophets were prophesying this as well, saying, "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and be successful, for the Lord will hand it over to the king."
verses.textEn: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."

verses.textZh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说："看哪，这里的众先知都异口同声地对王说吉话，请你与他们一样说吉话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说："看哪，这里的众先知都异口同声地对王说吉话，请你与他们一样说吉话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说：「众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。」
verses.textEnNiv: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, "Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably."
verses.textEnEsv: And the messenger who went to summon Micaiah said to him, "Behold, the words of the prophets with one accord are favorable to the king. Let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak favorably."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, "Now listen, the words of the prophets with one accord encourage the king. Therefore please let your word be like thewordof one of them, and speak encouragement."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah said to him, "Look, all the prophets are promising victory for the king. Be sure that you agree with them and promise success."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the messenger who went to summon Micaiah spoke to him saying, "Behold, the words of the prophets are unanimously favorable to the king. So please let your word be like one of them, and speak favorably."
verses.textEn: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, "Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably."

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，我的神说甚么，我就说甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，我的神说甚么，我就说甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我的神说什么，我就说什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what my God says."
verses.textEnEsv: But Micaiah said, "As the Lord lives, what my God says, that I will speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Micaiah said, "As the Lord lives, whatever my God says, that I will speak."
verses.textEnNlt: But Micaiah replied, "As surely as the Lord lives, I will say only what my God says."
verses.textEnNasb: But Micaiah said, "As the Lord lives, whatever my God says, I will speak it."
verses.textEn: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what my God says."

verses.textZh: 米该雅来到王那里，王问他："米该雅啊，我们可以到基列的拉末作战吗？还是不要去呢？"他回答："可以上去，一定得胜，他们必交在你们手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅来到王那里，王问他："米该雅啊，我们可以到基列的拉末作战吗？还是不要去呢？"他回答："可以上去，一定得胜，他们必交在你们手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：「米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他说：「可以上去，必然得胜，敌人必交在你们手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for they will be given into your hand."
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had come to the king, the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I refrain?" And he answered, "Go up and triumph; they will be given into your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came to the king; and the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" And he said, "Go and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Micaiah arrived before the king, Ahab asked him, "Micaiah, should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should I hold back?" Micaiah replied sarcastically, "Yes, go up and be victorious, for you will have victory over them!"
verses.textEnNasb: When he came to the king, the king said to him, "Micaiah, should we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?" He said, "Go up and succeed, for they will be handed over to you!"
verses.textEn: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for they will be given into your hand."

verses.textZh: 王对他说："我要嘱咐你多少次，你才会奉耶和华的名对我只说真话呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对他说："我要嘱咐你多少次，你才会奉耶和华的名对我只说真话呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对他说：「我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the king said to him, "How many times shall I make you swear that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king said to him, "How many times shall I make you swear that you tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the king replied sharply, "How many times must I demand that you speak only the truth to me when you speak for the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear that you will tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"

verses.textZh: 米该雅说： "我看见以色列人四散在山上， 好象没有牧人的羊群一样。 耶和华说：‘这些人既然没有主人， 使他们平平安安各自回家去吧！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说： "我看见以色列人四散在山上， 好象没有牧人的羊群一样。 耶和华说：‘这些人既然没有主人， 使他们平平安安各自回家去吧！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：『这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘These have no master; let each return to his home in peace.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘These have no master. Let each return to his house in peace.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then Micaiah told him, "In a vision I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, like sheep without a shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘Their master has been killed. Send them home in peace.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "I saw all Israel Scattered on the mountains, Like sheep that have no shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Each of them is to return to his house in peace.’ "
verses.textEn: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列王对约沙法说："我不是早告诉你，他对我说的预言，总没有吉话，只说凶话吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王对约沙法说："我不是早告诉你，他对我说的预言，总没有吉话，只说凶话吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Didn’t I tell you?" the king of Israel exclaimed to Jehoshaphat. "He never prophesies anything but trouble for me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy anything good regarding me, but only bad?"
verses.textEn: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："所以你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："所以你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
verses.textEnNiv: Micaiah continued, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing on his right and on his left.
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah said, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Micaiah said, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing on His right hand and His left.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Micaiah continued, "Listen to what the Lord says! I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the armies of heaven around him, on his right and on his left.
verses.textEnNasb: And Micaiah said, "Therefore, hear the word of the Lord. I saw the Lord sitting on His throne, and all the angels of heaven standing on His right and on His left.
verses.textEn: Micaiah continued, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing on his right and on his left.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说：‘谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上去，好使他倒毙在基列的拉末呢？’有人这样说，也有人那样说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说：‘谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上去，好使他倒毙在基列的拉末呢？’有人这样说，也有人那样说。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：『谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？』这个就这样说，那个就那样说。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ "One suggested this, and another that.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab the king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one said one thing, and another said another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, ‘Who will persuade Ahab king of Israel to go up, that he may fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ So one spoke in this manner, and another spoke in that manner.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said, ‘Who can entice King Ahab of Israel to go into battle against Ramoth-gilead so he can be killed?’ "There were many suggestions,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one spirit said this, while another said that.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ "One suggested this, and another that.

verses.textZh: 后来有一个灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：‘我去引诱他。’耶和华问他：‘你怎样引诱他呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来有一个灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：‘我去引诱他。’耶和华问他：‘你怎样引诱他呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 随后，有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前说：『我去引诱他。』耶和华问他说：『你用何法呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’ " ‘By what means?’ the Lord asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord , saying, ‘I will entice him.’ And the Lord said to him, ‘By what means?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord, and said, ‘I will persuade him.’ The Lord said to him, ‘In what way?’
verses.textEnNlt: and finally a spirit approached the Lord and said, ‘I can do it!’ "‘How will you do this?’ the Lord asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’ And the Lord said to him, ‘How?’
verses.textEn: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’ " ‘By what means?’ the Lord asked.

verses.textZh: 他回答：‘我要出去，在他众先知的口里成为谎言的灵。’耶和华说：‘你必能引诱他，并且可以成功；你去这样行吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答：‘我要出去，在他众先知的口里成为谎言的灵。’耶和华说：‘你必能引诱他，并且可以成功；你去这样行吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：『我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。』耶和华说：『这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧！』
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will go and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. " ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the Lord . ‘Go and do it.’
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘I will go out, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ And he said, ‘You are to entice him, and you shall succeed; go out and do so.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ And theLord said, ‘You shall persuade him and also prevail; go out and do so.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And the spirit replied, ‘I will go out and inspire all of Ahab’s prophets to speak lies.’ "‘You will succeed,’ said the Lord . ‘Go ahead and do it.’
verses.textEnNasb: He said, ‘I will go out and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ Then He said, ‘You shall entice him, and you will also prevail. Go out and do so.’
verses.textEn: " ‘I will go and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. " ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the Lord . ‘Go and do it.’

verses.textZh: 所以现在耶和华把谎言的灵放在你这些先知的口里，并且耶和华已宣告灾祸必临到你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以现在耶和华把谎言的灵放在你这些先知的口里，并且耶和华已宣告灾祸必临到你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "So now the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore behold, the Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets. The Lord has declared disaster concerning you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore look! The Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these prophets of yours, and the Lord has declared disaster against you."
verses.textEnNlt: "So you see, the Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouths of your prophets. For the Lord has pronounced your doom."
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, behold, the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, for the Lord has declared disaster against you."
verses.textEn: "So now the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you."

verses.textZh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家走前来，打米该雅的脸，说："耶和华的灵是怎样离开了我，去与你说话呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基拿拿的儿子西底家走前来，打米该雅的脸，说："耶和华的灵是怎样离开了我，去与你说话呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来打米该雅的脸，说：「耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek and said, "Which way did the Spirit of the Lord go from me to speak to you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go from me to speak to you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah walked up to Micaiah and slapped him across the face. "Since when did the Spirit of the Lord leave me to speak to you?" he demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah approached and struck Micaiah on the cheek; and he said, " How did the Spirit of the Lord pass from me to speak to you?"
verses.textEn: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："你进密室躲藏的那一天，就必看见了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："你进密室躲藏的那一天，就必看见了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Micaiah replied, "You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room."
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah said, "Behold, you shall see on that day when you go into an inner chamber to hide yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Micaiah said, "Indeed you shall see on that day when you go into an inner chamber to hide!"
verses.textEnNlt: And Micaiah replied, "You will find out soon enough when you are trying to hide in some secret room!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Micaiah said, "Behold, you are going to see how on that day when you go from one inner room to another trying to hide yourself."
verses.textEn: Micaiah replied, "You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room."

verses.textZh: 以色列王说："把米该雅带回去，交给市长亚们和王的儿子约阿施，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王说："把米该雅带回去，交给市长亚们和王的儿子约阿施，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王说：「将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel then ordered, "Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said, "Seize Micaiah and take him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel said, "Take Micaiah, and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.textEnNlt: "Arrest him!" the king of Israel ordered. "Take him back to Amon, the governor of the city, and to my son Joash.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel said, "Take Micaiah and return him to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.textEn: The king of Israel then ordered, "Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son,

verses.textZh: 说：‘王这样吩咐：把这人囚在监里，少给他食物和水，直到我平平安安回来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘王这样吩咐：把这人囚在监里，少给他食物和水，直到我平平安安回来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 『王如此说：把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and say, ‘Thus says the king, Put this fellow in prison and feed him with meager rations of bread and water until I return in peace.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the king: "Put this fellow in prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and water of affliction, until I return in peace." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Give them this order from the king: ‘Put this man in prison, and feed him nothing but bread and water until I return safely from the battle!’"
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘This is what the king says: "Put this man in prison, and feed him enough bread and water to survive until I return safely." ’ "
verses.textEn: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ "

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："如果你真的可以平平安安回来，那么耶和华就没有借着我说话了。"他又说："众民啊，你们都要听！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："如果你真的可以平平安安回来，那么耶和华就没有借着我说话了。"他又说："众民啊，你们都要听！"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「你若能平安回来，那就是耶和华没有藉我说这话了」；又说：「众民哪，你们都要听！」
verses.textEnNiv: Micaiah declared, "If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me." Then he added, "Mark my words, all you people!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah said, "If you return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, "Hear, all you peoples!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Micaiah said, "If you ever return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, "Take heed, all you people!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Micaiah replied, "If you return safely, it will mean that the Lord has not spoken through me!" Then he added to those standing around, "Everyone mark my words!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Micaiah said, "If you actually return safely, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, " Listen, all you people!"
verses.textEn: Micaiah declared, "If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me." Then he added, "Mark my words, all you people!"

verses.textZh: 于是，以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah led their armies against Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up against Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

verses.textZh: 以色列王对约沙法说："我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿朝服。"于是以色列王改了装，他们就上阵去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王对约沙法说："我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿朝服。"于是以色列王改了装，他们就上阵去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。」于是以色列王改装，他们就上阵去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your robes." And the king of Israel disguised himself, and they went into battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle; but you put on your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself, and they went into battle.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "As we go into battle, I will disguise myself so no one will recognize me, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself, and they went into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you put on your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself, and they went into battle.
verses.textEn: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

verses.textZh: 原来亚兰王曾经吩咐他的战车队长说："无论是大小的将兵，你们都不要和他们交战，只管攻击以色列王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来亚兰王曾经吩咐他的战车队长说："无论是大小的将兵，你们都不要和他们交战，只管攻击以色列王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先是亚兰王吩咐车兵长说：「他们的兵将，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the king of Aram had ordered his chariot commanders, "Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, "Fight with neither small nor great, but only with the king of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots who were with him, saying, "Fight with no one small or great, but only with the king of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the king of Aram had issued these orders to his chariot commanders: "Attack only the king of Israel! Don’t bother with anyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Aram had commanded the commanders of his chariots, saying, "Do not fight with the small or great, but only with the king of Israel."
verses.textEn: Now the king of Aram had ordered his chariot commanders, "Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel."

verses.textZh: 众战车队长看见约沙法，就都心里说："这必是以色列王。"于是都绕过去攻击他。约沙法呼救，耶和华就帮助他；神又使敌人离开他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众战车队长看见约沙法，就都心里说："这必是以色列王。"于是都绕过去攻击他。约沙法呼救，耶和华就帮助他；神又使敌人离开他。
verses.textZhCuv: 车兵长看见约沙法便说，这必是以色列王，就转过去与他争战。约沙法一呼喊，耶和华就帮助他，神又感动他们离开他。
verses.textEnNiv: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "This is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him. God drew them away from him,
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, "It is the king of Israel." So they turned to fight against him. And Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him; God drew them away from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, "It is the king of Israel!" Therefore they surrounded him to attack; but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him, and God diverted them from him.
verses.textEnNlt: So when the Aramean chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat in his royal robes, they went after him. "There is the king of Israel!" they shouted. But Jehoshaphat called out, and the Lord saved him. God helped him by turning the attackers away from him.
verses.textEnNasb: So when the commanders of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, "He is the king of Israel!" And they turned aside to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him, and God diverted them from him.
verses.textEn: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "This is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him. God drew them away from him,

verses.textZh: 众战车队长见他不是以色列王，就转回去，不再追击他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众战车队长见他不是以色列王，就转回去，不再追击他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。
verses.textEnNiv: for when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they stopped pursuing him.
verses.textEnEsv: For as soon as the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For so it was, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as the chariot commanders realized he was not the king of Israel, they stopped chasing him.
verses.textEnNasb: When the commanders of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.textEn: for when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they stopped pursuing him.

verses.textZh: 有一人随意拉弓，竟射进了以色列王的铠甲中间的缝隙里。王对驾车的说："你把车转过来，载我出阵吧，因为我受了重伤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一人随意拉弓，竟射进了以色列王的铠甲中间的缝隙里。王对驾车的说："你把车转过来，载我出阵吧，因为我受了重伤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：「我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the breastplate and the scale armor. The king told the chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded."
verses.textEnEsv: But a certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the scale armor and the breastplate. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am wounded."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man drew a bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. So he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am wounded."
verses.textEnNlt: An Aramean soldier, however, randomly shot an arrow at the Israelite troops and hit the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. "Turn the horses and get me out of here!" Ahab groaned to the driver of the chariot. "I’m badly wounded!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now one man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel in a joint of the armor. So he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded."
verses.textEn: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the breastplate and the scale armor. The king told the chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded."

verses.textZh: 那天战事越来越激烈；以色列王勉强站在战车上，对抗亚兰人，直到黄昏。日落的时候，王就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天战事越来越激烈；以色列王勉强站在战车上，对抗亚兰人，直到黄昏。日落的时候，王就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日阵势越战越猛，以色列王勉强站在车上抵挡亚兰人，直到晚上。约在日落的时候，王就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long the battle raged, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. Then at sunset he died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the battle continued that day, and the king of Israel was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians until evening. Then at sunset he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: The battle increased that day, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Syrians until evening; and about the time of sunset he died.
verses.textEnNlt: The battle raged all that day, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans. In the evening, just as the sun was setting, he died.
verses.textEnNasb: The battle raged on that day, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot in front of the Arameans until the evening; and at sunset he died.
verses.textEn: All day long the battle raged, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. Then at sunset he died.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约沙法平平安安回到耶路撒冷自己的王宫里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约沙法平平安安回到耶路撒冷自己的王宫里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约沙法平平安安地回耶路撒冷，到宫里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned in safety to his house in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned safely to his house in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Jehoshaphat of Judah arrived safely home in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned in safety to his house in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎见约沙法王，对他说："你怎能帮助恶人，喜爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒必临到你身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎见约沙法王，对他说："你怎能帮助恶人，喜爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒必临到你身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎接约沙法王，对他说：「你岂当帮助恶人，爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒临到你。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu the seer, the son of Hanani, went out to meet him and said to the king, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord ? Because of this, the wrath of the Lord is on you.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him and said to King Jehoshaphat, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord ? Because of this, wrath has gone out against you from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord? Therefore the wrath of the Lordis upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him. "Why should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord ?" he asked the king. "Because of what you have done, the Lord is very angry with you.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him and said to King Jehoshaphat, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord, and by doing so bring wrath on yourself from the Lord?
verses.textEn: Jehu the seer, the son of Hanani, went out to meet him and said to the king, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord ? Because of this, the wrath of the Lord is on you.

verses.textZh: 可是你还有善行，因为你从国中除掉亚舍拉，并且决心寻求神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是你还有善行，因为你从国中除掉亚舍拉，并且决心寻求神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而你还有善行，因你从国中除掉木偶，立定心意寻求神。」
verses.textEnNiv: There is, however, some good in you, for you have rid the land of the Asherah poles and have set your heart on seeking God."
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, some good is found in you, for you destroyed the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless good things are found in you, in that you have removed the wooden images from the land, and have prepared your heart to seek God."
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, there is some good in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles throughout the land, and you have committed yourself to seeking God."
verses.textEnNasb: But there is some good in you, for you have removed the Asheroth from the land and you have set your heart to seek God."
verses.textEn: There is, however, some good in you, for you have rid the land of the Asherah poles and have set your heart on seeking God."

verses.textZh: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，后来又出巡民间，从别是巴到以法莲山地，领人民归向耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，后来又出巡民间，从别是巴到以法莲山地，领人民归向耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，以后又出巡民间，从别是巴直到以法莲山地，引导民归向耶和华－他们列祖的神；
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem. And he went out again among the people, from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the Lord , the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the mountains of Ephraim, and brought them back to the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he went out among the people, traveling from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, encouraging the people to return to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem and went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the Lord, the God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 他又在犹大境内的一切设防城中，都设立审判官；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在犹大境内的一切设防城中，都设立审判官；
verses.textZhCuv: 又在犹大国中遍地的坚固城里设立审判官，
verses.textEnNiv: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: He appointed judges in the land in all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,
verses.textEnNlt: He appointed judges throughout the nation in all the fortified towns,
verses.textEnNasb: He appointed judges in the land in all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city.
verses.textEn: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

verses.textZh: 他对他们说："你们行事，必须谨慎；因为你们审判，不是为人，而是为耶和华；你们审判的时候，耶和华必和你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他们说："你们行事，必须谨慎；因为你们审判，不是为人，而是为耶和华；你们审判的时候，耶和华必和你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「你们办事应当谨慎；因为你们判断不是为人，乃是为耶和华。判断的时候，他必与你们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: He told them, "Consider carefully what you do, because you are not judging for mere mortals but for the Lord , who is with you whenever you give a verdict.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to the judges, "Consider what you do, for you judge not for man but for the Lord . He is with you in giving judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to the judges, "Take heed to what you are doing, for you do not judge for man but for the Lord, who is with you in the judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: and he said to them, "Always think carefully before pronouncing judgment. Remember that you do not judge to please people but to please the Lord . He will be with you when you render the verdict in each case.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to the judges, "Consider what you are doing, for you do not judge for mankind but for the Lord who is with you when you render judgment.
verses.textEn: He told them, "Consider carefully what you do, because you are not judging for mere mortals but for the Lord , who is with you whenever you give a verdict.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要敬畏耶和华；你们要谨慎行事，因为耶和华我们的神没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要敬畏耶和华；你们要谨慎行事，因为耶和华我们的神没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们应当敬畏耶和华，谨慎办事；因为耶和华－我们的神没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now let the fear of the Lord be on you. Judge carefully, for with the Lord our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, let the fear of the Lord be upon you. Be careful what you do, for there is no injustice with the Lord our God, or partiality or taking bribes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, let the fear of the Lord be upon you; take care and do it, for thereis no iniquity with the Lord our God, no partiality, nor taking of bribes."
verses.textEnNlt: Fear the Lord and judge with integrity, for the Lord our God does not tolerate perverted justice, partiality, or the taking of bribes."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, let the fear of the Lord be upon you; be careful about what you do, for the Lord our God will have no part in injustice or partiality, or in the taking of a bribe."
verses.textEn: Now let the fear of the Lord be on you. Judge carefully, for with the Lord our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery."

verses.textZh: 约沙法又在耶路撒冷，从利未人、祭司和以色列各家族的首领中设立了一些人，替耶和华施行审判，为耶路撒冷的居民处理诉讼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法又在耶路撒冷，从利未人、祭司和以色列各家族的首领中设立了一些人，替耶和华施行审判，为耶路撒冷的居民处理诉讼。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法从利未人和祭司，并以色列族长中派定人，在耶路撒冷为耶和华判断，听民间的争讼，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: In Jerusalem also, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites, priests and heads of Israelite families to administer the law of the Lord and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites and priests and heads of families of Israel, to give judgment for the Lord and to decide disputed cases. They had their seat at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover in Jerusalem, for the judgment of the Lord and for controversies, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites and priests, and some of the chief fathers of Israel, when they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: In Jerusalem, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites and priests and clan leaders in Israel to serve as judges for cases involving the Lord ’s regulations and for civil disputes.
verses.textEnNasb: In Jerusalem Jehoshaphat also appointed some of the Levites and priests, and some of the heads of the fathers’ households of Israel, for the judgment of the Lord, and to judge disputes among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: In Jerusalem also, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites, priests and heads of Israelite families to administer the law of the Lord and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 约沙法吩咐他们说："你们要以敬畏耶和华的心，忠心和尽心办事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法吩咐他们说："你们要以敬畏耶和华的心，忠心和尽心办事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法嘱咐他们说：「你们当敬畏耶和华，忠心诚实办事。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave them these orders: "You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And he charged them: "Thus you shall do in the fear of the Lord , in faithfulness, and with your whole heart:
verses.textEnNkjv: And he commanded them, saying, "Thus you shall act in the fear of the Lord, faithfully and with a loyal heart:
verses.textEnNlt: These were his instructions to them: "You must always act in the fear of the Lord , with faithfulness and an undivided heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he commanded them, saying, "This is what you shall do in the fear of the Lord, faithfully and wholeheartedly.
verses.textEn: He gave them these orders: "You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们住在各城里的同胞带到你们面前的一切诉讼，无论是流血的事件，或是有关律法、诫命、律例和典章的诉讼，你们总要警告他们，免得他们得罪耶和华，以致耶和华的烈怒临到你们和你们的同胞身上；你们必须这样行，就没有罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们住在各城里的同胞带到你们面前的一切诉讼，无论是流血的事件，或是有关律法、诫命、律例和典章的诉讼，你们总要警告他们，免得他们得罪耶和华，以致耶和华的烈怒临到你们和你们的同胞身上；你们必须这样行，就没有罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在各城里你们的弟兄，若有争讼的事来到你们这里，或为流血，或犯律法、诫命、律例、典章，你们要警戒他们，免得他们得罪耶和华，以致他的忿怒临到你们和你们的弟兄；这样行，你们就没有罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: In every case that comes before you from your people who live in the cities—whether bloodshed or other concerns of the law, commands, decrees or regulations—you are to warn them not to sin against the Lord ; otherwise his wrath will come on you and your people. Do this, and you will not sin.
verses.textEnEsv: whenever a case comes to you from your brothers who live in their cities, concerning bloodshed, law or commandment, statutes or rules, then you shall warn them, that they may not incur guilt before the Lord and wrath may not come upon you and your brothers. Thus you shall do, and you will not incur guilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever case comes to you from your brethren who dwell in their cities, whether of bloodshed or offenses against law or commandment, against statutes or ordinances, you shall warn them, lest they trespass against the Lord and wrath come upon you and your brethren. Do this, and you will not be guilty.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever a case comes to you from fellow citizens in an outlying town, whether a murder case or some other violation of God’s laws, commands, decrees, or regulations, you must warn them not to sin against the Lord , so that he will not be angry with you and them. Do this and you will not be guilty.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever any dispute comes to you from your countrymen who live in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you shall warn them so that they will not be guilty before the Lord, and wrath will not come on you and your countrymen. This you shall do and you will not be guilty.
verses.textEn: In every case that comes before you from your people who live in the cities—whether bloodshed or other concerns of the law, commands, decrees or regulations—you are to warn them not to sin against the Lord ; otherwise his wrath will come on you and your people. Do this, and you will not sin.

verses.textZh: 所有属于耶和华的事，有大祭司亚玛利雅管理你们；所有属于王的事，有犹大家的领袖以实玛利的儿子西巴第雅管理你们；在你们面前也有利未人作官长。你们要勇敢行事；愿耶和华和良善的人同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有属于耶和华的事，有大祭司亚玛利雅管理你们；所有属于王的事，有犹大家的领袖以实玛利的儿子西巴第雅管理你们；在你们面前也有利未人作官长。你们要勇敢行事；愿耶和华和良善的人同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属耶和华的事，有大祭司亚玛利雅管理你们；凡属王的事，有犹大支派的族长以实玛利的儿子西巴第雅管理你们；在你们面前有利未人作官长。你们应当壮胆办事，愿耶和华与善人同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Amariah the chief priest will be over you in any matter concerning the Lord , and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be over you in any matter concerning the king, and the Levites will serve as officials before you. Act with courage, and may the Lord be with those who do well."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the Lord ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the governor of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters, and the Levites will serve you as officers. Deal courageously, and may the Lord be with the upright!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And take notice: Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the Lord; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king’s matters; also the Levites willbe officials before you. Behave courageously, and the Lord will be with the good."
verses.textEnNlt: "Amariah the high priest will have final say in all cases involving the Lord . Zebadiah son of Ishmael, a leader from the tribe of Judah, will have final say in all civil cases. The Levites will assist you in making sure that justice is served. Take courage as you fulfill your duties, and may the Lord be with those who do what is right."
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, Amariah the chief priest will be over you in every matter that pertains to the Lord, and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Act resolutely, and may the Lord be with the upright."
verses.textEn: "Amariah the chief priest will be over you in any matter concerning the Lord , and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be over you in any matter concerning the king, and the Levites will serve as officials before you. Act with courage, and may the Lord be with those who do well."

verses.textZh: 后来，摩押人、亚扪人和一些米乌尼人 ，一同来攻击约沙法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，摩押人、亚扪人和一些米乌尼人 ，一同来攻击约沙法。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，摩押人和亚扪人，又有米乌尼人，一同来攻击约沙法。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites with some of the Meunites came to wage war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnEsv: After this the Moabites and Ammonites, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened after this that the people of Moab with the people of Ammon, and others with them besides the Ammonites, came to battle against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, the armies of the Moabites, Ammonites, and some of the Meunites declared war on Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after this, that the sons of Moab and the sons of Ammon, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.textEn: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites with some of the Meunites came to wage war against Jehoshaphat.

verses.textZh: 有人来向约沙法报告说："从海的对岸，就是从以东 ，有大军前来攻击你；现在他们在哈洗逊．他玛。"哈洗逊．他玛就是隐．基底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人来向约沙法报告说："从海的对岸，就是从以东 ，有大军前来攻击你；现在他们在哈洗逊．他玛。"哈洗逊．他玛就是隐．基底。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人来报告约沙法说：「从海外亚兰 那边有大军来攻击你，如今他们在哈洗逊‧他玛，就是隐‧基底。」
verses.textEnNiv: Some people came and told Jehoshaphat, "A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from the other side of the Dead Sea. It is already in Hazezon Tamar" (that is, En Gedi).
verses.textEnEsv: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, "A great multitude is coming against you from Edom, from beyond the sea; and, behold, they are in Hazazon-tamar" (that is, Engedi).
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some came and told Jehoshaphat, saying, "A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea, from Syria; and they are in Hazazon Tamar" (which is En Gedi).
verses.textEnNlt: Messengers came and told Jehoshaphat, "A vast army from Edom is marching against you from beyond the Dead Sea. They are already at Hazazon-tamar." (This was another name for En-gedi.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then some came and reported to Jehoshaphat, saying, "A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea, from Aram; and behold, they are in Hazazon-tamar (that is Engedi)."
verses.textEn: Some people came and told Jehoshaphat, "A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from the other side of the Dead Sea. It is already in Hazezon Tamar" (that is, En Gedi).

verses.textZh: 于是约沙法害怕起来，定意要寻求耶和华，就在犹大全地宣告禁食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约沙法害怕起来，定意要寻求耶和华，就在犹大全地宣告禁食。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法便惧怕，定意寻求耶和华，在犹大全地宣告禁食。
verses.textEnNiv: Alarmed, Jehoshaphat resolved to inquire of the Lord , and he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoshaphat was afraid and set his face to seek the Lord , and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the Lord, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat was terrified by this news and begged the Lord for guidance. He also ordered everyone in Judah to begin fasting.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoshaphat was afraid and turned his attention to seek the Lord; and he proclaimed a period of fasting throughout Judah.
verses.textEn: Alarmed, Jehoshaphat resolved to inquire of the Lord , and he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.

verses.textZh: 于是犹大人集合起来，寻求耶和华的帮助；犹大各城中都有人出来寻求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹大人集合起来，寻求耶和华的帮助；犹大各城中都有人出来寻求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是犹大人聚会，求耶和华帮助。犹大各城都有人出来寻求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Judah came together to seek help from the Lord ; indeed, they came from every town in Judah to seek him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah assembled to seek help from the Lord ; from all the cities of Judah they came to seek the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Judah gathered together to ask help from the Lord; and from all the cities of Judah they came to seek the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So people from all the towns of Judah came to Jerusalem to seek the Lord ’s help.
verses.textEnNasb: So Judah gathered together to seek help from the Lord; they even came from all the cities of Judah to seek the Lord.
verses.textEn: The people of Judah came together to seek help from the Lord ; indeed, they came from every town in Judah to seek him.

verses.textZh: 约沙法就在犹大和耶路撒冷的会众中，站在耶和华殿的新院子前面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法就在犹大和耶路撒冷的会众中，站在耶和华殿的新院子前面，
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法就在犹大和耶路撒冷的会中，站在耶和华殿的新院前，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the Lord in the front of the new courtyard
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord , before the new court,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, before the new court,
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat stood before the community of Judah and Jerusalem in front of the new courtyard at the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord in front of the new courtyard;
verses.textEn: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the Lord in the front of the new courtyard

verses.textZh: 说："耶和华我们列祖的神啊，你不是天上的神吗？你不是统治列邦万国的吗？你手中有大能大力，没有人能抵挡你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："耶和华我们列祖的神啊，你不是天上的神吗？你不是统治列邦万国的吗？你手中有大能大力，没有人能抵挡你。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「耶和华－我们列祖的神啊，你不是天上的神吗？你不是万邦万国的主宰吗？在你手中有大能大力，无人能抵挡你。
verses.textEnNiv: and said: " Lord , the God of our ancestors, are you not the God who is in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. Power and might are in your hand, and no one can withstand you.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "O Lord , God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. In your hand are power and might, so that none is able to withstand you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said: "O Lord God of our fathers, are You not God in heaven, and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations, and in Your hand istherenot power and might, so that no one is able to withstand You?
verses.textEnNlt: He prayed, "O Lord , God of our ancestors, you alone are the God who is in heaven. You are ruler of all the kingdoms of the earth. You are powerful and mighty; no one can stand against you!
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "Lord, God of our fathers, are You not God in the heavens? And are You not ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in Your hand so that no one can stand against You.
verses.textEn: and said: " Lord , the God of our ancestors, are you not the God who is in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. Power and might are in your hand, and no one can withstand you.

verses.textZh: 我们的神啊，你不是曾经把这地的居民从你的子民以色列人面前赶走，把这地赐给你的朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔永远作产业吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神啊，你不是曾经把这地的居民从你的子民以色列人面前赶走，把这地赐给你的朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔永远作产业吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的神啊，你不是曾在你民以色列人面前驱逐这地的居民，将这地赐给你朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔永远为业吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Our God, did you not drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?
verses.textEnEsv: Did you not, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are You not our God, who drove out the inhabitants of this land before Your people Israel, and gave it to the descendants of Abraham Your friend forever?
verses.textEnNlt: O our God, did you not drive out those who lived in this land when your people Israel arrived? And did you not give this land forever to the descendants of your friend Abraham?
verses.textEnNasb: Did You not, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land from Your people Israel, and give it to the descendants of Your friend Abraham forever?
verses.textEn: Our God, did you not drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?

verses.textZh: 他们住在这地，又在这里为你的名建造了一座圣所，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们住在这地，又在这里为你的名建造了一座圣所，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他们住在这地，又为你的名建造圣所，说：
verses.textEnNiv: They have lived in it and have built in it a sanctuary for your Name, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: And they have lived in it and have built for you in it a sanctuary for your name, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they dwell in it, and have built You a sanctuary in it for Your name, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Your people settled here and built this Temple to honor your name.
verses.textEnNasb: They have lived in it, and have built You a sanctuary in it for Your name, saying,
verses.textEn: They have lived in it and have built in it a sanctuary for your Name, saying,

verses.textZh: ‘如果有灾祸临到我们，无论是刀剑、刑罚、瘟疫、饥荒，我们在急难的时候，站在这殿和你的面前，向你呼求，你必垂听和施行拯救，因为你的名是在这殿内。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘如果有灾祸临到我们，无论是刀剑、刑罚、瘟疫、饥荒，我们在急难的时候，站在这殿和你的面前，向你呼求，你必垂听和施行拯救，因为你的名是在这殿内。’
verses.textZhCuv: 『倘有祸患临到我们，或刀兵灾殃，或瘟疫饥荒，我们在急难的时候，站在这殿前向你呼求，你必垂听而拯救，因为你的名在这殿里。』
verses.textEnNiv: ‘If calamity comes upon us, whether the sword of judgment, or plague or famine, we will stand in your presence before this temple that bears your Name and will cry out to you in our distress, and you will hear us and save us.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘If disaster comes upon us, the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house and before you— for your name is in this house—and cry out to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If disaster comes upon us—sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this temple and in Your presence (for Your name is in this temple), and cry out to You in our affliction, and You will hear and save.’
verses.textEnNlt: They said, ‘Whenever we are faced with any calamity such as war, plague, or famine, we can come to stand in your presence before this Temple where your name is honored. We can cry out to you to save us, and you will hear us and rescue us.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If disaster comes upon us, the sword, or judgment, or plague, or famine, we will stand before this house and before You (for Your name is in this house), and cry out to You in our distress, and You will hear and save us.’
verses.textEn: ‘If calamity comes upon us, whether the sword of judgment, or plague or famine, we will stand in your presence before this temple that bears your Name and will cry out to you in our distress, and you will hear us and save us.’

verses.textZh: 现在这里有亚扪人、摩押人和西珥山的人，从前以色列人从埃及地出来的时候，你不许以色列人侵犯他们。那时，以色列人就离开了他们，不除灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在这里有亚扪人、摩押人和西珥山的人，从前以色列人从埃及地出来的时候，你不许以色列人侵犯他们。那时，以色列人就离开了他们，不除灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以色列人出埃及地的时候，你不容以色列人侵犯亚扪人、摩押人，和西珥山人，以色列人就离开他们，不灭绝他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "But now here are men from Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir, whose territory you would not allow Israel to invade when they came from Egypt; so they turned away from them and did not destroy them.
verses.textEnEsv: And now behold, the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came from the land of Egypt, and whom they avoided and did not destroy—
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, here are the people of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir—whom You would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them and did not destroy them—
verses.textEnNlt: "And now see what the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir are doing. You would not let our ancestors invade those nations when Israel left Egypt, so they went around them and did not destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, the sons of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, whom You did not allow Israel to invade when they came out of the land of Egypt (for they turned aside from them and did not destroy them),
verses.textEn: "But now here are men from Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir, whose territory you would not allow Israel to invade when they came from Egypt; so they turned away from them and did not destroy them.

verses.textZh: 现在你看，他们怎样报复我们；他们要来把我们从你赐给我们承受作产业的地赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你看，他们怎样报复我们；他们要来把我们从你赐给我们承受作产业的地赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他们怎样报复我们，要来驱逐我们出离你的地，就是你赐给我们为业之地。
verses.textEnNiv: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession you gave us as an inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, they reward us by coming to drive us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
verses.textEnNkjv: here they are, rewarding us by coming to throw us out of Your possession which You have given us to inherit.
verses.textEnNlt: Now see how they reward us! For they have come to throw us out of your land, which you gave us as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNasb: see how they are rewarding us by coming to drive us out from Your possession which You have given us as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession you gave us as an inheritance.

verses.textZh: 我们的神啊，你不惩罚他们吗？因为我们没有力量抵挡这来攻打我们的大军；我们也不知道该作甚么；我们的眼睛只有仰望你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神啊，你不惩罚他们吗？因为我们没有力量抵挡这来攻打我们的大军；我们也不知道该作甚么；我们的眼睛只有仰望你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的神啊，你不惩罚他们吗？因为我们无力抵挡这来攻击我们的大军，我们也不知道怎样行，我们的眼目单仰望你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power to face this vast army that is attacking us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you."
verses.textEnEsv: O our God, will you not execute judgment on them? For we are powerless against this great horde that is coming against us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you."
verses.textEnNkjv: O our God, will You not judge them? For we have no power against this great multitude that is coming against us; nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon You."
verses.textEnNlt: O our God, won’t you stop them? We are powerless against this mighty army that is about to attack us. We do not know what to do, but we are looking to you for help."
verses.textEnNasb: Our God, will You not judge them? For we are powerless before this great multitude that is coming against us; nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are on You."
verses.textEn: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power to face this vast army that is attacking us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you."

verses.textZh: 那时全犹大的人，连他们的婴孩、妻子和儿女，都站在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时全犹大的人，连他们的婴孩、妻子和儿女，都站在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大众人和他们的婴孩、妻子、儿女都站在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: All the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, stood there before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Meanwhile all Judah stood before the Lord , with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all Judah, with their little ones, their wives, and their children, stood before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: As all the men of Judah stood before the Lord with their little ones, wives, and children,
verses.textEnNasb: All Judah was standing before the Lord, with their infants, their wives, and their children.
verses.textEn: All the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, stood there before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 当时，耶和华的灵在会众中临到利未人亚萨的后裔，玛探雅的玄孙、耶利的曾孙、比拿雅的孙子、撒迦利亚的儿子雅哈悉；
