verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，耶和华的灵在会众中临到利未人亚萨的后裔，玛探雅的玄孙、耶利的曾孙、比拿雅的孙子、撒迦利亚的儿子雅哈悉；
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华的灵在会中临到利未人亚萨的后裔－玛探雅的玄孙，耶利的曾孙，比拿雅的孙子，撒迦利雅的儿子雅哈悉。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, as he stood in the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, son of Benaiah, son of Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the midst of the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the midst of the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: the Spirit of the Lord came upon one of the men standing there. His name was Jahaziel son of Zechariah, son of Benaiah, son of Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, a Levite who was a descendant of Asaph.
verses.textEnNasb: Then in the midst of the assembly the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite of the sons of Asaph;
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, as he stood in the assembly.

verses.textZh: 他就说："全犹大的人、耶路撒冷的居民和约沙法王啊，你们要留意！耶和华这样对你们说：‘你们不要因这大军惧怕和惊慌，因为战争的胜负不是在于你们，而是在于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就说："全犹大的人、耶路撒冷的居民和约沙法王啊，你们要留意！耶和华这样对你们说：‘你们不要因这大军惧怕和惊慌，因为战争的胜负不是在于你们，而是在于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「犹大众人、耶路撒冷的居民，和约沙法王，你们请听。耶和华对你们如此说：『不要因这大军恐惧惊惶；因为胜败不在乎你们，乃在乎神。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "Listen, King Jehoshaphat and all who live in Judah and Jerusalem! This is what the Lord says to you: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God’s.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Listen, all Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem and King Jehoshaphat: Thus says the Lord to you, ‘Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed at this great horde, for the battle is not yours but God’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Listen, all you of Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat! Thus says the Lord to you: ‘Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid! Don’t be discouraged by this mighty army, for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "Listen, all you of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and King Jehoshaphat: This is what the Lord says to you: ‘Do not fear or be dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours but God’s.
verses.textEn: He said: "Listen, King Jehoshaphat and all who live in Judah and Jerusalem! This is what the Lord says to you: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God’s.

verses.textZh: 明天你们要下去攻击他们，他们会从洗斯的斜坡上来，你们必在耶鲁伊勒旷野东面的谷口遇见他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 明天你们要下去攻击他们，他们会从洗斯的斜坡上来，你们必在耶鲁伊勒旷野东面的谷口遇见他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 明日你们要下去迎敌，他们是从洗斯坡上来，你们必在耶鲁伊勒旷野前的谷口遇见他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Tomorrow march down against them. They will be climbing up by the Pass of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the gorge in the Desert of Jeruel.
verses.textEnEsv: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they will come up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, east of the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tomorrow go down against them. They will surely come up by the Ascent of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the brook before the Wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.textEnNlt: Tomorrow, march out against them. You will find them coming up through the ascent of Ziz at the end of the valley that opens into the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.textEnNasb: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they will come up by the ascent of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the valley in front of the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.textEn: Tomorrow march down against them. They will be climbing up by the Pass of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the gorge in the Desert of Jeruel.

verses.textZh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷人哪，这次你们不必出战，只要稳守阵地，站立不动，看耶和华为你们施行的拯救。’你们不要惧怕，也不要惊慌；明天要出去攻击他们，耶和华必和你们同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人和耶路撒冷人哪，这次你们不必出战，只要稳守阵地，站立不动，看耶和华为你们施行的拯救。’你们不要惧怕，也不要惊慌；明天要出去攻击他们，耶和华必和你们同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大和耶路撒冷人哪，这次你们不要争战，要摆阵站着，看耶和华为你们施行拯救。不要恐惧，也不要惊惶。明日当出去迎敌，因为耶和华与你们同在。』」
verses.textEnNiv: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the Lord will give you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Go out to face them tomorrow, and the Lord will be with you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You will not need to fight in this battle. Stand firm, hold your position, and see the salvation of the Lord on your behalf, O Judah and Jerusalem.’ Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed. Tomorrow go out against them, and the Lord will be with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: You will not need to fight in this battle. Position yourselves, stand still and see the salvation of the Lord, who is with you, O Judah and Jerusalem!’ Do not fear or be dismayed; tomorrow go out against them, for the Lordis with you."
verses.textEnNlt: But you will not even need to fight. Take your positions; then stand still and watch the Lord ’s victory. He is with you, O people of Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid or discouraged. Go out against them tomorrow, for the Lord is with you!"
verses.textEnNasb: You need not fight in this battle; take your position, stand and watch the salvation of the Lord in your behalf, Judah and Jerusalem.’ Do not fear or be dismayed; tomorrow, go out to face them, for the Lord is with you."
verses.textEn: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the Lord will give you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Go out to face them tomorrow, and the Lord will be with you.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是约沙法面伏于地，全犹大的人和耶路撒冷的居民都俯伏在耶和华面前，敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约沙法面伏于地，全犹大的人和耶路撒冷的居民都俯伏在耶和华面前，敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法就面伏于地，犹大众人和耶路撒冷的居民也俯伏在耶和华面前，叩拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat bowed down with his face to the ground, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down in worship before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the Lord , worshiping the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem bowed before the Lord, worshiping the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Jehoshaphat bowed low with his face to the ground. And all the people of Judah and Jerusalem did the same, worshiping the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the Lord, worshiping the Lord.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat bowed down with his face to the ground, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down in worship before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 哥辖子孙中和可拉子孙中的利未人，都站起来高声赞美耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖子孙中和可拉子孙中的利未人，都站起来高声赞美耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖族和可拉族的利未人都起来，用极大的声音赞美耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then some Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up and praised the Lord , the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levites, of the Kohathites and the Korahites, stood up to praise the Lord , the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Levites of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites stood up to praise the Lord God of Israel with voices loud and high.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Levites from the clans of Kohath and Korah stood to praise the Lord , the God of Israel, with a very loud shout.
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites, from the sons of the Kohathites and from the sons of the Korahites, stood up to praise the Lord God of Israel, with a very loud voice.
verses.textEn: Then some Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up and praised the Lord , the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.

verses.textZh: 第二天早晨，众人清早起来，出发到提哥亚的旷野去；他们正出去的时候，约沙法站起来，说："犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，你们要听我的话；信靠耶和华你们的神，你们就必坚立；信靠他的先知，你们就必亨通。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天早晨，众人清早起来，出发到提哥亚的旷野去；他们正出去的时候，约沙法站起来，说："犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，你们要听我的话；信靠耶和华你们的神，你们就必坚立；信靠他的先知，你们就必亨通。"
verses.textZhCuv: 次日清早，众人起来往提哥亚的旷野去。出去的时候，约沙法站着说：「犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，要听我说：信耶和华－你们的神就必立稳；信他的先知就必亨通。」
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the morning they left for the Desert of Tekoa. As they set out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Listen to me, Judah and people of Jerusalem! Have faith in the Lord your God and you will be upheld; have faith in his prophets and you will be successful."
verses.textEnEsv: And they rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. And when they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Hear me, Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the Lord your God, and you will be established; believe his prophets, and you will succeed."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they rose early in the morning and went out into the Wilderness of Tekoa; and as they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Hear me, O Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem: Believe in the Lord your God, and you shall be established; believe His prophets, and you shall prosper."
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning the army of Judah went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. On the way Jehoshaphat stopped and said, "Listen to me, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Believe in the Lord your God, and you will be able to stand firm. Believe in his prophets, and you will succeed."
verses.textEnNasb: They rose early in the morning and went out to the wilderness of Tekoa; and when they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Listen to me, Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Put your trust in the Lord your God and you will endure. Put your trust in His prophets, and succeed."
verses.textEn: Early in the morning they left for the Desert of Tekoa. As they set out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Listen to me, Judah and people of Jerusalem! Have faith in the Lord your God and you will be upheld; have faith in his prophets and you will be successful."

verses.textZh: 约沙法和人民商议好了，就指派向耶和华歌唱的人，使他们身穿圣洁的服饰，走在军队的前面，赞美耶和华，说： "你们要称颂耶和华， 因他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法和人民商议好了，就指派向耶和华歌唱的人，使他们身穿圣洁的服饰，走在军队的前面，赞美耶和华，说： "你们要称颂耶和华， 因他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法既与民商议了，就设立歌唱的人，颂赞耶和华，使他们穿上圣洁的礼服，走在军前赞美耶和华说：「当称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存！」
verses.textEnNiv: After consulting the people, Jehoshaphat appointed men to sing to the Lord and to praise him for the splendor of his holiness as they went out at the head of the army, saying: "Give thanks to the Lord , for his love endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the Lord and praise him in holy attire, as they went before the army, and say, "Give thanks to the Lord , for his steadfast love endures forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed those who should sing to the Lord, and who should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army and were saying: "Praise the Lord, For His mercy endures forever."
verses.textEnNlt: After consulting the people, the king appointed singers to walk ahead of the army, singing to the Lord and praising him for his holy splendor. This is what they sang: "Give thanks to the Lord ; his faithful love endures forever!"
verses.textEnNasb: When he had consulted with the people, he appointed those who sang to the Lord and those who praised Him in holy attire, as they went out before the army and said, "Give thanks to the Lord, for His faithfulness is everlasting."
verses.textEn: After consulting the people, Jehoshaphat appointed men to sing to the Lord and to praise him for the splendor of his holiness as they went out at the head of the army, saying: "Give thanks to the Lord , for his love endures forever."

verses.textZh: 当他们开始欢呼赞美的时候，耶和华就派出伏兵，击杀那前来攻打犹大人的亚扪人、摩押人和西珥山的人，他们就被击溃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当他们开始欢呼赞美的时候，耶和华就派出伏兵，击杀那前来攻打犹大人的亚扪人、摩押人和西珥山的人，他们就被击溃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人方唱歌赞美的时候，耶和华就派伏兵击杀那来攻击犹大人的亚扪人、摩押人，和西珥山人，他们就被打败了。
verses.textEnNiv: As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushes against the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir who were invading Judah, and they were defeated.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they began to sing and praise, the Lord set an ambush against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah, so that they were routed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushes against the people of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were defeated.
verses.textEnNlt: At the very moment they began to sing and give praise, the Lord caused the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir to start fighting among themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: When they began singing and praising, the Lord set ambushes against the sons of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; so they were struck down.
verses.textEn: As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushes against the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir who were invading Judah, and they were defeated.

verses.textZh: 原来亚扪人和摩押人起来攻击住西珥山的人，把他们杀尽灭绝；他们灭尽了住西珥山的人以后，竟又自相残杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来亚扪人和摩押人起来攻击住西珥山的人，把他们杀尽灭绝；他们灭尽了住西珥山的人以后，竟又自相残杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为亚扪人和摩押人起来，击杀住西珥山的人，将他们灭尽；灭尽住西珥山的人之后，他们又彼此自相击杀。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the men from Mount Seir to destroy and annihilate them. After they finished slaughtering the men from Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
verses.textEnEsv: For the men of Ammon and Moab rose against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction, and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, they all helped to destroy one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the people of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. And when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
verses.textEnNlt: The armies of Moab and Ammon turned against their allies from Mount Seir and killed every one of them. After they had destroyed the army of Seir, they began attacking each other.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Ammon and Moab rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, completely destroying them; and when they had finished with the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
verses.textEn: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the men from Mount Seir to destroy and annihilate them. After they finished slaughtering the men from Seir, they helped to destroy one another.

verses.textZh: 犹大人来到旷野的瞭望楼，向那大军观望，只见伏尸遍地，没有一个逃脱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人来到旷野的瞭望楼，向那大军观望，只见伏尸遍地，没有一个逃脱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人来到旷野的望楼，向那大军观看，见尸横遍地，没有一个逃脱的。
verses.textEnNiv: When the men of Judah came to the place that overlooks the desert and looked toward the vast army, they saw only dead bodies lying on the ground; no one had escaped.
verses.textEnEsv: When Judah came to the watchtower of the wilderness, they looked toward the horde, and behold, there were dead bodies lying on the ground; none had escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Judah came to a place overlooking the wilderness, they looked toward the multitude; and there were their dead bodies, fallen on the earth. No one had escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: So when the army of Judah arrived at the lookout point in the wilderness, all they saw were dead bodies lying on the ground as far as they could see. Not a single one of the enemy had escaped.
verses.textEnNasb: When Judah came to the watchtower of the wilderness, they turned toward the multitude, and behold, they were corpses lying on the ground, and there was no survivor.
verses.textEn: When the men of Judah came to the place that overlooks the desert and looked toward the vast army, they saw only dead bodies lying on the ground; no one had escaped.

verses.textZh: 约沙法和他的人民就来掠夺敌人的财物，在尸首中见许多财物、衣服和珍宝。他们剥脱下来据为己有的，多得不能携带；因为掠物甚多，所以掠夺了三天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法和他的人民就来掠夺敌人的财物，在尸首中见许多财物、衣服和珍宝。他们剥脱下来据为己有的，多得不能携带；因为掠物甚多，所以掠夺了三天。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法和他的百姓就来收取敌人的财物，在尸首中见了许多财物、珍宝，他们剥脱下来的多得不可携带；因为甚多，直收取了三日。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehoshaphat and his men went to carry off their plunder, and they found among them a great amount of equipment and clothing and also articles of value—more than they could take away. There was so much plunder that it took three days to collect it.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their spoil, they found among them, in great numbers, goods, clothing, and precious things, which they took for themselves until they could carry no more. They were three days in taking the spoil, it was so much.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away their spoil, they found among them an abundance of valuables on the dead bodies, and precious jewelry, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away; and they were three days gathering the spoil because there was so much.
verses.textEnNlt: King Jehoshaphat and his men went out to gather the plunder. They found vast amounts of equipment, clothing, and other valuables—more than they could carry. There was so much plunder that it took them three days just to collect it all!
verses.textEnNasb: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their spoils, they found much among them, including goods, garments, and valuable things which they took for themselves, more than they could carry. And they were taking the spoils for three days because there was so much.
verses.textEn: So Jehoshaphat and his men went to carry off their plunder, and they found among them a great amount of equipment and clothing and also articles of value—more than they could take away. There was so much plunder that it took three days to collect it.

verses.textZh: 第四日，他们聚集在比拉迦谷，在那里称颂耶和华，因此那地方名叫比拉迦谷，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四日，他们聚集在比拉迦谷，在那里称颂耶和华，因此那地方名叫比拉迦谷，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四日众人聚集在比拉迦谷 ，在那里称颂耶和华。因此那地方名叫比拉迦谷，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Berakah, where they praised the Lord . This is why it is called the Valley of Berakah to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah, for there they blessed the Lord . Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Beracah to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Berachah, for there they blessed the Lord; therefore the name of that place was called The Valley of Berachah until this day.
verses.textEnNlt: On the fourth day they gathered in the Valley of Blessing, which got its name that day because the people praised and thanked the Lord there. It is still called the Valley of Blessing today.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah, for they blessed the Lord there. Therefore they have named that place "The Valley of Beracah" until today.
verses.textEn: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Berakah, where they praised the Lord . This is why it is called the Valley of Berakah to this day.

verses.textZh: 事后，犹大和耶路撒冷所有的人，在约沙法率领下，都欢欢喜喜回耶路撒冷去了，耶和华使他们因胜过仇敌欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 事后，犹大和耶路撒冷所有的人，在约沙法率领下，都欢欢喜喜回耶路撒冷去了，耶和华使他们因胜过仇敌欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人和耶路撒冷人都欢欢喜喜地回耶路撒冷，约沙法率领他们；因为耶和华使他们战胜仇敌，就欢喜快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Then, led by Jehoshaphat, all the men of Judah and Jerusalem returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the Lord had given them cause to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat at their head, returning to Jerusalem with joy, for the Lord had made them rejoice over their enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go back to Jerusalem with joy, for the Lord had made them rejoice over their enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the men returned to Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat leading them, overjoyed that the Lord had given them victory over their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Every man of Judah and Jerusalem returned, with Jehoshaphat at their head, returning to Jerusalem with joy, for the Lord had helped them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.textEn: Then, led by Jehoshaphat, all the men of Judah and Jerusalem returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the Lord had given them cause to rejoice over their enemies.

verses.textZh: 他们拿着琴瑟和号筒来到耶路撒冷，进了耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拿着琴瑟和号筒来到耶路撒冷，进了耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们弹琴、鼓瑟、吹号来到耶路撒冷，进了耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: They entered Jerusalem and went to the temple of the Lord with harps and lyres and trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: They came to Jerusalem with harps and lyres and trumpets, to the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So they came to Jerusalem, with stringed instruments and harps and trumpets, to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They marched into Jerusalem to the music of harps, lyres, and trumpets, and they proceeded to the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They came to Jerusalem with harps, lyres, and trumpets, to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They entered Jerusalem and went to the temple of the Lord with harps and lyres and trumpets.

verses.textZh: 世上列国一听见耶和华战败了以色列的仇敌，就都惧怕神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上列国一听见耶和华战败了以色列的仇敌，就都惧怕神。
verses.textZhCuv: 列邦诸国听见耶和华战败以色列的仇敌，就甚惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of God came on all the surrounding kingdoms when they heard how the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the fear of God came on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries when they heard that the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the surrounding kingdoms heard that the Lord himself had fought against the enemies of Israel, the fear of God came over them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the dread of God was on all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.textEn: The fear of God came on all the surrounding kingdoms when they heard how the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.

verses.textZh: 这样，约沙法的国得享太平，因为他的神使他四境安宁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，约沙法的国得享太平，因为他的神使他四境安宁。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，约沙法的国得享太平，因为神赐他四境平安。
verses.textEnNiv: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jehoshaphat’s kingdom was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.
verses.textEnNasb: So the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, for his God gave him rest on all sides.
verses.textEn: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.

verses.textZh: 约沙法登基统治犹大的时候，是三十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共二十五年。他的母亲名叫阿苏巴，是示利希的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法登基统治犹大的时候，是三十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共二十五年。他的母亲名叫阿苏巴，是示利希的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法作犹大王，登基的时候年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，乃示利希的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoshaphat was king over Judah. Hewas thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jehoshaphat ruled over the land of Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem for twenty-five years. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEn: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

verses.textZh: 约沙法遵行他父亲亚撒的道路，总不偏离，行耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法遵行他父亲亚撒的道路，总不偏离，行耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法效法他父亚撒所行的，不偏左右，行耶和华眼中看为正的事。
verses.textEnNiv: He followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He walked in the way of Asa his father and did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he walked in the way of his father Asa, and did not turn aside from it, doing whatwas right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat was a good king, following the ways of his father, Asa. He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: He walked in the way of his father Asa and did not deviate from it, doing right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 只是邱坛还没有除掉，人民仍然没有定意归向他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是邱坛还没有除掉，人民仍然没有定意归向他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓也没有立定心意归向他们列祖的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The high places, however, were not removed, and the people still had not set their hearts on the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: The high places, however, were not taken away; the people had not yet set their hearts upon the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away, for as yet the people had not directed their hearts to the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: During his reign, however, he failed to remove all the pagan shrines, and the people never fully committed themselves to follow the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: The high places, however, were not removed; the people had not yet directed their hearts to the God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: The high places, however, were not removed, and the people still had not set their hearts on the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 约沙法其余的事迹，一生的始末，都记在哈拿尼的儿子耶户的言行录上；这言行录又收录在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法其余的事迹，一生的始末，都记在哈拿尼的儿子耶户的言行录上；这言行录又收录在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法其余的事，自始至终都写在哈拿尼的儿子耶户的书上，也载入以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the annals of Jehu son of Hanani, which are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, from first to last, are written in the chronicles of Jehu the son of Hanani, which are recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, indeed they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded in The Record of Jehu Son of Hanani, which is included in The Book of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first to last, behold, they are written in the annals of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the annals of Jehu son of Hanani, which are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 后来，犹大王约沙法和作恶多端的以色列王亚哈谢结盟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，犹大王约沙法和作恶多端的以色列王亚哈谢结盟。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，犹大王约沙法与以色列王亚哈谢交好；亚哈谢行恶太甚。
verses.textEnNiv: Later, Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel, whose ways were wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: After this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined with Ahaziah king of Israel, who acted wickedly.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this Jehoshaphat king of Judah allied himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who acted very wickedly.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later King Jehoshaphat of Judah made an alliance with King Ahaziah of Israel, who was very wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: After this Jehoshaphat king of Judah allied himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. He acted wickedly in so doing.
verses.textEn: Later, Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel, whose ways were wicked.

verses.textZh: 约沙法和他合伙建造船只，开往他施去；他们是在以旬．迦别建造船只。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法和他合伙建造船只，开往他施去；他们是在以旬．迦别建造船只。
verses.textZhCuv: 二王合伙造船要往他施去，遂在以旬‧迦别造船。
verses.textEnNiv: He agreed with him to construct a fleet of trading ships. After these were built at Ezion Geber,
verses.textEnEsv: He joined him in building ships to go to Tarshish, and they built the ships in Ezion-geber.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he allied himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish, and they made the ships in Ezion Geber.
verses.textEnNlt: Together they built a fleet of trading ships at the port of Ezion-geber.
verses.textEnNasb: So he allied himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish, and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.
verses.textEn: He agreed with him to construct a fleet of trading ships. After these were built at Ezion Geber,

verses.textZh: 那时，玛利沙人多大瓦的儿子以利以谢说预言攻击约沙法，说："因为你和亚哈谢结盟，耶和华必破坏你建造的船只。"后来那些船只果然受到破坏，不能开往他施去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，玛利沙人多大瓦的儿子以利以谢说预言攻击约沙法，说："因为你和亚哈谢结盟，耶和华必破坏你建造的船只。"后来那些船只果然受到破坏，不能开往他施去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时玛利沙人、多大瓦的儿子以利以谢向约沙法预言说：「因你与亚哈谢交好，耶和华必破坏你所造的。」后来那船果然破坏，不能往他施去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have made an alliance with Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy what you have made." The ships were wrecked and were not able to set sail to trade.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have joined with Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy what you have made." And the ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have allied yourself with Ahaziah, the Lord has destroyed your works." Then the ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliezer son of Dodavahu from Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat. He said, "Because you have allied yourself with King Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy your work." So the ships met with disaster and never put out to sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have allied yourself with Ahaziah, the Lord has destroyed your works." So the ships were wrecked and could not go to Tarshish.
verses.textEn: Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have made an alliance with Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy what you have made." The ships were wrecked and were not able to set sail to trade.

verses.textZh: 约沙法和他的列祖同睡，和他的列祖一起葬在大卫城里；他的儿子约兰接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法和他的列祖同睡，和他的列祖一起葬在大卫城里；他的儿子约兰接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. Then Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehoshaphat died, he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then his son Jehoram became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoshaphat lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David, and his son Jehoram became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约兰有几个兄弟，就是约沙法的儿子亚撒利雅、耶歇、撒迦利雅、亚撒利雅、米迦勒和示法提雅；这些人都是犹大王约沙法的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约兰有几个兄弟，就是约沙法的儿子亚撒利雅、耶歇、撒迦利雅、亚撒利雅、米迦勒和示法提雅；这些人都是犹大王约沙法的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰有几个兄弟，就是约沙法的儿子亚撒利雅、耶歇、撒迦利雅、亚撒利雅、米迦勒、示法提雅。这都是犹大王约沙法的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoram’s brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael and Shephatiah. All these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azaryahu, Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoram’s brothers—the other sons of Jehoshaphat—were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azaryahu, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.textEn: Jehoram’s brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael and Shephatiah. All these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们的父亲把许多礼物，就是金、银、财宝，以及犹大地的几座设防城都赐给了他们，却把王位赐给了约兰，因为他是长子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的父亲把许多礼物，就是金、银、财宝，以及犹大地的几座设防城都赐给了他们，却把王位赐给了约兰，因为他是长子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的父亲将许多金银、财宝，和犹大地的坚固城赐给他们；但将国赐给约兰，因为他是长子。
verses.textEnNiv: Their father had given them many gifts of silver and gold and articles of value, as well as fortified cities in Judah, but he had given the kingdom to Jehoram because he was his firstborn son.
verses.textEnEsv: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, gold, and valuable possessions, together with fortified cities in Judah, but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their father gave them great gifts of silver and gold and precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: Their father had given each of them valuable gifts of silver, gold, and costly items, and also some of Judah’s fortified towns. However, he designated Jehoram as the next king because he was the oldest.
verses.textEnNasb: Their father gave them many gifts of silver, gold, and precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram because he was the firstborn.
verses.textEn: Their father had given them many gifts of silver and gold and articles of value, as well as fortified cities in Judah, but he had given the kingdom to Jehoram because he was his firstborn son.

verses.textZh: 约兰一登上了他父亲的王位，巩固了自己的权势以后，就用刀杀了他所有的兄弟和犹大的一些领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约兰一登上了他父亲的王位，巩固了自己的权势以后，就用刀杀了他所有的兄弟和犹大的一些领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰兴起坐他父的位，奋勇自强，就用刀杀了他的众兄弟和以色列的几个首领。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jehoram established himself firmly over his father’s kingdom, he put all his brothers to the sword along with some of the officials of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jehoram had ascended the throne of his father and was established, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Jehoram was established over the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself and killed all his brothers with the sword, and also others of the princes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jehoram had become solidly established as king, he killed all his brothers and some of the other leaders of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jehoram had taken over the kingdom of his father and gathered courage, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and some of the leaders of Israel as well.
verses.textEn: When Jehoram established himself firmly over his father’s kingdom, he put all his brothers to the sword along with some of the officials of Israel.

verses.textZh: 约兰登基的时候是三十二岁，他在耶路撒冷作王共八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约兰登基的时候是三十二岁，他在耶路撒冷作王共八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned for eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

verses.textZh: 他随从众以色列王的道路，好象亚哈家所行的一样，因为他娶了亚哈的女儿作妻子，行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他随从众以色列王的道路，好象亚哈家所行的一样，因为他娶了亚哈的女儿作妻子，行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行以色列诸王的道，与亚哈家一样；因他娶了亚哈的女儿为妻，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for the daughter of Ahab was his wife. And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, just as the house of Ahab had done, for he had the daughter of Ahab as a wife; and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jehoram followed the example of the kings of Israel and was as wicked as King Ahab, for he had married one of Ahab’s daughters. So Jehoram did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, just as the house of Ahab had done, for Ahab’s daughter was his wife; and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华因为自己和大卫所立的约，不愿消灭大卫家；却照着他应许的，永远赐灯光给大卫和他的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华因为自己和大卫所立的约，不愿消灭大卫家；却照着他应许的，永远赐灯光给大卫和他的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华却因自己与大卫所立的约，不肯灭大卫的家，照他所应许的，永远赐灯光与大卫和他的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, because of the covenant the Lord had made with David, the Lord was not willing to destroy the house of David. He had promised to maintain a lamp for him and his descendants forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the Lord was not willing to destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and since he had promised to give a lamp to him and to his sons forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the Lord would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that He had made with David, and since He had promised to give a lamp to him and to his sons forever.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord did not want to destroy David’s dynasty, for he had made a covenant with David and promised that his descendants would continue to rule, shining like a lamp forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord was not willing to destroy the house of David because of the covenant which He had made with David, and because He had promised to give a lamp to him and his sons forever.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, because of the covenant the Lord had made with David, the Lord was not willing to destroy the house of David. He had promised to maintain a lamp for him and his descendants forever.

verses.textZh: 约兰在位的日子，以东人反叛，脱离了犹大的统治，自立一王统治他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约兰在位的日子，以东人反叛，脱离了犹大的统治，自立一王统治他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。
verses.textEnNiv: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.
verses.textEnEsv: In his days Edom revolted from the rule of Judah and set up a king of their own.
verses.textEnNkjv: In his days Edom revolted against Judah’s authority, and made a king over themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: During Jehoram’s reign, the Edomites revolted against Judah and crowned their own king.
verses.textEnNasb: In his days Edom broke away from the rule of Judah, and appointed a king over themselves.
verses.textEn: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.

verses.textZh: 约兰率领他的众军长和所有的战车一同前去；他夜间起来，攻击那些包围他的以东人和战车队长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约兰率领他的众军长和所有的战车一同前去；他夜间起来，攻击那些包围他的以东人和战车队长。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰就率领军长和所有的战车，夜间起来，攻击围困他的以东人和车兵长。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehoram went there with his officers and all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he rose up and broke through by night.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoram passed over with his commanders and all his chariots, and he rose by night and struck the Edomites who had surrounded him and his chariot commanders.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoram went out with his officers, and all his chariots with him. And he rose by night and attacked the Edomites who had surrounded him and the captains of the chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jehoram went out with his full army and all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he went out at night and attacked them under cover of darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoram crossed over with his commanders and all his chariots with him. And he got up at night and struck and killed the Edomites who were surrounding him, and the commanders of the chariots.
verses.textEn: So Jehoram went there with his officers and all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he rose up and broke through by night.

verses.textZh: 从此，以东人反叛，脱离了犹大的统治，直到今日。那时，立拿人也反叛了，因为约兰离弃了耶和华他列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此，以东人反叛，脱离了犹大的统治，直到今日。那时，立拿人也反叛了，因为约兰离弃了耶和华他列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，直到今日。那时，立拿人也背叛了，因为约兰离弃耶和华－他列祖的神。
verses.textEnNiv: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time, because Jehoram had forsaken the Lord , the God of his ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: So Edom revolted from the rule of Judah to this day. At that time Libnah also revolted from his rule, because he had forsaken the Lord , the God of his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Edom has been in revolt against Judah’s authority to this day. At that time Libnah revolted against his rule, because he had forsaken the Lord God of his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, Edom has been independent from Judah to this day. The town of Libnah also revolted about that same time. All this happened because Jehoram had abandoned the Lord , the God of his ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: So Edom revolted against Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time against his rule because he had abandoned the Lord God of his fathers.
verses.textEn: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time, because Jehoram had forsaken the Lord , the God of his ancestors.

verses.textZh: 他又在犹大众山上建筑邱坛，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，引诱犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在犹大众山上建筑邱坛，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，引诱犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又在犹大诸山建筑邱坛，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，诱惑犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: He had also built high places on the hills of Judah and had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, he made high places in the hill country of Judah and led the inhabitants of Jerusalem into whoredom and made Judah go astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit harlotry, and led Judah astray.
verses.textEnNlt: He had built pagan shrines in the hill country of Judah and had led the people of Jerusalem and Judah to give themselves to pagan gods and to go astray.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to be unfaithful, and led Judah astray.
verses.textEn: He had also built high places on the hills of Judah and had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.

verses.textZh: 以利亚先知有信送给约兰，说："耶和华你的先祖大卫的神这样说：‘因为你没有遵行你父亲约沙法的道路，也没有遵行犹大王亚撒的道路，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚先知有信送给约兰，说："耶和华你的先祖大卫的神这样说：‘因为你没有遵行你父亲约沙法的道路，也没有遵行犹大王亚撒的道路，
verses.textZhCuv: 先知以利亚达信与约兰说：「耶和华－你祖大卫的神如此说：『因为你不行你父约沙法和犹大王亚撒的道，
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet, which said: "This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: ‘You have not followed the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And a letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, "Thus says the Lord , the God of David your father, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, or in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: And a letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus says the Lord God of your father David: Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, or in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah the prophet wrote Jehoram this letter: "This is what the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, says: You have not followed the good example of your father, Jehoshaphat, or your grandfather King Asa of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, "This is what the Lord, the God of your father David says: ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of your father Jehoshaphat and the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.textEn: Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet, which said: "This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: ‘You have not followed the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah.

verses.textZh: 却随从了以色列诸王的道路，使犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，好象亚哈家行邪淫一样；又杀了你父家比你良善的众兄弟；
verses.textZhCnvs: 却随从了以色列诸王的道路，使犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，好象亚哈家行邪淫一样；又杀了你父家比你良善的众兄弟；
verses.textZhCuv: 乃行以色列诸王的道，使犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，像亚哈家一样，又杀了你父家比你好的诸兄弟。
verses.textEnNiv: But you have followed the ways of the kings of Israel, and you have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab did. You have also murdered your own brothers, members of your own family, men who were better than you.
verses.textEnEsv: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel and have enticed Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem into whoredom, as the house of Ahab led Israel into whoredom, and also you have killed your brothers, of your father’s house, who were better than you,
verses.textEnNkjv: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the harlot like the harlotry of the house of Ahab, and also have killed your brothers, those of your father’s household, whowere better than yourself,
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you have been as evil as the kings of Israel. You have led the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship idols, just as King Ahab did in Israel. And you have even killed your own brothers, men who were better than you.
verses.textEnNasb: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have caused Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to be unfaithful as the house of Ahab was unfaithful, and you have also killed your brothers, your own family, who were better than you,
verses.textEn: But you have followed the ways of the kings of Israel, and you have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab did. You have also murdered your own brothers, members of your own family, men who were better than you.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华要用极大的灾祸击打你的人民、妻子和儿女，以及你的一切财产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华要用极大的灾祸击打你的人民、妻子和儿女，以及你的一切财产。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，耶和华降大灾与你的百姓和你的妻子、儿女，并你一切所有的。
verses.textEnNiv: So now the Lord is about to strike your people, your sons, your wives and everything that is yours, with a heavy blow.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, the Lord will bring a great plague on your people, your children, your wives, and all your possessions,
verses.textEnNkjv: behold, the Lord will strike your people with a serious affliction—your children, your wives, and all your possessions;
verses.textEnNlt: So now the Lord is about to strike you, your people, your children, your wives, and all that is yours with a heavy blow.
verses.textEnNasb: behold, the Lord is going to strike your people, your sons, your wives, and all your possessions with a great plague;
verses.textEn: So now the Lord is about to strike your people, your sons, your wives and everything that is yours, with a heavy blow.

verses.textZh: 至于你，你的肠脏必患严重的病，直到因病情日益严重，你的肠子都流出来了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，你的肠脏必患严重的病，直到因病情日益严重，你的肠子都流出来了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的肠子必患病，日加沉重，以致你的肠子坠落下来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: You yourself will be very ill with a lingering disease of the bowels, until the disease causes your bowels to come out.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and you yourself will have a severe sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels come out because of the disease, day by day.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: and you willbecome very sick with a disease of your intestines, until your intestines come out by reason of the sickness, day by day.
verses.textEnNlt: You yourself will suffer with a severe intestinal disease that will get worse each day until your bowels come out."
verses.textEnNasb: and you will suffer severe sickness, a disease of your bowels, until your bowels come out because of the sickness, day by day.’ "
verses.textEn: You yourself will be very ill with a lingering disease of the bowels, until the disease causes your bowels to come out.’ "

verses.textZh: 后来，耶和华激动了非利士人和靠近古实的阿拉伯人的心，和约兰作对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，耶和华激动了非利士人和靠近古实的阿拉伯人的心，和约兰作对。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后，耶和华激动非利士人和靠近古实的阿拉伯人来攻击约兰。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord aroused against Jehoram the hostility of the Philistines and of the Arabs who lived near the Cushites.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord stirred up against Jehoram the anger of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are near the Ethiopians.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Lord stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and the Arabians who were near the Ethiopians.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord stirred up the Philistines and the Arabs, who lived near the Ethiopians, to attack Jehoram.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and the Arabs who bordered the Ethiopians;
verses.textEn: The Lord aroused against Jehoram the hostility of the Philistines and of the Arabs who lived near the Cushites.

verses.textZh: 他们上来攻打犹大，侵入境内，掠去了王宫的一切财物，又掳去了他的众子和妻妾；除了他最小的儿子约哈斯以外，没有给他留下一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上来攻打犹大，侵入境内，掠去了王宫的一切财物，又掳去了他的众子和妻妾；除了他最小的儿子约哈斯以外，没有给他留下一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上来攻击犹大，侵入境内，掳掠了王宫里所有的财货和他的妻子、儿女，除了他小儿子约哈斯 之外，没有留下一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: They attacked Judah, invaded it and carried off all the goods found in the king’s palace, together with his sons and wives. Not a son was left to him except Ahaziah, the youngest.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came up against Judah and invaded it and carried away all the possessions they found that belonged to the king’s house, and also his sons and his wives, so that no son was left to him except Jehoahaz, his youngest son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came up into Judah and invaded it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, and also his sons and his wives, so that there was not a son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.textEnNlt: They marched against Judah, broke down its defenses, and carried away everything of value in the royal palace, including the king’s sons and his wives. Only his youngest son, Ahaziah, was spared.
verses.textEnNasb: and they came against Judah and invaded it, and carried away all the possessions found in the king’s house together with his sons and his wives, so that no son was left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.textEn: They attacked Judah, invaded it and carried off all the goods found in the king’s palace, together with his sons and wives. Not a son was left to him except Ahaziah, the youngest.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，耶和华击打约兰，使他的肠脏患了不治之症。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，耶和华击打约兰，使他的肠脏患了不治之症。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事以后，耶和华使约兰的肠子患不能医治的病。
verses.textEnNiv: After all this, the Lord afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
verses.textEnEsv: And after all this the Lord struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.textEnNkjv: After all this the Lord struck him in his intestines with an incurable disease.
verses.textEnNlt: After all this, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable intestinal disease.
verses.textEnNasb: So after all this the Lord struck him in his intestines with an incurable sickness.
verses.textEn: After all this, the Lord afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.

verses.textZh: 他病了很久。过了二年，他的肠子因病重流了出来，他就病死了；他的人民没有为他烧火，好象从前为他的列祖烧火一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他病了很久。过了二年，他的肠子因病重流了出来，他就病死了；他的人民没有为他烧火，好象从前为他的列祖烧火一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他患此病缠绵日久，过了二年，肠子坠落下来，病重而死。他的民没有为他烧什么物件，像从前为他列祖所烧的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, at the end of the second year, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great pain. His people made no funeral fire in his honor, as they had for his predecessors.
verses.textEnEsv: In the course of time, at the end of two years, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great agony. His people made no fire in his honor, like the fires made for his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened in the course of time, after the end of two years, that his intestines came out because of his sickness; so he died in severe pain. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning for his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: The disease grew worse and worse, and at the end of two years it caused his bowels to come out, and he died in agony. His people did not build a great funeral fire to honor him as they had done for his ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the course of time, at the end of two years, that his bowels came out because of his sickness, and he died in great pain. And his people did not make a funeral fire for him like the fire for his fathers.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, at the end of the second year, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great pain. His people made no funeral fire in his honor, as they had for his predecessors.

verses.textZh: 约兰登基的时候是三十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共八年；他离世的时候，没有人哀悼他。人把他埋葬在大卫城里，可是没有葬在众王的陵墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约兰登基的时候是三十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共八年；他离世的时候，没有人哀悼他。人把他埋葬在大卫城里，可是没有葬在众王的陵墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。他去世无人思慕，众人葬他在大卫城，只是不在列王的坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He passed away, to no one’s regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEnEsv: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was thirty-two years old when he became king. He reigned in Jerusalem eight years and, to no one’s sorrow, departed. However they buried him in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. No one was sorry when he died. They buried him in the City of David, but not in the royal cemetery.
verses.textEnNasb: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem for eight years; and he departed with no one’s regret, and they buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEn: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He passed away, to no one’s regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的居民立了约兰的小儿子亚哈谢接续他作王；因为那些和阿拉伯人同来攻营的匪徒，把亚哈谢的哥哥全都杀了。这样，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢就作了王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的居民立了约兰的小儿子亚哈谢接续他作王；因为那些和阿拉伯人同来攻营的匪徒，把亚哈谢的哥哥全都杀了。这样，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢就作了王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的居民立约兰的小儿子亚哈谢接续他作王；因为跟随阿拉伯人来攻营的军兵曾杀了亚哈谢的众兄长。这样，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢作了王。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram’s youngest son, king in his place, since the raiders, who came with the Arabs into the camp, had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, his youngest son, king in his place, for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, for the raiders who came with the Arabians into the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, reigned.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram’s youngest son, their next king, since the marauding bands who came with the Arabs had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram reigned as king of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, his youngest son, king in his place, for the band of men who came with the Arabs to the camp had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEn: The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram’s youngest son, king in his place, since the raiders, who came with the Arabs into the camp, had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢登基的时候是二十二岁 ；他在耶路撒冷作王一年。他的母亲名叫亚他利雅，是暗利的孙女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢登基的时候是二十二岁 ；他在耶路撒冷作王一年。他的母亲名叫亚他利雅，是暗利的孙女。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢登基的时候年四十二岁 ，在耶路撒冷作王一年。他母亲名叫亚她利雅，是暗利的孙女。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the granddaughter of Omri.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned for one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
verses.textEn: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri.

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢也随从亚哈家的道路，因为他母亲教唆他行恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢也随从亚哈家的道路，因为他母亲教唆他行恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢也行亚哈家的道；因为他母亲给他主谋，使他行恶。
verses.textEnNiv: He too followed the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother encouraged him to act wickedly.
verses.textEnEsv: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in doing wickedly.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother advised him to do wickedly.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaziah also followed the evil example of King Ahab’s family, for his mother encouraged him in doing wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor to act wickedly.
verses.textEn: He too followed the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother encouraged him to act wickedly.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象亚哈家一样，因为他的父亲死了以后，亚哈家的人就教唆他，好使他灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象亚哈家一样，因为他的父亲死了以后，亚哈家的人就教唆他，好使他灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像亚哈家一样；因他父亲死后有亚哈家的人给他主谋，以致败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father’s death they became his advisers, to his undoing.
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done. For after the death of his father they were his counselors, to his undoing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he did evil in the sight of the Lord, like the house of Ahab; for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as Ahab’s family had done. They even became his advisers after the death of his father, and they led him to ruin.
verses.textEnNasb: So he did evil in the sight of the Lord like the house of Ahab, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his own destruction.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father’s death they became his advisers, to his undoing.

verses.textZh: 他随从了他们的计谋，和以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰一同到基列的拉末去，和亚兰王哈薛交战；亚兰人击伤了约兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他随从了他们的计谋，和以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰一同到基列的拉末去，和亚兰王哈薛交战；亚兰人击伤了约兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他听从亚哈家的计谋，同以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰往基列的拉末去，与亚兰王哈薛争战；亚兰人打伤了约兰。
verses.textEnNiv: He also followed their counsel when he went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to wage war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;
verses.textEnEsv: He even followed their counsel and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to make war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead. And the Syrians wounded Joram,
verses.textEnNkjv: He also followed their advice, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
verses.textEnNlt: Following their evil advice, Ahaziah joined Joram, the son of King Ahab of Israel, in his war against King Hazael of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. When the Arameans wounded Joram in the battle,
verses.textEnNasb: He also walked by their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to wage war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. But the Arameans wounded Joram.
verses.textEn: He also followed their counsel when he went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to wage war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;

verses.textZh: 于是约兰回到耶斯列去，医治他在拉末和亚兰王交战的时候所受的伤。犹大王约兰的儿子亚撒利雅，因亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列去看他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约兰回到耶斯列去，医治他在拉末和亚兰王交战的时候所受的伤。犹大王约兰的儿子亚撒利雅，因亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列去看他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰回到耶斯列，医治在拉末与亚兰王哈薛打仗所受的伤，犹大王约兰的儿子亚撒利雅 因为亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列看望他。
verses.textEnNiv: so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab because he had been wounded.
verses.textEnEsv: and he returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds that he had received at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was wounded.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds which he had received at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.textEnNlt: he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds he had received at Ramoth. Because Joram was wounded, King Ahaziah of Judah went to Jezreel to visit him.
verses.textEnNasb: So he returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had inflicted on him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. And Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.textEn: so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab because he had been wounded.

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢去见约兰，就遇了害，这原是出于神；因为他去到以后，就和约兰一同出去攻击宁示的孙子耶户。这耶户就是耶和华所膏的，为要除灭亚哈家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢去见约兰，就遇了害，这原是出于神；因为他去到以后，就和约兰一同出去攻击宁示的孙子耶户。这耶户就是耶和华所膏的，为要除灭亚哈家。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢去见约兰就被害了，这是出乎神；因为他到了，就同约兰出去攻击宁示的孙子耶户。这耶户是耶和华所膏、使他剪除亚哈家的。
verses.textEnNiv: Through Ahaziah’s visit to Joram, God brought about Ahaziah’s downfall. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
verses.textEnEsv: But it was ordained by God that the downfall of Ahaziah should come about through his going to visit Joram. For when he came there, he went out with Jehoram to meet Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: His going to Joram was God’s occasion for Ahaziah’s downfall; for when he arrived, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.textEnNlt: But God had decided that this visit would be Ahaziah’s downfall. While he was there, Ahaziah went out with Joram to meet Jehu grandson of Nimshi, whom the Lord had appointed to destroy the dynasty of Ahab.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was from God, in that he went to Joram. For when he arrived, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to eliminate the house of Ahab.
verses.textEn: Through Ahaziah’s visit to Joram, God brought about Ahaziah’s downfall. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.

verses.textZh: 耶户讨伐亚哈家的罪的时候，遇见了犹大的众领袖和亚哈谢的兄弟的儿子，他们都是侍候亚哈谢的，耶户把他们都杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户讨伐亚哈家的罪的时候，遇见了犹大的众领袖和亚哈谢的兄弟的儿子，他们都是侍候亚哈谢的，耶户把他们都杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户讨亚哈家罪的时候，遇见犹大的众首领和亚哈谢的众侄子服事亚哈谢，就把他们都杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: While Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s relatives, who had been attending Ahaziah, and he killed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he met the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers, who attended Ahaziah, and he killed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers who served Ahaziah, that he killed them.
verses.textEnNlt: While Jehu was executing judgment against the family of Ahab, he happened to meet some of Judah’s officials and Ahaziah’s relatives who were traveling with Ahaziah. So Jehu killed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, that he found the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers attending to Ahaziah, and killed them.
verses.textEn: While Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s relatives, who had been attending Ahaziah, and he killed them.

verses.textZh: 耶户追寻亚哈谢。那时，亚哈谢躲藏在撒玛利亚，有人捉住他，把他带到耶户那里，耶户就杀了他，却把他埋葬了，因为他们说："他是约沙法的孙子；这约沙法是一心寻求耶和华的。"这样，亚哈谢的家没有一人有能力可以保持王权的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户追寻亚哈谢。那时，亚哈谢躲藏在撒玛利亚，有人捉住他，把他带到耶户那里，耶户就杀了他，却把他埋葬了，因为他们说："他是约沙法的孙子；这约沙法是一心寻求耶和华的。"这样，亚哈谢的家没有一人有能力可以保持王权的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢藏在撒马利亚，耶户寻找他，众人将他拿住，送到耶户那里，就杀了他，将他葬埋；因他们说，他是那尽心寻求耶和华之约沙法的儿子。这样，亚哈谢的家无力保守国权。
verses.textEnNiv: He then went in search of Ahaziah, and his men captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. He was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, "He was a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart." So there was no one in the house of Ahaziah powerful enough to retain the kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: He searched for Ahaziah, and he was captured while hiding in Samaria, and he was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, "He is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart." And the house of Ahaziah had no one able to rule the kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he searched for Ahaziah; and they caught him (he was hiding in Samaria), and brought him to Jehu. When they had killed him, they buried him, "because," they said, "he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart." So the house of Ahaziah had no one to assume power over the kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu’s men searched for Ahaziah, and they found him hiding in the city of Samaria. They brought him to Jehu, who killed him. Ahaziah was given a decent burial because the people said, "He was the grandson of Jehoshaphat—a man who sought the Lord with all his heart." But none of the surviving members of Ahaziah’s family was capable of ruling the kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: He also searched for Ahaziah, and they caught him while he was hiding in Samaria; they brought him to Jehu, put him to death, and buried him. For they said, "He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart." So there was no one of the house of Ahaziah to retain the power of the kingdom.
verses.textEn: He then went in search of Ahaziah, and his men captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. He was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, "He was a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart." So there was no one in the house of Ahaziah powerful enough to retain the kingdom.

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚他利雅见自己的儿子死了，就起来杀尽犹大家中所有王族的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢的母亲亚他利雅见自己的儿子死了，就起来杀尽犹大家中所有王族的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢的母亲亚她利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭犹大王室。
verses.textEnNiv: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal family of the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal heirs of the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: When Athaliah, the mother of King Ahaziah of Judah, learned that her son was dead, she began to destroy the rest of Judah’s royal family.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she rose and eliminated all the royal children of the house of Judah.
verses.textEn: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.

verses.textZh: 但是王的女儿约示巴，把亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那些将要被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都藏在卧房里。约兰王的女儿约示巴是大祭司耶何耶大的妻子，把约阿施收藏起来，躲避亚他利雅，免得被亚他利雅杀死，因为约示巴是亚哈谢的妹妹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是王的女儿约示巴，把亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那些将要被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都藏在卧房里。约兰王的女儿约示巴是大祭司耶何耶大的妻子，把约阿施收藏起来，躲避亚他利雅，免得被亚他利雅杀死，因为约示巴是亚哈谢的妹妹。
verses.textZhCuv: 但王的女儿约示巴将亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都藏在卧房里。约示巴是约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹子，祭司耶何耶大的妻。她收藏约阿施，躲避亚她利雅，免得被杀。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes who were about to be murdered and put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and wife of the priest Jehoiada, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid the child from Athaliah so she could not kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were about to be put to death, and she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Thus Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram and wife of Jehoiada the priest, because she was a sister of Ahaziah, hid him from Athaliah, so that she did not put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were being murdered, and put him and his nurse in a bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah so that she did not kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Ahaziah’s sister Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Ahaziah’s infant son, Joash, and stole him away from among the rest of the king’s children, who were about to be killed. She put Joash and his nurse in a bedroom. In this way, Jehosheba, wife of Jehoiada the priest and sister of Ahaziah, hid the child so that Athaliah could not murder him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehoshabeath the king’s daughter took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons who were being put to death, and placed him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah so that she would not put him to death.
verses.textEn: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes who were about to be murdered and put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and wife of the priest Jehoiada, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid the child from Athaliah so she could not kill him.

verses.textZh: 约阿施和他们在神的殿里一同躲藏了六年；那时亚他利雅统治犹大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施和他们在神的殿里一同躲藏了六年；那时亚他利雅统治犹大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施和她们一同藏在神殿里六年；亚她利雅篡了国位。
verses.textEnNiv: He remained hidden with them at the temple of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And he remained with them six years, hidden in the house of God, while Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he was hidden with them in the house of God for six years, while Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash remained hidden in the Temple of God for six years while Athaliah ruled over the land.
verses.textEnNasb: He kept himself hidden with them in the house of God for six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.textEn: He remained hidden with them at the temple of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.

verses.textZh: 到了第七年，耶何耶大奋勇图强，召来耶罗罕的儿子亚撒利雅、约哈难的儿子以实玛利、俄备得的儿子亚撒利雅、亚大雅的儿子玛西雅和细基利的儿子以利沙法等几位百夫长，和他们立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七年，耶何耶大奋勇图强，召来耶罗罕的儿子亚撒利雅、约哈难的儿子以实玛利、俄备得的儿子亚撒利雅、亚大雅的儿子玛西雅和细基利的儿子以利沙法等几位百夫长，和他们立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七年，耶何耶大奋勇自强，将百夫长耶罗罕的儿子亚撒利雅，约哈难的儿子以实玛利，俄备得的儿子亚撒利雅，亚大雅的儿子玛西雅，细基利的儿子以利沙法召来，与他们立约。
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventh year Jehoiada showed his strength. He made a covenant with the commanders of units of a hundred: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zikri.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the seventh year Jehoiada took courage and entered into a covenant with the commanders of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, andmadea covenant with the captains of hundreds: Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri.
verses.textEnNlt: In the seventh year of Athaliah’s reign, Jehoiada the priest decided to act. He summoned his courage and made a pact with five army commanders: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zicri.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the seventh year, Jehoiada gathered his courage, and took captains of hundreds: Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Johanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, and they entered into a covenant with him.
verses.textEn: In the seventh year Jehoiada showed his strength. He made a covenant with the commanders of units of a hundred: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zikri.

verses.textZh: 他们就走遍犹大，从犹大各城召集利未人和以色列各家族的首领；他们就来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就走遍犹大，从犹大各城召集利未人和以色列各家族的首领；他们就来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们走遍犹大，从犹大各城里招聚利未人和以色列的众族长到耶路撒冷来。
verses.textEnNiv: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israelite families from all the towns. When they came to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: And they went about through Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ houses of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah, and the chief fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: These men traveled secretly throughout Judah and summoned the Levites and clan leaders in all the towns to come to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah, and the heads of the fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israelite families from all the towns. When they came to Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 全体会众在神的殿里与王立约。耶何耶大对他们说："王的儿子应当按照耶和华应许大卫的子孙的话作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众在神的殿里与王立约。耶何耶大对他们说："王的儿子应当按照耶和华应许大卫的子孙的话作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众在神殿里与王立约。耶何耶大对他们说：「看哪，王的儿子必当作王，正如耶和华指着大卫子孙所应许的话」；
verses.textEnNiv: the whole assembly made a covenant with the king at the temple of God. Jehoiada said to them, "The king’s son shall reign, as the Lord promised concerning the descendants of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And Jehoiada said to them, "Behold, the king’s son! Let him reign, as the Lord spoke concerning the sons of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said to them, "Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as the Lord has said of the sons of David.
verses.textEnNlt: They all gathered at the Temple of God, where they made a solemn pact with Joash, the young king. Jehoiada said to them, "Here is the king’s son! The time has come for him to reign! The Lord has promised that a descendant of David will be our king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And Jehoiada said to them, "Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as the Lord has spoken concerning the sons of David.
verses.textEn: the whole assembly made a covenant with the king at the temple of God. Jehoiada said to them, "The king’s son shall reign, as the Lord promised concerning the descendants of David.

verses.textZh: 你们要这样行：你们中间每逢安息日来值班的祭司和利未人，三分之一要把守各门；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要这样行：你们中间每逢安息日来值班的祭司和利未人，三分之一要把守各门；
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「你们当这样行：祭司和利未人凡安息日进班的，三分之一要把守各门，
verses.textEnNiv: Now this is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who are going on duty on the Sabbath are to keep watch at the doors,
verses.textEnEsv: This is the thing that you shall do: of you priests and Levites who come off duty on the Sabbath, one third shall be gatekeepers,
verses.textEnNkjv: This is what you shall do: One-third of you entering on the Sabbath, of the priests and the Levites, shallbe keeping watch over the doors;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what you must do. When you priests and Levites come on duty on the Sabbath, a third of you will serve as gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the thing which you shall do: a third of you, of the priests and Levites who come in on the Sabbath, shall be gatekeepers,
verses.textEn: Now this is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who are going on duty on the Sabbath are to keep watch at the doors,

verses.textZh: 三分之一要在王宫，三分之一要在基址门；全体人民都要在耶和华殿的院子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 三分之一要在王宫，三分之一要在基址门；全体人民都要在耶和华殿的院子里。
