verses.textZhCuv: 三分之一要在王宫，三分之一要在基址门；众百姓要在耶和华殿的院内。
verses.textEnNiv: a third of you at the royal palace and a third at the Foundation Gate, and all the others are to be in the courtyards of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and one third shall be at the king’s house and one third at the Gate of the Foundation. And all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: one-third shallbe at the king’s house; and one-third at the Gate of the Foundation. All the people shallbe in the courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Another third will go over to the royal palace, and the final third will be at the Foundation Gate. Everyone else should stay in the courtyards of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: and a third shall be at the king’s house, and a third at the Gate of the Foundation; and all the people shall be in the courtyards of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: a third of you at the royal palace and a third at the Foundation Gate, and all the others are to be in the courtyards of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 除了祭司和供职的利未人以外，任何人不得进入耶和华的殿，只有他们可以进去，因为他们是分别为圣的；全体人民都要遵守耶和华的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了祭司和供职的利未人以外，任何人不得进入耶和华的殿，只有他们可以进去，因为他们是分别为圣的；全体人民都要遵守耶和华的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了祭司和供职的利未人之外，不准别人进耶和华的殿；惟独他们可以进去，因为他们圣洁。众百姓要遵守耶和华所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: No one is to enter the temple of the Lord except the priests and Levites on duty; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the others are to observe the Lord ’s command not to enter.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one enter the house of the Lord except the priests and ministering Levites. They may enter, for they are holy, but all the people shall keep the charge of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But let no one come into the house of the Lord except the priests and those of the Levites who serve. They may go in, for they are holy; but all the people shall keep the watch of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, only the priests and Levites on duty may enter the Temple of the Lord , for they are set apart as holy. The rest of the people must obey the Lord ’s instructions and stay outside.
verses.textEnNasb: But no one is to enter the house of the Lord except the priests and the ministering Levites; they may enter, for they are holy. And all the people are to keep the command of the Lord.
verses.textEn: No one is to enter the temple of the Lord except the priests and Levites on duty; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the others are to observe the Lord ’s command not to enter.

verses.textZh: 利未人要在周围环绕君王，各人手里拿着武器；擅自进殿的，都必被处死；王出入的时候，你们都要随着他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人要在周围环绕君王，各人手里拿着武器；擅自进殿的，都必被处死；王出入的时候，你们都要随着他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人要手中各拿兵器，四围护卫王；凡擅入殿宇的，必当治死。王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites are to station themselves around the king, each with weapon in hand. Anyone who enters the temple is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."
verses.textEnEsv: The Levites shall surround the king, each with his weapons in his hand. And whoever enters the house shall be put to death. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Levites shall surround the king on all sides, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whoever comes into the house, let him be put to death. You are to be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out."
verses.textEnNlt: You Levites, form a bodyguard around the king and keep your weapons in hand. Kill anyone who tries to enter the Temple. Stay with the king wherever he goes."
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites will surround the king, each man with his weapons in his hand; and whoever enters the house is to be put to death. Therefore be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out."
verses.textEn: The Levites are to station themselves around the king, each with weapon in hand. Anyone who enters the temple is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."

verses.textZh: 利未人和犹大众人都照着耶何耶大祭司吩咐的一切去行；他们各人带着在安息日值班或在安息日下班的人来，因为耶何耶大祭司不准他们下班。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人和犹大众人都照着耶何耶大祭司吩咐的一切去行；他们各人带着在安息日值班或在安息日下班的人来，因为耶何耶大祭司不准他们下班。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人和犹大众人都照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来，因为祭司耶何耶大不许他们下班。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites and all the men of Judah did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.
verses.textEnEsv: The Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded, and they each brought his men, who were to go off duty on the Sabbath, with those who were to come on duty on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest did not dismiss the divisions.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. And each man took his men who were to be on duty on the Sabbath, with those who were going offduty on the Sabbath; for Jehoiada the priest had not dismissed the divisions.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Levites and all the people of Judah did everything as Jehoiada the priest ordered. The commanders took charge of the men reporting for duty that Sabbath, as well as those who were going off duty. Jehoiada the priest did not let anyone go home after their shift ended.
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. And each one of them took his men who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest did not dismiss any of the divisions.
verses.textEn: The Levites and all the men of Judah did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.

verses.textZh: 于是耶何耶大祭司把神的殿里，原本属于大卫王的矛枪、大盾和小盾，交给了众百夫长；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶何耶大祭司把神的殿里，原本属于大卫王的矛枪、大盾和小盾，交给了众百夫长；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司耶何耶大便将神殿里所藏大卫王的枪、盾牌、挡牌交给百夫长，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he gave the commanders of units of a hundred the spears and the large and small shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoiada the priest gave to the captains the spears and the large and small shields that had been King David’s, which were in the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoiada the priest gave to the captains of hundreds the spears and the large and small shields which hadbelonged to King David, that were in the temple of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada supplied the commanders with the spears and the large and small shields that had once belonged to King David and were stored in the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoiada the priest gave the captains of hundreds the spears and the shields and quivers which had been King David’s, which were in the house of God.
verses.textEn: Then he gave the commanders of units of a hundred the spears and the large and small shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of God.

verses.textZh: 他又分派众民，手中各拿兵器，守在祭坛和殿的四周，从殿的右面到殿的左面，环绕着王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又分派众民，手中各拿兵器，守在祭坛和殿的四周，从殿的右面到殿的左面，环绕着王。
verses.textZhCuv: 又分派众民手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围；
verses.textEnNiv: He stationed all the men, each with his weapon in his hand, around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set all the people as a guard for the king, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the south side of the house to the north side of the house, around the altar and the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and by the temple, all around the king.
verses.textEnNlt: He stationed all the people around the king, with their weapons ready. They formed a line from the south side of the Temple around to the north side and all around the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: He stationed all the people, each man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, by the altar and by the house, around the king.
verses.textEn: He stationed all the men, each with his weapon in his hand, around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.

verses.textZh: 于是他们把王子领出来，给他戴上王冠，又把约书交给他，立他为王；耶何耶大和他的众子用膏膏他，并且说："愿王万岁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们把王子领出来，给他戴上王冠，又把约书交给他，立他为王；耶何耶大和他的众子用膏膏他，并且说："愿王万岁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法书交给他，立他作王。耶何耶大和众子膏他，众人说：「愿王万岁！」
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; they presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then they brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him and gave him the testimony. And they proclaimed him king, and Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, "Long live the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gavehim the Testimony, and made him king. Then Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada and his sons brought out Joash, the king’s son, placed the crown on his head, and presented him with a copy of God’s laws. They anointed him and proclaimed him king, and everyone shouted, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him, and gave him the testimony and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and said, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEn: Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; they presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, "Long live the king!"

verses.textZh: 亚他利雅听见人民奔跑和赞美王的声音，就进了耶和华的殿，到众民那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚他利雅听见人民奔跑和赞美王的声音，就进了耶和华的殿，到众民那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚她利雅听见民奔走赞美王的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went to them at the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she went into the house of the Lord to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people in the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and the shouts of praise to the king, she hurried to the Lord ’s Temple to see what was happening.
verses.textEnNasb: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she went into the house of the Lord to the people.
verses.textEn: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went to them at the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 她一观看，见王站在殿门口的柱旁，众官长和吹号的人在王的周围；国民都欢乐吹号，又有歌唱的人用各种乐器领导众人歌颂。于是亚他利雅撕裂衣服，说："反了！反了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她一观看，见王站在殿门口的柱旁，众官长和吹号的人在王的周围；国民都欢乐吹号，又有歌唱的人用各种乐器领导众人歌颂。于是亚他利雅撕裂衣服，说："反了！反了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 看见王站在殿门的柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国民都欢乐吹号，又有歌唱的，用各样的乐器领人歌唱赞美；亚她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说：「反了！反了！」
verses.textEnNiv: She looked, and there was the king, standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and musicians with their instruments were leading the praises. Then Athaliah tore her robes and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when she looked, there was the king standing by his pillar at the entrance, and the captains and the trumpeters beside the king, and all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and the singers with their musical instruments leading in the celebration. And Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When she looked, there was the king standing by his pillar at the entrance; and the leaders and the trumpeters were by the king. All the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, also the singers with musical instruments, and those who led in praise. So Athaliah tore her clothes and said, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnNlt: When she arrived, she saw the newly crowned king standing in his place of authority by the pillar at the Temple entrance. The commanders and trumpeters were surrounding him, and people from all over the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Singers with musical instruments were leading the people in a great celebration. When Athaliah saw all this, she tore her clothes in despair and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnNasb: She looked, and behold, the king was standing by his pillar at the entrance, and the captains and the trumpeters were beside the king. And all the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets, the singers with their musical instruments leading the praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and said, "Conspiracy! Conspiracy!"
verses.textEn: She looked, and there was the king, standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and musicians with their instruments were leading the praises. Then Athaliah tore her robes and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大祭司把管辖军队的众百夫长叫出来，对他们说："把她从各班次中间赶出去；跟随她的人，都要用刀杀死。"因为祭司说："不可在耶和华的殿内杀死她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大祭司把管辖军队的众百夫长叫出来，对他们说："把她从各班次中间赶出去；跟随她的人，都要用刀杀死。"因为祭司说："不可在耶和华的殿内杀死她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司耶何耶大带管辖军兵的百夫长出来，吩咐他们说：「将她赶到班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死！」因为祭司说：「不可在耶和华殿里杀她。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops, and said to them: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not put her to death at the temple of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains who were set over the army, saying to them, "Bring her out between the ranks, and anyone who follows her is to be put to death with the sword." For the priest said, "Do not put her to death in the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, "Take her outside under guard, and slay with the sword whoever follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not kill her in the house of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders who were in charge of the troops, "Take her to the soldiers in front of the Temple, and kill anyone who tries to rescue her." For the priest had said, "She must not be killed in the Temple of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were appointed over the army, and said to them, "Bring her out between the ranks, and whoever follows her is to be put to death with the sword." For the priest said, "You shall not put her to death in the house of the Lord."
verses.textEn: Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops, and said to them: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not put her to death at the temple of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 她走到王宫的马门入口的时候，众兵就把她拿住，在那里把她杀死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她走到王宫的马门入口的时候，众兵就把她拿住，在那里把她杀死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 众兵就闪开，让她去；她走到王宫的马门，便在那里把她杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: So they seized her as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.
verses.textEnEsv: So they laid hands on her, and she went into the entrance of the horse gate of the king’s house, and they put her to death there.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they seized her; and she went by way of the entrance of the Horse Gate into the king’s house, and they killed her there.
verses.textEnNlt: So they seized her and led her out to the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and they killed her there.
verses.textEnNasb: So they seized her, and when she arrived at the entrance of the Horse Gate of the king’s house, they put her to death there.
verses.textEn: So they seized her as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大与众民和王立约，要他们作耶和华的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大与众民和王立约，要他们作耶和华的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大与众民和王立约，都要作耶和华的民。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada then made a covenant that he, the people and the king would be the Lord ’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and all the people and the king that they should be the Lord ’s people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, the people, and the king, that they should be the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and the king and the people that they would be the Lord ’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and all the people and the king, that they would be the Lord’s people.
verses.textEn: Jehoiada then made a covenant that he, the people and the king would be the Lord ’s people.

verses.textZh: 于是众民都去到巴力庙，把庙拆毁，打碎祭坛和偶像，又在祭坛前杀了巴力的祭司玛坦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众民都去到巴力庙，把庙拆毁，打碎祭坛和偶像，又在祭坛前杀了巴力的祭司玛坦。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people went to the house of Baal and tore it down; his altars and his images they broke in pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people went to the temple of Baal, and tore it down. They broke in pieces its altars and images, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people went over to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They demolished the altars and smashed the idols, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people went to the house of Baal and tore it down, and they broke in pieces his altars and his images, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.textEn: All the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大把看守耶和华殿的责任，交在利未支派的祭司手里；这些利未支派的祭司是大卫分派在耶和华的殿中，照着摩西的律法所记的，给耶和华献燔祭，又照着大卫所定的，欢乐歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大把看守耶和华殿的责任，交在利未支派的祭司手里；这些利未支派的祭司是大卫分派在耶和华的殿中，照着摩西的律法所记的，给耶和华献燔祭，又照着大卫所定的，欢乐歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，是在祭司利未人手下。这祭司利未人是大卫分派在耶和华殿中、照摩西律法上所写的，给耶和华献燔祭，又按大卫所定的例，欢乐歌唱；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehoiada placed the oversight of the temple of the Lord in the hands of the Levitical priests, to whom David had made assignments in the temple, to present the burnt offerings of the Lord as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and singing, as David had ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoiada posted watchmen for the house of the Lord under the direction of the Levitical priests and the Levites whom David had organized to be in charge of the house of the Lord , to offer burnt offerings to the Lord , as it is written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, according to the order of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jehoiada appointed the oversight of the house of the Lord to the hand of the priests, the Levites, whom David had assigned in the house of the Lord, to offer the burnt offerings of the Lord, as itis written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, asitwasestablished by David.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiada now put the priests and Levites in charge of the Temple of the Lord , following all the directions given by David. He also commanded them to present burnt offerings to the Lord , as prescribed by the Law of Moses, and to sing and rejoice as David had instructed.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Jehoiada placed the offices of the house of the Lord under the authority of the Levitical priests, whom David had assigned over the house of the Lord, to offer the burnt offerings of the Lord, as it is written in the Law of Moses—with rejoicing and singing according to the order of David.
verses.textEn: Then Jehoiada placed the oversight of the temple of the Lord in the hands of the Levitical priests, to whom David had made assignments in the temple, to present the burnt offerings of the Lord as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and singing, as David had ordered.

verses.textZh: 他又设立守门的看守耶和华殿的各门，无论为了甚么事，不洁净的人，都不能进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又设立守门的看守耶和华殿的各门，无论为了甚么事，不洁净的人，都不能进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 且设立守门的把守耶和华殿的各门，无论为何事，不洁净的人都不准进去。
verses.textEnNiv: He also stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the Lord ’s temple so that no one who was in any way unclean might enter.
verses.textEnEsv: He stationed the gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the Lord so that no one should enter who was in any way unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he set the gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the Lord, so that no one whowas in any way unclean should enter.
verses.textEnNlt: He also stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the Lord ’s Temple to keep out those who for any reason were ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: He stationed the gatekeepers of the house of the Lord, so that no one would enter who was in any way unclean.
verses.textEn: He also stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the Lord ’s temple so that no one who was in any way unclean might enter.

verses.textZh: 他率领百夫长、贵族、民间的官长和国民，又把王从耶和华的殿领下来，从"上门"进入王宫，拥立王坐在王位上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他率领百夫长、贵族、民间的官长和国民，又把王从耶和华的殿领下来，从"上门"进入王宫，拥立王坐在王位上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又率领百夫长和贵胄，与民间的官长，并国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由上门进入王宫，立王坐在国位上。
verses.textEnNiv: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the temple of the Lord . They went into the palace through the Upper Gate and seated the king on the royal throne.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took the captains, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the Lord , marching through the upper gate to the king’s house. And they set the king on the royal throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the house of the Lord; and they went through the Upper Gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the commanders, nobles, rulers, and all the people of the land escorted the king from the Temple of the Lord . They went through the upper gate and into the palace, and they seated the king on the royal throne.
verses.textEnNasb: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the house of the Lord, and went through the upper gate to the king’s house. And they seated the king upon the royal throne.
verses.textEn: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the temple of the Lord . They went into the palace through the Upper Gate and seated the king on the royal throne.

verses.textZh: 于是全国的人民都欢乐，全城也都宁静；因为他们把亚他利雅用刀杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是全国的人民都欢乐，全城也都宁静；因为他们把亚他利雅用刀杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚她利雅用刀杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet after Athaliah had been put to death with the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet, for they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was peaceful because Athaliah had been killed.
verses.textEnNasb: So all of the people of the land rejoiced and the city was at rest. For they had put Athaliah to death with the sword.
verses.textEn: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword.

verses.textZh: 约阿施登基的时候是七岁，在耶路撒冷作王共四十年。他的母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施登基的时候是七岁，在耶路撒冷作王共四十年。他的母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施登基的时候年七岁，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。
verses.textEnNiv: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother was Zibiah from Beersheba.
verses.textEnNasb: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned for forty years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Zibiah from Beersheba.
verses.textEn: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大祭司在世的日子，约阿施行耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大祭司在世的日子，约阿施行耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司耶何耶大在世的时候，约阿施行耶和华眼中看为正的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joash did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight throughout the lifetime of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Joash did what was right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEn: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years of Jehoiada the priest.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大为他娶了两个妻子，他就生了一些儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大为他娶了两个妻子，他就生了一些儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大为他娶了两个妻，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada chose two wives for him, and he had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoiada got for him two wives, and he had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoiada took two wives for him, and he had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiada chose two wives for Joash, and he had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoiada took two wives for him, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: Jehoiada chose two wives for him, and he had sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 此后，约阿施有意重修耶和华的殿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，约阿施有意重修耶和华的殿，
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，约阿施有意重修耶和华的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later Joash decided to restore the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: After this Joash decided to restore the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened after this that Joash set his heart on repairing the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: At one point Joash decided to repair and restore the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after this that Joash decided to restore the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Some time later Joash decided to restore the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 就召集了众祭司和利未人，对他们说："你们要去到犹大各城，向所有以色列人募捐金钱，可以年年修建你们神的殿；你们应急速办理这事。"可是利未人却不急速办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就召集了众祭司和利未人，对他们说："你们要去到犹大各城，向所有以色列人募捐金钱，可以年年修建你们神的殿；你们应急速办理这事。"可是利未人却不急速办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 便召聚众祭司和利未人，吩咐他们说：「你们要往犹大各城去，使以色列众人捐纳银子，每年可以修理你们神的殿；你们要急速办理这事。」只是利未人不急速办理。
verses.textEnNiv: He called together the priests and Levites and said to them, "Go to the towns of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the temple of your God. Do it now." But the Levites did not act at once.
verses.textEnEsv: And he gathered the priests and the Levites and said to them, "Go out to the cities of Judah and gather from all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that you act quickly." But the Levites did not act quickly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he gathered the priests and the Levites, and said to them, "Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather from all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that you do it quickly." However the Levites did not do it quickly.
verses.textEnNlt: He summoned the priests and Levites and gave them these instructions: "Go to all the towns of Judah and collect the required annual offerings, so that we can repair the Temple of your God. Do not delay!" But the Levites did not act immediately.
verses.textEnNasb: He gathered the priests and Levites and said to them, "Go out to the cities of Judah and collect money from all Israel to repair the house of your God annually, and you shall do the work quickly." But the Levites did not act quickly.
verses.textEn: He called together the priests and Levites and said to them, "Go to the towns of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the temple of your God. Do it now." But the Levites did not act at once.

verses.textZh: 于是王把大祭司耶何耶大召来，对他说："你为甚么不命令利未人把耶和华的仆人摩西和以色列的会众，为法柜的会幕规定的税款，从犹大和耶路撒冷征收回来，作修殿的费用呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王把大祭司耶何耶大召来，对他说："你为甚么不命令利未人把耶和华的仆人摩西和以色列的会众，为法柜的会幕规定的税款，从犹大和耶路撒冷征收回来，作修殿的费用呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王召了大祭司耶何耶大来，对他说：「从前耶和华的仆人摩西，为法柜的帐幕与以色列会众所定的捐项，你为何不叫利未人照这例从犹大和耶路撒冷带来作殿的费用呢？」（
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the king summoned Jehoiada the chief priest and said to him, "Why haven’t you required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the Lord and by the assembly of Israel for the tent of the covenant law?"
verses.textEnEsv: So the king summoned Jehoiada the chief and said to him, "Why have you not required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax levied by Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the congregation of Israel for the tent of testimony?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king called Jehoiada the chief priest, and said to him, "Why have you not required the Levites to bring in from Judah and from Jerusalem the collection, accordingtothecommandment of Moses the servant of the Lord and of the assembly of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?"
verses.textEnNlt: So the king called for Jehoiada the high priest and asked him, "Why haven’t you demanded that the Levites go out and collect the Temple taxes from the towns of Judah and from Jerusalem? Moses, the servant of the Lord , levied this tax on the community of Israel in order to maintain the Tabernacle of the Covenant. "
verses.textEnNasb: So the king summoned Jehoiada, the chief priest, and said to him, "Why have you not required the Levites to bring in from Judah and from Jerusalem the contribution of Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the congregation of Israel, for the tent of the testimony?"
verses.textEn: Therefore the king summoned Jehoiada the chief priest and said to him, "Why haven’t you required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the Lord and by the assembly of Israel for the tent of the covenant law?"

verses.textZh: 原来那恶妇亚他利雅的众子曾经拆毁神的殿，又把耶和华殿中一切分别为圣的物品用来供奉巴力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来那恶妇亚他利雅的众子曾经拆毁神的殿，又把耶和华殿中一切分别为圣的物品用来供奉巴力。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那恶妇亚她利雅的众子曾拆毁神的殿，又用耶和华殿中分别为圣的物供奉巴力。）
verses.textEnNiv: Now the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the temple of God and had used even its sacred objects for the Baals.
verses.textEnEsv: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken into the house of God, and had also used all the dedicated things of the house of the Lord for the Baals.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken into the house of God, and had also presented all the dedicated things of the house of the Lord to the Baals.
verses.textEnNlt: Over the years the followers of wicked Athaliah had broken into the Temple of God, and they had used all the dedicated things from the Temple of the Lord to worship the images of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of the wicked Athaliah had broken into the house of God, and even used the holy things of the house of the Lord for the Baals.
verses.textEn: Now the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the temple of God and had used even its sacred objects for the Baals.

verses.textZh: 于是王下令，他们就造了一个柜，放在耶和华殿的门外；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王下令，他们就造了一个柜，放在耶和华殿的门外；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是王下令，众人做了一柜，放在耶和华殿的门外，
verses.textEnNiv: At the king’s command, a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So the king commanded, and they made a chest and set it outside the gate of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then at the king’s command they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So now the king ordered a chest to be made and set outside the gate leading to the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So the king commanded, and they made a chest and set it outside by the gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: At the king’s command, a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 又在犹大和耶路撒冷发出通告，叫人把神的仆人摩西，在旷野规定以色列人缴交的税款带来，献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在犹大和耶路撒冷发出通告，叫人把神的仆人摩西，在旷野规定以色列人缴交的税款带来，献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 又通告犹大和耶路撒冷的百姓，要将神仆人摩西在旷野所吩咐以色列人的捐项给耶和华送来。
verses.textEnNiv: A proclamation was then issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they should bring to the Lord the tax that Moses the servant of God had required of Israel in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: And proclamation was made throughout Judah and Jerusalem to bring in for the Lord the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to bring to the Lord the collection that Moses the servant of God hadimposed on Israel in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a proclamation was sent throughout Judah and Jerusalem, telling the people to bring to the Lord the tax that Moses, the servant of God, had required of the Israelites in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: And they made a proclamation in Judah and Jerusalem to bring to the Lord the contribution commanded by Moses the servant of God on Israel in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: A proclamation was then issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they should bring to the Lord the tax that Moses the servant of God had required of Israel in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 众领袖和人民都欢欢喜喜把税款带来，投进柜中，直到他们都投完了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众领袖和人民都欢欢喜喜把税款带来，投进柜中，直到他们都投完了。
verses.textZhCuv: 众首领和百姓都欢欢喜喜地将银子送来，投入柜中，直到捐完。
verses.textEnNiv: All the officials and all the people brought their contributions gladly, dropping them into the chest until it was full.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced and brought their tax and dropped it into the chest until they had finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the leaders and all the people rejoiced, brought their contributions, and put them into the chest until all had given.
verses.textEnNlt: This pleased all the leaders and the people, and they gladly brought their money and filled the chest with it.
verses.textEnNasb: All the officers and all the people rejoiced, and they brought in their contribution and dropped it into the chest until they had finished.
verses.textEn: All the officials and all the people brought their contributions gladly, dropping them into the chest until it was full.

verses.textZh: 利未人把银柜抬到王指定负责这事的人那里的时候，他们看见税银很多，王的书记和大祭司的属员就来把银柜倒空，然后抬回原处。天天都是这样，所以收集了很多银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人把银柜抬到王指定负责这事的人那里的时候，他们看见税银很多，王的书记和大祭司的属员就来把银柜倒空，然后抬回原处。天天都是这样，所以收集了很多银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人见银子多了，就把柜抬到王所派的司事面前；王的书记和大祭司的属员来将柜倒空，仍放在原处。日日都是这样，积蓄的银子甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the chest was brought in by the Levites to the king’s officials and they saw that there was a large amount of money, the royal secretary and the officer of the chief priest would come and empty the chest and carry it back to its place. They did this regularly and collected a great amount of money.
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the Levites, when they saw that there was much money in it, the king’s secretary and the officer of the chief priest would come and empty the chest and take it and return it to its place. Thus they did day after day, and collected money in abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, at that time, when the chest was brought to the king’s official by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that therewas much money, that the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it and returned it to its place. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the chest became full, the Levites would carry it to the king’s officials. Then the court secretary and an officer of the high priest would come and empty the chest and take it back to the Temple again. This went on day after day, and a large amount of money was collected.
verses.textEnNasb: It happened that whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officer by the Levites, and they saw that the money was substantial, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer would come and empty the chest, and pick it up and return it to its place. They did this daily and collected a large amount of money.
verses.textEn: Whenever the chest was brought in by the Levites to the king’s officials and they saw that there was a large amount of money, the royal secretary and the officer of the chief priest would come and empty the chest and carry it back to its place. They did this regularly and collected a great amount of money.

verses.textZh: 王和耶何耶大把银子交给耶和华殿的办事人员，他们就雇了石匠和木匠，重建耶和华的殿，又雇了铁匠和铜匠，重建耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和耶何耶大把银子交给耶和华殿的办事人员，他们就雇了石匠和木匠，重建耶和华的殿，又雇了铁匠和铜匠，重建耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 王与耶何耶大将银子交给耶和华殿里办事的人，他们就雇了石匠、木匠重修耶和华的殿，又雇了铁匠、铜匠修理耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who carried out the work required for the temple of the Lord . They hired masons and carpenters to restore the Lord ’s temple, and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to those who had charge of the work of the house of the Lord , and they hired masons and carpenters to restore the house of the Lord , and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the house of the Lord; and they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, and also those who worked in iron and bronze to restore the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The king and Jehoiada gave the money to the construction supervisors, who hired masons and carpenters to restore the Temple of the Lord . They also hired metalworkers, who made articles of iron and bronze for the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the house of the Lord; and they hired masons and carpenters to restore the house of the Lord, and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who carried out the work required for the temple of the Lord . They hired masons and carpenters to restore the Lord ’s temple, and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the temple.

verses.textZh: 作工的人不住工作，重修的工程在他们手下顺利进行；他们把神的殿重建得和先前一样，并且非常坚固。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作工的人不住工作，重修的工程在他们手下顺利进行；他们把神的殿重建得和先前一样，并且非常坚固。
verses.textZhCuv: 工人操作，渐渐修成，将神殿修造得与从前一样，而且甚是坚固。
verses.textEnNiv: The men in charge of the work were diligent, and the repairs progressed under them. They rebuilt the temple of God according to its original design and reinforced it.
verses.textEnEsv: So those who were engaged in the work labored, and the repairing went forward in their hands, and they restored the house of God to its proper condition and strengthened it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the workmen labored, and the work was completed by them; they restored the house of God to its original condition and reinforced it.
verses.textEnNlt: The men in charge of the renovation worked hard and made steady progress. They restored the Temple of God according to its original design and strengthened it.
verses.textEnNasb: So the workmen labored, and the repair work progressed in their hands, and they restored the house of God according to its specifications and strengthened it.
verses.textEn: The men in charge of the work were diligent, and the repairs progressed under them. They rebuilt the temple of God according to its original design and reinforced it.

verses.textZh: 他们完工以后，就把剩下的银子送到王和耶何耶大面前，用来制造耶和华殿里的器皿、供奉和献祭所用的器皿、盘子，以及各种金银器皿。耶何耶大在世的日子，众人都常在耶和华的殿里献燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们完工以后，就把剩下的银子送到王和耶何耶大面前，用来制造耶和华殿里的器皿、供奉和献祭所用的器皿、盘子，以及各种金银器皿。耶何耶大在世的日子，众人都常在耶和华的殿里献燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 工程完了，他们就把其余的银子拿到王与耶何耶大面前，用以制造耶和华殿供奉所用的器皿和调羹，并金银的器皿。 耶何耶大在世的时候，众人常在耶和华殿里献燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the Lord ’s temple: articles for the service and for the burnt offerings, and also dishes and other objects of gold and silver. As long as Jehoiada lived, burnt offerings were presented continually in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made utensils for the house of the Lord , both for the service and for the burnt offerings, and dishes for incense and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord regularly all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada; they made from it articles for the house of the Lord, articles for serving and offering, spoons and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the repairs were finished, they brought the remaining money to the king and Jehoiada. It was used to make various articles for the Temple of the Lord —articles for worship services and for burnt offerings, including ladles and other articles made of gold and silver. And the burnt offerings were sacrificed continually in the Temple of the Lord during the lifetime of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada; and it was made into utensils for the house of the Lord, utensils for the service and the burnt offerings, and pans and utensils of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually, all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.textEn: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the Lord ’s temple: articles for the service and for the burnt offerings, and also dishes and other objects of gold and silver. As long as Jehoiada lived, burnt offerings were presented continually in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大年纪老了，寿数满足就死了；他死的时候，是一百三十岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大年纪老了，寿数满足就死了；他死的时候，是一百三十岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大年纪老迈，日子满足而死。死的时候年一百三十岁，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jehoiada was old and full of years, and he died at the age of a hundred and thirty.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehoiada grew old and full of days, and died. He was 130 years old at his death.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died; hewas one hundred and thirty years old when he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiada lived to a very old age, finally dying at 130.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jehoiada reached a good old age and he died; he was 130 years old at his death.
verses.textEn: Now Jehoiada was old and full of years, and he died at the age of a hundred and thirty.

verses.textZh: 他和列王一同埋葬在大卫城里，因为他在以色列为神和神的殿作了美善的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他和列王一同埋葬在大卫城里，因为他在以色列为神和神的殿作了美善的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 葬在大卫城列王的坟墓里；因为他在以色列人中行善，又事奉神，修理神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: He was buried with the kings in the City of David, because of the good he had done in Israel for God and his temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they buried him in the City of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God and His house.
verses.textEnNlt: He was buried among the kings in the City of David, because he had done so much good in Israel for God and his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And they buried him in the city of David with the kings, because he had done well in Israel and for God and His house.
verses.textEn: He was buried with the kings in the City of David, because of the good he had done in Israel for God and his temple.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大死后，犹大的领袖们来朝拜王；王听从了他们的主意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大死后，犹大的领袖们来朝拜王；王听从了他们的主意。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大死后，犹大的众首领来朝拜王；王就听从他们。
verses.textEnNiv: After the death of Jehoiada, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now after the death of Jehoiada the princes of Judah came and paid homage to the king. Then the king listened to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the death of Jehoiada the leaders of Judah came and bowed down to the king. And the king listened to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But after Jehoiada’s death, the leaders of Judah came and bowed before King Joash and persuaded him to listen to their advice.
verses.textEnNasb: But after the death of Jehoiada the officials of Judah came and bowed down to the king, and the king listened to them.
verses.textEn: After the death of Jehoiada, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.

verses.textZh: 他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神的殿，去事奉亚舍拉和偶像。因为他们的罪，神的忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神的殿，去事奉亚舍拉和偶像。因为他们的罪，神的忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离弃耶和华－他们列祖神的殿，去事奉亚舍拉和偶像；因他们这罪，就有忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: They abandoned the temple of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and worshiped Asherah poles and idols. Because of their guilt, God’s anger came on Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And they abandoned the house of the Lord , the God of their fathers, and served the Asherim and the idols. And wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they left the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served wooden images and idols; and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem because of their trespass.
verses.textEnNlt: They decided to abandon the Temple of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and they worshiped Asherah poles and idols instead! Because of this sin, divine anger fell on Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And they abandoned the house of the Lord, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherim and the idols; so wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.
verses.textEn: They abandoned the temple of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and worshiped Asherah poles and idols. Because of their guilt, God’s anger came on Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华仍然差派先知到他们中间，引导他们归向耶和华；这些先知虽然警告他们，他们却不肯听从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华仍然差派先知到他们中间，引导他们归向耶和华；这些先知虽然警告他们，他们却不肯听从。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神仍遣先知到他们那里，引导他们归向耶和华。这先知警戒他们，他们却不肯听。
verses.textEnNiv: Although the Lord sent prophets to the people to bring them back to him, and though they testified against them, they would not listen.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he sent prophets among them to bring them back to the Lord . These testified against them, but they would not pay attention.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He sent prophets to them, to bring them back to the Lord; and they testified against them, but they would not listen.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet the Lord sent prophets to bring them back to him. The prophets warned them, but still the people would not listen.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet He sent prophets to them to bring them back to the Lord; and they testified against them, but they would not listen.
verses.textEn: Although the Lord sent prophets to the people to bring them back to him, and though they testified against them, they would not listen.

verses.textZh: 那时，神的灵临到耶何耶大祭司的儿子撒迦利亚身上，他就站在比众民高的地方，对他们说："神这样说：‘你们为甚么违背耶和华的诫命，使你们不得亨通呢？因为你们离弃了耶和华，所以耶和华也离弃你们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，神的灵临到耶何耶大祭司的儿子撒迦利亚身上，他就站在比众民高的地方，对他们说："神这样说：‘你们为甚么违背耶和华的诫命，使你们不得亨通呢？因为你们离弃了耶和华，所以耶和华也离弃你们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，神的灵感动祭司耶何耶大的儿子撒迦利亚，他就站在上面对民说：「神如此说：你们为何干犯耶和华的诫命，以致不得亨通呢？因为你们离弃耶和华，所以他也离弃你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit of God came on Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood before the people and said, "This is what God says: ‘Why do you disobey the Lord ’s commands? You will not prosper. Because you have forsaken the Lord , he has forsaken you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Spirit of God clothed Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people, and said to them, "Thus says God, ‘Why do you break the commandments of the Lord , so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the Lord , he has forsaken you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood above the people, and said to them, "Thus says God: ‘Why do you transgress the commandments of the Lord, so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the Lord, He also has forsaken you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood before the people and said, "This is what God says: Why do you disobey the Lord ’s commands and keep yourselves from prospering? You have abandoned the Lord , and now he has abandoned you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Spirit of God covered Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada the priest like clothing; and he stood above the people and said to them, "This is what God has said, ‘Why do you break the commandments of the Lord and do not prosper? Because you have abandoned the Lord, He has also abandoned you.’ "
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit of God came on Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood before the people and said, "This is what God says: ‘Why do you disobey the Lord ’s commands? You will not prosper. Because you have forsaken the Lord , he has forsaken you.’ "

verses.textZh: 众人要杀害撒迦利亚，于是照着王的命令，在耶和华殿的院子里用石头把他打死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人要杀害撒迦利亚，于是照着王的命令，在耶和华殿的院子里用石头把他打死。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民同心谋害撒迦利亚，就照王的吩咐，在耶和华殿的院内用石头打死他。
verses.textEnNiv: But they plotted against him, and by order of the king they stoned him to death in the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: But they conspired against him, and by command of the king they stoned him with stones in the court of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So they conspired against him, and at the command of the king they stoned him with stones in the court of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leaders plotted to kill Zechariah, and King Joash ordered that they stone him to death in the courtyard of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: So they conspired against him, and at the command of the king they stoned him to death in the courtyard of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: But they plotted against him, and by order of the king they stoned him to death in the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 约阿施王没有记念撒迦利亚的父亲耶何耶大对他所施的恩，反而杀了他的儿子。撒迦利亚临死的时候，说："愿耶和华鉴察，并且责问你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施王没有记念撒迦利亚的父亲耶何耶大对他所施的恩，反而杀了他的儿子。撒迦利亚临死的时候，说："愿耶和华鉴察，并且责问你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，约阿施王不想念撒迦利亚的父亲耶何耶大向自己所施的恩，杀了他的儿子。撒迦利亚临死的时候说：「愿耶和华鉴察伸冤！」
verses.textEnNiv: King Joash did not remember the kindness Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had shown him but killed his son, who said as he lay dying, "May the Lord see this and call you to account."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Joash the king did not remember the kindness that Jehoiada, Zechariah’s father, had shown him, but killed his son. And when he was dying, he said, "May the Lord see and avenge!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Joash the king did not remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son; and as he died, he said, "The Lord look on it, and repay!"
verses.textEnNlt: That was how King Joash repaid Jehoiada for his loyalty—by killing his son. Zechariah’s last words as he died were, "May the Lord see what they are doing and avenge my death!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Joash the king did not remember the kindness which Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had shown him, but he murdered his son. And as Zechariah died he said, "May the Lord see and avenge!"
verses.textEn: King Joash did not remember the kindness Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had shown him but killed his son, who said as he lay dying, "May the Lord see this and call you to account."

verses.textZh: 过了年，亚兰的军队上来攻打约阿施；他们侵入犹大和耶路撒冷，杀了民间的领袖，又把他们的一切战利品都送到大马士革王那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了年，亚兰的军队上来攻打约阿施；他们侵入犹大和耶路撒冷，杀了民间的领袖，又把他们的一切战利品都送到大马士革王那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 满了一年，亚兰的军兵上来攻击约阿施，来到犹大和耶路撒冷，杀了民中的众首领，将所掠的财货送到大马士革王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: At the turn of the year, the army of Aram marched against Joash; it invaded Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the people. They sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of the year the army of the Syrians came up against Joash. They came to Judah and Jerusalem and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people and sent all their spoil to the king of Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it happened in the spring of the year that the army of Syria came up against him; and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the leaders of the people from among the people, and sent all their spoil to the king of Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: In the spring of the year the Aramean army marched against Joash. They invaded Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the nation. Then they sent all the plunder back to their king in Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened at the turn of the year that the army of the Arameans came up against Joash; and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, destroyed all the officials of the people from among the people, and sent all their spoils to the king of Damascus.
verses.textEn: At the turn of the year, the army of Aram marched against Joash; it invaded Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the people. They sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.

verses.textZh: 亚兰的军队虽然只来了一小队人，耶和华却把一支庞大的军队交在他们手里；因为犹大人离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神，亚兰人向约阿施执行了惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰的军队虽然只来了一小队人，耶和华却把一支庞大的军队交在他们手里；因为犹大人离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神，亚兰人向约阿施执行了惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰的军兵虽来了一小队，耶和华却将大队的军兵交在他们手里，是因犹大人离弃耶和华－他们列祖的神，所以藉亚兰人惩罚约阿施。
verses.textEnNiv: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the Lord delivered into their hands a much larger army. Because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors, judgment was executed on Joash.
verses.textEnEsv: Though the army of the Syrians had come with few men, the Lord delivered into their hand a very great army, because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their fathers. Thus they executed judgment on Joash.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; but the Lord delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.textEnNlt: Although the Arameans attacked with only a small army, the Lord helped them conquer the much larger army of Judah. The people of Judah had abandoned the Lord , the God of their ancestors, so judgment was carried out against Joash.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the army of the Arameans came with a small number of men; yet the Lord handed a very great army over to them, because Judah and Joash had abandoned the Lord, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.
verses.textEn: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the Lord delivered into their hands a much larger army. Because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors, judgment was executed on Joash.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人离开约阿施的时候，他们丢下约阿施，因为他受了重伤，他的臣仆要杀害他，为了报复耶何耶大祭司的儿子流血的仇；他们在床上杀死他，他就死了；有人把他埋葬在大卫城里，只是没有埋葬在列王的陵墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人离开约阿施的时候，他们丢下约阿施，因为他受了重伤，他的臣仆要杀害他，为了报复耶何耶大祭司的儿子流血的仇；他们在床上杀死他，他就死了；有人把他埋葬在大卫城里，只是没有埋葬在列王的陵墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰人离开约阿施的时候，他患重病；臣仆背叛他，要报祭司耶何耶大儿子流血之仇，杀他在床上，葬他在大卫城，只是不葬在列王的坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Arameans withdrew, they left Joash severely wounded. His officials conspired against him for murdering the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him in his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had departed from him, leaving him severely wounded, his servants conspired against him because of the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed. So he died, and they buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had withdrawn from him (for they left him severely wounded), his own servants conspired against him because of the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed. So he died. And they buried him in the City of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEnNlt: The Arameans withdrew, leaving Joash severely wounded. But his own officials plotted to kill him for murdering the son of Jehoiada the priest. They assassinated him as he lay in bed. Then he was buried in the City of David, but not in the royal cemetery.
verses.textEnNasb: When they left him (for they left him very sick), his own servants conspired against him because of the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they murdered him on his bed. So he died, and they buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the tombs of the kings.
verses.textEn: When the Arameans withdrew, they left Joash severely wounded. His officials conspired against him for murdering the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him in his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

verses.textZh: 谋害他的是亚扪妇人示米押的儿子撒拔和摩押妇人示米利的儿子约萨拔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谋害他的是亚扪妇人示米押的儿子撒拔和摩押妇人示米利的儿子约萨拔。
verses.textZhCuv: 背叛他的是亚扪妇人示米押的儿子撒拔和摩押妇人示米利的儿子约萨拔。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who conspired against him were Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabite woman.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who conspired against him were Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonite, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabite.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the ones who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
verses.textEnNlt: The assassins were Jozacar, the son of an Ammonite woman named Shimeath, and Jehozabad, the son of a Moabite woman named Shomer.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the men who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
verses.textEn: Those who conspired against him were Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabite woman.

verses.textZh: 至于约阿施的众子，以及许多警戒他的话，还有他重建神的殿的事，都记在列王记的注释上。约阿施的儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于约阿施的众子，以及许多警戒他的话，还有他重建神的殿的事，都记在列王记的注释上。约阿施的儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于他的众子和他所受的警戒，并他重修神殿的事，都写在列王的传上。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: The account of his sons, the many prophecies about him, and the record of the restoration of the temple of God are written in the annotations on the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Accounts of his sons and of the many oracles against him and of the rebuilding of the house of God are written in the Story of the Book of the Kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning his sons, and the many oracles about him, and the repairing of the house of God, indeed they are written in the annals of the book of the kings. Then Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: The account of the sons of Joash, the prophecies about him, and the record of his restoration of the Temple of God are written in The Commentary on the Book of the Kings. His son Amaziah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: As to his sons and the many pronouncements against him and the rebuilding of the house of God, behold, they are written in the treatise of the Book of the Kings. Then his son Amaziah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: The account of his sons, the many prophecies about him, and the record of the restoration of the temple of God are written in the annotations on the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢登基的时候是二十五岁，他在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他的母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢登基的时候是二十五岁，他在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他的母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother was Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢行耶和华看为正的事，只是心不专一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢行耶和华看为正的事，只是心不专一。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，只是心不专诚。
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not wholeheartedly.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , yet not with a whole heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a loyal heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, but not wholeheartedly.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, only not wholeheartedly.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not wholeheartedly.

verses.textZh: 他巩固了王位以后，就把击杀他父王的臣仆杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他巩固了王位以后，就把击杀他父王的臣仆杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，
verses.textEnNiv: After the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as the royal power was firmly his, he killed his servants who had struck down the king his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as soon as the kingdom was established for him, that he executed his servants who had murdered his father the king.
verses.textEnNlt: When Amaziah was well established as king, he executed the officials who had assassinated his father.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, that he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.
verses.textEn: After the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.

verses.textZh: 他却没有处死他们的儿子，因为照着摩西律法书上所记，耶和华曾吩咐："不可因儿子的罪处死父亲，也不可因父亲的罪处死儿子；各人要因自己的罪被处死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却没有处死他们的儿子，因为照着摩西律法书上所记，耶和华曾吩咐："不可因儿子的罪处死父亲，也不可因父亲的罪处死儿子；各人要因自己的罪被处死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 却没有治死他们的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说：「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he did not put their children to death, but acted in accordance with what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded: "Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor children be put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin."
verses.textEnEsv: But he did not put their children to death, according to what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded, "Fathers shall not die because of their children, nor children die because of their fathers, but each one shall die for his own sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: However he did not execute their children, but did as itis written in the Law in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded, saying, "The fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall the children be put to death for their fathers; but a person shall die for his own sin."
verses.textEnNlt: However, he did not kill the children of the assassins, for he obeyed the command of the Lord as written by Moses in the Book of the Law: "Parents must not be put to death for the sins of their children, nor children for the sins of their parents. Those deserving to die must be put to death for their own crimes."
verses.textEnNasb: However, he did not put their children to death, but did as it is written in the Law in the Book of Moses, which the Lord commanded, saying, "Fathers shall not be put to death for sons, nor sons be put to death for fathers; but each shall be put to death for his own sin."
verses.textEn: Yet he did not put their children to death, but acted in accordance with what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded: "Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor children be put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin."

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢召集了犹大人，按着他们的家族为全犹大和便雅悯人，设立千夫长和百夫长，又数点他们的数目，从二十岁起，能出去打仗，能拿枪持盾的精兵，共有三十万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢召集了犹大人，按着他们的家族为全犹大和便雅悯人，设立千夫长和百夫长，又数点他们的数目，从二十岁起，能出去打仗，能拿枪持盾的精兵，共有三十万。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢招聚犹大人，按着犹大和便雅悯的宗族设立千夫长、百夫长，又数点人数，从二十岁以外，能拿枪拿盾牌出去打仗的精兵共有三十万；
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah called the people of Judah together and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He then mustered those twenty years old or more and found that there were three hundred thousand men fit for military service, able to handle the spear and shield.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amaziah assembled the men of Judah and set them by fathers’ houses under commanders of thousands and of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He mustered those twenty years old and upward, and found that they were 300,000 choice men, fit for war, able to handle spear and shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and set over them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, according to their fathers’ houses, throughout all Judah and Benjamin; and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them to be three hundred thousand choice men, able to go to war, who could handle spear and shield.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Amaziah organized the army, assigning generals and captains for all Judah and Benjamin. He took a census and found that he had an army of 300,000 select troops, twenty years old and older, all trained in the use of spear and shield.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Amaziah assembled Judah and appointed them according to their fathers’ households under commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds throughout Judah and Benjamin; and he took a census of those from twenty years old and upward and found them to be three hundred thousand choice men, able to go to war and handle spear and shield.
verses.textEn: Amaziah called the people of Judah together and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He then mustered those twenty years old or more and found that there were three hundred thousand men fit for military service, able to handle the spear and shield.

verses.textZh: 又用了三千四百公斤银子，从以色列中雇了十万英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用了三千四百公斤银子，从以色列中雇了十万英勇的战士。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用银子一百他连得，从以色列招募了十万大能的勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: He also hired a hundred thousand fighting men from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: He hired also 100,000 mighty men of valor from Israel for 100 talents of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor from Israel for one hundred talents of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: He also paid about 7,500 pounds of silver to hire 100,000 experienced fighting men from Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He also hired a hundred thousand valiant warriors from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
verses.textEn: He also hired a hundred thousand fighting men from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

verses.textZh: 有一位神人来见亚玛谢，说："王啊，请不要领以色列的军队和你同去，因为耶和华不和以色列人，不和任何以法莲的子孙同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位神人来见亚玛谢，说："王啊，请不要领以色列的军队和你同去，因为耶和华不和以色列人，不和任何以法莲的子孙同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个神人来见亚玛谢，对他说：「王啊，不要使以色列的军兵与你同去，因为耶和华不与以色列人以法莲的后裔同在。
verses.textEnNiv: But a man of God came to him and said, "Your Majesty, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the Lord is not with Israel—not with any of the people of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: But a man of God came to him and said, "O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the Lord is not with Israel, with all these Ephraimites.
verses.textEnNkjv: But a man of God came to him, saying, "O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the Lordis not with Israel—notwith any of the children of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: But a man of God came to him and said, "Your Majesty, do not hire troops from Israel, for the Lord is not with Israel. He will not help those people of Ephraim!
verses.textEnNasb: But a man of God came to him saying, "O king, do not let the army of Israel come with you, for the Lord is not with Israel nor with any of the sons of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: But a man of God came to him and said, "Your Majesty, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the Lord is not with Israel—not with any of the people of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 即使你一定要去，奋勇争战，神也会使你在敌人面前覆灭，因为神有能力帮助人，也有能力使人覆灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使你一定要去，奋勇争战，神也会使你在敌人面前覆灭，因为神有能力帮助人，也有能力使人覆灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若一定要去，就奋勇争战吧！但神必使你败在敌人面前；因为神能助人得胜，也能使人倾败。」
verses.textEnNiv: Even if you go and fight courageously in battle, God will overthrow you before the enemy, for God has the power to help or to overthrow."
verses.textEnEsv: But go, act, be strong for the battle. Why should you suppose that God will cast you down before the enemy? For God has power to help or to cast down."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you go, be gone! Be strong in battle! Evenso, God shall make you fall before the enemy; for God has power to help and to overthrow."
verses.textEnNlt: If you let them go with your troops into battle, you will be defeated by the enemy no matter how well you fight. God will overthrow you, for he has the power to help you or to trip you up."
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do go, do it, be strong for the battle; yet God will bring you down before the enemy, for God has the power to help and to bring down."
verses.textEn: Even if you go and fight courageously in battle, God will overthrow you before the enemy, for God has the power to help or to overthrow."

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢问神人："我给以色列雇佣兵的那三千四百公斤银子怎么办呢？"神人回答："耶和华能把比这更多赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢问神人："我给以色列雇佣兵的那三千四百公斤银子怎么办呢？"神人回答："耶和华能把比这更多赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢问神人说：「我给了以色列军的那一百他连得银子怎么样呢？」神人回答说：「耶和华能把更多的赐给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about the hundred talents I paid for these Israelite troops?" The man of God replied, "The Lord can give you much more than that."
verses.textEnEsv: And Amaziah said to the man of God, "But what shall we do about the hundred talents that I have given to the army of Israel?" The man of God answered, "The Lord is able to give you much more than this."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Amaziah said to the man of God, "But what shallwe do about the hundred talents which I have given to the troops of Israel?" And the man of God answered, "The Lord is able to give you much more than this."
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about all that silver I paid to hire the army of Israel?" The man of God replied, "The Lord is able to give you much more than this!"
verses.textEnNasb: Amaziah said to the man of God, "But what are we to do about the hundred talents which I have given to the troops of Israel?" And the man of God answered, "The Lord has much more to give you than this."
verses.textEn: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about the hundred talents I paid for these Israelite troops?" The man of God replied, "The Lord can give you much more than that."

verses.textZh: 于是亚玛谢把那从以法莲来的雇佣兵解散了，遣送他们回家；因此他们非常恼怒犹大人，就气冲冲地回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚玛谢把那从以法莲来的雇佣兵解散了，遣送他们回家；因此他们非常恼怒犹大人，就气冲冲地回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚玛谢将那从以法莲来的军兵分别出来，叫他们回家去。故此，他们甚恼怒犹大人，气忿忿地回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They were furious with Judah and left for home in a great rage.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amaziah discharged the army that had come to him from Ephraim to go home again. And they became very angry with Judah and returned home in fierce anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Amaziah discharged the troops that had come to him from Ephraim, to go back home. Therefore their anger was greatly aroused against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
verses.textEnNlt: So Amaziah discharged the hired troops and sent them back to Ephraim. This made them very angry with Judah, and they returned home in a great rage.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Amaziah dismissed the troops which came to him from Ephraim, to go home; so their anger burned against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.
verses.textEn: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They were furious with Judah and left for home in a great rage.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢鼓起勇气，率领他的人民到盐谷去，击杀了一万西珥人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢鼓起勇气，率领他的人民到盐谷去，击杀了一万西珥人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢壮起胆来，率领他的民到盐谷，杀了西珥人一万。
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah then marshaled his strength and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where he killed ten thousand men of Seir.
verses.textEnEsv: But Amaziah took courage and led out his people and went to the Valley of Salt and struck down 10,000 men of Seir.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Amaziah strengthened himself, and leading his people, he went to the Valley of Salt and killed ten thousand of the people of Seir.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Amaziah summoned his courage and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where they killed 10,000 Edomite troops from Seir.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Amaziah gathered his courage and led his people out, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck and killed ten thousand of the sons of Seir.
verses.textEn: Amaziah then marshaled his strength and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where he killed ten thousand men of Seir.

verses.textZh: 犹大人又生擒了一万人，带到一处崖顶，从崖顶把他们拋下去，使他们都摔得肢离破碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人又生擒了一万人，带到一处崖顶，从崖顶把他们拋下去，使他们都摔得肢离破碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人又生擒了一万带到山崖上，从那里把他们扔下去，以致他们都摔碎了。
verses.textEnNiv: The army of Judah also captured ten thousand men alive, took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Judah captured another 10,000 alive and took them to the top of a rock and threw them down from the top of the rock, and they were all dashed to pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the children of Judah took captive ten thousand alive, brought them to the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were dashed in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: They captured another 10,000 and took them to the top of a cliff and threw them off, dashing them to pieces on the rocks below.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Judah also captured ten thousand alive and brought them to the top of the cliff, and threw them down from the top of the cliff so that they were all dashed to pieces.
verses.textEn: The army of Judah also captured ten thousand men alive, took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.

verses.textZh: 但亚玛谢打发回去、不许和他一同作战的雇佣兵，竟侵入犹大各城，从撒玛利亚直到伯．和仑，击杀了三千人，又掠去了很多财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但亚玛谢打发回去、不许和他一同作战的雇佣兵，竟侵入犹大各城，从撒玛利亚直到伯．和仑，击杀了三千人，又掠去了很多财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 但亚玛谢所打发回去、不许一同出征的那些军兵攻打犹大各城，从撒马利亚直到伯‧和仑，杀了三千人，抢了许多财物。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had sent back and had not allowed to take part in the war raided towns belonging to Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon. They killed three thousand people and carried off great quantities of plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, not letting them go with him to battle, raided the cities of Judah, from Samaria to Beth-horon, and struck down 3,000 people in them and took much spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for the soldiers of the army which Amaziah had discharged, so that they would not go with him to battle, they raided the cities of Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon, killed three thousand in them, and took much spoil.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the hired troops that Amaziah had sent home raided several of the towns of Judah between Samaria and Beth-horon. They killed 3,000 people and carried off great quantities of plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: But the troops whom Amaziah sent back, those not going with him to battle, raided the cities of Judah from Samaria to Beth-horon, and struck and killed three thousand of them, and plundered a large amount of spoils.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had sent back and had not allowed to take part in the war raided towns belonging to Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon. They killed three thousand people and carried off great quantities of plunder.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢击败了以东人回来的时候，把西珥人的神像也带回来，立为自己的神，在它们面前叩拜，又向它们烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢击败了以东人回来的时候，把西珥人的神像也带回来，立为自己的神，在它们面前叩拜，又向它们烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢杀了以东人回来，就把西珥的神像带回，立为自己的神，在它面前叩拜烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.
verses.textEnEsv: After Amaziah came from striking down the Edomites, he brought the gods of the men of Seir and set them up as his gods and worshiped them, making offerings to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was so, after Amaziah came from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the people of Seir, set them up tobe his gods, and bowed down before them and burned incense to them.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought with him idols taken from the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down in front of them, and offered sacrifices to them!
verses.textEnNasb: Now after Amaziah came from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought the gods of the sons of Seir and set them up as his gods. Then he bowed down before them and burned incense to them.
verses.textEn: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华向亚玛谢发怒，于是差派一位先知去见他，对他说："这民族的神不能拯救自己的人民脱离你的手，你为甚么还寻求它们呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华向亚玛谢发怒，于是差派一位先知去见他，对他说："这民族的神不能拯救自己的人民脱离你的手，你为甚么还寻求它们呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，耶和华的怒气向亚玛谢发作，就差一个先知去见他，说：「这些神不能救它的民脱离你的手，你为何寻求它呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The anger of the Lord burned against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him, who said, "Why do you consult this people’s gods, which could not save their own people from your hand?"
