verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord was angry with Amaziah and sent to him a prophet, who said to him, "Why have you sought the gods of a people who did not deliver their own people from your hand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was aroused against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet who said to him, "Why have you sought the gods of the people, which could not rescue their own people from your hand?"
verses.textEnNlt: This made the Lord very angry, and he sent a prophet to ask, "Why do you turn to gods who could not even save their own people from you?"
verses.textEnNasb: So the anger of the Lord burned against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet who said to him, "Why have you sought the gods of the people who have not saved their own people from your hand?"
verses.textEn: The anger of the Lord burned against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him, who said, "Why do you consult this people’s gods, which could not save their own people from your hand?"

verses.textZh: 先知向王讲话的时候，王对他说："我们立了你作王的谋士吗？住口吧！你要挨打吗？"先知就住口，可是又说："我知道神已定意消灭你，因为你作了这事，又不听从我的劝戒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知向王讲话的时候，王对他说："我们立了你作王的谋士吗？住口吧！你要挨打吗？"先知就住口，可是又说："我知道神已定意消灭你，因为你作了这事，又不听从我的劝戒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先知与王说话的时候，王对他说：「谁立你作王的谋士呢？你住口吧！为何找打呢？」先知就止住了，又说：「你行这事，不听从我的劝戒，我知道神定意要灭你。」
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking, the king said to him, "Have we appointed you an adviser to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?" So the prophet stopped but said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel."
verses.textEnEsv: But as he was speaking, the king said to him, "Have we made you a royal counselor? Stop! Why should you be struck down?" So the prophet stopped, but said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as he talked with him, that theking said to him, "Have we made you the king’s counselor? Cease! Why should you be killed?" Then the prophet ceased, and said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not heeded my advice."
verses.textEnNlt: But the king interrupted him and said, "Since when have I made you the king’s counselor? Be quiet now before I have you killed!" So the prophet stopped with this warning: "I know that God has determined to destroy you because you have done this and have refused to accept my counsel."
verses.textEnNasb: As he was talking with him, the king said to him, "Have we appointed you to be a royal counselor? Stop! Why should you be put to death?" Then the prophet stopped and said, "I know that God has planned to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel."
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking, the king said to him, "Have we appointed you an adviser to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?" So the prophet stopped but said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel."

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚玛谢和群臣商议以后，就派人去见耶户的孙子、约哈斯的儿子、以色列王约阿施，说："来吧，我们在战场上相见吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚玛谢和群臣商议以后，就派人去见耶户的孙子、约哈斯的儿子、以色列王约阿施，说："来吧，我们在战场上相见吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚玛谢与群臣商议，就差遣使者去见耶户的孙子、约哈斯的儿子、以色列王约阿施，说：「你来，我们二人相见于战场。」
verses.textEnNiv: After Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, he sent this challenge to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel: "Come, let us face each other in battle."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent to Joash the son of Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us look one another in the face."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Amaziah king of Judah asked advice and sent to Joash the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us face one another inbattle."
verses.textEnNlt: After consulting with his advisers, King Amaziah of Judah sent this challenge to Israel’s king Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz and grandson of Jehu: "Come and meet me in battle!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent word to Joash the son of Jehoahaz the son of Jehu, the king of Israel, saying, "Come, let’s face each other."
verses.textEn: After Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, he sent this challenge to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel: "Come, let us face each other in battle."

verses.textZh: 以色列王约阿施派人去见犹大王亚玛谢，说："黎巴嫩的蒺藜派人去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：‘把你的女儿给我的儿子作妻子吧！’后来有一只黎巴嫩的野兽从那里经过，把蒺藜践踏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约阿施派人去见犹大王亚玛谢，说："黎巴嫩的蒺藜派人去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：‘把你的女儿给我的儿子作妻子吧！’后来有一只黎巴嫩的野兽从那里经过，把蒺藜践踏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说：「黎巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：『将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。』后来黎巴嫩有一个野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joash the king of Israel sent word to Amaziah king of Judah, "A thistle on Lebanon sent to a cedar on Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son for a wife,’ and a wild beast of Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife’; and a wild beast that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle.
verses.textEnNlt: But King Jehoash of Israel replied to King Amaziah of Judah with this story: "Out in the Lebanon mountains, a thistle sent a message to a mighty cedar tree: ‘Give your daughter in marriage to my son.’ But just then a wild animal of Lebanon came by and stepped on the thistle, crushing it!
verses.textEnNasb: But Joash the king of Israel sent a reply to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thorn bush that was in Lebanon sent word to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ But a wild beast that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thorn bush.
verses.textEn: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

verses.textZh: 你心里说你击败了以东人，你就心里骄傲，以这事夸口。现在你留在家里吧，为甚么要惹祸，使犹大和你一同覆亡呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你心里说你击败了以东人，你就心里骄傲，以这事夸口。现在你留在家里吧，为甚么要惹祸，使犹大和你一同覆亡呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你说：『看哪，我打败了以东人』，你就心高气傲，以致矜夸。你在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: You say to yourself that you have defeated Edom, and now you are arrogant and proud. But stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"
verses.textEnEsv: You say, ‘See, I have struck down Edom,’ and your heart has lifted you up in boastfulness. But now stay at home. Why should you provoke trouble so that you fall, you and Judah with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed you say that you have defeated the Edomites, and your heart is lifted up to boast. Stay at home now; why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall—you and Judah with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "You are saying, ‘I have defeated Edom,’ and you are very proud of it. But my advice is to stay at home. Why stir up trouble that will only bring disaster on you and the people of Judah?"
verses.textEnNasb: You said, ‘Behold, you have defeated Edom.’ And your heart has lifted you up in boasting. Now stay home; why should you provoke trouble so that you, would fall, you and Judah with you?"
verses.textEn: You say to yourself that you have defeated Edom, and now you are arrogant and proud. But stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢却不听从；这原是出于神，好把他们交在约阿施手里，因为他们寻求以东的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢却不听从；这原是出于神，好把他们交在约阿施手里，因为他们寻求以东的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢却不肯听从。这是出乎神，好将他们交在敌人手里，因为他们寻求以东的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might deliver them into the hands of Jehoash, because they sought the gods of Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: But Amaziah would not listen, for it was of God, in order that he might give them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought the gods of Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Amaziah would not heed, for it came from God, that He might give them into the hand oftheirenemies, because they sought the gods of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: But Amaziah refused to listen, for God was determined to destroy him for turning to the gods of Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: But Amaziah would not listen, for it was from God, so that He might hand them over to Joash, because they had sought the gods of Edom.
verses.textEn: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might deliver them into the hands of Jehoash, because they sought the gods of Edom.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯．示麦，和犹大王亚玛谢相会于战场上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯．示麦，和犹大王亚玛谢相会于战场上。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯‧示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见于战场。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another in battle at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joash king of Israel went out; and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Jehoash of Israel mobilized his army against King Amaziah of Judah. The two armies drew up their battle lines at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh, which belonged to Judah.
verses.textEn: So Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

verses.textZh: 犹大人在以色列人面前被击败，各自逃回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人在以色列人面前被击败，各自逃回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah was routed by the army of Israel, and its army scattered and fled for home.
verses.textEnNasb: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and they fled, every man to his tent.
verses.textEn: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.

verses.textZh: 以色列王约阿施在伯．示麦捉住了约哈斯的孙子、约阿施的儿子、犹大王亚玛谢，把他带到耶路撒冷，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共两百公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约阿施在伯．示麦捉住了约哈斯的孙子、约阿施的儿子、犹大王亚玛谢，把他带到耶路撒冷，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共两百公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约阿施在伯‧示麦擒住约哈斯 的孙子、约阿施的儿子、犹大王亚玛谢，将他带到耶路撒冷，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共四百肘；
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem for 400 cubits, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joash the king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh; and he brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate—four hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: King Jehoash of Israel captured Judah’s king, Amaziah son of Joash and grandson of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh. Then he brought him to Jerusalem, where he demolished 600 feet of Jerusalem’s wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem and tore down the wall of Jerusalem from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.textEn: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.

verses.textZh: 又把俄别．以东负责看守神殿里的一切金银和一切器皿，以及王宫里的宝物都掠去，又掳走人质，然后回撒玛利亚去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把俄别．以东负责看守神殿里的一切金银和一切器皿，以及王宫里的宝物都掠去，又掳走人质，然后回撒玛利亚去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将俄别‧以东所看守神殿里的一切金银和器皿，与王宫里的财宝都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒马利亚去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-Edom, together with the palace treasures and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And he seized all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God, in the care of Obed-edom. He seized also the treasuries of the king’s house, also hostages, and he returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And hetook all the gold and silver, all the articles that were found in the house of God with Obed-Edom, the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: He carried off all the gold and silver and all the articles from the Temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-edom. He also seized the treasures of the royal palace, along with hostages, and then returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: He took all the gold and silver and all the utensils which were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages too, and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEn: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-Edom, together with the palace treasures and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢还活了十五年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢还活了十五年。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: King Amaziah of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of King Jehoash of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And Amaziah, the son of Joash king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
verses.textEn: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢其余的事迹，一生的始末，不是都记在犹大和以色列诸王记上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢其余的事迹，一生的始末，不是都记在犹大和以色列诸王记上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢其余的事，自始至终不都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上吗？
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Amaziah, from first to last, are they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, from first to last, indeed are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Amaziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, from the first to the last, behold, are they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

verses.textZh: 自从亚玛谢离弃耶和华以后，在耶路撒冷有人要谋害他；他就逃到拉吉去。谋害他的人派人追到拉吉，在那里把他杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从亚玛谢离弃耶和华以后，在耶路撒冷有人要谋害他；他就逃到拉吉去。谋害他的人派人追到拉吉，在那里把他杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从亚玛谢离弃耶和华之后，在耶路撒冷有人背叛他，他就逃到拉吉；叛党却打发人到拉吉，将他杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord , they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.
verses.textEnEsv: From the time when he turned away from the Lord they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.
verses.textEnNkjv: After the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
verses.textEnNlt: After Amaziah turned away from the Lord , there was a conspiracy against his life in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But his enemies sent assassins after him, and they killed him there.
verses.textEnNasb: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord they conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent men after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
verses.textEn: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord , they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.

verses.textZh: 然后用马把他的尸体运回来，埋葬在大卫城 里，和他的列祖一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后用马把他的尸体运回来，埋葬在大卫城 里，和他的列祖一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 人就用马将他的尸首驮回，葬在犹大京城他列祖的坟地里。
verses.textEnNiv: He was brought back by horse and was buried with his ancestors in the City of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought him upon horses, and he was buried with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought his body back on a horse, and he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
verses.textEn: He was brought back by horse and was buried with his ancestors in the City of Judah.

verses.textZh: 全犹大的人民立乌西雅 接续他的父亲亚玛谢作王，那时他才十六岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全犹大的人民立乌西雅 接续他的父亲亚玛谢作王，那时他才十六岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子乌西雅 接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。（
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people of Judah had crowned Amaziah’s sixteen-year-old son, Uzziah, as king in place of his father.
verses.textEnNasb: Now all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEn: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢王和列祖同睡以后，乌西雅重建以禄，并且收归犹大所有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢王和列祖同睡以后，乌西雅重建以禄，并且收归犹大所有。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，乌西雅收回以禄仍归犹大，又重新修理。）
verses.textEnNiv: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah, after the king slept with his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after the king rested with his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: After his father’s death, Uzziah rebuilt the town of Elath and restored it to Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah after the king lay down with his fathers.
verses.textEn: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅登基的时候，是十六岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共五十二年。他的母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅登基的时候，是十六岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共五十二年。他的母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned for fifty-two years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Jechiliah of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅行耶和华看为正的事，像他的父亲亚玛谢一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅行耶和华看为正的事，像他的父亲亚玛谢一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亚玛谢一切所行的；
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, just as his father, Amaziah, had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with everything that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.

verses.textZh: 撒迦利亚在世的日子，教导乌西雅敬畏神，所以乌西雅常常寻求神；乌西雅寻求神的时候，神就使他亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒迦利亚在世的日子，教导乌西雅敬畏神，所以乌西雅常常寻求神；乌西雅寻求神的时候，神就使他亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 通晓神默示，撒迦利亚在世的时候，乌西雅定意寻求神；他寻求耶和华，神就使他亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the Lord , God gave him success.
verses.textEnEsv: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God, and as long as he sought the Lord , God made him prosper.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God; and as long as he sought the Lord, God made him prosper.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah sought God during the days of Zechariah, who taught him to fear God. And as long as the king sought guidance from the Lord , God gave him success.
verses.textEnNasb: He continued to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding through the vision of God; and as long as he sought the Lord, God made him successful.
verses.textEn: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the Lord , God gave him success.

verses.textZh: 他出去攻打非利士人，拆毁了迦特的城墙、雅比尼的城墙和亚实突的城墙；又在亚实突境内非利士人中，建造了几座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他出去攻打非利士人，拆毁了迦特的城墙、雅比尼的城墙和亚实突的城墙；又在亚实突境内非利士人中，建造了几座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 他出去攻击非利士人，拆毁了迦特城、雅比尼城，和亚实突城；在非利士人中，在亚实突境内，又建筑了些城。
verses.textEnNiv: He went to war against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: He went out and made war against the Philistines and broke through the wall of Gath and the wall of Jabneh and the wall of Ashdod, and he built cities in the territory of Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he went out and made war against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities around Ashdod and among the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah declared war on the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Then he built new towns in the Ashdod area and in other parts of Philistia.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the area of Ashdod and among the Philistines.
verses.textEn: He went to war against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 神帮助他攻打非利士人和住在姑珥．巴力的阿拉伯人，以及米乌尼人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神帮助他攻打非利士人和住在姑珥．巴力的阿拉伯人，以及米乌尼人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神帮助他攻击非利士人和住在姑珥‧巴力的阿拉伯人，并米乌尼人。
verses.textEnNiv: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur Baal and against the Meunites.
verses.textEnEsv: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabians who lived in Gurbaal and against the Meunites.
verses.textEnNkjv: God helped him against the Philistines, against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and against the Meunites.
verses.textEnNlt: God helped him in his wars against the Philistines, his battles with the Arabs of Gur, and his wars with the Meunites.
verses.textEnNasb: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur-baal, and the Meunites.
verses.textEn: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur Baal and against the Meunites.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人给乌西雅进贡，他的名声传到埃及的边境，因为他极其强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人给乌西雅进贡，他的名声传到埃及的边境，因为他极其强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人给乌西雅进贡。他的名声传到埃及，因他甚是强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, because he had become very powerful.
verses.textEnEsv: The Ammonites paid tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread even to the border of Egypt, for he became very strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah. His fame spread as far as the entrance of Egypt, for he became exceedingly strong.
verses.textEnNlt: The Meunites paid annual tribute to him, and his fame spread even to Egypt, for he had become very powerful.
verses.textEnNasb: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah, and his fame extended to the border of Egypt, for he became very strong.
verses.textEn: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, because he had become very powerful.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门、谷门和城墙转角的地方，建筑了城楼，这些城楼非常坚固。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门、谷门和城墙转角的地方，建筑了城楼，这些城楼非常坚固。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门和谷门，并城墙转弯之处，建筑城楼，且甚坚固；
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate and at the Valley Gate and at the Angle, and fortified them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate, and at the corner buttress of the wall; then he fortified them.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah built fortified towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate, and at the angle in the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and at the corner buttress, and he fortified them.
verses.textEn: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.

verses.textZh: 他又在旷野建造了一些瞭望楼，挖了许多贮水池，因为他在高原和平原上有很多牲畜；又因为他喜爱种植，所以在山地上和果园里，雇有农夫和修剪葡萄树的工人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在旷野建造了一些瞭望楼，挖了许多贮水池，因为他在高原和平原上有很多牲畜；又因为他喜爱种植，所以在山地上和果园里，雇有农夫和修剪葡萄树的工人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在旷野与高原和平原，建筑望楼，挖了许多井，因他的牲畜甚多；又在山地和佳美之地，有农夫和修理葡萄园的人，因为他喜悦农事。
verses.textEnNiv: He also built towers in the wilderness and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.
verses.textEnEsv: And he built towers in the wilderness and cut out many cisterns, for he had large herds, both in the Shephelah and in the plain, and he had farmers and vinedressers in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he built towers in the desert. He dug many wells, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains; healsohad farmers and vinedressers in the mountains and in Carmel, for he loved the soil.
verses.textEnNlt: He also constructed forts in the wilderness and dug many water cisterns, because he kept great herds of livestock in the foothills of Judah and on the plains. He was also a man who loved the soil. He had many workers who cared for his farms and vineyards, both on the hillsides and in the fertile valleys.
verses.textEnNasb: He also built towers in the wilderness and carved out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowland and in the plain. He also had plowmen and vinedressers in the hill country and the fertile fields, for he loved the soil.
verses.textEn: He also built towers in the wilderness and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅又有善于作战的军队，照著书记耶利和官长玛西雅数点的数目，由王的一个将军哈拿尼雅指挥，编队上阵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅又有善于作战的军队，照著书记耶利和官长玛西雅数点的数目，由王的一个将军哈拿尼雅指挥，编队上阵。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅又有军兵，照书记耶利和官长玛西雅所数点的，在王的一个将军哈拿尼雅手下，分队出战。
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah had a well-trained army, ready to go out by divisions according to their numbers as mustered by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officials.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, Uzziah had an army of soldiers, fit for war, in divisions according to the numbers in the muster made by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer, under the direction of Hananiah, one of the king’s commanders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by companies, according to the number on their roll as prepared by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah had an army of well-trained warriors, ready to march into battle, unit by unit. This army had been mustered and organized by Jeiel, the secretary of the army, and his assistant, Maaseiah. They were under the direction of Hananiah, one of the king’s officials.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Uzziah had an army ready for battle, which entered combat by divisions according to the number of their muster, recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the official, under the direction of Hananiah, one of the king’s officers.
verses.textEn: Uzziah had a well-trained army, ready to go out by divisions according to their numbers as mustered by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officials.

verses.textZh: 这些英勇战士中的各家族首领，总数共二千六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些英勇战士中的各家族首领，总数共二千六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 族长、大能勇士的总数共有二千六百人，
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.
verses.textEnEsv: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ houses of mighty men of valor was 2,600.
verses.textEnNkjv: The total number of chief officers of the mighty men of valor was two thousand six hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These regiments of mighty warriors were commanded by 2,600 clan leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: The total number of the heads of the households, of valiant warriors, was 2,600.
verses.textEn: The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.

verses.textZh: 在他们指挥下的军队，共有三十万七千五百人，都是大有能力，善于作战的，能帮助王攻打仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们指挥下的军队，共有三十万七千五百人，都是大有能力，善于作战的，能帮助王攻打仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们手下的军兵共有三十万七千五百人，都有大能，善于争战，帮助王攻击仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Under their command was an army of 307,500, who could make war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And under their authority was an army of three hundred and seven thousand five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: The army consisted of 307,500 men, all elite troops. They were prepared to assist the king against any enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: Under their direction was an army of 307,500, who could wage war with great power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.textEn: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅给全队军兵配备了盾牌、矛枪、头盔、铠甲、弓箭和用机弦甩的石头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅给全队军兵配备了盾牌、矛枪、头盔、铠甲、弓箭和用机弦甩的石头。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅为全军预备盾牌、枪、盔、甲、弓，和甩石的机弦，
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah provided shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and slingstones for the entire army.
verses.textEnEsv: And Uzziah prepared for all the army shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Uzziah prepared for them, for the entire army, shields, spears, helmets, body armor, bows, and slings tocast stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah provided the entire army with shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and sling stones.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Uzziah prepared for all the army shields, spears, helmets, body armor, bows, and slingstones.
verses.textEn: Uzziah provided shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and slingstones for the entire army.

verses.textZh: 他又在耶路撒冷制造巧匠发明的器械，安放在城楼和城角上，用来发射利箭和大石。乌西雅的名声传到远方，因为他得了非常的帮助，使他十分强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在耶路撒冷制造巧匠发明的器械，安放在城楼和城角上，用来发射利箭和大石。乌西雅的名声传到远方，因为他得了非常的帮助，使他十分强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在耶路撒冷使巧匠做机器，安在城楼和角楼上，用以射箭发石。乌西雅的名声传到远方；因为他得了非常的帮助，甚是强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: In Jerusalem he made devices invented for use on the towers and on the corner defenses so that soldiers could shoot arrows and hurl large stones from the walls. His fame spread far and wide, for he was greatly helped until he became powerful.
verses.textEnEsv: In Jerusalem he made machines, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and the corners, to shoot arrows and great stones. And his fame spread far, for he was marvelously helped, till he was strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made devices in Jerusalem, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and the corners, to shoot arrows and large stones. So his fame spread far and wide, for he was marvelously helped till he became strong.
verses.textEnNlt: And he built structures on the walls of Jerusalem, designed by experts to protect those who shot arrows and hurled large stones from the towers and the corners of the wall. His fame spread far and wide, for the Lord gave him marvelous help, and he became very powerful.
verses.textEnNasb: In Jerusalem he made machines of war invented by skillful workmen to be on the towers and the corners, for the purpose of shooting arrows and great stones. So his fame spread far, for he was marvelously helped until he was strong.
verses.textEn: In Jerusalem he made devices invented for use on the towers and on the corner defenses so that soldiers could shoot arrows and hurl large stones from the walls. His fame spread far and wide, for he was greatly helped until he became powerful.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅强盛起来，就心高气傲，以致自寻毁灭，竟冒犯耶和华他的神；他进了耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅强盛起来，就心高气傲，以致自寻毁灭，竟冒犯耶和华他的神；他进了耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既强盛，就心高气傲，以致行事邪僻，干犯耶和华－他的神，进耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: But after Uzziah became powerful, his pride led to his downfall. He was unfaithful to the Lord his God, and entered the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
verses.textEnEsv: But when he was strong, he grew proud, to his destruction. For he was unfaithful to the Lord his God and entered the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he was strong his heart was lifted up, to his destruction, for he transgressed against the Lord his God by entering the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
verses.textEnNlt: But when he had become powerful, he also became proud, which led to his downfall. He sinned against the Lord his God by entering the sanctuary of the Lord ’s Temple and personally burning incense on the incense altar.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he became strong, his heart was so proud that he acted corruptly, and he was untrue to the Lord his God, for he entered the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
verses.textEn: But after Uzziah became powerful, his pride led to his downfall. He was unfaithful to the Lord his God, and entered the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.

verses.textZh: 跟随乌西雅进去的，有亚撒利雅祭司，还有耶和华的祭司八十个，都是英勇的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟随乌西雅进去的，有亚撒利雅祭司，还有耶和华的祭司八十个，都是英勇的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司亚撒利雅率领耶和华勇敢的祭司八十人，跟随他进去。
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah the priest with eighty other courageous priests of the Lord followed him in.
verses.textEnEsv: But Azariah the priest went in after him, with eighty priests of the Lord who were men of valor,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him were eighty priests of the Lord—valiant men.
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah the high priest went in after him with eighty other priests of the Lord , all brave men.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Azariah the priest entered after him, and with him eighty priests of the Lord, valiant men.
verses.textEn: Azariah the priest with eighty other courageous priests of the Lord followed him in.

verses.textZh: 他们阻止乌西雅王，对他说："乌西雅啊，给耶和华烧香不是你应作的事，而是亚伦的子孙作祭司的事，他们是分别为圣作烧香的事；请离开圣所吧，因为你作了不应该作的事了，你必不能从耶和华神那里得着尊荣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们阻止乌西雅王，对他说："乌西雅啊，给耶和华烧香不是你应作的事，而是亚伦的子孙作祭司的事，他们是分别为圣作烧香的事；请离开圣所吧，因为你作了不应该作的事了，你必不能从耶和华神那里得着尊荣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就阻挡乌西雅王，对他说：「乌西雅啊，给耶和华烧香不是你的事，乃是亚伦子孙承接圣职祭司的事。你出圣殿吧！因为你犯了罪。你行这事，耶和华神必不使你得荣耀。」
verses.textEnNiv: They confronted King Uzziah and said, "It is not right for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord . That is for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who have been consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been unfaithful; and you will not be honored by the Lord God."
verses.textEnEsv: and they withstood King Uzziah and said to him, "It is not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord , but for the priests, the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have done wrong, and it will bring you no honor from the Lord God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they withstood King Uzziah, and said to him, "It is not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but for the priests, the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Get out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed! You shallhave no honor from the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: They confronted King Uzziah and said, "It is not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord . That is the work of the priests alone, the descendants of Aaron who are set apart for this work. Get out of the sanctuary, for you have sinned. The Lord God will not honor you for this!"
verses.textEnNasb: They opposed Uzziah the king and said to him, "It is not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but for the priests, the sons of Aaron who have been consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been untrue and will have no honor from the Lord God."
verses.textEn: They confronted King Uzziah and said, "It is not right for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord . That is for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who have been consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been unfaithful; and you will not be honored by the Lord God."

verses.textZh: 于是乌西雅十分忿怒，手里拿着香炉正要烧香，他向众祭司发怒的时候，就在耶和华的殿里香坛旁边众祭司的面前，他的额上忽然长出了大痲风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是乌西雅十分忿怒，手里拿着香炉正要烧香，他向众祭司发怒的时候，就在耶和华的殿里香坛旁边众祭司的面前，他的额上忽然长出了大痲风。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅就发怒，手拿香炉要烧香。他向祭司发怒的时候，在耶和华殿中香坛旁众祭司面前，额上忽然发出大麻风。
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah, who had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, became angry. While he was raging at the priests in their presence before the incense altar in the Lord ’s temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Uzziah was angry. Now he had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and when he became angry with the priests, leprosy broke out on his forehead in the presence of the priests in the house of the Lord , by the altar of incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Uzziah became furious; and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense. And while he was angry with the priests, leprosy broke out on his forehead, before the priests in the house of the Lord, beside the incense altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah, who was holding an incense burner, became furious. But as he was standing there raging at the priests before the incense altar in the Lord ’s Temple, leprosy suddenly broke out on his forehead.
verses.textEnNasb: But Uzziah, with a censer in his hand for burning incense, was enraged; and while he was enraged with the priests, leprosy broke out on his forehead in the presence of the priests in the house of the Lord, beside the altar of incense.
verses.textEn: Uzziah, who had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, became angry. While he was raging at the priests in their presence before the incense altar in the Lord ’s temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead.

verses.textZh: 大祭司亚撒利雅和众祭司看着他，忽然见他的额上长了大痲风，就急忙催他出殿；他自己也急忙出去，因为耶和华击打了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司亚撒利雅和众祭司看着他，忽然见他的额上长了大痲风，就急忙催他出殿；他自己也急忙出去，因为耶和华击打了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司亚撒利雅和众祭司观看，见他额上发出大麻风，就催他出殿；他自己也急速出去，因为耶和华降灾与他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him, they saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they hurried him out. Indeed, he himself was eager to leave, because the Lord had afflicted him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead! And they rushed him out quickly, and he himself hurried to go out, because the Lord had struck him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and there, on his forehead, he was leprous; so they thrust him out of that place. Indeed he also hurried to get out, because the Lord had struck him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Azariah the high priest and all the other priests saw the leprosy, they rushed him out. And the king himself was eager to get out because the Lord had struck him.
verses.textEnNasb: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous on his forehead; and they quickly removed him from there, and he himself also hurried to get out because the Lord had stricken him.
verses.textEn: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him, they saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they hurried him out. Indeed, he himself was eager to leave, because the Lord had afflicted him.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅王长大痲风直到死的时候；他既然长了大痲风，就住在一间隔离的房子里，不能进耶和华的殿。他的儿子约坦执掌朝政，治理国民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅王长大痲风直到死的时候；他既然长了大痲风，就住在一间隔离的房子里，不能进耶和华的殿。他的儿子约坦执掌朝政，治理国民。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅王长大麻风直到死日，因此住在别的宫里，与耶和华的殿隔绝。他儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。
verses.textEnNiv: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in a separate house —leprous, and banned from the temple of the Lord . Jotham his son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And King Uzziah was a leper to the day of his death, and being a leper lived in a separate house, for he was excluded from the house of the Lord . And Jotham his son was over the king’s household, governing the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death. He dwelt in an isolated house, because he was a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the Lord. Then Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in isolation in a separate house, for he was excluded from the Temple of the Lord . His son Jotham was put in charge of the royal palace, and he governed the people of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: King Uzziah had leprosy to the day of his death; and he lived in a separate house, afflicted as he was with leprosy, for he was cut off from the house of the Lord. And his son Jotham was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
verses.textEn: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in a separate house —leprous, and banned from the temple of the Lord . Jotham his son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅其余的事迹，一生的始末，亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知都记下来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅其余的事迹，一生的始末，亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知都记下来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅其余的事，自始至终都是亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚所记的。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Uzziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, from first to last, Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz wrote.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, from first to last, the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz wrote.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Uzziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, the first to the last, the prophet Isaiah, the son of Amoz, has written.
verses.textEn: The other events of Uzziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅和他的列祖同睡；由于有人说："他是个长大痲风的人"，所以把他埋葬在王陵的田间，和他的列祖一起。他的儿子约坦接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅和他的列祖同睡；由于有人说："他是个长大痲风的人"，所以把他埋葬在王陵的田间，和他的列祖一起。他的儿子约坦接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅与他列祖同睡，葬在王陵的田间他列祖的坟地里；因为人说，他是长大麻风的。他儿子约坦接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in a cemetery that belonged to the kings, for people said, "He had leprosy." And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the burial field that belonged to the kings, for they said, "He is a leper." And Jotham his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Uzziah rested with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, "He is a leper." Then Jotham his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Uzziah died, he was buried with his ancestors; his grave was in a nearby burial field belonging to the kings, for the people said, "He had leprosy." And his son Jotham became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Uzziah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the grave which belonged to the kings, for they said, "He had leprosy." And his son Jotham became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Uzziah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in a cemetery that belonged to the kings, for people said, "He had leprosy." And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约坦登基的时候，是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十六年；他的母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦登基的时候，是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十六年；他的母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年，他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnEsv: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnNasb: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEn: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

verses.textZh: 约坦行耶和华看为正的事，像他父亲乌西雅一切所行的，只是没有进入耶和华的殿；但人民还是行败坏的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦行耶和华看为正的事，像他父亲乌西雅一切所行的，只是没有进入耶和华的殿；但人民还是行败坏的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父乌西雅一切所行的，只是不入耶和华的殿。百姓还行邪僻的事。
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done, but unlike him he did not enter the temple of the Lord . The people, however, continued their corrupt practices.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord according to all that his father Uzziah had done, except he did not enter the temple of the Lord . But the people still followed corrupt practices.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Uzziah had done (although he did not enter the temple of the Lord). But still the people acted corruptly.
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight. He did everything his father, Uzziah, had done, except that Jotham did not sin by entering the Temple of the Lord . But the people continued in their corrupt ways.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Uzziah had done; however he did not enter the temple of the Lord. But the people continued acting corruptly.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done, but unlike him he did not enter the temple of the Lord . The people, however, continued their corrupt practices.

verses.textZh: 约坦建造了耶和华殿的上门；在俄斐勒的城墙上，他也有很多建设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦建造了耶和华殿的上门；在俄斐勒的城墙上，他也有很多建设。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦建立耶和华殿的上门，在俄斐勒城上多有建造，
verses.textEnNiv: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
verses.textEnEsv: He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord and did much building on the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEnNkjv: He built the Upper Gate of the house of the Lord, and he built extensively on the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham rebuilt the upper gate of the Temple of the Lord . He also did extensive rebuilding on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
verses.textEnNasb: He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord, and he built the wall of Ophel extensively.
verses.textEn: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel.

verses.textZh: 他在犹大山地建造城市，又在树林中建造一些营寨和瞭望楼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在犹大山地建造城市，又在树林中建造一些营寨和瞭望楼。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在犹大山地建造城邑，在树林中建筑营寨和高楼。
verses.textEnNiv: He built towns in the hill country of Judah and forts and towers in the wooded areas.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and forts and towers on the wooded hills.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.
verses.textEnNlt: He built towns in the hill country of Judah and constructed fortresses and towers in the wooded areas.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and he built fortresses and towers on the wooded hills.
verses.textEn: He built towns in the hill country of Judah and forts and towers in the wooded areas.

verses.textZh: 约坦和亚扪人的王交战，战胜了他们；那一年，亚扪人就献给他三千四百公斤银子，一千公吨小麦，一千公吨大麦；第二年和第三年，亚扪人也献给他这个数目。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦和亚扪人的王交战，战胜了他们；那一年，亚扪人就献给他三千四百公斤银子，一千公吨小麦，一千公吨大麦；第二年和第三年，亚扪人也献给他这个数目。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦与亚扪人的王打仗胜了他们，当年他们进贡银一百他连得，小麦一万歌珥，大麦一万歌珥；第二年、第三年也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and conquered them. That year the Ammonites paid him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. The Ammonites brought him the same amount also in the second and third years.
verses.textEnEsv: He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed against them. And the Ammonites gave him that year 100 talents of silver, and 10,000 cors of wheat and 10,000 of barley. The Ammonites paid him the same amount in the second and the third years.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also fought with the king of the Ammonites and defeated them. And the people of Ammon gave him in that year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. The people of Ammon paid this to him in the second and third years also.
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham went to war against the Ammonites and conquered them. Over the next three years he received from them an annual tribute of 7,500 pounds of silver, 50,000 bushels of wheat, and 50,000 bushels of barley.
verses.textEnNasb: He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed over them so that during that year the Ammonites gave him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. The Ammonites also paid him this amount in the second year and in the third.
verses.textEn: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and conquered them. That year the Ammonites paid him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. The Ammonites brought him the same amount also in the second and third years.

verses.textZh: 约坦在耶和华他的神面前坚守正道，所以日渐强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦在耶和华他的神面前坚守正道，所以日渐强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦在耶和华－他神面前行正道，以致日渐强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNlt: King Jotham became powerful because he was careful to live in obedience to the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jotham became powerful because he directed his ways before the Lord his God.
verses.textEn: Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 约坦其余的事迹，他的一切战争和作为，都记在以色列和犹大列王记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦其余的事迹，他的一切战争和作为，都记在以色列和犹大列王记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦其余的事和一切争战，并他的行为，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events in Jotham’s reign, including all his wars and the other things he did, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, indeed they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Jotham’s reign, including all his wars and other activities, are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEn: The other events in Jotham’s reign, including all his wars and the other things he did, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.textZh: 他登基的时候是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十六年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他登基的时候是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十六年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。
verses.textEnNiv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.
verses.textEnEsv: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.
verses.textEnNasb: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem for sixteen years.
verses.textEn: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.

verses.textZh: 约坦和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫城里；他的儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫城里；他的儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jotham rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jotham died, he was buried in the City of David. And his son Ahaz became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jotham lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and his son Ahaz became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯登基的时候，是二十岁；他在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他不像他的祖先大卫一样，行耶和华看为正的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯登基的时候，是二十岁；他在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他不像他的祖先大卫一样，行耶和华看为正的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord , as his father David had done,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not do whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, as his father David haddone.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. He did not do what was pleasing in the sight of the Lord , as his ancestor David had done.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem for sixteen years. He did not do what was right in the sight of the Lord as his father David had done.
verses.textEn: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他却随从以色列诸王的道路，又为巴力铸造偶像；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却随从以色列诸王的道路，又为巴力铸造偶像；
verses.textZhCuv: 却行以色列诸王的道，又铸造巴力的像，
verses.textEnNiv: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and also made idols for worshiping the Baals.
verses.textEnEsv: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel. He even made metal images for the Baals,
verses.textEnNkjv: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made molded images for the Baals.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, he followed the example of the kings of Israel. He cast metal images for the worship of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: But he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel; he also made cast metal images for the Baals.
verses.textEn: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and also made idols for worshiping the Baals.

verses.textZh: 并且在欣嫩子谷烧香，用火焚烧自己的儿女，像耶和华在以色列人面前驱走的外族人所行可厌恶的事一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且在欣嫩子谷烧香，用火焚烧自己的儿女，像耶和华在以色列人面前驱走的外族人所行可厌恶的事一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 并且在欣嫩子谷烧香，用火焚烧他的儿女，行耶和华在以色列人面前所驱逐的外邦人那可憎的事；
verses.textEnNiv: He burned sacrifices in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his children in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: and he made offerings in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom and burned his sons as an offering, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord drove out before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: He burned incense in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He offered sacrifices in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, even sacrificing his own sons in the fire. In this way, he followed the detestable practices of the pagan nations the Lord had driven from the land ahead of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, he burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, and burned his sons in fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had driven out from the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He burned sacrifices in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his children in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 又在邱坛上、山冈上和各青翠树下，献祭烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在邱坛上、山冈上和各青翠树下，献祭烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 并在邱坛上、山冈上、各青翠树下献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sacrificed and made offerings on the high places and on the hills and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNlt: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the pagan shrines and on the hills and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNasb: He sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.textEn: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华他的神把他交在亚兰王手里；亚兰王击败了他，掳走了他很多人民，带到大马士革去。神又把他交在以色列王手里，以色列王就在犹大进行大屠杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华他的神把他交在亚兰王手里；亚兰王击败了他，掳走了他很多人民，带到大马士革去。神又把他交在以色列王手里，以色列王就在犹大进行大屠杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华－他的神将他交在亚兰王手里。亚兰王打败他，掳了他许多的民，带到大马士革去。神又将他交在以色列王手里，以色列王向他大行杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hands of the king of Aram. The Arameans defeated him and took many of his people as prisoners and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hands of the king of Israel, who inflicted heavy casualties on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord his God gave him into the hand of the king of Syria, who defeated him and took captive a great number of his people and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with great force.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They defeated him, and carried away a great multitude of them as captives, and brought them to Damascus. Then he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who defeated him with a great slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of all this, the Lord his God allowed the king of Aram to defeat Ahaz and to exile large numbers of his people to Damascus. The armies of the king of Israel also defeated Ahaz and inflicted many casualties on his army.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord his God handed him over to the king of Aram; and they defeated him and carried from him a great number of captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also handed over to the king of Israel, who struck him with heavy casualties.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hands of the king of Aram. The Arameans defeated him and took many of his people as prisoners and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hands of the king of Israel, who inflicted heavy casualties on him.

verses.textZh: 利玛利的儿子比加在犹大一天之内杀了十二万人，全是勇士，因为他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利玛利的儿子比加在犹大一天之内杀了十二万人，全是勇士，因为他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 利玛利的儿子比加一日杀了犹大人十二万，都是勇士，因为他们离弃了耶和华－他们列祖的神。
verses.textEnNiv: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah—because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed 120,000 from Judah in one day, all of them men of valor, because they had forsaken the Lord , the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed one hundred and twenty thousand in Judah in one day, all valiant men, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: In a single day Pekah son of Remaliah, Israel’s king, killed 120,000 of Judah’s troops, all of them experienced warriors, because they had abandoned the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed 120,000 in Judah in one day, all valiant men, because they had abandoned the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah—because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 有一个以法莲的勇士，名叫细基利，杀了王的儿子玛西雅、王宫的总管押斯利甘和王的宰相以利加拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个以法莲的勇士，名叫细基利，杀了王的儿子玛西雅、王宫的总管押斯利甘和王的宰相以利加拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个以法莲中的勇士，名叫细基利，杀了王的儿子玛西雅和管理王宫的押斯利甘，并宰相以利加拿。
verses.textEnNiv: Zikri, an Ephraimite warrior, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer in charge of the palace, and Elkanah, second to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son and Azrikam the commander of the palace and Elkanah the next in authority to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer over the house, and Elkanah whowas second to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zicri, a warrior from Ephraim, killed Maaseiah, the king’s son; Azrikam, the king’s palace commander; and Elkanah, the king’s second-in-command.
verses.textEnNasb: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah the second to the king.
verses.textEn: Zikri, an Ephraimite warrior, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer in charge of the palace, and Elkanah, second to the king.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从他们的兄弟中掳走妇孺共二十万人；又从他们中间夺取了很多战利品，带回撒玛利亚去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从他们的兄弟中掳走妇孺共二十万人；又从他们中间夺取了很多战利品，带回撒玛利亚去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人掳了他们的弟兄，连妇人带儿女共有二十万，又掠了许多的财物，带到撒马利亚去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Israel took captive from their fellow Israelites who were from Judah two hundred thousand wives, sons and daughters. They also took a great deal of plunder, which they carried back to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Israel took captive 200,000 of their relatives, women, sons, and daughters. They also took much spoil from them and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters; and they also took away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: The armies of Israel captured 200,000 women and children from Judah and seized tremendous amounts of plunder, which they took back to Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel led away captive two hundred thousand of their relatives, women, sons, and daughters; and they also took a great deal of spoils from them, and brought the spoils to Samaria.
verses.textEn: The men of Israel took captive from their fellow Israelites who were from Judah two hundred thousand wives, sons and daughters. They also took a great deal of plunder, which they carried back to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 那里有一位耶和华的先知名叫俄德，出来迎接回到撒玛利亚来的军队，对他们说："耶和华你们列祖的神因为恼怒犹大人，才把他们交在你们手里，你们却怒气冲天，杀戮了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里有一位耶和华的先知名叫俄德，出来迎接回到撒玛利亚来的军队，对他们说："耶和华你们列祖的神因为恼怒犹大人，才把他们交在你们手里，你们却怒气冲天，杀戮了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那里有耶和华的一个先知，名叫俄德，出来迎接往撒马利亚去的军兵，对他们说：「因为耶和华－你们列祖的神恼怒犹大人，所以将他们交在你们手里，你们竟怒气冲天，大行杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: But a prophet of the Lord named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army when it returned to Samaria. He said to them, "Because the Lord , the God of your ancestors, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches to heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded, and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria and said to them, "Behold, because the Lord , the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand, but you have killed them in a rage that has reached up to heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out before the army that came to Samaria, and said to them: "Look, because the Lord God of your fathers was angry with Judah, He has delivered them into your hand; but you have killed them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: But a prophet of the Lord named Oded was there in Samaria when the army of Israel returned home. He went out to meet them and said, "The Lord , the God of your ancestors, was angry with Judah and let you defeat them. But you have gone too far, killing them without mercy, and all heaven is disturbed.
verses.textEnNasb: But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army which came to Samaria and said to them, "Behold, because the Lord, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, He has handed them over to you, and you have killed them in a rage which has even reached heaven.
verses.textEn: But a prophet of the Lord named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army when it returned to Samaria. He said to them, "Because the Lord , the God of your ancestors, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches to heaven.

verses.textZh: 现在你们又想强迫犹大人和耶路撒冷人作你们的奴婢。难道你们自己就没有得罪耶和华你们的神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们又想强迫犹大人和耶路撒冷人作你们的奴婢。难道你们自己就没有得罪耶和华你们的神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 如今你们又有意强逼犹大人和耶路撒冷人作你们的奴婢，你们岂不也有得罪耶和华－你们神的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: And now you intend to make the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves. But aren’t you also guilty of sins against the Lord your God?
verses.textEnEsv: And now you intend to subjugate the people of Judah and Jerusalem, male and female, as your slaves. Have you not sins of your own against the Lord your God?
verses.textEnNkjv: And now you propose to force the children of Judah and Jerusalem to be your male and female slaves; butare you not also guilty before the Lord your God?
verses.textEnNlt: And now you are planning to make slaves of these people from Judah and Jerusalem. What about your own sins against the Lord your God?
verses.textEnNasb: Now you are proposing to subjugate the people of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Are you not, however guilty yourselves of offenses against the Lord your God?
verses.textEn: And now you intend to make the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves. But aren’t you also guilty of sins against the Lord your God?

verses.textZh: 你们现在要听我的话，把你们掳回来的兄弟释放回去，因为耶和华的震怒已经临到你们身上了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们现在要听我的话，把你们掳回来的兄弟释放回去，因为耶和华的震怒已经临到你们身上了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们当听我说，要将掳来的弟兄释放回去，因为耶和华向你们已经大发烈怒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now listen to me! Send back your fellow Israelites you have taken as prisoners, for the Lord ’s fierce anger rests on you."
verses.textEnEsv: Now hear me, and send back the captives from your relatives whom you have taken, for the fierce wrath of the Lord is upon you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now hear me, therefore, and return the captives, whom you have taken captive from your brethren, for the fierce wrath of the Lordis upon you."
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me and return these prisoners you have taken, for they are your own relatives. Watch out, because now the Lord ’s fierce anger has been turned against you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, listen to me and return the captives whom you captured from your brothers, for the burning anger of the Lord is against you."
verses.textEn: Now listen to me! Send back your fellow Israelites you have taken as prisoners, for the Lord ’s fierce anger rests on you."

verses.textZh: 于是以法莲人的几个首领，就是约哈难的儿子亚撒利雅、米实利末的儿子比利家、沙龙的儿子耶希西家和哈得莱的儿子亚玛撒，起来阻挡从战场回来的军队，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以法莲人的几个首领，就是约哈难的儿子亚撒利雅、米实利末的儿子比利家、沙龙的儿子耶希西家和哈得莱的儿子亚玛撒，起来阻挡从战场回来的军队，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，以法莲人的几个族长－就是约哈难的儿子亚撒利雅、米实利末的儿子比利家、沙龙的儿子耶希西家、哈得莱的儿子亚玛撒－起来拦挡出兵回来的人，
verses.textEnNiv: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim—Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—confronted those who were arriving from the war.
verses.textEnEsv: Certain chiefs also of the men of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who were coming from the war
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,
verses.textEnNlt: Then some of the leaders of Israel —Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—agreed with this and confronted the men returning from battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then some of the leading men of the sons of Ephraim—Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai—rose up against those who were coming from the battle,
verses.textEn: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim—Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—confronted those who were arriving from the war.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："你们不可把这些俘虏带进来，因为我们已经得罪了耶和华，你们想增加我们的罪恶和过犯，我们的过犯实在严重，耶和华的震怒临到以色列人身上了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："你们不可把这些俘虏带进来，因为我们已经得罪了耶和华，你们想增加我们的罪恶和过犯，我们的过犯实在严重，耶和华的震怒临到以色列人身上了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「你们不可带进这被掳的人来！你们想要使我们得罪耶和华，加增我们的罪恶过犯？因为我们的罪过甚大，已经有烈怒临到以色列人了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You must not bring those prisoners here," they said, "or we will be guilty before the Lord . Do you intend to add to our sin and guilt? For our guilt is already great, and his fierce anger rests on Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "You shall not bring the captives in here, for you propose to bring upon us guilt against the Lord in addition to our present sins and guilt. For our guilt is already great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to them, "You shall not bring the captives here, for we already have offended the Lord. You intend to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and thereis fierce wrath against Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not bring the prisoners here!" they declared. "We cannot afford to add to our sins and guilt. Our guilt is already great, and the Lord ’s fierce anger is already turned against Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: and said to them, "You must not bring the captives in here, for you are proposing to bring guilt upon us before the Lord, adding to our sins and our guilt; for our guilt is great, and His burning anger is against Israel."
verses.textEn: "You must not bring those prisoners here," they said, "or we will be guilty before the Lord . Do you intend to add to our sin and guilt? For our guilt is already great, and his fierce anger rests on Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是，军队把俘虏和战利品都留在众领袖和全体会众的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，军队把俘虏和战利品都留在众领袖和全体会众的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是带兵器的人将掳来的人口和掠来的财物都留在众首领和会众的面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So the soldiers gave up the prisoners and plunder in the presence of the officials and all the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the leaders and all the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: So the warriors released the prisoners and handed over the plunder in the sight of the leaders and all the people.
verses.textEnNasb: So the armed men left the captives and the spoils before the officers and all the assembly.
verses.textEn: So the soldiers gave up the prisoners and plunder in the presence of the officials and all the assembly.

verses.textZh: 上面提过的那些人就起来，领走那些俘虏，从战利品中拿出衣服给所有赤身的穿著，给他们穿上鞋，给他们吃喝，又给他们抹油，又把所有疲弱的人放在驴子上，把他们送回棕树城耶利哥他们的兄弟那里，然后就回撒玛利亚去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 上面提过的那些人就起来，领走那些俘虏，从战利品中拿出衣服给所有赤身的穿著，给他们穿上鞋，给他们吃喝，又给他们抹油，又把所有疲弱的人放在驴子上，把他们送回棕树城耶利哥他们的兄弟那里，然后就回撒玛利亚去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上提名的那些人就站起，使被掳的人前来；其中有赤身的，就从所掠的财物中拿出衣服和鞋来，给他们穿，又给他们吃喝，用膏抹他们；其中有软弱的，就使他们骑驴，送到棕树城耶利哥他们弟兄那里；随后就回撒马利亚去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The men designated by name took the prisoners, and from the plunder they clothed all who were naked. They provided them with clothes and sandals, food and drink, and healing balm. All those who were weak they put on donkeys. So they took them back to their fellow Israelites at Jericho, the City of Palms, and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men who have been mentioned by name rose and took the captives, and with the spoil they clothed all who were naked among them. They clothed them, gave them sandals, provided them with food and drink, and anointed them, and carrying all the feeble among them on donkeys, they brought them to their kinsfolk at Jericho, the city of palm trees. Then they returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men who were designated by name rose up and took the captives, and from the spoil they clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them and gave them sandals, gave them food and drink, and anointed them; and they let all the feeble ones ride on donkeys. So they brought them to their brethren at Jericho, the city of palm trees. Then they returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the four men just mentioned by name came forward and distributed clothes from the plunder to the prisoners who were naked. They provided clothing and sandals to wear, gave them enough food and drink, and dressed their wounds with olive oil. They put those who were weak on donkeys and took all the prisoners back to their own people in Jericho, the city of palms. Then they returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men who were designated by name got up, took the captives, and they clothed all their naked people from the spoils; they gave them clothes and sandals, fed them and gave them drink, anointed them with oil, led all their feeble ones on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers; then they returned to Samaria.
verses.textEn: The men designated by name took the prisoners, and from the plunder they clothed all who were naked. They provided them with clothes and sandals, food and drink, and healing balm. All those who were weak they put on donkeys. So they took them back to their fellow Israelites at Jericho, the City of Palms, and returned to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 那时，亚哈斯王派人去求亚述王 帮助他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，亚哈斯王派人去求亚述王 帮助他，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，亚哈斯王差遣人去见亚述诸王，求他们帮助；
verses.textEnNiv: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria for help.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time King Ahaz sent to the king of Assyria for help.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the same time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time King Ahaz of Judah asked the king of Assyria for help.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time King Ahaz sent word to the kings of Assyria for help.
verses.textEn: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria for help.

verses.textZh: 因为以东人又来攻打犹大，掳走了许多人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以东人又来攻打犹大，掳走了许多人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以东人又来攻击犹大，掳掠子民。
verses.textEnNiv: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away prisoners,
verses.textEnEsv: For the Edomites had again invaded and defeated Judah and carried away captives.
verses.textEnNkjv: For again the Edomites had come, attacked Judah, and carried away captives.
verses.textEnNlt: The armies of Edom had again invaded Judah and taken captives.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Edomites had come again and attacked Judah, and led away captives.
verses.textEn: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away prisoners,

verses.textZh: 非利士人也侵入了高原和犹大南面的众城，占领了伯．示麦、亚雅仑、基低罗、梭哥和属于梭哥的村庄，亭纳和属于亭纳的村庄，瑾琐和属于瑾琐的村庄，并且住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人也侵入了高原和犹大南面的众城，占领了伯．示麦、亚雅仑、基低罗、梭哥和属于梭哥的村庄，亭纳和属于亭纳的村庄，瑾琐和属于瑾琐的村庄，并且住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人也来侵占高原和犹大南方的城邑，取了伯‧示麦、亚雅仑、基低罗，梭哥和属梭哥的乡村，亭纳和属亭纳的乡村，瑾锁和属瑾锁的乡村，就住在那里。
