verses.textEnNiv: while the Philistines had raided towns in the foothills and in the Negev of Judah. They captured and occupied Beth Shemesh, Aijalon and Gederoth, as well as Soko, Timnah and Gimzo, with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines had made raids on the cities in the Shephelah and the Negeb of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo with its villages. And they settled there.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Sochoh with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo with its villages; and they dwelt there.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Philistines had raided towns located in the foothills of Judah and in the Negev of Judah. They had already captured and occupied Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo with its villages.
verses.textEnNasb: The Philistines had also invaded the cities of the lowland and of the Negev of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, and Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo with its villages; and they had settled there.
verses.textEn: while the Philistines had raided towns in the foothills and in the Negev of Judah. They captured and occupied Beth Shemesh, Aijalon and Gederoth, as well as Soko, Timnah and Gimzo, with their surrounding villages.

verses.textZh: 因为犹大王亚哈斯在犹大放纵邪恶，大大地冒犯了耶和华，所以耶和华使犹大卑微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为犹大王亚哈斯在犹大放纵邪恶，大大地冒犯了耶和华，所以耶和华使犹大卑微。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列王亚哈斯在犹大放肆，大大干犯耶和华，所以耶和华使犹大卑微。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had promoted wickedness in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had made Judah act sinfully and had been very unfaithful to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had encouraged moral decline in Judah and had been continually unfaithful to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was humbling Judah because of King Ahaz of Judah, for he had encouraged his people to sin and had been utterly unfaithful to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had brought about a lack of restraint in Judah and was very unfaithful to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Lord had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had promoted wickedness in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚述王提革拉．毘尼色来到他那里，不但没有援助他，反倒欺压他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王提革拉．毘尼色来到他那里，不但没有援助他，反倒欺压他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王提革拉‧毗列色上来，却没有帮助他，反倒欺凌他。
verses.textEnNiv: Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him, but he gave him trouble instead of help.
verses.textEnEsv: So Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came against him and afflicted him instead of strengthening him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him and distressed him, and did not assist him.
verses.textEnNlt: So when King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria arrived, he attacked Ahaz instead of helping him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came against him and afflicted him instead of strengthening him.
verses.textEn: Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him, but he gave him trouble instead of help.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯取了耶和华殿里和王宫中，以及众领袖家里的财宝，给了亚述王，但也无济于事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯取了耶和华殿里和王宫中，以及众领袖家里的财宝，给了亚述王，但也无济于事。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯从耶和华殿里和王宫中，并首领家内所取的财宝给了亚述王，这也无济于事。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz took some of the things from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace and from the officials and presented them to the king of Assyria, but that did not help him.
verses.textEnEsv: For Ahaz took a portion from the house of the Lord and the house of the king and of the princes, and gave tribute to the king of Assyria, but it did not help him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Ahaz took part ofthetreasures from the house of the Lord, from the house of the king, and from the leaders, and he gave it to the king of Assyria; but he did not help him.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz took valuable items from the Lord ’s Temple, the royal palace, and from the homes of his officials and gave them to the king of Assyria as tribute. But this did not help him.
verses.textEnNasb: Although Ahaz took a portion out of the house of the Lord and out of the palace of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria, it did not help him.
verses.textEn: Ahaz took some of the things from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace and from the officials and presented them to the king of Assyria, but that did not help him.

verses.textZh: 这亚哈斯王在急难的时候，竟越发冒犯耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这亚哈斯王在急难的时候，竟越发冒犯耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 这亚哈斯王在急难的时候，越发得罪耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: In his time of trouble King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: In the time of his distress he became yet more faithless to the Lord —this same King Ahaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the time of his distress King Ahaz became increasingly unfaithful to the Lord. This isthat King Ahaz.
verses.textEnNlt: Even during this time of trouble, King Ahaz continued to reject the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now during the time of his distress, this same King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the Lord.
verses.textEn: In his time of trouble King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他向击败了他的大马士革的神献祭，说："亚兰王的神帮助了他们，我也向它们献祭，使它们也帮助我。"它们却使他和以色列人灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向击败了他的大马士革的神献祭，说："亚兰王的神帮助了他们，我也向它们献祭，使它们也帮助我。"它们却使他和以色列人灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他祭祀攻击他的大马士革之神，说：「因为亚兰王的神帮助他们，我也献祭与他，他好帮助我。」但那些神使他和以色列众人败亡了。
verses.textEnNiv: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him; for he thought, "Since the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them so they will help me." But they were his downfall and the downfall of all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus that had defeated him and said, "Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me." But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him, saying, "Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me." But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus who had defeated him, for he said, "Since these gods helped the kings of Aram, they will help me, too, if I sacrifice to them." But instead, they led to his ruin and the ruin of all Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus who had defeated him, and said, "Because the gods of the kings of Aram helped them, I will sacrifice to them so that they may help me." But they became the downfall of him and all Israel.
verses.textEn: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him; for he thought, "Since the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them so they will help me." But they were his downfall and the downfall of all Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯把神殿里的器皿收集起来，把这些神殿里的器皿都击碎了，又封闭了耶和华殿的各门，并且在耶路撒冷的各个角落建造祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯把神殿里的器皿收集起来，把这些神殿里的器皿都击碎了，又封闭了耶和华殿的各门，并且在耶路撒冷的各个角落建造祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯将神殿里的器皿都聚了来，毁坏了，且封锁耶和华殿的门；在耶路撒冷各处的拐角建筑祭坛，
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz gathered together the furnishings from the temple of God and cut them in pieces. He shut the doors of the Lord ’s temple and set up altars at every street corner in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and he shut up the doors of the house of the Lord , and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahaz gathered the articles of the house of God, cut in pieces the articles of the house of God, shut up the doors of the house of the Lord, and made for himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: The king took the various articles from the Temple of God and broke them into pieces. He shut the doors of the Lord ’s Temple so that no one could worship there, and he set up altars to pagan gods in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, when Ahaz gathered together the utensils of the house of God, he cut the utensils of the house of God in pieces; and he closed the doors of the house of the Lord, and made altars for himself in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Ahaz gathered together the furnishings from the temple of God and cut them in pieces. He shut the doors of the Lord ’s temple and set up altars at every street corner in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他又在犹大各城建造邱坛，向别的神烧香，惹怒他列祖的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在犹大各城建造邱坛，向别的神烧香，惹怒他列祖的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在犹大各城建立邱坛，与别神烧香，惹动耶和华－他列祖神的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: In every town in Judah he built high places to burn sacrifices to other gods and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of his ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: In every city of Judah he made high places to make offerings to other gods, provoking to anger the Lord , the God of his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in every single city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger the Lord God of his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: He made pagan shrines in all the towns of Judah for offering sacrifices to other gods. In this way, he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of his ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked the Lord, the God of his fathers, to anger.
verses.textEn: In every town in Judah he built high places to burn sacrifices to other gods and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of his ancestors.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯其余的事迹和他一切所行的，以及一生的始末，都记在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯其余的事迹和他一切所行的，以及一生的始末，都记在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯其余的事和他的行为，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of his reign and all his ways, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of his acts and all his ways, from first to last, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of his acts and all his ways, from first to last, indeed they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Ahaz’s reign and everything he did, from beginning to end, are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of his acts and all his ways, from the first to the last, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of his reign and all his ways, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在耶路撒冷城里，但没有葬在以色列诸王的陵墓里。他的儿子希西家接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在耶路撒冷城里，但没有葬在以色列诸王的陵墓里。他的儿子希西家接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在耶路撒冷城里，没有送入以色列诸王的坟墓中。他儿子希西家接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem, for they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahaz rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem; but they did not bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel. Then Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ahaz died, he was buried in Jerusalem but not in the royal cemetery of the kings of Judah. Then his son Hezekiah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahaz lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem, for they did not bring him to the tombs of the kings of Israel; and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 希西家登基的时候，是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他的母亲名叫亚比雅 ，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家登基的时候，是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他的母亲名叫亚比雅 ，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比雅，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnEsv: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hezekiah became king whenhewas twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became the king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnNasb: Hezekiah became king when he was twenty-five years old; and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

verses.textZh: 希西家行耶和华看为正的事，像他祖先大卫一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家行耶和华看为正的事，像他祖先大卫一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , according to all that David his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, just as his ancestor David had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with everything that his father David had done.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.

verses.textZh: 他在位的元年正月，开了耶和华殿的门，重新修理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在位的元年正月，开了耶和华殿的门，重新修理。
verses.textZhCuv: 元年正月，开了耶和华殿的门，重新修理。
verses.textEnNiv: In the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of the temple of the Lord and repaired them.
verses.textEnEsv: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.
verses.textEnNlt: In the very first month of the first year of his reign, Hezekiah reopened the doors of the Temple of the Lord and repaired them.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.
verses.textEn: In the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of the temple of the Lord and repaired them.

verses.textZh: 他把祭司和利未人都召了来，聚集在东面的广场上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把祭司和利未人都召了来，聚集在东面的广场上，
verses.textZhCuv: 他召众祭司和利未人来，聚集在东边的宽阔处，
verses.textEnNiv: He brought in the priests and the Levites, assembled them in the square on the east side
verses.textEnEsv: He brought in the priests and the Levites and assembled them in the square on the east
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them in the East Square,
verses.textEnNlt: He summoned the priests and Levites to meet him at the courtyard east of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them into the public square on the east.
verses.textEn: He brought in the priests and the Levites, assembled them in the square on the east side

verses.textZh: 对他们说："利未人哪，你们要听我的话；现在你们要自洁，又要洁净耶和华你们列祖的神的殿，把污秽之物从圣所中除去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："利未人哪，你们要听我的话；现在你们要自洁，又要洁净耶和华你们列祖的神的殿，把污秽之物从圣所中除去。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「利未人哪，当听我说：现在你们要洁净自己，又洁净耶和华－你们列祖神的殿，从圣所中除去污秽之物。
verses.textEnNiv: and said: "Listen to me, Levites! Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the temple of the Lord , the God of your ancestors. Remove all defilement from the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "Hear me, Levites! Now consecrate yourselves, and consecrate the house of the Lord , the God of your fathers, and carry out the filth from the Holy Place.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to them: "Hear me, Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and carry out the rubbish from the holy place.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "Listen to me, you Levites! Purify yourselves, and purify the Temple of the Lord , the God of your ancestors. Remove all the defiled things from the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to them, "Listen to me, you Levites. Consecrate yourselves now, and consecrate the house of the Lord, the God of your fathers, and carry the uncleanness out of the holy place.
verses.textEn: and said: "Listen to me, Levites! Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the temple of the Lord , the God of your ancestors. Remove all defilement from the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 我们的列祖冒犯了神，行了耶和华我们的神看为恶的事，离弃了他，转脸不顾耶和华的居所，以背向他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的列祖冒犯了神，行了耶和华我们的神看为恶的事，离弃了他，转脸不顾耶和华的居所，以背向他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们列祖犯了罪，行耶和华－我们神眼中看为恶的事，离弃他，转脸背向他的居所，
verses.textEnNiv: Our parents were unfaithful; they did evil in the eyes of the Lord our God and forsook him. They turned their faces away from the Lord ’s dwelling place and turned their backs on him.
verses.textEnEsv: For our fathers have been unfaithful and have done what was evil in the sight of the Lord our God. They have forsaken him and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the Lord and turned their backs.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our fathers have trespassed and done evil in the eyes of the Lord our God; they have forsaken Him, have turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the Lord, and turned their backs onHim.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors were unfaithful and did what was evil in the sight of the Lord our God. They abandoned the Lord and his dwelling place; they turned their backs on him.
verses.textEnNasb: For our fathers have been unfaithful and have done evil in the sight of the Lord our God, and they have abandoned Him and turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the Lord, and have turned their backs.
verses.textEn: Our parents were unfaithful; they did evil in the eyes of the Lord our God and forsook him. They turned their faces away from the Lord ’s dwelling place and turned their backs on him.

verses.textZh: 他们又封闭廊门，熄灭灯火，不在圣所中向以色列的神烧香或献燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又封闭廊门，熄灭灯火，不在圣所中向以色列的神烧香或献燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 封锁廊门，吹灭灯火，不在圣所中向以色列神烧香，或献燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: They also shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present any burnt offerings at the sanctuary to the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: They also shut the doors of the vestibule and put out the lamps and have not burned incense or offered burnt offerings in the Holy Place to the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have also shut up the doors of the vestibule, put out the lamps, and have not burned incense or offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: They also shut the doors to the Temple’s entry room, and they snuffed out the lamps. They stopped burning incense and presenting burnt offerings at the sanctuary of the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: They have also shut the doors of the porch and extinguished the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: They also shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present any burnt offerings at the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华的震怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷的居民身上，使他们成为令人恐惧、惊骇和嗤笑的对象，就像你们亲眼看见的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华的震怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷的居民身上，使他们成为令人恐惧、惊骇和嗤笑的对象，就像你们亲眼看见的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，耶和华的忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷，将其中的人抛来抛去，令人惊骇、嗤笑，正如你们亲眼所见的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, the anger of the Lord has fallen on Judah and Jerusalem; he has made them an object of dread and horror and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the wrath of the Lord came on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has made them an object of horror, of astonishment, and of hissing, as you see with your own eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the wrath of the Lord fell upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has given them up to trouble, to desolation, and to jeering, as you see with your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "That is why the Lord ’s anger has fallen upon Judah and Jerusalem. He has made them an object of dread, horror, and ridicule, as you can see with your own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the wrath of the Lord was against Judah and Jerusalem, and He has made them an object of terror, of horror, and of hissing, as you see with your own eyes.
verses.textEn: Therefore, the anger of the Lord has fallen on Judah and Jerusalem; he has made them an object of dread and horror and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.

verses.textZh: 所以我们的列祖倒在刀下；我们的儿女和妻子也都因此作了俘虏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们的列祖倒在刀下；我们的儿女和妻子也都因此作了俘虏。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们的祖宗倒在刀下，我们的妻子儿女也被掳掠。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and why our sons and daughters and our wives are in captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed, because of this our fathers have fallen by the sword; and our sons, our daughters, and our wives are in captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of this, our fathers have been killed in battle, and our sons and daughters and wives have been captured.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons, our daughters, and our wives are in captivity because of this.
verses.textEn: This is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and why our sons and daughters and our wives are in captivity.

verses.textZh: 现在我心中有意要和耶和华以色列的神立约，好使他的震怒转离我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我心中有意要和耶和华以色列的神立约，好使他的震怒转离我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我心中有意与耶和华－以色列的神立约，好使他的烈怒转离我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I intend to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, in order that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now itis in my heart to make a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.
verses.textEnNlt: But now I will make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, so that His burning anger may turn away from us.
verses.textEn: Now I intend to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.

verses.textZh: 我的孩子们，你们现在不要懈怠，因为耶和华拣选了你们站在他面前事奉他，为要作他的仆人，向他烧香。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的孩子们，你们现在不要懈怠，因为耶和华拣选了你们站在他面前事奉他，为要作他的仆人，向他烧香。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的众子啊，现在不要懈怠；因为耶和华拣选你们站在他面前事奉他，与他烧香。」
verses.textEnNiv: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him and serve him, to minister before him and to burn incense."
verses.textEnEsv: My sons, do not now be negligent, for the Lord has chosen you to stand in his presence, to minister to him and to be his ministers and make offerings to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that you should minister to Him and burn incense."
verses.textEnNlt: My sons, do not neglect your duties any longer! The Lord has chosen you to stand in his presence, to minister to him, and to lead the people in worship and present offerings to him."
verses.textEnNasb: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and to be His ministers and burn incense."
verses.textEn: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him and serve him, to minister before him and to burn incense."

verses.textZh: 于是，利未人哥辖的子孙亚玛赛的儿子玛哈、亚撒利雅的儿子约珥；米拉利的子孙亚伯底的儿子基士、耶哈利勒的儿子亚撒利雅；革顺的子孙薪玛的儿子约亚、约亚的儿子伊甸；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，利未人哥辖的子孙亚玛赛的儿子玛哈、亚撒利雅的儿子约珥；米拉利的子孙亚伯底的儿子基士、耶哈利勒的儿子亚撒利雅；革顺的子孙薪玛的儿子约亚、约亚的儿子伊甸；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，利未人哥辖的子孙、亚玛赛的儿子玛哈，亚撒利雅的儿子约珥；米拉利的子孙、亚伯底的儿子基士，耶哈利勒的儿子亚撒利雅；革顺的子孙、薪玛的儿子约亚，约亚的儿子伊甸；
verses.textEnNiv: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then these Levites arose: Mahath the son of Amasai and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah;
verses.textEnNlt: Then these Levites got right to work: From the clan of Kohath: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah. From the clan of Merari: Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel. From the clan of Gershon: Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Levites arose: Mahath the son of Amasai and Joel the son of Azariah, from the sons of the Kohathites; and from the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and from the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah;
verses.textEn: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;

verses.textZh: 以利撒反的子孙申利和耶利；亚萨的子孙撒迦利亚和玛探雅；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利撒反的子孙申利和耶利；亚萨的子孙撒迦利亚和玛探雅；
verses.textZhCuv: 以利撒反的子孙申利和耶利；亚萨的子孙撒迦利雅和玛探雅；
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
verses.textEnEsv: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeiel. From the family of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.
verses.textEnNasb: and from the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; and from the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

verses.textZh: 希幔的子孙耶歇和示每；耶杜顿的子孙示玛雅和乌薛都起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希幔的子孙耶歇和示每；耶杜顿的子孙示玛雅和乌薛都起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 希幔的子孙耶歇和示每；耶杜顿的子孙示玛雅和乌薛；
verses.textEnNiv: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
verses.textEnEsv: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei. From the family of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: and from the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and from the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
verses.textEn: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

verses.textZh: 集合他们的亲族，洁净自己，照着王的吩咐，根据耶和华的命令，进去洁净耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 集合他们的亲族，洁净自己，照着王的吩咐，根据耶和华的命令，进去洁净耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 起来聚集他们的弟兄，洁净自己，照着王的吩咐、耶和华的命令，进去洁净耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had assembled their fellow Levites and consecrated themselves, they went in to purify the temple of the Lord , as the king had ordered, following the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They gathered their brothers and consecrated themselves and went in as the king had commanded, by the words of the Lord , to cleanse the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gathered their brethren, sanctified themselves, and went according to the commandment of the king, at the words of the Lord, to cleanse the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: These men called together their fellow Levites, and they all purified themselves. Then they began to cleanse the Temple of the Lord , just as the king had commanded. They were careful to follow all the Lord ’s instructions in their work.
verses.textEnNasb: They assembled their brothers, consecrated themselves, and went in to cleanse the house of the Lord, according to the commandment of the king by the words of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When they had assembled their fellow Levites and consecrated themselves, they went in to purify the temple of the Lord , as the king had ordered, following the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 祭司进入耶和华殿的里面进行洁净，他们在耶和华殿里发现的一切污秽之物，都搬到耶和华殿的院子里；利未人接过，就搬到城外的汲沦溪边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司进入耶和华殿的里面进行洁净，他们在耶和华殿里发现的一切污秽之物，都搬到耶和华殿的院子里；利未人接过，就搬到城外的汲沦溪边。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司进入耶和华的殿要洁净殿，将殿中所有污秽之物搬到耶和华殿的院内，利未人接去，搬到外头汲沦溪边。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests went into the sanctuary of the Lord to purify it. They brought out to the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple everything unclean that they found in the temple of the Lord . The Levites took it and carried it out to the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnEsv: The priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord to cleanse it, and they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the Lord into the court of the house of the Lord . And the Levites took it and carried it out to the brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord to cleanse it, and brought out all the debris that they found in the temple of the Lord to the court of the house of the Lord. And the Levites took it out and carried it to the Brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests went into the sanctuary of the Temple of the Lord to cleanse it, and they took out to the Temple courtyard all the defiled things they found. From there the Levites carted it all out to the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: So the priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord to cleanse it, and they brought every unclean thing which they found in the temple of the Lord out to the courtyard of the house of the Lord. Then the Levites received it to carry out to the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEn: The priests went into the sanctuary of the Lord to purify it. They brought out to the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple everything unclean that they found in the temple of the Lord . The Levites took it and carried it out to the Kidron Valley.

verses.textZh: 他们在正月初一开始洁净圣殿，第八日去到耶和华殿的走廊；他们用了八日洁净耶和华的殿，到了正月十六日才完工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在正月初一开始洁净圣殿，第八日去到耶和华殿的走廊；他们用了八日洁净耶和华的殿，到了正月十六日才完工。
verses.textZhCuv: 从正月初一日洁净起，初八日到了耶和华的殿廊，用八日的工夫洁净耶和华的殿，到正月十六日才洁净完了。
verses.textEnNiv: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the Lord . For eight more days they consecrated the temple of the Lord itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnEsv: They began to consecrate on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the vestibule of the Lord . Then for eight days they consecrated the house of the Lord , and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they began to sanctify on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the vestibule of the Lord. So they sanctified the house of the Lord in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
verses.textEnNlt: They began the work in early spring, on the first day of the new year, and in eight days they had reached the entry room of the Lord ’s Temple. Then they purified the Temple of the Lord itself, which took another eight days. So the entire task was completed in sixteen days.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they entered the porch of the Lord. Then they consecrated the house of the Lord in eight days, and finished on the sixteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEn: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the Lord . For eight more days they consecrated the temple of the Lord itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.

verses.textZh: 于是他们进王宫见希西家王，说："我们已经把整个耶和华的殿、燔祭坛和坛的一切器皿、陈设饼的桌子和桌子上的一切器皿，都洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们进王宫见希西家王，说："我们已经把整个耶和华的殿、燔祭坛和坛的一切器皿、陈设饼的桌子和桌子上的一切器皿，都洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他们晋见希西家王，说：「我们已将耶和华的全殿和燔祭坛，并坛的一切器皿、陈设饼的桌子，与桌子的一切器皿都洁净了；
verses.textEnNiv: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported: "We have purified the entire temple of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table for setting out the consecrated bread, with all its articles.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king and said, "We have cleansed all the house of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the table for the showbread and all its utensils.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and said, "We have cleansed all the house of the Lord, the altar of burnt offerings with all its articles, and the table of the showbread with all its articles.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Levites went to King Hezekiah and gave him this report: "We have cleansed the entire Temple of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the Bread of the Presence with all its utensils.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and said, "We have cleansed the whole house of the Lord, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the showbread with all of its utensils.
verses.textEn: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported: "We have purified the entire temple of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table for setting out the consecrated bread, with all its articles.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯王在位，他得罪神的时候丢弃的一切器皿，我们都预备齐全，也都洁净好了；现在都放在耶和华的祭坛前。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯王在位，他得罪神的时候丢弃的一切器皿，我们都预备齐全，也都洁净好了；现在都放在耶和华的祭坛前。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且亚哈斯王在位犯罪的时候所废弃的器皿，我们预备齐全，且洁净了，现今都在耶和华的坛前。」
verses.textEnNiv: We have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz removed in his unfaithfulness while he was king. They are now in front of the Lord ’s altar."
verses.textEnEsv: All the utensils that King Ahaz discarded in his reign when he was faithless, we have made ready and consecrated, and behold, they are before the altar of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover all the articles which King Ahaz in his reign had cast aside in his transgression we have prepared and sanctified; and there they are, before the altar of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: We have also recovered all the items discarded by King Ahaz when he was unfaithful and closed the Temple. They are now in front of the altar of the Lord , purified and ready for use."
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, all the utensils which King Ahaz had discarded during his reign in his unfaithfulness, we have prepared and consecrated; and behold, they are before the altar of the Lord."
verses.textEn: We have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz removed in his unfaithfulness while he was king. They are now in front of the Lord ’s altar."

verses.textZh: 希西家王清早起来，召集城中的领袖，上耶和华的殿去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王清早起来，召集城中的领袖，上耶和华的殿去。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王清早起来，聚集城里的首领都上耶和华的殿；
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials together and went up to the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah the king rose early and gathered the officials of the city and went up to the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Hezekiah rose early, gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials and went to the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Hezekiah got up early and assembled the princes of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials together and went up to the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们牵来了七头公牛、七只公绵羊、七只羊羔和七只公山羊，要为国家、为圣所和为犹大人作赎罪祭；王吩咐亚伦的子孙众祭司把牠们献在耶和华的坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们牵来了七头公牛、七只公绵羊、七只羊羔和七只公山羊，要为国家、为圣所和为犹大人作赎罪祭；王吩咐亚伦的子孙众祭司把牠们献在耶和华的坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 牵了七只公牛，七只公羊，七只羊羔，七只公山羊，要为国、为殿、为犹大人作赎罪祭。王吩咐亚伦的子孙众祭司，献在耶和华的坛上，
verses.textEnNiv: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer these on the altar of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom and for the sanctuary and for Judah. And he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. Then he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, and seven male lambs as a burnt offering, together with seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the Temple, and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice the animals on the altar of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, the sanctuary, and Judah. And he ordered the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer these on the altar of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们宰了公牛，祭司把血接过来，洒在祭坛上；他们又宰了公绵羊，把血洒在祭坛上；他们又宰了羊羔，也把血洒在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们宰了公牛，祭司把血接过来，洒在祭坛上；他们又宰了公绵羊，把血洒在祭坛上；他们又宰了羊羔，也把血洒在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 就宰了公牛，祭司接血洒在坛上，宰了公羊，把血洒在坛上，又宰了羊羔，也把血洒在坛上；
verses.textEnNiv: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and splashed it against the altar; next they slaughtered the rams and splashed their blood against the altar; then they slaughtered the lambs and splashed their blood against the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests received the blood and threw it against the altar. And they slaughtered the rams, and their blood was thrown against the altar. And they slaughtered the lambs, and their blood was thrown against the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. Likewise they killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: So they killed the bulls, and the priests took the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. Next they killed the rams and sprinkled their blood on the altar. And finally, they did the same with the male lambs.
verses.textEnNasb: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They also slaughtered the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar; they slaughtered the lambs as well, and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
verses.textEn: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and splashed it against the altar; next they slaughtered the rams and splashed their blood against the altar; then they slaughtered the lambs and splashed their blood against the altar.

verses.textZh: 最后把作赎罪祭的公山羊，牵到王和会众面前，王和会众就按手在公山羊的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后把作赎罪祭的公山羊，牵到王和会众面前，王和会众就按手在公山羊的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 把那作赎罪祭的公山羊牵到王和会众面前，他们就按手在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: The goats for the sin offering were brought before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the goats for the sin offering were brought to the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought out the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.
verses.textEnNlt: The male goats for the sin offering were then brought before the king and the assembly of people, who laid their hands on them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they brought the male goats of the sin offering before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.
verses.textEn: The goats for the sin offering were brought before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.

verses.textZh: 祭司宰了公山羊，把血洒在祭坛上作赎罪祭，为所有以色列人赎罪；因为王曾经吩咐要为所有以色列人献上燔祭和赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司宰了公山羊，把血洒在祭坛上作赎罪祭，为所有以色列人赎罪；因为王曾经吩咐要为所有以色列人献上燔祭和赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司宰了羊，将血献在坛上作赎罪祭，为以色列众人赎罪，因为王吩咐将燔祭和赎罪祭为以色列众人献上。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests then slaughtered the goats and presented their blood on the altar for a sin offering to atone for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and the priests slaughtered them and made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel. For the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priests killed them; and they presented their blood on the altar as a sin offering to make an atonement for all Israel, for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering bemade for all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests then killed the goats as a sin offering and sprinkled their blood on the altar to make atonement for the sins of all Israel. The king had specifically commanded that this burnt offering and sin offering should be made for all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The priests slaughtered them and purified the altar with their blood to atone for all Israel, because the king ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
verses.textEn: The priests then slaughtered the goats and presented their blood on the altar for a sin offering to atone for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.

verses.textZh: 王又指派在耶和华殿中的利未人拿着响钹和琴瑟，是照着大卫、王的先见迦得和拿单先知所吩咐的，就是耶和华藉他的先知所吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又指派在耶和华殿中的利未人拿着响钹和琴瑟，是照着大卫、王的先见迦得和拿单先知所吩咐的，就是耶和华藉他的先知所吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 王又派利未人在耶和华殿中敲钹，鼓瑟，弹琴，乃照大卫和他先见迦得，并先知拿单所吩咐的，就是耶和华藉先知所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: He stationed the Levites in the temple of the Lord with cymbals, harps and lyres in the way prescribed by David and Gad the king’s seer and Nathan the prophet; this was commanded by the Lord through his prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, harps, and lyres, according to the commandment of David and of Gad the king’s seer and of Nathan the prophet, for the commandment was from the Lord through his prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet; for thus was the commandment of the Lord by His prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hezekiah then stationed the Levites at the Temple of the Lord with cymbals, lyres, and harps. He obeyed all the commands that the Lord had given to King David through Gad, the king’s seer, and the prophet Nathan.
verses.textEnNasb: He then stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, harps, and lyres, according to the command of David and of Gad, the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet; for the command was from the Lord through His prophets.
verses.textEn: He stationed the Levites in the temple of the Lord with cymbals, harps and lyres in the way prescribed by David and Gad the king’s seer and Nathan the prophet; this was commanded by the Lord through his prophets.

verses.textZh: 利未人拿着大卫的乐器，祭司持着号筒，一同站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人拿着大卫的乐器，祭司持着号筒，一同站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人拿大卫的乐器，祭司拿号，一同站立。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Levites stood ready with David’s instruments, and the priests with their trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites then took their positions around the Temple with the instruments of David, and the priests took their positions with the trumpets.
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites stood with the musical instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.textEn: So the Levites stood ready with David’s instruments, and the priests with their trumpets.

verses.textZh: 希西家吩咐在祭坛上献上燔祭。开始献燔祭的时候，就开始向耶和华歌唱，并且用号筒和以色列王大卫的乐器伴奏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家吩咐在祭坛上献上燔祭。开始献燔祭的时候，就开始向耶和华歌唱，并且用号筒和以色列王大卫的乐器伴奏。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家吩咐在坛上献燔祭，燔祭一献，就唱赞美耶和华的歌，用号，并用以色列王大卫的乐器相和。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah gave the order to sacrifice the burnt offering on the altar. As the offering began, singing to the Lord began also, accompanied by trumpets and the instruments of David king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah commanded that the burnt offering be offered on the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song to the Lord began also, and the trumpets, accompanied by the instruments of David king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the Lordalso began, with the trumpets and with the instruments of David king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hezekiah ordered that the burnt offering be placed on the altar. As the burnt offering was presented, songs of praise to the Lord were begun, accompanied by the trumpets and other instruments of David, the former king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah gave the order to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the song to the Lordalso began with the trumpets, accompanied by the instruments of David, king of Israel.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah gave the order to sacrifice the burnt offering on the altar. As the offering began, singing to the Lord began also, accompanied by trumpets and the instruments of David king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 全体会众都叩拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹号的吹号，直到燔祭都献完了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众都叩拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹号的吹号，直到燔祭都献完了。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众都敬拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹号的吹号，如此直到燔祭献完了。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole assembly bowed in worship, while the musicians played and the trumpets sounded. All this continued until the sacrifice of the burnt offering was completed.
verses.textEnEsv: The whole assembly worshiped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded; all thiscontinued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire assembly worshiped the Lord as the singers sang and the trumpets blew, until all the burnt offerings were finished.
verses.textEnNasb: While the whole assembly worshiped, the singers also sang and the trumpets sounded; all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.textEn: The whole assembly bowed in worship, while the musicians played and the trumpets sounded. All this continued until the sacrifice of the burnt offering was completed.

verses.textZh: 献完了祭，王和所有在场的人，都屈膝叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 献完了祭，王和所有在场的人，都屈膝叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 献完了祭，王和一切跟随的人都俯伏敬拜。
verses.textEnNiv: When the offerings were finished, the king and everyone present with him knelt down and worshiped.
verses.textEnEsv: When the offering was finished, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed and worshiped.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king and everyone with him bowed down in worship.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at the completion of the burnt offerings, the king and all who were present with him bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEn: When the offerings were finished, the king and everyone present with him knelt down and worshiped.

verses.textZh: 希西家王和众领袖，又吩咐利未人用大卫和先见亚萨的诗词赞美耶和华，于是他们欢欢喜喜地赞美耶和华，低头敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王和众领袖，又吩咐利未人用大卫和先见亚萨的诗词赞美耶和华，于是他们欢欢喜喜地赞美耶和华，低头敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王与众首领又吩咐利未人用大卫和先见亚萨的诗词颂赞耶和华；他们就欢欢喜喜地颂赞耶和华，低头敬拜。
verses.textEnNiv: King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to praise the Lord with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah the king and the officials commanded the Levites to sing praises to the Lord with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover King Hezekiah and the leaders commanded the Levites to sing praise to the Lord with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hezekiah and the officials ordered the Levites to praise the Lord with the psalms written by David and by Asaph the seer. So they offered joyous praise and bowed down in worship.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, King Hezekiah and the officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the Lord with the words of David and Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with joy, and bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEn: King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to praise the Lord with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed down and worshiped.

verses.textZh: 希西家说："你们现在归耶和华为圣了。请前来，把祭物和感恩祭带到耶和华的殿里来。"于是会众把祭物和感恩祭带来；凡是甘心乐意的，都把燔祭带来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家说："你们现在归耶和华为圣了。请前来，把祭物和感恩祭带到耶和华的殿里来。"于是会众把祭物和感恩祭带来；凡是甘心乐意的，都把燔祭带来。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家说：「你们既然归耶和华为圣，就要前来把祭物和感谢祭奉到耶和华殿里。」会众就把祭物和感谢祭奉来，凡甘心乐意的也将燔祭奉来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Hezekiah said, "You have now dedicated yourselves to the Lord . Come and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the temple of the Lord ." So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah said, "You have now consecrated yourselves to the Lord . Come near; bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of the Lord ." And the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all who were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah answered and said, "Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the Lord, come near, and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the Lord." So the assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hezekiah declared, "Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the Lord , bring your sacrifices and thanksgiving offerings to the Temple of the Lord ." So the people brought their sacrifices and thanksgiving offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah said, "Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the Lord, come forward and bring sacrifices and thanksgiving offerings to the house of the Lord." So the assembly brought sacrifices and thanksgiving offerings, and everyone who was willing brought burnt offerings.
verses.textEn: Then Hezekiah said, "You have now dedicated yourselves to the Lord . Come and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the temple of the Lord ." So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.

verses.textZh: 会众带来的燔祭数目如下：公牛七十头、公绵羊一百只、羊羔二百只。这些都是作燔祭献给耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会众带来的燔祭数目如下：公牛七十头、公绵羊一百只、羊羔二百只。这些都是作燔祭献给耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众所奉的燔祭如下：公牛七十只，公羊一百只，羊羔二百只，这都是作燔祭献给耶和华的；
verses.textEnNiv: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams and two hundred male lambs—all of them for burnt offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The number of the burnt offerings that the assembly brought was 70 bulls, 100 rams, and 200 lambs; all these were for a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs; all these were for a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The people brought to the Lord 70 bulls, 100 rams, and 200 male lambs for burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams, and two hundred lambs; all of these were for a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams and two hundred male lambs—all of them for burnt offerings to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 还有分别为圣之物：公牛六百头、绵羊三千只。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有分别为圣之物：公牛六百头、绵羊三千只。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有分别为圣之物，公牛六百只，绵羊三千只。
verses.textEnNiv: The animals consecrated as sacrifices amounted to six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: And the consecrated offerings were 600 bulls and 3,000 sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: The consecrated things were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: They also brought 600 cattle and 3,000 sheep and goats as sacred offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: The consecrated offerings were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.
verses.textEn: The animals consecrated as sacrifices amounted to six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep and goats.

verses.textZh: 只是祭司太少，不能把所有燔祭牲剥皮，所以他们的亲族利未人协助他们，直到剥皮的工作完了，又等到其他祭司自洁完了，因为利未人在自洁的事上比众祭司更加诚心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是祭司太少，不能把所有燔祭牲剥皮，所以他们的亲族利未人协助他们，直到剥皮的工作完了，又等到其他祭司自洁完了，因为利未人在自洁的事上比众祭司更加诚心。
verses.textZhCuv: 但祭司太少，不能剥尽燔祭牲的皮，所以他们的弟兄利未人帮助他们，直等燔祭的事完了，又等别的祭司自洁了；因为利未人诚心自洁，胜过祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests, however, were too few to skin all the burnt offerings; so their relatives the Levites helped them until the task was finished and until other priests had been consecrated, for the Levites had been more conscientious in consecrating themselves than the priests had been.
verses.textEnEsv: But the priests were too few and could not flay all the burnt offerings, so until other priests had consecrated themselves, their brothers the Levites helped them, until the work was finished— for the Levites were more upright in heart than the priests in consecrating themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings; therefore their brethren the Levites helped them until the work was ended and until the other priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more diligent in sanctifying themselves than the priests.
verses.textEnNlt: But there were too few priests to prepare all the burnt offerings. So their relatives the Levites helped them until the work was finished and more priests had been purified, for the Levites had been more conscientious about purifying themselves than the priests had been.
verses.textEnNasb: But the priests were too few, so that they were unable to skin all the burnt offerings; therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was finished and the other priests had consecrated themselves. For the Levites were more conscientious to consecrate themselves than the priests.
verses.textEn: The priests, however, were too few to skin all the burnt offerings; so their relatives the Levites helped them until the task was finished and until other priests had been consecrated, for the Levites had been more conscientious in consecrating themselves than the priests had been.

verses.textZh: 此外，还有很多燔祭牲和平安祭牲的脂肪，以及和燔祭同献的奠祭很多。这样，耶和华殿里的事奉就重新恢复了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，还有很多燔祭牲和平安祭牲的脂肪，以及和燔祭同献的奠祭很多。这样，耶和华殿里的事奉就重新恢复了。
verses.textZhCuv: 燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油，并燔祭同献的奠祭甚多。这样，耶和华殿中的事务俱都齐备了 。
verses.textEnNiv: There were burnt offerings in abundance, together with the fat of the fellowship offerings and the drink offerings that accompanied the burnt offerings. So the service of the temple of the Lord was reestablished.
verses.textEnEsv: Besides the great number of burnt offerings, there was the fat of the peace offerings, and there were the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. Thus the service of the house of the Lord was restored.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the Lord was set in order.
verses.textEnNlt: There was an abundance of burnt offerings, along with the usual liquid offerings, and a great deal of fat from the many peace offerings. So the Temple of the Lord was restored to service.
verses.textEnNasb: There were also many burnt offerings with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. So the service of the house of the Lord was established again.
verses.textEn: There were burnt offerings in abundance, together with the fat of the fellowship offerings and the drink offerings that accompanied the burnt offerings. So the service of the temple of the Lord was reestablished.

verses.textZh: 因为事情很快办完，希西家和全体人民因神为他的子民所预备的，都甚欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为事情很快办完，希西家和全体人民因神为他的子民所预备的，都甚欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事办的甚速，希西家和众民都喜乐，是因神为众民所预备的。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had brought about for his people, because it was done so quickly.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because God had provided for the people, for the thing came about suddenly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced that God had prepared the people, since the events took place so suddenly.
verses.textEnNlt: And Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of what God had done for the people, for everything had been accomplished so quickly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced over what God had prepared for the people, because the thing came about suddenly.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had brought about for his people, because it was done so quickly.

verses.textZh: 希西家派人走遍以色列和犹大，又写信给以法莲人和玛拿西人，叫他们到耶路撒冷耶和华的殿来，守逾越节记念耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家派人走遍以色列和犹大，又写信给以法莲人和玛拿西人，叫他们到耶路撒冷耶和华的殿来，守逾越节记念耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家差遣人去见以色列和犹大众人，又写信给以法莲和玛拿西人，叫他们到耶路撒冷耶和华的殿，向耶和华－以色列的神守逾越节；
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, inviting them to come to the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the Lord at Jerusalem to keep the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hezekiah now sent word to all Israel and Judah, and he wrote letters of invitation to the people of Ephraim and Manasseh. He asked everyone to come to the Temple of the Lord at Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, inviting them to come to the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 因为王和众领袖，以及耶路撒冷的全体会众曾经商议，要在二月守逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为王和众领袖，以及耶路撒冷的全体会众曾经商议，要在二月守逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为王和众首领，并耶路撒冷全会众已经商议，要在二月内守逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: The king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to celebrate the Passover in the second month.
verses.textEnEsv: For the king and his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem had taken counsel to keep the Passover in the second month—
verses.textEnNkjv: For the king and his leaders and all the assembly in Jerusalem had agreed to keep the Passover in the second month.
verses.textEnNlt: The king, his officials, and all the community of Jerusalem decided to celebrate Passover a month later than usual.
verses.textEnNasb: For the king and his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem had decided to celebrate the Passover in the second month,
verses.textEn: The king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to celebrate the Passover in the second month.

verses.textZh: 王和全体会众都认为这计划很好，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和全体会众都认为这计划很好，
verses.textZhCuv: 正月 间他们不能守；因为自洁的祭司尚不敷用，百姓也没有聚集在耶路撒冷；
verses.textEnNiv: They had not been able to celebrate it at the regular time because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not assembled in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: for they could not keep it at that time because the priests had not consecrated themselves in sufficient number, nor had the people assembled in Jerusalem—
verses.textEnNkjv: For they could not keep it at the regular time, because a sufficient number of priests had not consecrated themselves, nor had the people gathered together at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: They were unable to celebrate it at the prescribed time because not enough priests could be purified by then, and the people had not yet assembled at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: since they could not celebrate it at that time, because the priests had not consecrated themselves in sufficient numbers, nor had the people been gathered to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: They had not been able to celebrate it at the regular time because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not assembled in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 于是下了命令，通告全以色列，从别是巴直到但，叫人民来耶路撒冷守逾越节记念耶和华以色列的神，因为照着所记的定例举行这节的人不多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是下了命令，通告全以色列，从别是巴直到但，叫人民来耶路撒冷守逾越节记念耶和华以色列的神，因为照着所记的定例举行这节的人不多。
verses.textZhCuv: 王与全会众都以这事为善。
verses.textEnNiv: The plan seemed right both to the king and to the whole assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: and the plan seemed right to the king and all the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the matter pleased the king and all the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: This plan for keeping the Passover seemed right to the king and all the people.
verses.textEnNasb: So the decision was right in the sight of the king and all the assembly.
verses.textEn: The plan seemed right both to the king and to the whole assembly.

verses.textZh: 信差就带着王和众领袖发出的书信，走遍全以色列和犹大，照着王的吩咐，宣告说："以色列人哪，你们应当转向耶和华，亚伯拉罕、以撒和以色列的神，使他也转向你们这些在亚述王手中逃脱的余民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信差就带着王和众领袖发出的书信，走遍全以色列和犹大，照着王的吩咐，宣告说："以色列人哪，你们应当转向耶和华，亚伯拉罕、以撒和以色列的神，使他也转向你们这些在亚述王手中逃脱的余民。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是定了命令，传遍以色列，从别是巴直到但，使他们都来，在耶路撒冷向耶和华－以色列的神守逾越节；因为照所写的例，守这节的不多了 。
verses.textEnNiv: They decided to send a proclamation throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, calling the people to come to Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel. It had not been celebrated in large numbers according to what was written.
verses.textEnEsv: So they decreed to make a proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, that the people should come and keep the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it as often as prescribed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they resolved to make a proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the Lord God of Israel at Jerusalem, since they had not done it for a long time in the prescribed manner.
verses.textEnNlt: So they sent a proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north, inviting everyone to come to Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover of the Lord , the God of Israel. The people had not been celebrating it in great numbers as required in the Law.
verses.textEnNasb: So they established a decree to circulate a proclamation throughout Israel from Beersheba to Dan, that they are to come to celebrate the Passover to the Lord God of Israel in Jerusalem. For they had not celebrated it in great numbers as was written.
verses.textEn: They decided to send a proclamation throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, calling the people to come to Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel. It had not been celebrated in large numbers according to what was written.

verses.textZh: 你们不要像你们的列祖和你们的亲族，他们得罪了耶和华他们列祖的神，以致耶和华使他们成为令人惊骇的对象，就像你们自己所见的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要像你们的列祖和你们的亲族，他们得罪了耶和华他们列祖的神，以致耶和华使他们成为令人惊骇的对象，就像你们自己所见的。
verses.textZhCuv: 驿卒就把王和众首领的信，遵着王命传遍以色列和犹大。信内说：「以色列人哪，你们当转向耶和华－亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神，好叫他转向你们这脱离亚述王手的余民。
verses.textEnNiv: At the king’s command, couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and from his officials, which read: "People of Israel, return to the Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to you who are left, who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: So couriers went throughout all Israel and Judah with letters from the king and his princes, as the king had commanded, saying, "O people of Israel, return to the Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may turn again to the remnant of you who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the runners went throughout all Israel and Judah with the letters from the king and his leaders, and spoke according to the command of the king: "Children of Israel, return to the Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel; then He will return to the remnant of you who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: At the king’s command, runners were sent throughout Israel and Judah. They carried letters that said: "O people of Israel, return to the Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, so that he will return to the few of us who have survived the conquest of the Assyrian kings.
verses.textEnNasb: The couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with the letters from the hand of the king and his princes, even according to the command of the king, saying, "Sons of Israel, return to the Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that He may return to those of you who escaped and are left from the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.textEn: At the king’s command, couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and from his officials, which read: "People of Israel, return to the Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to you who are left, who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 现在你们不可顽固，像你们的列祖那样；要顺服耶和华，进入他永远分别为圣的圣所，事奉耶和华你们的神，使他的烈怒转离你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们不可顽固，像你们的列祖那样；要顺服耶和华，进入他永远分别为圣的圣所，事奉耶和华你们的神，使他的烈怒转离你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要效法你们列祖和你们的弟兄；他们干犯耶和华－他们列祖的神，以致耶和华丢弃他们，使他们败亡 ，正如你们所见的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be like your parents and your fellow Israelites, who were unfaithful to the Lord , the God of their ancestors, so that he made them an object of horror, as you see.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be like your fathers and your brothers, who were faithless to the Lord God of their fathers, so that he made them a desolation, as you see.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not be like your fathers and your brethren, who trespassed against the Lord God of their fathers, so that He gave them up to desolation, as you see.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be like your ancestors and relatives who abandoned the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and became an object of derision, as you yourselves can see.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be like your fathers and your brothers, who were untrue to the Lord God of their fathers, so that He made them an object of horror, just as you see.
verses.textEn: Do not be like your parents and your fellow Israelites, who were unfaithful to the Lord , the God of their ancestors, so that he made them an object of horror, as you see.

verses.textZh: 如果你们是归向耶和华，你们的亲族和儿女就必在俘掳他们的人面前蒙怜悯，可以返回这地；因为耶和华你们的神是有恩惠有怜悯；如果你们归向他，他必不转脸不顾你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们是归向耶和华，你们的亲族和儿女就必在俘掳他们的人面前蒙怜悯，可以返回这地；因为耶和华你们的神是有恩惠有怜悯；如果你们归向他，他必不转脸不顾你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在不要像你们列祖硬着颈项，只要归顺耶和华，进入他的圣所，就是永远成圣的居所；又要事奉耶和华－你们的神，好使他的烈怒转离你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be stiff-necked, as your ancestors were; submit to the Lord . Come to his sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever. Serve the Lord your God, so that his fierce anger will turn away from you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not now be stiff-necked as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to the Lord and come to his sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever, and serve the Lord your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now do not be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to the Lord; and enter His sanctuary, which He has sanctified forever, and serve the Lord your God, that the fierceness of His wrath may turn away from you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be stubborn, as they were, but submit yourselves to the Lord . Come to his Temple, which he has set apart as holy forever. Worship the Lord your God so that his fierce anger will turn away from you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now do not stiffen your neck like your fathers, but yield to the Lord and enter His sanctuary which He has consecrated forever, and serve the Lord your God, that His burning anger may turn away from you.
verses.textEn: Do not be stiff-necked, as your ancestors were; submit to the Lord . Come to his sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever. Serve the Lord your God, so that his fierce anger will turn away from you.

verses.textZh: 信差从这城到那城，走遍了以法莲和玛拿西各地，直到西布伦；那里的人却戏弄他们，讥笑他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信差从这城到那城，走遍了以法莲和玛拿西各地，直到西布伦；那里的人却戏弄他们，讥笑他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若转向耶和华，你们的弟兄和儿女必在掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤，得以归回这地，因为耶和华－你们的神有恩典、施怜悯。你们若转向他，他必不转脸不顾你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you return to the Lord , then your fellow Israelites and your children will be shown compassion by their captors and will return to this land, for the Lord your God is gracious and compassionate. He will not turn his face from you if you return to him."
verses.textEnEsv: For if you return to the Lord , your brothers and your children will find compassion with their captors and return to this land. For the Lord your God is gracious and merciful and will not turn away his face from you, if you return to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you return to the Lord, your brethren and your children willbetreated with compassion by those who lead them captive, so that they may come back to this land; for the Lord your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn His face from you if you return to Him."
verses.textEnNlt: "For if you return to the Lord , your relatives and your children will be treated mercifully by their captors, and they will be able to return to this land. For the Lord your God is gracious and merciful. If you return to him, he will not continue to turn his face from you."
verses.textEnNasb: For if you return to the Lord, your brothers and your sons will find compassion in the presence of those who led them captive, and will return to this land. For the Lord your God is gracious and compassionate, and will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him."
verses.textEn: If you return to the Lord , then your fellow Israelites and your children will be shown compassion by their captors and will return to this land, for the Lord your God is gracious and compassionate. He will not turn his face from you if you return to him."

verses.textZh: 可是在亚设、玛拿西和西布伦中，也有人愿意谦卑，来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是在亚设、玛拿西和西布伦中，也有人愿意谦卑，来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 驿卒就由这城跑到那城，传遍了以法莲、玛拿西，直到西布伦。那里的人却戏笑他们，讥诮他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The couriers went from town to town in Ephraim and Manasseh, as far as Zebulun, but people scorned and ridiculed them.
verses.textEnEsv: So the couriers went from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, and as far as Zebulun, but they laughed them to scorn and mocked them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the runners passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, as far as Zebulun; but they laughed at them and mocked them.
verses.textEnNlt: The runners went from town to town throughout Ephraim and Manasseh and as far as the territory of Zebulun. But most of the people just laughed at the runners and made fun of them.
verses.textEnNasb: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, and as far as Zebulun, but they laughed at them with scorn and mocked them.
verses.textEn: The couriers went from town to town in Ephraim and Manasseh, as far as Zebulun, but people scorned and ridiculed them.

verses.textZh: 神的能力也帮助犹大人，使他们一心遵行王和众领袖奉耶和华的命令发出的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的能力也帮助犹大人，使他们一心遵行王和众领袖奉耶和华的命令发出的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而亚设、玛拿西、西布伦中也有人自卑，来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, some from Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: However, some men of Asher, of Manasseh, and of Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless some from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: However, some people from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, some from Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 二月，有很多人在耶路撒冷聚集，要举行无酵节，集合了一大群会众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二月，有很多人在耶路撒冷聚集，要举行无酵节，集合了一大群会众。
verses.textZhCuv: 神也感动犹大人，使他们一心遵行王与众首领凭耶和华之言所发的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: Also in Judah the hand of God was on the people to give them unity of mind to carry out what the king and his officials had ordered, following the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The hand of God was also on Judah to give them one heart to do what the king and the princes commanded by the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the hand of God was on Judah to give them singleness of heart to obey the command of the king and the leaders, at the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: At the same time, God’s hand was on the people in the land of Judah, giving them all one heart to obey the orders of the king and his officials, who were following the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The hand of God was also on Judah to give them one heart to do what the king and the princes commanded by the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Also in Judah the hand of God was on the people to give them unity of mind to carry out what the king and his officials had ordered, following the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们起来，把耶路撒冷城中的祭坛和一切香坛，尽都除去，拋在汲沦溪中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们起来，把耶路撒冷城中的祭坛和一切香坛，尽都除去，拋在汲沦溪中。
verses.textZhCuv: 二月，有许多人在耶路撒冷聚集，成为大会，要守除酵节。
verses.textEnNiv: A very large crowd of people assembled in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month.
verses.textEnEsv: And many people came together in Jerusalem to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now many people, a very great assembly, gathered at Jerusalem to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the second month.
verses.textEnNlt: So a huge crowd assembled at Jerusalem in midspring to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread.
verses.textEnNasb: Now many people were gathered at Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the second month, a very large assembly.
verses.textEn: A very large crowd of people assembled in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month.

verses.textZh: 二月十四日，他们宰了逾越节的羊羔。祭司和利未人都觉得惭愧，就自洁，把燔祭带到耶和华的殿里。

verses.textEnNiv: They removed the altars in Jerusalem and cleared away the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.

verses.textEnNlt: They set to work and removed the pagan altars from Jerusalem. They took away all the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: They got up and removed the altars which were in Jerusalem; they also removed all the incense altars and threw them into the brook Kidron.
verses.textEn: They removed the altars in Jerusalem and cleared away the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.

verses.textEnNiv: They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. And the priests and the Levites were ashamed, so that they consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings into the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they slaughtered the Passover lambs on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought the burnt offerings to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: On the fourteenth day of the second month, one month later than usual, the people slaughtered the Passover lamb. This shamed the priests and Levites, so they purified themselves and brought burnt offerings to the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then they slaughtered the Passover lambs on the fourteenth of the second month. And the priests and Levites were ashamed of themselves, and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因为会众中有很多人还没有自洁，所以利未人必须为所有不洁的人宰杀逾越节的羊羔，使他们在耶和华面前成为圣洁。

verses.textEnNiv: Then they took up their regular positions as prescribed in the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them by the Levites.

verses.textEnNkjv: They stood in their place according to their custom, according to the Law of Moses the man of God; the priests sprinkled the blood received from the hand of the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they took their places at the Temple as prescribed in the Law of Moses, the man of God. The Levites brought the sacrificial blood to the priests, who then sprinkled it on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: They stood at their stations following their custom, according to the Law of Moses the man of God; the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from the hand of the Levites.
verses.textEn: Then they took up their regular positions as prescribed in the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them by the Levites.

verses.textZh: 耶和华垂听了希西家的祷告，就饶恕 众民。
