verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Hezekiah’s reign and his acts of devotion are recorded in The Vision of the Prophet Isaiah Son of Amoz, which is included in The Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his deeds of devotion, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Hezekiah’s reign and his acts of devotion are written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.textZh: 希西家和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫子孙墓地的高层；他死的时候，犹大众人和耶路撒冷的居民都向他致敬。他的儿子玛拿西接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在大卫子孙墓地的高层；他死的时候，犹大众人和耶路撒冷的居民都向他致敬。他的儿子玛拿西接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫子孙的高陵上。他死的时候，犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民都尊敬他。他儿子玛拿西接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors and was buried on the hill where the tombs of David’s descendants are. All Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him when he died. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the upper part of the tombs of the sons of David, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honor at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hezekiah rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the upper tombs of the sons of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Then Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Hezekiah died, he was buried in the upper area of the royal cemetery, and all Judah and Jerusalem honored him at his death. And his son Manasseh became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hezekiah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the upper section of the tombs of the sons of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. And his son Manasseh became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors and was buried on the hill where the tombs of David’s descendants are. All Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him when he died. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西登基的时候，是十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共五十五年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西登基的时候，是十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共五十五年。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。
verses.textEnNiv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years.
verses.textEnEsv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years.
verses.textEnNasb: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned for fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，随从耶和华在以色列人面前赶走的列国所行可厌恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，随从耶和华在以色列人面前赶走的列国所行可厌恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人那可憎的事，
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord drove out before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, following the detestable practices of the pagan nations that the Lord had driven from the land ahead of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord dispossessed before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 他重新建造他父亲希西家拆毁的邱坛，又为巴力立坛，制造亚舍拉，并且敬拜和事奉天上的万象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他重新建造他父亲希西家拆毁的邱坛，又为巴力立坛，制造亚舍拉，并且敬拜和事奉天上的万象。
verses.textZhCuv: 重新建筑他父希西家所拆毁的邱坛，又为巴力筑坛，做木偶，且敬拜事奉天上的万象，
verses.textEnNiv: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had demolished; he also erected altars to the Baals and made Asherah poles. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.
verses.textEnEsv: For he rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had broken down, and he erected altars to the Baals, and made Asheroth, and worshiped all the host of heaven and served them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he rebuilt the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; he raised up altars for the Baals, and made wooden images; and he worshiped all the host of heaven and served them.
verses.textEnNlt: He rebuilt the pagan shrines his father, Hezekiah, had broken down. He constructed altars for the images of Baal and set up Asherah poles. He also bowed before all the powers of the heavens and worshiped them.
verses.textEnNasb: For he rebuilt the high places which his father Hezekiah had torn down; he also set up altars for the Baals and made Asherim, and he worshiped all the heavenly lights and served them.
verses.textEn: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had demolished; he also erected altars to the Baals and made Asherah poles. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.

verses.textZh: 他又在耶和华的殿中筑坛，耶和华曾经指着这殿说："我的名必永远留在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在耶和华的殿中筑坛，耶和华曾经指着这殿说："我的名必永远留在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华的殿宇中筑坛－耶和华曾指着这殿说：「我的名必永远在耶路撒冷。」
verses.textEnNiv: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever."
verses.textEnEsv: And he built altars in the house of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem shall my name be forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: He also built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem shall My name be forever."
verses.textEnNlt: He built pagan altars in the Temple of the Lord , the place where the Lord had said, "My name will remain in Jerusalem forever."
verses.textEnNasb: He built altars in the house of the Lord of which the Lord had said, "My name shall be in Jerusalem forever."
verses.textEn: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever."

verses.textZh: 玛拿西在耶和华殿的两院中，为天上的万象筑坛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西在耶和华殿的两院中，为天上的万象筑坛，
verses.textZhCuv: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，
verses.textEnNiv: In both courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.
verses.textEnEsv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He built these altars for all the powers of the heavens in both courtyards of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: He built altars for all the heavenly lights in the two courtyards of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: In both courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.

verses.textZh: 并且在欣嫩子谷把自己的儿女用火烧为祭，又占卜、行邪术、用法术、交鬼和通灵；作了很多耶和华看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且在欣嫩子谷把自己的儿女用火烧为祭，又占卜、行邪术、用法术、交鬼和通灵；作了很多耶和华看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 并在欣嫩子谷使他的儿女经火，又观兆，用法术，行邪术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气，
verses.textEnNiv: He sacrificed his children in the fire in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, practiced divination and witchcraft, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: And he burned his sons as an offering in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, and used fortune-telling and omens and sorcery, and dealt with mediums and with necromancers. He did much evil in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he caused his sons to pass through the fire in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom; he practiced soothsaying, used witchcraft and sorcery, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh also sacrificed his own sons in the fire in the valley of Ben-Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and he consulted with mediums and psychics. He did much that was evil in the Lord ’s sight, arousing his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of Ben-hinnom; and he practiced witchcraft, used divination, practiced sorcery, and dealt with mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the sight of the Lord, provoking Him to anger.
verses.textEn: He sacrificed his children in the fire in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, practiced divination and witchcraft, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.

verses.textZh: 他又把他所做的雕像立在神的殿中，神曾经指着这殿，对大卫和他的儿子所罗门说："我要在这殿里，和在我从以色列各支派中拣选的耶路撒冷中，立我的名，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把他所做的雕像立在神的殿中，神曾经指着这殿，对大卫和他的儿子所罗门说："我要在这殿里，和在我从以色列各支派中拣选的耶路撒冷中，立我的名，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在神殿内立雕刻的偶像。神曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说：「我在以色列各支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He took the image he had made and put it in God’s temple, of which God had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.
verses.textEnEsv: And the carved image of the idol that he had made he set in the house of God, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: He even set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh even took a carved idol he had made and set it up in God’s Temple, the very place where God had told David and his son Solomon: "My name will be honored forever in this Temple and in Jerusalem—the city I have chosen from among all the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he put the carved image of the idol which he had made in the house of God, of which God had said to David and his son Solomon, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever;
verses.textEn: He took the image he had made and put it in God’s temple, of which God had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.

verses.textZh: 只要以色列人谨守遵行我借着摩西吩咐他们的一切律法、律例和典章，我就决不再使他们的脚离开我赐给他们列祖的地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要以色列人谨守遵行我借着摩西吩咐他们的一切律法、律例和典章，我就决不再使他们的脚离开我赐给他们列祖的地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人若谨守遵行我藉摩西所吩咐他们的一切法度、律例、典章，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites leave the land I assigned to your ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them concerning all the laws, decrees and regulations given through Moses."
verses.textEnEsv: and I will no more remove the foot of Israel from the land that I appointed for your fathers, if only they will be careful to do all that I have commanded them, all the law, the statutes, and the rules given through Moses."
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will not again remove the foot of Israel from the land which I have appointed for your fathers—only if they are careful to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses."
verses.textEnNlt: If the Israelites will be careful to obey my commands—all the laws, decrees, and regulations given through Moses—I will not send them into exile from this land that I set aside for your ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: and I will not remove the foot of Israel again from the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will take care to do everything that I have commanded them according to all the Law, the statutes, and the ordinances given through Moses."
verses.textEn: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites leave the land I assigned to your ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them concerning all the laws, decrees and regulations given through Moses."

verses.textZh: 可是玛拿西却引诱犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前除灭的列国更厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是玛拿西却引诱犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前除灭的列国更厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西引诱犹大和耶路撒冷的居民，以致他们行恶比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: But Manasseh led Judah and the people of Jerusalem astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Manasseh led Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem astray, to do more evil than the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to do more evil than the nations whom the Lord had destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But Manasseh led the people of Judah and Jerusalem to do even more evil than the pagan nations that the Lord had destroyed when the people of Israel entered the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So Manasseh encouraged Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to do more evil than the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: But Manasseh led Judah and the people of Jerusalem astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 耶和华曾警告玛拿西和他的人民，他们却不理会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华曾警告玛拿西和他的人民，他们却不理会。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华警戒玛拿西和他的百姓，他们却是不听。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they paid no attention.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they paid no attention.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they would not listen.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they ignored all his warnings.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they paid no attention.
verses.textEn: The Lord spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they paid no attention.

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华领亚述王的将帅来攻打他们，用钩子钩着玛拿西，用铜炼锁住他，把他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华领亚述王的将帅来攻打他们，用钩子钩着玛拿西，用铜炼锁住他，把他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华使亚述王的将帅来攻击他们，用铙钩钩住玛拿西，用铜链锁住他，带到巴比伦去。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord brought against them the army commanders of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh prisoner, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord brought upon them the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria, who captured Manasseh with hooks and bound him with chains of bronze and brought him to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord brought upon them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh with hooks, bound him with bronze fetters, and carried him off to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord sent the commanders of the Assyrian armies, and they took Manasseh prisoner. They put a ring through his nose, bound him in bronze chains, and led him away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord brought the commanders of the army of the king of Assyria against them, and they captured Manasseh with hooks, bound him with bronze chains, and led him to Babylon.
verses.textEn: So the Lord brought against them the army commanders of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh prisoner, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西在急难的时候，就恳求耶和华他的神，并且在他列祖的神面前非常谦卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西在急难的时候，就恳求耶和华他的神，并且在他列祖的神面前非常谦卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在急难的时候，就恳求耶和华－他的神，且在他列祖的神面前极其自卑。
verses.textEnNiv: In his distress he sought the favor of the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he was in distress, he entreated the favor of the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he was in affliction, he implored the Lord his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: But while in deep distress, Manasseh sought the Lord his God and sincerely humbled himself before the God of his ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: When he was in distress, he appeased the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
verses.textEn: In his distress he sought the favor of the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his ancestors.

verses.textZh: 他向耶和华祷告，耶和华应允他的恳求，垂听他的祈求，使他归回耶路撒冷，恢复他的王位。玛拿西这才知道只有耶和华是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向耶和华祷告，耶和华应允他的恳求，垂听他的祈求，使他归回耶路撒冷，恢复他的王位。玛拿西这才知道只有耶和华是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他祈祷耶和华，耶和华就允准他的祈求，垂听他的祷告，使他归回耶路撒冷，仍坐国位。玛拿西这才知道惟独耶和华是神。
verses.textEnNiv: And when he prayed to him, the Lord was moved by his entreaty and listened to his plea; so he brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord is God.
verses.textEnEsv: He prayed to him, and God was moved by his entreaty and heard his plea and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord was God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and prayed to Him; and He received his entreaty, heard his supplication, and brought him back to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lordwas God.
verses.textEnNlt: And when he prayed, the Lord listened to him and was moved by his request. So the Lord brought Manasseh back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh finally realized that the Lord alone is God!
verses.textEnNasb: When he prayed to Him, He was moved by him and heard his pleading, and brought him back to Jerusalem to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lordalone is God.
verses.textEn: And when he prayed to him, the Lord was moved by his entreaty and listened to his plea; so he brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord is God.

verses.textZh: 此后，玛拿西在大卫城外，从谷中的基训西边起直到鱼门口，建了一道城墙，围绕着俄斐勒，他把城墙建得很高；又在犹大各设防城里，派驻军长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，玛拿西在大卫城外，从谷中的基训西边起直到鱼门口，建了一道城墙，围绕着俄斐勒，他把城墙建得很高；又在犹大各设防城里，派驻军长。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，玛拿西在大卫城外，从谷内基训西边直到鱼门口，建筑城墙，环绕俄斐勒，这墙筑得甚高；又在犹大各坚固城内设立勇敢的军长；
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward he rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David, west of the Gihon spring in the valley, as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate and encircling the hill of Ophel; he also made it much higher. He stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward he built an outer wall for the city of David west of Gihon, in the valley, and for the entrance into the Fish Gate, and carried it around Ophel, and raised it to a very great height. He also put commanders of the army in all the fortified cities in Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this he built a wall outside the City of David on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate; and it enclosed Ophel, and he raised it to a very great height. Then he put military captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: After this Manasseh rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David, from west of the Gihon Spring in the Kidron Valley to the Fish Gate, and continuing around the hill of Ophel. He built the wall very high. And he stationed his military officers in all of the fortified towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after this he built the outer wall of the city of David on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, up to the entrance of the Fish Gate; and he encircled the Ophel with it and made it very high. Then he put army commanders in all the fortified cities in Judah.
verses.textEn: Afterward he rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David, west of the Gihon spring in the valley, as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate and encircling the hill of Ophel; he also made it much higher. He stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities in Judah.

verses.textZh: 又从耶和华的殿中除掉外族人的神和偶像，又把他在耶和华殿的山和在耶路撒冷所筑的一切坛，都拋出城外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从耶和华的殿中除掉外族人的神和偶像，又把他在耶和华殿的山和在耶路撒冷所筑的一切坛，都拋出城外。
verses.textZhCuv: 并除掉外邦人的神像与耶和华殿中的偶像，又将他在耶和华殿的山上和耶路撒冷所筑的各坛都拆毁抛在城外；
verses.textEnNiv: He got rid of the foreign gods and removed the image from the temple of the Lord , as well as all the altars he had built on the temple hill and in Jerusalem; and he threw them out of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took away the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the Lord , and all the altars that he had built on the mountain of the house of the Lord and in Jerusalem, and he threw them outside of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: He took away the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the Lord, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the Lord and in Jerusalem; and he cast them out of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh also removed the foreign gods and the idol from the Lord ’s Temple. He tore down all the altars he had built on the hill where the Temple stood and all the altars that were in Jerusalem, and he dumped them outside the city.
verses.textEnNasb: He also removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the Lord, as well as all the altars which he had built on the mountain of the house of the Lord and in Jerusalem, and he threw them outside the city.
verses.textEn: He got rid of the foreign gods and removed the image from the temple of the Lord , as well as all the altars he had built on the temple hill and in Jerusalem; and he threw them out of the city.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西重修了耶和华的祭坛，在坛上献上平安祭和感恩祭，又吩咐犹大人事奉耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西重修了耶和华的祭坛，在坛上献上平安祭和感恩祭，又吩咐犹大人事奉耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 重修耶和华的祭坛，在坛上献平安祭、感谢祭，吩咐犹大人事奉耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed fellowship offerings and thank offerings on it, and told Judah to serve the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: He also restored the altar of the Lord and offered on it sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving, and he commanded Judah to serve the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also repaired the altar of the Lord, sacrificed peace offerings and thank offerings on it, and commanded Judah to serve the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed peace offerings and thanksgiving offerings on it. He also encouraged the people of Judah to worship the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He set up the altar of the Lord and sacrificed peace offerings and thanksgiving offerings on it; and he ordered Judah to serve the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed fellowship offerings and thank offerings on it, and told Judah to serve the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 可是人民仍然在邱坛上献祭，尽管只向耶和华他们的神献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是人民仍然在邱坛上献祭，尽管只向耶和华他们的神献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓却仍在邱坛上献祭，只献给耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The people, however, continued to sacrifice at the high places, but only to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, the people still sacrificed at the high places, but only to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed on the high places, but only to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: However, the people still sacrificed at the pagan shrines, though only to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the people still sacrificed on the high places, although only to the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: The people, however, continued to sacrifice at the high places, but only to the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西其余的事迹，包括他对他的神的祷告，和那些先见奉耶和华以色列的神的名向他所说的话，都记在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西其余的事迹，包括他对他的神的祷告，和那些先见奉耶和华以色列的神的名向他所说的话，都记在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西其余的事和祷告他神的话，并先见奉耶和华－以色列神的名警戒他的言语，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Manasseh’s reign, including his prayer to his God and the words the seers spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, are written in the annals of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, behold, they are in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the Lord God of Israel, indeed they arewritten in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Manasseh’s reign, his prayer to God, and the words the seers spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the Lord God of Israel, behold, they are among the records of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Manasseh’s reign, including his prayer to his God and the words the seers spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, are written in the annals of the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他的祷告，神怎样应允他的恳求，他谦卑下来以前的一切罪恶和过犯，以及他在甚么地方建筑邱坛，设立亚舍拉和偶像，都记在先见 的言行录上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的祷告，神怎样应允他的恳求，他谦卑下来以前的一切罪恶和过犯，以及他在甚么地方建筑邱坛，设立亚舍拉和偶像，都记在先见 的言行录上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的祷告，与神怎样应允他，他未自卑以前的罪愆过犯，并在何处建筑邱坛，设立亚舍拉和雕刻的偶像，都写在何赛的书上。
verses.textEnNiv: His prayer and how God was moved by his entreaty, as well as all his sins and unfaithfulness, and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself—all these are written in the records of the seers.
verses.textEnEsv: And his prayer, and how God was moved by his entreaty, and all his sin and his faithlessness, and the sites on which he built high places and set up the Asherim and the images, before he humbled himself, behold, they are written in the Chronicles of the Seers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also his prayer and howGod received his entreaty, and all his sin and trespass, and the sites where he built high places and set up wooden images and carved images, before he was humbled, indeed they are written among the sayings of Hozai.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh’s prayer, the account of the way God answered him, and an account of all his sins and unfaithfulness are recorded in The Record of the Seers. It includes a list of the locations where he built pagan shrines and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself and repented.
verses.textEnNasb: His prayer also and how God was moved by him, and all his sin, his unfaithfulness, and the sites on which he built high places and erected the Asherim and the carved images, before he humbled himself, behold, they are written in the records of Hozai.
verses.textEn: His prayer and how God was moved by his entreaty, as well as all his sins and unfaithfulness, and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself—all these are written in the records of the seers.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在他的宫中；他的儿子亚们接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西和他的列祖同睡，埋葬在他的宫中；他的儿子亚们接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己的宫院里。他儿子亚们接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his house, and Amon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Manasseh rested with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house. Then his son Amon reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Manasseh died, he was buried in his palace. Then his son Amon became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Manasseh lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house. And his son Amon became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 亚们登基的时候，是二十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共两年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚们登基的时候，是二十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共两年。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。
verses.textEnNiv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
verses.textEnEsv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
verses.textEnNasb: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned for two years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，像他父亲玛拿西所行的一样；亚们向他父亲玛拿西所做的一切雕像献祭，并且事奉它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，像他父亲玛拿西所行的一样；亚们向他父亲玛拿西所做的一切雕像献祭，并且事奉它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父玛拿西所行的，祭祀事奉他父玛拿西所雕刻的偶像，
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done. Amon worshiped and offered sacrifices to all the idols Manasseh had made.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , as Manasseh his father had done. Amon sacrificed to all the images that Manasseh his father had made, and served them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh had done; for Amon sacrificed to all the carved images which his father Manasseh had made, and served them.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as his father, Manasseh, had done. He worshiped and sacrificed to all the idols his father had made.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done, and Amon sacrificed to all the carved images which his father Manasseh had made, and he served them.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done. Amon worshiped and offered sacrifices to all the idols Manasseh had made.

verses.textZh: 他没有在耶和华面前谦卑，像他父亲玛拿西谦卑一样；这亚们所犯的罪过越来越多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他没有在耶和华面前谦卑，像他父亲玛拿西谦卑一样；这亚们所犯的罪过越来越多。
verses.textZhCuv: 不在耶和华面前像他父玛拿西自卑。这亚们所犯的罪越犯越大。
verses.textEnNiv: But unlike his father Manasseh, he did not humble himself before the Lord ; Amon increased his guilt.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did not humble himself before the Lord , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself, but this Amon incurred guilt more and more.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did not humble himself before the Lord, as his father Manasseh had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
verses.textEnNlt: But unlike his father, he did not humble himself before the Lord . Instead, Amon sinned even more.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, he did not humble himself before the Lord as his father Manasseh had done, but Amon multiplied his guilt.
verses.textEn: But unlike his father Manasseh, he did not humble himself before the Lord ; Amon increased his guilt.

verses.textZh: 后来，他的臣仆阴谋造反，在宫中把他杀死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，他的臣仆阴谋造反，在宫中把他杀死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的臣仆背叛，在宫里杀了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.
verses.textEnEsv: And his servants conspired against him and put him to death in his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his servants conspired against him, and killed him in his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Amon’s own officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally, his servants conspired against him and put him to death in his own house.
verses.textEn: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.

verses.textZh: 但犹大的人民把所有反叛亚们王的人都击杀了，并且立他的儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但犹大的人民把所有反叛亚们王的人都击杀了，并且立他的儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of the land struck down all those who had conspired against King Amon. And the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people of the land executed all those who had conspired against King Amon. Then the people of the land made his son Josiah king in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon, and they made his son Josiah the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: But the people of the land killed all the conspirators against King Amon, and the people of the land made his son Josiah king in his place.
verses.textEn: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.

verses.textZh: 约西亚登基的时候是八岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共三十一年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚登基的时候是八岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共三十一年。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.
verses.textEnEsv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.
verses.textEnNasb: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned for thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为正的事，效法他先祖大卫所行的，不偏左，也不偏右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为正的事，效法他先祖大卫所行的，不偏左，也不偏右。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫所行的，不偏左右。
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , and walked in the ways of David his father; and he did not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight and followed the example of his ancestor David. He did not turn away from doing what was right.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of his father David and did not turn aside to the right or the left.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

verses.textZh: 他在位第八年，还是年幼的时候，就开始寻求他先祖大卫的神。到了第十二年，他就开始洁净犹大和耶路撒冷，除掉邱坛、亚舍拉、雕像和铸像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在位第八年，还是年幼的时候，就开始寻求他先祖大卫的神。到了第十二年，他就开始洁净犹大和耶路撒冷，除掉邱坛、亚舍拉、雕像和铸像。
verses.textZhCuv: 他作王第八年，尚且年幼，就寻求他祖大卫的神。到了十二年才洁净犹大和耶路撒冷，除掉邱坛、木偶、雕刻的像，和铸造的像。
verses.textEnNiv: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of his father David. In his twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of high places, Asherah poles and idols.
verses.textEnEsv: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet a boy, he began to seek the God of David his father, and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherim, and the carved and the metal images.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of his father David; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the wooden images, the carved images, and the molded images.
verses.textEnNlt: During the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his ancestor David. Then in the twelfth year he began to purify Judah and Jerusalem, destroying all the pagan shrines, the Asherah poles, and the carved idols and cast images.
verses.textEnNasb: For in the eighth year of his reign while he was still a youth, he began to seek the God of his father David; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherim, the carved images, and the cast metal images.
verses.textEn: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of his father David. In his twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of high places, Asherah poles and idols.

verses.textZh: 众人在他面前拆毁了巴力的祭坛，他亲自打碎了坛上高高的香坛，又把亚舍拉、雕像和铸像砍碎成灰，撒在向这些偶像献过祭的人的坟上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人在他面前拆毁了巴力的祭坛，他亲自打碎了坛上高高的香坛，又把亚舍拉、雕像和铸像砍碎成灰，撒在向这些偶像献过祭的人的坟上。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人在他面前拆毁巴力的坛，砍断坛上高高的日像，又把木偶和雕刻的像，并铸造的像打碎成灰，撒在祭偶像人的坟上，
verses.textEnNiv: Under his direction the altars of the Baals were torn down; he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them, and smashed the Asherah poles and the idols. These he broke to pieces and scattered over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they chopped down the altars of the Baals in his presence, and he cut down the incense altars that stood above them. And he broke in pieces the Asherim and the carved and the metal images, and he made dust of them and scattered it over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence, and the incense altars which were above them he cut down; and the wooden images, the carved images, and the molded images he broke in pieces, and made dust of them and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
verses.textEnNlt: He ordered that the altars of Baal be demolished and that the incense altars which stood above them be broken down. He also made sure that the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images were smashed and scattered over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
verses.textEnNasb: They tore down the altars of the Baals in his presence, and he chopped down the incense altars that were high above them; also he broke in pieces the Asherim, the carved images, and the cast metal images, and ground them to powder, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
verses.textEn: Under his direction the altars of the Baals were torn down; he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them, and smashed the Asherah poles and the idols. These he broke to pieces and scattered over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

verses.textZh: 他把祭司的骨头烧在他们的祭坛上，这样就洁净了犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把祭司的骨头烧在他们的祭坛上，这样就洁净了犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 将他们祭司的骸骨烧在坛上，洁净了犹大和耶路撒冷；
verses.textEnNiv: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and so he purged Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: He also burned the bones of the priests on their altars and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He burned the bones of the pagan priests on their own altars, and so he purified Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he burned the bones of the priests on their altars and purged Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and so he purged Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他又在玛拿西、以法莲、西缅，以至拿弗他利的各城，以及它们周围荒废的地方，都这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在玛拿西、以法莲、西缅，以至拿弗他利的各城，以及它们周围荒废的地方，都这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在玛拿西、以法莲、西缅、拿弗他利各城，和四围破坏之处，都这样行；
verses.textEnNiv: In the towns of Manasseh, Ephraim and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them,
verses.textEnEsv: And in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, and as far as Naphtali, in their ruins all around,
verses.textEnNkjv: And sohedid in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Naphtali and all around, with axes.
verses.textEnNlt: He did the same thing in the towns of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even as far as Naphtali, and in the regions all around them.
verses.textEnNasb: In the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon, and as far as Naphtali, in their surrounding spaces,
verses.textEn: In the towns of Manasseh, Ephraim and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them,

verses.textZh: 他拆毁了祭坛，把亚舍拉和雕刻的偶像打碎，破碎了以色列全地所有的香坛，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拆毁了祭坛，把亚舍拉和雕刻的偶像打碎，破碎了以色列全地所有的香坛，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拆毁祭坛，把木偶和雕刻的像打碎成灰，砍断以色列遍地所有的日像，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: he tore down the altars and the Asherah poles and crushed the idols to powder and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout Israel. Then he went back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: he broke down the altars and beat the Asherim and the images into powder and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had broken down the altars and the wooden images, had beaten the carved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He destroyed the pagan altars and the Asherah poles, and he crushed the idols into dust. He cut down all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Finally, he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: he also tore down the altars and crushed the Asherim and the carved images into powder, and chopped down all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: he tore down the altars and the Asherah poles and crushed the idols to powder and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout Israel. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 约西亚在位第十八年，洁净犹大地和圣殿以后，就差派亚萨利雅的儿子沙番、市长玛西雅和约哈斯的儿子史官约亚，去修筑耶和华他的神的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚在位第十八年，洁净犹大地和圣殿以后，就差派亚萨利雅的儿子沙番、市长玛西雅和约哈斯的儿子史官约亚，去修筑耶和华他的神的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚王十八年，净地净殿之后，就差遣亚萨利雅的儿子沙番、邑宰玛西雅、约哈斯的儿子史官约亚去修理耶和华－他神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, to purify the land and the temple, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah and Maaseiah the ruler of the city, with Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the temple of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had cleansed the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the temple, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNlt: In the eighteenth year of his reign, after he had purified the land and the Temple, Josiah appointed Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of Jerusalem, and Joah son of Joahaz, the royal historian, to repair the Temple of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah an official of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the secretary, to repair the house of the Lord his God.
verses.textEn: In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, to purify the land and the temple, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah and Maaseiah the ruler of the city, with Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the temple of the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 于是他们来见大祭司希勒家，把献给神的殿的银子交给他。这银子都是守门的利未人，从玛拿西、以法莲和以色列所有的余民，以及犹大、便雅悯和耶路撒冷的居民那里收集来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们来见大祭司希勒家，把献给神的殿的银子交给他。这银子都是守门的利未人，从玛拿西、以法莲和以色列所有的余民，以及犹大、便雅悯和耶路撒冷的居民那里收集来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就去见大祭司希勒家，将奉到神殿的银子交给他；这银子是看守殿门的利未人从玛拿西、以法莲，和一切以色列剩下的人，以及犹大、便雅悯众人，并耶路撒冷的居民收来的。
verses.textEnNiv: They went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the temple of God, which the Levites who were the gatekeepers had collected from the people of Manasseh, Ephraim and the entire remnant of Israel and from all the people of Judah and Benjamin and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had collected from Manasseh and Ephraim and from all the remnant of Israel and from all Judah and Benjamin and from the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites who kept the doors had gathered from the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, from all the remnant of Israel, from all Judah and Benjamin, and which they had brought back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: They gave Hilkiah the high priest the money that had been collected by the Levites who served as gatekeepers at the Temple of God. The gifts were brought by people from Manasseh, Ephraim, and from all the remnant of Israel, as well as from all Judah, Benjamin, and the people of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites, the doorkeepers, had collected from Manasseh and Ephraim, and from all the remnant of Israel, from all Judah and Benjamin and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: They went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the temple of God, which the Levites who were the gatekeepers had collected from the people of Manasseh, Ephraim and the entire remnant of Israel and from all the people of Judah and Benjamin and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们又把银子交给在耶和华殿里负责监察的人；他们又把银子发给在耶和华殿里作工的工人，去修补圣殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把银子交给在耶和华殿里负责监察的人；他们又把银子发给在耶和华殿里作工的工人，去修补圣殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将这银子交给耶和华殿里督工的，转交修理耶和华殿的工匠，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they entrusted it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the Lord ’s temple. These men paid the workers who repaired and restored the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And they gave it to the workmen who were working in the house of the Lord . And the workmen who were working in the house of the Lord gave it for repairing and restoring the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they put it in the hand of the foremen who had the oversight of the house of the Lord; and they gave it to the workmen who worked in the house of the Lord, to repair and restore the house.
verses.textEnNlt: He entrusted the money to the men assigned to supervise the restoration of the Lord ’s Temple. Then they paid the workers who did the repairs and renovation of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they handed it over to the workmen who had the oversight of the house of the Lord, and the workmen who were working in the house of the Lord used it to restore and repair the house.
verses.textEn: Then they entrusted it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the Lord ’s temple. These men paid the workers who repaired and restored the temple.

verses.textZh: 他们把银子交给木匠和石匠，去购买凿好的石头和作木架与横梁的木材，修补犹大列王毁坏了的殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把银子交给木匠和石匠，去购买凿好的石头和作木架与横梁的木材，修补犹大列王毁坏了的殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是交给木匠、石匠，买凿成的石头和架木与栋梁，修犹大王所毁坏的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to purchase dressed stone, and timber for joists and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to fall into ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: They gave it to the carpenters and the builders to buy quarried stone, and timber for binders and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had let go to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gave it to the craftsmen and builders to buy hewn stone and timber for beams, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: They hired carpenters and builders, who purchased finished stone for the walls and timber for the rafters and beams. They restored what earlier kings of Judah had allowed to fall into ruin.
verses.textEnNasb: They in turn gave it to the carpenters and the builders to buy quarried stone and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had let go to ruin.
verses.textEn: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to purchase dressed stone, and timber for joists and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to fall into ruin.

verses.textZh: 这些人忠心地工作；管理他们的督工是利未人米拉利的子孙雅哈和俄巴底；监管他们的是哥辖的子孙撒迦利雅和米书兰；还有所有精通乐器的利未人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人忠心地工作；管理他们的督工是利未人米拉利的子孙雅哈和俄巴底；监管他们的是哥辖的子孙撒迦利雅和米书兰；还有所有精通乐器的利未人，
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人办事诚实，督工的是利未人米拉利的子孙雅哈、俄巴底；督催的是哥辖的子孙撒迦利亚、米书兰；还有善于作乐的利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: The workers labored faithfully. Over them to direct them were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites descended from Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, descended from Kohath. The Levites—all who were skilled in playing musical instruments—
verses.textEnEsv: And the men did the work faithfully. Over them were set Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to have oversight. The Levites, all who were skillful with instruments of music,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to supervise. Othersof the Levites, all of whom were skillful with instruments of music,
verses.textEnNlt: The workers served faithfully under the leadership of Jahath and Obadiah, Levites of the Merarite clan, and Zechariah and Meshullam, Levites of the Kohathite clan. Other Levites, all of whom were skilled musicians,
verses.textEnNasb: The men did the work faithfully with foremen over them to supervise: Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites of the sons of Merari, Zechariah and Meshullam of the sons of the Kohathites, and the Levites, all who were skillful with musical instruments.
verses.textEn: The workers labored faithfully. Over them to direct them were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites descended from Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, descended from Kohath. The Levites—all who were skilled in playing musical instruments—

verses.textZh: 管理扛抬的，并且监管所有作各种工作的人；利未人中，也有作书记、作职员和作守门的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理扛抬的，并且监管所有作各种工作的人；利未人中，也有作书记、作职员和作守门的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又监管扛抬的人，督催一切做工的。利未人中也有作书记、作司事、作守门的。
verses.textEnNiv: had charge of the laborers and supervised all the workers from job to job. Some of the Levites were secretaries, scribes and gatekeepers.
verses.textEnEsv: were over the burden-bearers and directed all who did work in every kind of service, and some of the Levites were scribes and officials and gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNkjv: were over the burden bearers and were overseers of all who did work in any kind of service. And some of the Levites were scribes, officers, and gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNlt: were put in charge of the laborers of the various trades. Still others assisted as secretaries, officials, and gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNasb: They were also in charge of the burden bearers, and supervised all the workmen from job to job; and some of the Levites were scribes, and officials, and gatekeepers.
verses.textEn: had charge of the laborers and supervised all the workers from job to job. Some of the Levites were secretaries, scribes and gatekeepers.

verses.textZh: 他们把献给耶和华殿的银子拿出来的时候，希勒家祭司发现了耶和华藉摩西所传的律法书。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把献给耶和华殿的银子拿出来的时候，希勒家祭司发现了耶和华藉摩西所传的律法书。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将奉到耶和华殿的银子运出来的时候，祭司希勒家偶然得了摩西所传耶和华的律法书。
verses.textEnNiv: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the temple of the Lord , Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lord that had been given through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: While they were bringing out the money that had been brought into the house of the Lord , Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lord given through Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the Lord, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lordgiven by Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: While they were bringing out the money collected at the Lord ’s Temple, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lord that was written by Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: When they were bringing out the money which had been brought into the house of the Lord, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lordgiven by Moses.
verses.textEn: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the temple of the Lord , Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lord that had been given through Moses.

verses.textZh: 希勒家对书记沙番说："我在耶和华的殿里发现了律法书。"希勒家就把书交给沙番。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希勒家对书记沙番说："我在耶和华的殿里发现了律法书。"希勒家就把书交给沙番。
verses.textZhCuv: 希勒家对书记沙番说：「我在耶和华殿里得了律法书。」遂将书递给沙番。
verses.textEnNiv: Hilkiah said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord ." He gave it to Shaphan.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord ." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
verses.textEnNlt: Hilkiah said to Shaphan the court secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the Lord ’s Temple!" Then Hilkiah gave the scroll to Shaphan.
verses.textEnNasb: Hilkiah responded and said to Shaphan the scribe, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
verses.textEn: Hilkiah said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord ." He gave it to Shaphan.

verses.textZh: 沙番把书带到王那里，同时向王报告："你交托你仆人的事，他们都办妥了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙番把书带到王那里，同时向王报告："你交托你仆人的事，他们都办妥了。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙番把书拿到王那里，回复王说：「凡交给仆人们办的都办理了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shaphan took the book to the king and reported to him: "Your officials are doing everything that has been committed to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Shaphan brought the book to the king, and further reported to the king, "All that was committed to your servants they are doing.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Shaphan carried the book to the king, bringing the king word, saying, "All that was committed to your servants they are doing.
verses.textEnNlt: Shaphan took the scroll to the king and reported, "Your officials are doing everything they were assigned to do.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Shaphan brought the book to the king and reported further word to the king, saying, "Everything that was entrusted to your servants, they are doing.
verses.textEn: Then Shaphan took the book to the king and reported to him: "Your officials are doing everything that has been committed to them.

verses.textZh: 他们把在耶和华殿里的银子倒出来，交给监督和作工的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把在耶和华殿里的银子倒出来，交给监督和作工的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华殿里的银子倒出来，交给督工的和匠人的手里了。」
verses.textEnNiv: They have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the supervisors and workers."
verses.textEnEsv: They have emptied out the money that was found in the house of the Lord and have given it into the hand of the overseers and the workmen."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they have gathered the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and the workmen."
verses.textEnNlt: The money that was collected at the Temple of the Lord has been turned over to the supervisors and workmen."
verses.textEnNasb: They have also emptied out the money which was found in the house of the Lord, and have handed it over to the supervisors and the workmen."
verses.textEn: They have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the supervisors and workers."

verses.textZh: 书记沙番又告诉王，说："希勒家祭司还交给我一卷书卷。"于是沙番在王面前诵读那书。
verses.textZhCnvs: 书记沙番又告诉王，说："希勒家祭司还交给我一卷书卷。"于是沙番在王面前诵读那书。
verses.textZhCuv: 书记沙番又对王说：「祭司希勒家递给我一卷书。」沙番就在王面前读那书。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Shaphan the secretary told the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Shaphan also told the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a scroll." So Shaphan read it to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe informed the king, saying, "Hilkiah the priest gave me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.
verses.textEn: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.

verses.textZh: 王一听见律法书上的话，就撕裂自己的衣服，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王一听见律法书上的话，就撕裂自己的衣服，
verses.textZhCuv: 王听见律法上的话，就撕裂衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his robes.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus it happened, when the king heard the words of the Law, that he tore his clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king heard what was written in the Law, he tore his clothes in despair.
verses.textEnNasb: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his clothes.
verses.textEn: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his robes.

verses.textZh: 吩咐希勒家和沙番的儿子亚希甘、米迦的儿子亚比顿、书记沙番，以及王的臣仆亚撒雅，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 吩咐希勒家和沙番的儿子亚希甘、米迦的儿子亚比顿、书记沙番，以及王的臣仆亚撒雅，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐希勒家与沙番的儿子亚希甘、米迦的儿子亚比顿、书记沙番，和王的臣仆亚撒雅说：
verses.textEnNiv: He gave these orders to Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:
verses.textEnEsv: And the king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gave these orders to Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Acbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the court secretary, and Asaiah the king’s personal adviser:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
verses.textEn: He gave these orders to Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:

verses.textZh: "你们去，为我、也为以色列和犹大的余民，求问耶和华关于我们发现的这书上的话；因为我们的列祖没有谨守耶和华的话，也没有照着这书上所记的一切去行，所以耶和华才向我们大发烈怒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们去，为我、也为以色列和犹大的余民，求问耶和华关于我们发现的这书上的话；因为我们的列祖没有谨守耶和华的话，也没有照着这书上所记的一切去行，所以耶和华才向我们大发烈怒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们去为我、为以色列和犹大剩下的人，以这书上的话求问耶和华；因我们列祖没有遵守耶和华的言语，没有照这书上所记的去行，耶和华的烈怒就倒在我们身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the remnant in Israel and Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that is poured out on us because those who have gone before us have not kept the word of the Lord ; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written in this book."
verses.textEnEsv: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the Lord that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord , to do according to all that is written in this book."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me, and for those who are left in Israel and Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is the wrath of the Lord that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord, to do according to all that is written in this book."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to the Temple and speak to the Lord for me and for all the remnant of Israel and Judah. Inquire about the words written in the scroll that has been found. For the Lord ’s great anger has been poured out on us because our ancestors have not obeyed the word of the Lord . We have not been doing everything this scroll says we must do."
verses.textEnNasb: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me and for those who are left in Israel and Judah, concerning the words of the book which has been found; for the wrath of the Lord which has poured out on us is great, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord, to act in accordance with everything that is written in this book."
verses.textEn: "Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the remnant in Israel and Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that is poured out on us because those who have gone before us have not kept the word of the Lord ; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written in this book."

verses.textZh: 于是希勒家和王所差派的人 去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服的沙龙的妻子；沙龙是哈斯拉的孙子、特瓦的儿子；户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区；他们对户勒大这样说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是希勒家和王所差派的人 去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服的沙龙的妻子；沙龙是哈斯拉的孙子、特瓦的儿子；户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区；他们对户勒大这样说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，希勒家和王所派的众人都去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服沙龙的妻，沙龙是哈斯拉的孙子、特瓦的儿子。户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区；他们请问于她。
verses.textEnNiv: Hilkiah and those the king had sent with him went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.
verses.textEnEsv: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had sent went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter) and spoke to her to that effect.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hilkiah and those the king hadappointed went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe. (She dwelt in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter.) And they spoke to her to that effect.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hilkiah and the other men went to the New Quarter of Jerusalem to consult with the prophet Huldah. She was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, the keeper of the Temple wardrobe.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had told went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the wardrobe (she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter); and they spoke to her regarding this.
verses.textEn: Hilkiah and those the king had sent with him went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.

verses.textZh: 她就回答他们："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们对那差你们来见我的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就回答他们："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们对那差你们来见我的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 她对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『你们可以回复那差遣你们来见我的人说，
verses.textEnNiv: She said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to them, "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she answered them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel, ‘Tell the man who sent you to Me,
verses.textEnNlt: She said to them, "The Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken! Go back and tell the man who sent you,
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said to them, "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to Me,
verses.textEn: She said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：我要按着在犹大王面前诵读的那卷书上所写的一切咒诅，降灾在这地和这地的居民身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：我要按着在犹大王面前诵读的那卷书上所写的一切咒诅，降灾在这地和这地的居民身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：我必照着在犹大王面前所读那书上的一切咒诅，降祸与这地和其上的居民；
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people—all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , Behold, I will bring disaster upon this place and upon its inhabitants, all the curses that are written in the book that was read before the king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will bring calamity on this place and on its inhabitants, all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah,
verses.textEnNlt: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this city and its people. All the curses written in the scroll that was read to the king of Judah will come true.
verses.textEnNasb: this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am bringing evil on this place and on its inhabitants, all the curses written in the book which they have read in the presence of the king of Judah.
verses.textEn: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people—all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah.

verses.textZh: 因为他们离弃了我，向别的神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒必倾倒在这地上，总不熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们离弃了我，向别的神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒必倾倒在这地上，总不熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们离弃我，向别神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒如火倒在这地上，总不息灭。』
verses.textEnNiv: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all that their hands have made, my anger will be poured out on this place and will not be quenched.’
verses.textEnEsv: Because they have forsaken me and have made offerings to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath will be poured out on this place and will not be quenched.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. Therefore My wrath will be poured out on this place, and not be quenched.’ " ’
verses.textEnNlt: For my people have abandoned me and offered sacrifices to pagan gods, and I am very angry with them for everything they have done. My anger will be poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’
verses.textEnNasb: Since they have abandoned Me and have burned incense to other gods, so that they may provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands, My wrath will be poured out on this place and it will not be quenched." ’
verses.textEn: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all that their hands have made, my anger will be poured out on this place and will not be quenched.’

verses.textZh: 至于那派你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样对他说：耶和华以色列的神这样说：论到你听见的话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那派你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样对他说：耶和华以色列的神这样说：论到你听见的话；
verses.textZhCuv: 然而差遣你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样回复他说：『耶和华－以色列的神如此说：至于你所听见的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:
verses.textEnEsv: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , thus shall you say to him, Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Regarding the words that you have heard,
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord, in this manner you shall speak to him, ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Concerning the words which you have heard—
verses.textEnNlt: "But go to the king of Judah who sent you to seek the Lord and tell him: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the message you have just heard:
verses.textEnNasb: But to the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of the Lord, this is what you shall say to him: ‘This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: In regard to the words which you have heard,
verses.textEn: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:

verses.textZh: 因为你听了我指着这地方和这里的居民所说的话，就心里感动，在神面前谦卑；你既然在我的面前谦卑，又撕裂衣服，在我的面前哭泣，所以我就垂听你的祷告；这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你听了我指着这地方和这里的居民所说的话，就心里感动，在神面前谦卑；你既然在我的面前谦卑，又撕裂衣服，在我的面前哭泣，所以我就垂听你的祷告；这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是听见我指着这地和其上居民所说的话，你便心里敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我应允了你。这是我－耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before God when you heard what he spoke against this place and its people, and because you humbled yourself before me and tore your robes and wept in my presence, I have heard you, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and its inhabitants, and you have humbled yourself before me and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its inhabitants, and you humbled yourself before Me, and you tore your clothes and wept before Me, I also have heard you," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You were sorry and humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this city and its people. You humbled yourself and tore your clothing in despair and wept before me in repentance. And I have indeed heard you, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and its inhabitants, and because you humbled yourself before Me, tore your clothes, and wept before Me, I have indeed heard you," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before God when you heard what he spoke against this place and its people, and because you humbled yourself before me and tore your robes and wept in my presence, I have heard you, declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必使你归到你的列祖那里去，你必平平安安归入你的坟墓。我所要降在这地方和这地上的居民身上的一切灾祸，你必不会亲眼看见。’"他们就把这番话回复王去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你归到你的列祖那里去，你必平平安安归入你的坟墓。我所要降在这地方和这地上的居民身上的一切灾祸，你必不会亲眼看见。’"他们就把这番话回复王去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你平平安安地归到坟墓，到你列祖那里，我要降与这地和其上居民的一切灾祸，你也不至亲眼看见。』」他们就回复王去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place and on those who live here.’ " So they took her answer back to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, and your eyes shall not see all the disaster that I will bring upon this place and its inhabitants.’" And they brought back word to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Surely I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace; and your eyes shall not see all the calamity which I will bring on this place and its inhabitants." ’ " So they brought back word to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will not send the promised disaster until after you have died and been buried in peace. You yourself will not see the disaster I am going to bring on this city and its people.’" So they took her message back to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace, so your eyes will not see all the evil which I am bringing on this place and its inhabitants." ’ " And they brought back word to the king.
verses.textEn: Now I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place and on those who live here.’ " So they took her answer back to the king.

verses.textZh: 于是王派人把犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老都召集了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王派人把犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老都召集了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 王差遣人招聚犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king sent word and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 王和犹大众人、耶路撒冷的居民、祭司、利未人，以及所有的人民，无论大小，都一同上耶和华的殿去；王就把在耶和华殿里发现的约书上的一切话，都诵读给他们听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和犹大众人、耶路撒冷的居民、祭司、利未人，以及所有的人民，无论大小，都一同上耶和华的殿去；王就把在耶和华殿里发现的约书上的一切话，都诵读给他们听。
verses.textZhCuv: 王和犹大众人，与耶路撒冷的居民，并祭司利未人，以及所有的百姓，无论大小，都一同上到耶和华的殿；王就把殿里所得的约书念给他们听。
verses.textEnNiv: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the Levites—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the king went up to the house of the Lord , with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the priests and the Levites, all the people both great and small. And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The king went up to the house of the Lord, with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests and the Levites, and all the people, great and small. And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant which had been found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And the king went up to the Temple of the Lord with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, along with the priests and the Levites—all the people from the greatest to the least. There the king read to them the entire Book of the Covenant that had been found in the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: The king went up to the house of the Lord with all the men of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests, the Levites, and all the people, from the greatest to the least; and he read in their presence all the words of the Book of the Covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the Levites—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 王站在他的位上，在耶和华面前立约，要一心一意跟随耶和华，谨守他的诫命、法度和律例，实行这书上所记立约的誓言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王站在他的位上，在耶和华面前立约，要一心一意跟随耶和华，谨守他的诫命、法度和律例，实行这书上所记立约的誓言。
verses.textZhCuv: 王站在他的地位上，在耶和华面前立约，要尽心尽性地顺从耶和华，遵守他的诫命、法度、律例，成就这书上所记的约言；
verses.textEnNiv: The king stood by his pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, and to obey the words of the covenant written in this book.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king stood in his place and made a covenant before the Lord , to walk after the Lord and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes, with all his heart and all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king stood in his place and made a covenant before the Lord, to follow the Lord, and to keep His commandments and His testimonies and His statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
verses.textEnNlt: The king took his place of authority beside the pillar and renewed the covenant in the Lord ’s presence. He pledged to obey the Lord by keeping all his commands, laws, and decrees with all his heart and soul. He promised to obey all the terms of the covenant that were written in the scroll.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king stood in his place and made a covenant before the Lord to walk after the Lord, and to keep His commandments, His testimonies, and His statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that are written in this book.
verses.textEn: The king stood by his pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, and to obey the words of the covenant written in this book.

verses.textZh: 他又使所有在耶路撒冷和便雅悯的人，都顺从这约。于是耶路撒冷的居民，都遵照他们列祖的神的约而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又使所有在耶路撒冷和便雅悯的人，都顺从这约。于是耶路撒冷的居民，都遵照他们列祖的神的约而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 又使住耶路撒冷和便雅悯的人都服从这约。于是耶路撒冷的居民都遵行他们列祖之神的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin pledge themselves to it; the people of Jerusalem did this in accordance with the covenant of God, the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he made all who were present in Jerusalem and in Benjamin join in it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made all who were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin take a stand. So the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: And he required everyone in Jerusalem and the people of Benjamin to make a similar pledge. The people of Jerusalem did so, renewing their covenant with God, the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, he made all who were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin stand with him. So the inhabitants of Jerusalem acted in accordance with the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin pledge themselves to it; the people of Jerusalem did this in accordance with the covenant of God, the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 约西亚在以色列人所属的各地，把一切可憎的物尽都除掉，使所有在以色列的人都事奉耶和华他们的神。约西亚在世的日子，人民都跟随耶和华他们列祖的神，总不离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚在以色列人所属的各地，把一切可憎的物尽都除掉，使所有在以色列的人都事奉耶和华他们的神。约西亚在世的日子，人民都跟随耶和华他们列祖的神，总不离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚从以色列各处将一切可憎之物尽都除掉，使以色列境内的人都事奉耶和华－他们的神。约西亚在世的日子，就跟从耶和华－他们列祖的神，总不离开。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah removed all the detestable idols from all the territory belonging to the Israelites, and he had all who were present in Israel serve the Lord their God. As long as he lived, they did not fail to follow the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And Josiah took away all the abominations from all the territory that belonged to the people of Israel and made all who were present in Israel serve the Lord their God. All his days they did not turn away from following the Lord , the God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Josiah removed all the abominations from all the country that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were present in Israel diligently serve the Lord their God. All his days they did not depart from following the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: So Josiah removed all detestable idols from the entire land of Israel and required everyone to worship the Lord their God. And throughout the rest of his lifetime, they did not turn away from the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands belonging to the sons of Israel, and made all who were present in Israel serve the Lord their God. Throughout his lifetime they did not turn from following the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.textEn: Josiah removed all the detestable idols from all the territory belonging to the Israelites, and he had all who were present in Israel serve the Lord their God. As long as he lived, they did not fail to follow the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 约西亚在耶路撒冷守逾越节记念耶和华；正月十四日他们宰了逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚在耶路撒冷守逾越节记念耶和华；正月十四日他们宰了逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚在耶路撒冷向耶和华守逾越节。正月十四日，就宰了逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah celebrated the Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem, and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnEsv: Josiah kept a Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem. And they slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Josiah kept a Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem, and they slaughtered the Passover lambs on the fourteenth day of the first month.
