verses.textEnNlt: Then Josiah announced that the Passover of the Lord would be celebrated in Jerusalem, and so the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Josiah celebrated the Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem, and they slaughtered the Passover animals on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEn: Josiah celebrated the Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem, and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.textZh: 王指派各祭司的职务，又鼓励他们去作耶和华殿的事务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王指派各祭司的职务，又鼓励他们去作耶和华殿的事务。
verses.textZhCuv: 王分派祭司各尽其职，又勉励他们办耶和华殿中的事；
verses.textEnNiv: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: He appointed the priests to their offices and encouraged them in the service of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he set the priests in their duties and encouraged them for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah also assigned the priests to their duties and encouraged them in their work at the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He appointed the priests to their offices and encouraged them in the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 他又对那些教导以色列众人，分别为圣归耶和华的利未人说："你们要把圣约柜安放在以色列王大卫的儿子所罗门建造的殿里；不必再用肩膀扛抬。现在你们要服事耶和华你们的神，服事他的子民以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对那些教导以色列众人，分别为圣归耶和华的利未人说："你们要把圣约柜安放在以色列王大卫的儿子所罗门建造的殿里；不必再用肩膀扛抬。现在你们要服事耶和华你们的神，服事他的子民以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对那归耶和华为圣、教训以色列人的利未人说：「你们将圣约柜安放在以色列王大卫儿子所罗门建造的殿里，不必再用肩扛抬。现在要事奉耶和华－你们的神，服事他的民以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the Levites, who instructed all Israel and who had been consecrated to the Lord : "Put the sacred ark in the temple that Solomon son of David king of Israel built. It is not to be carried about on your shoulders. Now serve the Lord your God and his people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel and who were holy to the Lord , "Put the holy ark in the house that Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, built. You need not carry it on your shoulders. Now serve the Lord your God and his people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the Lord: "Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, built. Itshall no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the Lord your God and His people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He issued this order to the Levites, who were to teach all Israel and who had been set apart to serve the Lord : "Put the holy Ark in the Temple that was built by Solomon son of David, the king of Israel. You no longer need to carry it back and forth on your shoulders. Now spend your time serving the Lord your God and his people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He also said to the Levites who taught all Israel and who were holy to the Lord, "Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built; it will not be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the Lord your God and His people Israel.
verses.textEn: He said to the Levites, who instructed all Israel and who had been consecrated to the Lord : "Put the sacred ark in the temple that Solomon son of David king of Israel built. It is not to be carried about on your shoulders. Now serve the Lord your God and his people Israel.

verses.textZh: 你们要按着家族和照着班次，根据以色列王大卫所写的和他儿子所罗门所写的，自己好好预备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要按着家族和照着班次，根据以色列王大卫所写的和他儿子所罗门所写的，自己好好预备。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们应当按着宗族，照着班次，遵以色列王大卫和他儿子所罗门所写的，自己预备。
verses.textEnNiv: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and by his son Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: Prepare yourselves according to your fathers’ houses by your divisions, as prescribed in the writing of David king of Israel and the document of Solomon his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Prepare yourselves according to your fathers’ houses, according to your divisions, following the written instruction of David king of Israel and the written instruction of Solomon his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Report for duty according to the family divisions of your ancestors, following the directions of King David of Israel and the directions of his son Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: Prepare yourselves by your fathers’ households in your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel and according to the writing of his son Solomon.
verses.textEn: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and by his son Solomon.

verses.textZh: 你们要按着你们的亲族这平民的家族的班次，侍立在圣所；每个班次中要有几个利未家族的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要按着你们的亲族这平民的家族的班次，侍立在圣所；每个班次中要有几个利未家族的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 要按着你们的弟兄，这民宗族的班次，站在圣所，每班中要利未宗族的几个人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Stand in the holy place with a group of Levites for each subdivision of the families of your fellow Israelites, the lay people.
verses.textEnEsv: And stand in the Holy Place according to the groupings of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the lay people, and according to the division of the Levites by fathers’ household.
verses.textEnNkjv: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brethren the lay people, and accordingto the division of the father’s house of the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then stand in the sanctuary at the place appointed for your family division and help the families assigned to you as they bring their offerings to the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, stand in the holy place according to the sections of the fathers’ households of your countrymen, the lay people, and according to the Levites, by division of a father’s household.
verses.textEn: "Stand in the holy place with a group of Levites for each subdivision of the families of your fellow Israelites, the lay people.

verses.textZh: 你们要宰逾越节的羊羔，洁净自己，为你们的亲族预备一切，遵守耶和华藉摩西吩咐的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要宰逾越节的羊羔，洁净自己，为你们的亲族预备一切，遵守耶和华藉摩西吩咐的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要宰逾越节的羊羔，洁净自己，为你们的弟兄预备了，好遵守耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves and prepare the lambs for your fellow Israelites, doing what the Lord commanded through Moses."
verses.textEnEsv: And slaughter the Passover lamb, and consecrate yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the word of the Lord by Moses."
verses.textEnNkjv: So slaughter the Passover offerings, consecrate yourselves, and prepare them for your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses."
verses.textEnNlt: Slaughter the Passover lambs, purify yourselves, and prepare to help those who come. Follow all the directions that the Lord gave through Moses."
verses.textEnNasb: Now slaughter the Passover animals, keep one another consecrated, and prepare for your countrymen to act in accordance with the word of the Lord by Moses."
verses.textEn: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves and prepare the lambs for your fellow Israelites, doing what the Lord commanded through Moses."

verses.textZh: 于是约西亚送出绵羊羔和山羊羔共三万只，还有公牛三千头，给所有在场的人民作逾越节的祭牲；这些都是取自王的财产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约西亚送出绵羊羔和山羊羔共三万只，还有公牛三千头，给所有在场的人民作逾越节的祭牲；这些都是取自王的财产。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚从群畜中赐给在那里所有的人民，绵羊羔和山羊羔三万只，牛三千只，作逾越节的祭物；这都是出自王的产业中。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah provided for all the lay people who were there a total of thirty thousand lambs and goats for the Passover offerings, and also three thousand cattle—all from the king’s own possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Josiah contributed to the lay people, as Passover offerings for all who were present, lambs and young goats from the flock to the number of 30,000, and 3,000 bulls; these were from the king’s possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Josiah gave the lay people lambs and young goats from the flock, all for Passover offerings for all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, as well as three thousand cattle; these were from the king’s possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Josiah provided 30,000 lambs and young goats for the people’s Passover offerings, along with 3,000 cattle, all from the king’s own flocks and herds.
verses.textEnNasb: Josiah contributed to the lay people, to all who were present, flocks of lambs and young goats, all for the Passover offerings, numbering thirty thousand, plus three thousand bulls; these were from the king’s property.
verses.textEn: Josiah provided for all the lay people who were there a total of thirty thousand lambs and goats for the Passover offerings, and also three thousand cattle—all from the king’s own possessions.

verses.textZh: 约西亚手下的众领袖也自愿把祭牲送给人民、祭司和利未人；又有神殿的总管希勒家、撒迦利亚和耶歇，也把羔羊二千六百只和公牛三百头，送给祭司作逾越节的祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚手下的众领袖也自愿把祭牲送给人民、祭司和利未人；又有神殿的总管希勒家、撒迦利亚和耶歇，也把羔羊二千六百只和公牛三百头，送给祭司作逾越节的祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚的众首领也乐意将牺牲给百姓和祭司利未人；又有管理神殿的希勒家、撒迦利亚、耶歇将羊羔二千六百只，牛三百只，给祭司作逾越节的祭物。
verses.textEnNiv: His officials also contributed voluntarily to the people and the priests and Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah and Jehiel, the officials in charge of God’s temple, gave the priests twenty-six hundred Passover offerings and three hundred cattle.
verses.textEnEsv: And his officials contributed willingly to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the chief officers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings 2,600 Passover lambs and 300 bulls.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his leaders gave willingly to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred fromtheflock, and three hundred cattle.
verses.textEnNlt: The king’s officials also made willing contributions to the people, priests, and Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the administrators of God’s Temple, gave the priests 2,600 lambs and young goats and 300 cattle as Passover offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: His officers also contributed a voluntary offering to the people, the priests, and the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the officials of the house of God, gave the priests 2,600 from the flocks and three hundred bulls, for the Passover offerings.
verses.textEn: His officials also contributed voluntarily to the people and the priests and Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah and Jehiel, the officials in charge of God’s temple, gave the priests twenty-six hundred Passover offerings and three hundred cattle.

verses.textZh: 利未人的领袖歌楠雅和他的两个兄弟示玛雅和拿坦业，以及哈沙比雅、耶利和约撒拔，也把羊羔五千只和公牛五百头，送给利未人作逾越节的祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人的领袖歌楠雅和他的两个兄弟示玛雅和拿坦业，以及哈沙比雅、耶利和约撒拔，也把羊羔五千只和公牛五百头，送给利未人作逾越节的祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人的族长歌楠雅和他两个兄弟示玛雅、拿坦业，与哈沙比雅、耶利、约撒拔将羊羔五千只，牛五百只，给利未人作逾越节的祭物。
verses.textEnNiv: Also Konaniah along with Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, the leaders of the Levites, provided five thousand Passover offerings and five hundred head of cattle for the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings 5,000 lambs and young goats and 500 bulls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Conaniah, his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave to the Levites for Passover offerings five thousand fromtheflock and five hundred cattle.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levite leaders—Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad—gave 5,000 lambs and young goats and 500 cattle to the Levites for their Passover offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: Conaniah also, and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the officers of the Levites, contributed five thousand from the flocks and five hundred bulls to the Levites for the Passover offerings.
verses.textEn: Also Konaniah along with Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, the leaders of the Levites, provided five thousand Passover offerings and five hundred head of cattle for the Levites.

verses.textZh: 这样，事奉的职务安排好了以后，他们照着王的吩咐，祭司站在自己的岗位，利未人也按着自己的班次侍立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，事奉的职务安排好了以后，他们照着王的吩咐，祭司站在自己的岗位，利未人也按着自己的班次侍立。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，供献的事齐备了。祭司站在自己的地方，利未人按着班次站立，都是照王所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: The service was arranged and the priests stood in their places with the Levites in their divisions as the king had ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: When the service had been prepared for, the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions according to the king’s command.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their places, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the king’s command.
verses.textEnNlt: When everything was ready for the Passover celebration, the priests and the Levites took their places, organized by their divisions, as the king had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood at their positions and the Levites by their divisions according to the king’s command.
verses.textEn: The service was arranged and the priests stood in their places with the Levites in their divisions as the king had ordered.

verses.textZh: 利未人宰了逾越节的羊羔，祭司从他们的手里把血接过来，洒在坛上，利未人剥了祭牲的皮，
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人宰了逾越节的羊羔，祭司从他们的手里把血接过来，洒在坛上，利未人剥了祭牲的皮，
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人宰了逾越节的羊羔，祭司从他们手里接过血来洒在坛上；利未人剥皮，
verses.textEnNiv: The Passover lambs were slaughtered, and the priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them, while the Levites skinned the animals.
verses.textEnEsv: And they slaughtered the Passover lamb, and the priests threw the blood that they received from them while the Levites flayed the sacrifices.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they slaughtered the Passover offerings; and the priests sprinkled theblood with their hands, while the Levites skinned theanimals.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites then slaughtered the Passover lambs and presented the blood to the priests, who sprinkled the blood on the altar while the Levites prepared the animals.
verses.textEnNasb: They slaughtered the Passover animals, and while the priests sprinkled the blood received from their hand, the Levites skinned the animals.
verses.textEn: The Passover lambs were slaughtered, and the priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them, while the Levites skinned the animals.

verses.textZh: 把作燔祭的部分拿去，按着各家族的系别分给众民，使他们可以照着摩西的书上所写的，奉献给耶和华。奉献公牛也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把作燔祭的部分拿去，按着各家族的系别分给众民，使他们可以照着摩西的书上所写的，奉献给耶和华。奉献公牛也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 将燔祭搬来，按着宗族的班次分给众民，好照摩西书上所写的，献给耶和华；献牛也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: They set aside the burnt offerings to give them to the subdivisions of the families of the people to offer to the Lord , as it is written in the Book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set aside the burnt offerings that they might distribute them according to the groupings of the fathers’ houses of the lay people, to offer to the Lord , as it is written in the Book of Moses. And so they did with the bulls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they removed the burnt offerings that they might give them to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the lay people, to offer to the Lord, as itis written in the Book of Moses. And so theydid with the cattle.
verses.textEnNlt: They divided the burnt offerings among the people by their family groups, so they could offer them to the Lord as prescribed in the Book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they removed the burnt offerings so that they might give them to the sections of the fathers’ households of the lay people to present to the Lord, as it is written in the Book of Moses. They did this with the bulls as well.
verses.textEn: They set aside the burnt offerings to give them to the subdivisions of the families of the people to offer to the Lord , as it is written in the Book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

verses.textZh: 他们按照规矩用火烤逾越节的羊羔，其他的圣物用锅、用釜，或用煎盘煮熟，迅速地送给众民；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们按照规矩用火烤逾越节的羊羔，其他的圣物用锅、用釜，或用煎盘煮熟，迅速地送给众民；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们按着常例，用火烤逾越节的羊羔。别的圣物用锅，用釜，用罐煮了，速速地送给众民。
verses.textEnNiv: They roasted the Passover animals over the fire as prescribed, and boiled the holy offerings in pots, caldrons and pans and served them quickly to all the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And they roasted the Passover lamb with fire according to the rule; and they boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the lay people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also they roasted the Passover offerings with fire according to the ordinance; but the other holy offerings they boiled in pots, in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them quickly among all the lay people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they roasted the Passover lambs as prescribed; and they boiled the holy offerings in pots, kettles, and pans, and brought them out quickly so the people could eat them.
verses.textEnNasb: So they roasted the Passover animals on the fire according to the ordinance, and they boiled the holy things in pots, in kettles, and in pans and carried them quickly to all the lay people.
verses.textEn: They roasted the Passover animals over the fire as prescribed, and boiled the holy offerings in pots, caldrons and pans and served them quickly to all the people.

verses.textZh: 然后他们才为自己和祭司预备祭物，因为作祭司的亚伦的子孙忙于献上燔祭和脂肪，直到晚上，利未人才为自己和祭司亚伦的子孙预备祭物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他们才为自己和祭司预备祭物，因为作祭司的亚伦的子孙忙于献上燔祭和脂肪，直到晚上，利未人才为自己和祭司亚伦的子孙预备祭物。
verses.textZhCuv: 然后为自己和祭司预备祭物；因为祭司亚伦的子孙献燔祭和脂油，直到晚上。所以利未人为自己和祭司亚伦的子孙，预备祭物。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, they made preparations for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were sacrificing the burnt offerings and the fat portions until nightfall. So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the Aaronic priests.
verses.textEnEsv: And afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the sons of Aaron, were offering the burnt offerings and the fat parts until night; so the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then afterward they prepared portions for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the sons of Aaron, werebusy in offering burnt offerings and fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared portions for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward the Levites prepared Passover offerings for themselves and for the priests—the descendants of Aaron—because the priests had been busy from morning till night offering the burnt offerings and the fat portions. The Levites took responsibility for all these preparations.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the sons of Aaron, were offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night; so the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEn: After this, they made preparations for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were sacrificing the burnt offerings and the fat portions until nightfall. So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the Aaronic priests.

verses.textZh: 歌唱的亚萨的子孙，照着大卫、亚萨、希幔和王的先见耶杜顿的吩咐，站在自己的岗位上；守门的看守各门，不用离开自己的职务，因为他们的利未亲族为他们预备了祭物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌唱的亚萨的子孙，照着大卫、亚萨、希幔和王的先见耶杜顿的吩咐，站在自己的岗位上；守门的看守各门，不用离开自己的职务，因为他们的利未亲族为他们预备了祭物。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌唱的亚萨之子孙，照着大卫、亚萨、希幔，和王的先见耶杜顿所吩咐的，站在自己的地位上。守门的看守各门，不用离开他们的职事，因为他们的弟兄利未人给他们预备祭物。
verses.textEnNiv: The musicians, the descendants of Asaph, were in the places prescribed by David, Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun the king’s seer. The gatekeepers at each gate did not need to leave their posts, because their fellow Levites made the preparations for them.
verses.textEnEsv: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place according to the command of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at each gate. They did not need to depart from their service, for their brothers the Levites prepared for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their places, according to the command of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer. Also the gatekeepers were at each gate; they did not have to leave their position, because their brethren the Levites prepared portions for them.
verses.textEnNlt: The musicians, descendants of Asaph, were in their assigned places, following the commands that had been given by David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, the king’s seer. The gatekeepers guarded the gates and did not need to leave their posts of duty, for their Passover offerings were prepared for them by their fellow Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were also at their positions according to the command of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers at each gate did not have to leave their service, because their kinsmen the Levites prepared for them.
verses.textEn: The musicians, the descendants of Asaph, were in the places prescribed by David, Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun the king’s seer. The gatekeepers at each gate did not need to leave their posts, because their fellow Levites made the preparations for them.

verses.textZh: 这样，当日一切事奉耶和华的职务都安排好了，就照着约西亚王的吩咐守逾越节，和在耶和华的祭坛上献上燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，当日一切事奉耶和华的职务都安排好了，就照着约西亚王的吩咐守逾越节，和在耶和华的祭坛上献上燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，供奉耶和华的事齐备了，就照约西亚王的吩咐守逾越节，献燔祭在耶和华的坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: So at that time the entire service of the Lord was carried out for the celebration of the Passover and the offering of burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord , as King Josiah had ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the service of the Lord was prepared that day, to keep the Passover and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord , according to the command of King Josiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the service of the Lord was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord, according to the command of King Josiah.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire ceremony for the Lord ’s Passover was completed that day. All the burnt offerings were sacrificed on the altar of the Lord , as King Josiah had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the service of the Lord was prepared on that day to celebrate the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord according to the command of King Josiah.
verses.textEn: So at that time the entire service of the Lord was carried out for the celebration of the Passover and the offering of burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord , as King Josiah had ordered.

verses.textZh: 当时在场的以色列人守逾越节，又守除酵节七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时在场的以色列人守逾越节，又守除酵节七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时在耶路撒冷的以色列人守逾越节，又守除酵节七日。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites who were present celebrated the Passover at that time and observed the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: All the Israelites present in Jerusalem celebrated Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel who were present celebrated the Passover at that time, and the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days.
verses.textEn: The Israelites who were present celebrated the Passover at that time and observed the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days.

verses.textZh: 自从撒母耳先知的日子以来，在以色列中没有守过像这样的逾越节；以色列诸王也都没有守过这样的逾越节，像约西亚、祭司、利未人、犹大众人和在场的以色列人，以及耶路撒冷的居民守的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从撒母耳先知的日子以来，在以色列中没有守过像这样的逾越节；以色列诸王也都没有守过这样的逾越节，像约西亚、祭司、利未人、犹大众人和在场的以色列人，以及耶路撒冷的居民守的。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从先知撒母耳以来，在以色列中没有守过这样的逾越节，以色列诸王也没有守过，像约西亚、祭司、利未人、在那里的犹大人，和以色列人，以及耶路撒冷居民所守的逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: The Passover had not been observed like this in Israel since the days of the prophet Samuel; and none of the kings of Israel had ever celebrated such a Passover as did Josiah, with the priests, the Levites and all Judah and Israel who were there with the people of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: No Passover like it had been kept in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet. None of the kings of Israel had kept such a Passover as was kept by Josiah, and the priests and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: There had been no Passover kept in Israel like that since the days of Samuel the prophet; and none of the kings of Israel had kept such a Passover as Josiah kept, with the priests and the Levites, all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Never since the time of the prophet Samuel had there been such a Passover. None of the kings of Israel had ever kept a Passover as Josiah did, involving all the priests and Levites, all the people of Jerusalem, and people from all over Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: There had not been a Passover celebrated like it in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet; nor had any of the kings of Israel celebrated such a Passover as Josiah did with the priests, the Levites, all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The Passover had not been observed like this in Israel since the days of the prophet Samuel; and none of the kings of Israel had ever celebrated such a Passover as did Josiah, with the priests, the Levites and all Judah and Israel who were there with the people of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 这逾越节是约西亚在位第十八年守的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这逾越节是约西亚在位第十八年守的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这逾越节是约西亚作王十八年守的。
verses.textEnNiv: This Passover was celebrated in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign.
verses.textEnEsv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah this Passover was kept.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah this Passover was kept.
verses.textEnNlt: This Passover was celebrated in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign this Passover was celebrated.
verses.textEn: This Passover was celebrated in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign.

verses.textZh: 约西亚整理好圣殿的一切事以后，埃及王尼哥上来，帮助靠近幼发拉底河的迦基米施；约西亚就出去阻挡他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚整理好圣殿的一切事以后，埃及王尼哥上来，帮助靠近幼发拉底河的迦基米施；约西亚就出去阻挡他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，约西亚修完了殿，有埃及王尼哥上来，要攻击靠近幼发拉底河的迦基米施；约西亚出去抵挡他。
verses.textEnNiv: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Necho king of Egypt went up to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates, and Josiah marched out to meet him in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates, and Josiah went out to meet him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates; and Josiah went out against him.
verses.textEnNlt: After Josiah had finished restoring the Temple, King Neco of Egypt led his army up from Egypt to do battle at Carchemish on the Euphrates River, and Josiah and his army marched out to fight him.
verses.textEnNasb: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Neco king of Egypt came up to wage war at Carchemish on the Euphrates, and Josiah went out to engage him.
verses.textEn: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Necho king of Egypt went up to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates, and Josiah marched out to meet him in battle.

verses.textZh: 尼哥差派使者来见约西亚说："犹大王啊，我和你有甚么关系呢？我现在不是来攻击你，而是要攻击和我交战的那国家；并且神吩咐我要赶快，你不可干预神的事，免得他毁灭你，因为神和我同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼哥差派使者来见约西亚说："犹大王啊，我和你有甚么关系呢？我现在不是来攻击你，而是要攻击和我交战的那国家；并且神吩咐我要赶快，你不可干预神的事，免得他毁灭你，因为神和我同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他差遣使者来见约西亚，说：「犹大王啊，我与你何干？我今日来不是要攻击你，乃是要攻击与我争战之家，并且神吩咐我速行，你不要干预神的事，免得他毁灭你，因为神是与我同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Necho sent messengers to him, saying, "What quarrel is there, king of Judah, between you and me? It is not you I am attacking at this time, but the house with which I am at war. God has told me to hurry; so stop opposing God, who is with me, or he will destroy you."
verses.textEnEsv: But he sent envoys to him, saying, "What have we to do with each other, king of Judah? I am not coming against you this day, but against the house with which I am at war. And God has commanded me to hurry. Cease opposing God, who is with me, lest he destroy you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he sent messengers to him, saying, "What have I to do with you, king of Judah? Ihave not come against you this day, but against the house with which I have war; for God commanded me to make haste. Refrain frommeddlingwith God, who is with me, lest He destroy you."
verses.textEnNlt: But King Neco sent messengers to Josiah with this message: "What do you want with me, king of Judah? I have no quarrel with you today! I am on my way to fight another nation, and God has told me to hurry! Do not interfere with God, who is with me, or he will destroy you."
verses.textEnNasb: But Neco sent messengers to him, saying, " What business do you have with me, King of Judah? I am not coming against you today, but against the house with which I am at war, and God has told me to hurry. For your own sake, stop interfering with God who is with me, so that He does not destroy you."
verses.textEn: But Necho sent messengers to him, saying, "What quarrel is there, king of Judah, between you and me? It is not you I am attacking at this time, but the house with which I am at war. God has told me to hurry; so stop opposing God, who is with me, or he will destroy you."

verses.textZh: 约西亚却不肯离开他，反而改了装要和他作战，不听从神藉尼哥所说的话；于是他去到米吉多平原和尼哥交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚却不肯离开他，反而改了装要和他作战，不听从神藉尼哥所说的话；于是他去到米吉多平原和尼哥交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚却不肯转去离开他，改装要与他打仗，不听从神藉尼哥之口所说的话，便来到米吉多平原争战。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah, however, would not turn away from him, but disguised himself to engage him in battle. He would not listen to what Necho had said at God’s command but went to fight him on the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, Josiah did not turn away from him, but disguised himself in order to fight with him. He did not listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, but came to fight in the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself so that he might fight with him, and did not heed the words of Necho from the mouth of God. So he came to fight in the Valley of Megiddo.
verses.textEnNlt: But Josiah refused to listen to Neco, to whom God had indeed spoken, and he would not turn back. Instead, he disguised himself and led his army into battle on the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Josiah would not turn away from him, but disguised himself in order to fight against him; nor did he listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, but he came to wage war on the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEn: Josiah, however, would not turn away from him, but disguised himself to engage him in battle. He would not listen to what Necho had said at God’s command but went to fight him on the plain of Megiddo.

verses.textZh: 弓箭手射中了约西亚王；王对他的臣仆说："你们把我带走吧，因为我受了重伤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 弓箭手射中了约西亚王；王对他的臣仆说："你们把我带走吧，因为我受了重伤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 弓箭手射中约西亚王。王对他的臣仆说：「我受了重伤，你拉我出阵吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Archers shot King Josiah, and he told his officers, "Take me away; I am badly wounded."
verses.textEnEsv: And the archers shot King Josiah. And the king said to his servants, "Take me away, for I am badly wounded."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the archers shot King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, "Take me away, for I am severely wounded."
verses.textEnNlt: But the enemy archers hit King Josiah with their arrows and wounded him. He cried out to his men, "Take me from the battle, for I am badly wounded!"
verses.textEnNasb: The archers shot King Josiah, and the king said to his servants, "Take me away, for I am badly wounded."
verses.textEn: Archers shot King Josiah, and he told his officers, "Take me away; I am badly wounded."

verses.textZh: 他的臣仆把他从战车上扶下来，放在他的第二辆战车上，把他送回耶路撒冷去，他跟着就死了，埋葬在他列祖的坟墓里。犹大和耶路撒冷的众人都为约西亚哀悼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的臣仆把他从战车上扶下来，放在他的第二辆战车上，把他送回耶路撒冷去，他跟着就死了，埋葬在他列祖的坟墓里。犹大和耶路撒冷的众人都为约西亚哀悼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的臣仆扶他下了战车，上了次车，送他到耶路撒冷，他就死了，葬在他列祖的坟墓里。犹大人和耶路撒冷人都为他悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: So they took him out of his chariot, put him in his other chariot and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died. He was buried in the tombs of his ancestors, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him.
verses.textEnEsv: So his servants took him out of the chariot and carried him in his second chariot and brought him to Jerusalem. And he died and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot and put him in the second chariot that he had, and they brought him to Jerusalem. So he died, and was buried in oneof the tombs of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.textEnNlt: So they lifted Josiah out of his chariot and placed him in another chariot. Then they brought him back to Jerusalem, where he died. He was buried there in the royal cemetery. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him.
verses.textEnNasb: So his servants took him out of the chariot and carried him on the second chariot which he had, and brought him to Jerusalem where he died and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.textEn: So they took him out of his chariot, put him in his other chariot and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died. He was buried in the tombs of his ancestors, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him.

verses.textZh: 耶利米为约西亚作了哀歌；所有歌唱的男女都唱哀歌，哀悼约西亚，直到今日；甚至在以色列中成了定例。这歌记在哀歌书上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米为约西亚作了哀歌；所有歌唱的男女都唱哀歌，哀悼约西亚，直到今日；甚至在以色列中成了定例。这歌记在哀歌书上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米为约西亚作哀歌。所有歌唱的男女也唱哀歌，追悼约西亚，直到今日；而且在以色列中成了定例。这歌载在哀歌书上。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah composed laments for Josiah, and to this day all the male and female singers commemorate Josiah in the laments. These became a tradition in Israel and are written in the Laments.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah also uttered a lament for Josiah; and all the singing men and singing women have spoken of Josiah in their laments to this day. They made these a rule in Israel; behold, they are written in the Laments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jeremiah also lamented for Josiah. And to this day all the singing men and the singing women speak of Josiah in their lamentations. They made it a custom in Israel; and indeed they are written in the Laments.
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet Jeremiah composed funeral songs for Josiah, and to this day choirs still sing these sad songs about his death. These songs of sorrow have become a tradition and are recorded in The Book of Laments.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah chanted a song of mourning for Josiah. And all the male and female singers speak about Josiah in their songs of mourning to this day. And they made them an ordinance in Israel; behold, they are also written in the Lamentations.
verses.textEn: Jeremiah composed laments for Josiah, and to this day all the male and female singers commemorate Josiah in the laments. These became a tradition in Israel and are written in the Laments.

verses.textZh: 约西亚其余的事迹，和他按着耶和华律法上所记而行的善事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚其余的事迹，和他按着耶和华律法上所记而行的善事，
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚其余的事和他遵着耶和华律法上所记而行的善事，
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Josiah’s reign and his acts of devotion in accordance with what is written in the Law of the Lord —
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his good deeds according to what is written in the Law of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his goodness, according to whatwas written in the Law of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events of Josiah’s reign and his acts of devotion (carried out according to what was written in the Law of the Lord ),
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his deeds of devotion as written in the Law of the Lord,
verses.textEn: The other events of Josiah’s reign and his acts of devotion in accordance with what is written in the Law of the Lord —

verses.textZh: 以及他一生的始末，都记在以色列和犹大列王记上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及他一生的始末，都记在以色列和犹大列王记上。
verses.textZhCuv: 并他自始至终所行的，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: all the events, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: and his deeds from first to last, indeed they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: from beginning to end—all are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: and his acts, the first to the last, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEn: all the events, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.textZh: 犹大地的人民选了约西亚的儿子约哈斯，立他在耶路撒冷接续他父亲作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大地的人民选了约西亚的儿子约哈斯，立他在耶路撒冷接续他父亲作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 国民立约西亚的儿子约哈斯在耶路撒冷接续他父作王。
verses.textEnNiv: And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of the land took Josiah’s son Jehoahaz and made him the next king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people of the land took Joahaz the son of Josiah and made him king in place of his father in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.

verses.textZh: 约哈斯登基的时候，是二十三岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共三个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯登基的时候，是二十三岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共三个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.
verses.textEnNasb: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

verses.textZh: 埃及王在耶路撒冷把他废了，又罚犹大地缴纳三千四百公斤银子，三十四公斤金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及王在耶路撒冷把他废了，又罚犹大地缴纳三千四百公斤银子，三十四公斤金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及王在耶路撒冷废了他，又罚犹大国银子一百他连得，金子一他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Egypt deposed him in Jerusalem and laid on the land a tribute of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Egypt deposed him at Jerusalem; and he imposed on the land a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he was deposed by the king of Egypt, who demanded that Judah pay 7,500 pounds of silver and 75 pounds of gold as tribute.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Egypt deposed him in Jerusalem, and imposed a fine on the land of a hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.
verses.textEn: The king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

verses.textZh: 后来埃及王立了约哈斯的兄弟以利雅敬作王，统治犹大和耶路撒冷，又给他改名叫约雅敬；尼哥却把约雅敬的兄弟约哈斯带到埃及去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来埃及王立了约哈斯的兄弟以利雅敬作王，统治犹大和耶路撒冷，又给他改名叫约雅敬；尼哥却把约雅敬的兄弟约哈斯带到埃及去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及王尼哥立约哈斯的哥哥以利雅敬作犹大和耶路撒冷的王，改名叫约雅敬，又将约哈斯带到埃及去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, a brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Necho took Eliakim’s brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Jehoahaz his brother and carried him to Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Egypt made Jehoahaz’s brother Eliakim king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother and carried him off to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Egypt then installed Eliakim, the brother of Jehoahaz, as the next king of Judah and Jerusalem, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. Then Neco took Jehoahaz to Egypt as a prisoner.
verses.textEnNasb: The king of Egypt made Joahaz’s brother Eliakim king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took his brother Joahaz and brought him to Egypt.
verses.textEn: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, a brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Necho took Eliakim’s brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬登基的时候，是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十一年，行耶和华他的神看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬登基的时候，是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十一年，行耶和华他的神看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年，行耶和华－他神眼中看为恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And he did evil in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and he did evil in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.textEn: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上来攻打他，用铜炼锁住他，把他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上来攻打他，用铜炼锁住他，把他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上来攻击他，用铜链锁着他，要将他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked him and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and bound him in chains to take him to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in bronze fetters to carry him off to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to Jerusalem and captured it, and he bound Jehoiakim in bronze chains and led him away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him and bound him with bronze chains to take him to Babylon.
verses.textEn: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked him and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒又把耶和华殿里一部分的器皿带回巴比伦，放在巴比伦他的神庙里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒又把耶和华殿里一部分的器皿带回巴比伦，放在巴比伦他的神庙里。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒又将耶和华殿里的器皿带到巴比伦，放在他神的庙里 。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuchadnezzar also took to Babylon articles from the temple of the Lord and put them in his temple there.
verses.textEnEsv: Nebuchadnezzar also carried part of the vessels of the house of the Lord to Babylon and put them in his palace in Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebuchadnezzar also carried off some of the articles from the house of the Lord to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuchadnezzar also took some of the treasures from the Temple of the Lord , and he placed them in his palace in Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar also brought some of the articles of the house of the Lord to Babylon, and he put them in his temple in Babylon.
verses.textEn: Nebuchadnezzar also took to Babylon articles from the temple of the Lord and put them in his temple there.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬其余的事迹，和他所行可憎的事，以及他的遭遇，都记在以色列和犹大列王记上。他的儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬其余的事迹，和他所行可憎的事，以及他的遭遇，都记在以色列和犹大列王记上。他的儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬其余的事和他所行可憎的事，并他一切的行为，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, the detestable things he did and all that was found against him, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and the abominations that he did, and what was found against him, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, the abominations which he did, and what was found against him, indeed they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. Then Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehoiakim’s reign, including all the evil things he did and everything found against him, are recorded in The Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. Then his son Jehoiachin became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim and the abominations which he committed, and what was found against him, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. And his son Jehoiachin became king in his place.
verses.textEn: The other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, the detestable things he did and all that was found against him, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约雅斤登基的时候，是八岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共三个月零十天，行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅斤登基的时候，是八岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共三个月零十天，行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅斤登基的时候年八岁 ，在耶路撒冷作王三个月零十天，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. And he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. Jehoiachin did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned for three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 过了年，尼布甲尼撒派人去把约雅斤和耶和华殿里的珍贵的器皿，一起带到巴比伦来。他立了约雅斤的叔叔西底家，作犹大和耶路撒冷的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了年，尼布甲尼撒派人去把约雅斤和耶和华殿里的珍贵的器皿，一起带到巴比伦来。他立了约雅斤的叔叔西底家，作犹大和耶路撒冷的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了一年，尼布甲尼撒差遣人将约雅斤和耶和华殿里各样宝贵的器皿带到巴比伦，就立约雅斤的叔叔 西底家作犹大和耶路撒冷的王。
verses.textEnNiv: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him and brought him to Babylon, together with articles of value from the temple of the Lord , and he made Jehoiachin’s uncle, Zedekiah, king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: In the spring of the year King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the precious vessels of the house of the Lord , and made his brother Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the turn of the year King Nebuchadnezzar summoned him and took him to Babylon, with the costly articles from the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah, Jehoiakim’s brother, king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: In the spring of the year King Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon. Many treasures from the Temple of the Lord were also taken to Babylon at that time. And Nebuchadnezzar installed Jehoiachin’s uncle, Zedekiah, as the next king in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: At the turn of the year King Nebuchadnezzar sent men and had him brought to Babylon with the valuable articles of the house of the Lord; and he made his relative Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him and brought him to Babylon, together with articles of value from the temple of the Lord , and he made Jehoiachin’s uncle, Zedekiah, king over Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 西底家登基的时候，是二十一岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十一年，
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家登基的时候，是二十一岁；他在耶路撒冷作王共十一年，
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年，
verses.textEnNiv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
verses.textEnEsv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
verses.textEnNasb: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华他的神看为恶的事；耶利米先知奉耶和华的命令警戒他，他仍不在耶利米面前谦卑下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华他的神看为恶的事；耶利米先知奉耶和华的命令警戒他，他仍不在耶利米面前谦卑下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 行耶和华－他神眼中看为恶的事。先知耶利米以耶和华的话劝他，他仍不在耶利米面前自卑。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord his God. He did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke from the mouth of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He did evil in the sight of the Lord his God, and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, whospoke from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But Zedekiah did what was evil in the sight of the Lord his God, and he refused to humble himself when the prophet Jeremiah spoke to him directly from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord his God; he did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet who spoke for the Lord.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒王曾经使他指着神起誓，他还是背叛了尼布甲尼撒；他顽固执拗，不肯归向耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒王曾经使他指着神起誓，他还是背叛了尼布甲尼撒；他顽固执拗，不肯归向耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒曾使他指着神起誓，他却背叛，强项硬心，不归服耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him take an oath in God’s name. He became stiff-necked and hardened his heart and would not turn to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. He stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear anoath by God; but he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, even though he had taken an oath of loyalty in God’s name. Zedekiah was a hard and stubborn man, refusing to turn to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear allegiance by God. But he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEn: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him take an oath in God’s name. He became stiff-necked and hardened his heart and would not turn to the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 此外，所有的祭司长和人民也都大大地得罪神，随从列国所行一切可憎的事；他们污秽了耶和华在耶路撒冷分别为圣的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，所有的祭司长和人民也都大大地得罪神，随从列国所行一切可憎的事；他们污秽了耶和华在耶路撒冷分别为圣的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 众祭司长和百姓也大大犯罪，效法外邦人一切可憎的事，污秽耶和华在耶路撒冷分别为圣的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people became more and more unfaithful, following all the detestable practices of the nations and defiling the temple of the Lord , which he had consecrated in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: All the officers of the priests and the people likewise were exceedingly unfaithful, following all the abominations of the nations. And they polluted the house of the Lord that he had made holy in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover all the leaders of the priests and the people transgressed more and more, according to all the abominations of the nations, and defiled the house of the Lord which He had consecrated in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Likewise, all the leaders of the priests and the people became more and more unfaithful. They followed all the pagan practices of the surrounding nations, desecrating the Temple of the Lord that had been consecrated in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, all the officials of the priests and the people were very unfaithful, following all the abominations of the nations; and they defiled the house of the Lord which He had sanctified in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people became more and more unfaithful, following all the detestable practices of the nations and defiling the temple of the Lord , which he had consecrated in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 耶和华他们列祖的神，因为爱惜自己的子民和居所，就常常差派使者警戒他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华他们列祖的神，因为爱惜自己的子民和居所，就常常差派使者警戒他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－他们列祖的神因为爱惜自己的民和他的居所，从早起来差遣使者去警戒他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord , the God of their ancestors, sent word to them through his messengers again and again, because he had pity on his people and on his dwelling place.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord , the God of their fathers, sent persistently to them by his messengers, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God of their fathers sent warnings to them by His messengers, rising up early and sending them, because He had compassion on His people and on His dwelling place.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord , the God of their ancestors, repeatedly sent his prophets to warn them, for he had compassion on his people and his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord, the God of their fathers, sent word to them again and again by His messengers, because He had compassion on His people and on His dwelling place;
verses.textEn: The Lord , the God of their ancestors, sent word to them through his messengers again and again, because he had pity on his people and on his dwelling place.

verses.textZh: 他们却戏弄神的使者，藐视他的话，讥诮他的先知，以致耶和华的忿怒临到他的子民身上，直到无法挽救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却戏弄神的使者，藐视他的话，讥诮他的先知，以致耶和华的忿怒临到他的子民身上，直到无法挽救。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却嘻笑神的使者，藐视他的言语，讥诮他的先知，以致耶和华的忿怒向他的百姓发作，无法可救。
verses.textEnNiv: But they mocked God’s messengers, despised his words and scoffed at his prophets until the wrath of the Lord was aroused against his people and there was no remedy.
verses.textEnEsv: But they kept mocking the messengers of God, despising his words and scoffing at his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord rose against his people, until there was no remedy.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they mocked the messengers of God, despised His words, and scoffed at His prophets, until the wrath of the Lord arose against His people, till therewas no remedy.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people mocked these messengers of God and despised their words. They scoffed at the prophets until the Lord ’s anger could no longer be restrained and nothing could be done.
verses.textEnNasb: but they continually mocked the messengers of God, despised His words, and scoffed at His prophets, until the wrath of the Lord rose against His people, until there was no remedy.
verses.textEn: But they mocked God’s messengers, despised his words and scoffed at his prophets until the wrath of the Lord was aroused against his people and there was no remedy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使迦勒底人的王上来攻打他们，在他们的圣殿里用刀杀了他们的壮丁，少男和少女以及年老衰弱的，他们都不怜惜；耶和华把所有这些人都交在迦勒底王的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使迦勒底人的王上来攻打他们，在他们的圣殿里用刀杀了他们的壮丁，少男和少女以及年老衰弱的，他们都不怜惜；耶和华把所有这些人都交在迦勒底王的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华使迦勒底人的王来攻击他们，在他们圣殿里用刀杀了他们的壮丁，不怜恤他们的少男处女、老人白叟。耶和华将他们都交在迦勒底王手里。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought up against them the king of the Babylonians, who killed their young men with the sword in the sanctuary, and did not spare young men or young women, the elderly or the infirm. God gave them all into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or aged. He gave them all into his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He brought against them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, on the aged or the weak; He gave them all into his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord brought the king of Babylon against them. The Babylonians killed Judah’s young men, even chasing after them into the Temple. They had no pity on the people, killing both young men and young women, the old and the infirm. God handed all of them over to Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNasb: So He brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or frail; He handed them all over to him.
verses.textEn: He brought up against them the king of the Babylonians, who killed their young men with the sword in the sanctuary, and did not spare young men or young women, the elderly or the infirm. God gave them all into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.textZh: 迦勒底王把神殿里所有的器皿，无论大小，和耶和华殿里的财宝，以及王和众领袖的财宝，都带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底王把神殿里所有的器皿，无论大小，和耶和华殿里的财宝，以及王和众领袖的财宝，都带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底王将神殿里的大小器皿与耶和华殿里的财宝，并王和众首领的财宝，都带到巴比伦去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He carried to Babylon all the articles from the temple of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the Lord ’s temple and the treasures of the king and his officials.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the Lord , and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the articles from the house of God, great and small, the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king and of his leaders, all these he took to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: The king took home to Babylon all the articles, large and small, used in the Temple of God, and the treasures from both the Lord ’s Temple and from the palace of the king and his officials.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought all the articles of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king and his officers, to Babylon.
verses.textEn: He carried to Babylon all the articles from the temple of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the Lord ’s temple and the treasures of the king and his officials.

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人烧了神的殿，拆毁了耶路撒冷的城墙，用火烧了城里所有的宫殿，又毁坏了城里一切珍贵的器皿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人烧了神的殿，拆毁了耶路撒冷的城墙，用火烧了城里所有的宫殿，又毁坏了城里一切珍贵的器皿。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人焚烧神的殿，拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，用火烧了城里的宫殿，毁坏了城里宝贵的器皿。
verses.textEnNiv: They set fire to God’s temple and broke down the wall of Jerusalem; they burned all the palaces and destroyed everything of value there.
verses.textEnEsv: And they burned the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem and burned all its palaces with fire and destroyed all its precious vessels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they burned the house of God, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all its precious possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: Then his army burned the Temple of God, tore down the walls of Jerusalem, burned all the palaces, and completely destroyed everything of value.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they burned the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burned all its fortified buildings with fire and destroyed all its valuable articles.
verses.textEn: They set fire to God’s temple and broke down the wall of Jerusalem; they burned all the palaces and destroyed everything of value there.

verses.textZh: 脱离刀剑的人，迦勒底王都把他们掳到巴比伦去，作他和他的子孙的奴仆，直到波斯国兴起的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 脱离刀剑的人，迦勒底王都把他们掳到巴比伦去，作他和他的子孙的奴仆，直到波斯国兴起的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡脱离刀剑的，迦勒底王都掳到巴比伦去，作他和他子孙的仆婢，直到波斯国兴起来。
verses.textEnNiv: He carried into exile to Babylon the remnant, who escaped from the sword, and they became servants to him and his successors until the kingdom of Persia came to power.
verses.textEnEsv: He took into exile in Babylon those who had escaped from the sword, and they became servants to him and to his sons until the establishment of the kingdom of Persia,
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who escaped from the sword he carried away to Babylon, where they became servants to him and his sons until the rule of the kingdom of Persia,
verses.textEnNlt: The few who survived were taken as exiles to Babylon, and they became servants to the king and his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power.
verses.textEnNasb: He took into exile those who had escaped from the sword to Babylon; and they were servants to him and to his sons until the rule of the kingdom of Persia,
verses.textEn: He carried into exile to Babylon the remnant, who escaped from the sword, and they became servants to him and his successors until the kingdom of Persia came to power.

verses.textZh: 这样，就应验了耶和华藉耶利米所说的话：直到这地享满了安息，因为这地在荒凉的日子，就享安息，直到满了七十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，就应验了耶和华藉耶利米所说的话：直到这地享满了安息，因为这地在荒凉的日子，就享安息，直到满了七十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就应验耶和华藉耶利米口所说的话：地享受安息；因为地土荒凉便守安息，直满了七十年。
verses.textEnNiv: The land enjoyed its sabbath rests; all the time of its desolation it rested, until the seventy years were completed in fulfillment of the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah.
verses.textEnEsv: to fulfill the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. All the days that it lay desolate it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.
verses.textEnNkjv: to fulfill the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her Sabbaths. As long as she lay desolate she kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.
verses.textEnNlt: So the message of the Lord spoken through Jeremiah was fulfilled. The land finally enjoyed its Sabbath rest, lying desolate until the seventy years were fulfilled, just as the prophet had said.
verses.textEnNasb: to fulfill the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. All the days of its desolation it kept the Sabbath until seventy years were complete.
verses.textEn: The land enjoyed its sabbath rests; all the time of its desolation it rested, until the seventy years were completed in fulfillment of the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah.

verses.textZh: 波斯王古列元年，耶和华为要应验他藉耶利米所说的话，就感动波斯王古列的心，使他通告全国，并且下诏书说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 波斯王古列元年，耶和华为要应验他藉耶利米所说的话，就感动波斯王古列的心，使他通告全国，并且下诏书说：
verses.textZhCuv: 波斯王塞鲁士元年，耶和华为要应验藉耶利米口所说的话，就激动波斯王塞鲁士的心，使他下诏通告全国，说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah, the Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation throughout his realm and also to put it in writing:
verses.textEnEsv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom and also put it in writing:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and also putit in writing, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: In the first year of King Cyrus of Persia, the Lord fulfilled the prophecy he had given through Jeremiah. He stirred the heart of Cyrus to put this proclamation in writing and to send it throughout his kingdom:
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia—in order to fulfill the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah—the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia so that he sent a proclamation throughout his kingdom, and also put it in writing, saying,
verses.textEn: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah, the Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation throughout his realm and also to put it in writing:

verses.textZh: "波斯王古列这样说：‘耶和华天上的神已经把地上万国赐给我。他指派我在犹大的耶路撒冷为他建造殿宇。你们中间凡是他的子民，都可以上去；愿耶和华他的神和他同在！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "波斯王古列这样说：‘耶和华天上的神已经把地上万国赐给我。他指派我在犹大的耶路撒冷为他建造殿宇。你们中间凡是他的子民，都可以上去；愿耶和华他的神和他同在！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「波斯王塞鲁士如此说：耶和华－天上的神已将天下万国赐给我，又嘱咐我在犹大的耶路撒冷为他建造殿宇。你们中间凡作他子民的，可以上去，愿耶和华－他的神与他同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: " ‘The Lord , the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and he has appointed me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in Judah. Any of his people among you may go up, and may the Lord their God be with them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, ‘The Lord , the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever is among you of all his people, may the Lord his God be with him. Let him go up.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth the Lord God of heaven has given me. And He has commanded me to build Him a house at Jerusalem which is in Judah. Who is among you of all His people? May the Lord his God be with him, and let him go up!
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what King Cyrus of Persia says: "The Lord , the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. He has appointed me to build him a Temple at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Any of you who are his people may go there for this task. And may the Lord your God be with you!"
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The Lord, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and He has appointed me to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all His people, may the Lord his God be with him; go up then!’ "
verses.textEn: "This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: " ‘The Lord , the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and he has appointed me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in Judah. Any of his people among you may go up, and may the Lord their God be with them.’ "
